    select 1
    from payments p
    where p.order_id = s.order_id

  and not exists (
    select *
    from orders o

      and o.order_date >= '2024-10-03'
)
order by id desc
limit 10

```python
    df_shipments.alias("s")
    .join(
        df_payments.alias("p"),

        & (F.col("p.paid_at") <= F.col("s.shipped_date")),
```

sql:
with base as (
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        datediff(end_date, start_date) as days_start_date_to_end_date,
        datediff(current_date(), end_date) / 30 as months_since_end_date
    from subscriptions
    where start_date >= to_date('2023-07-14')
),
latest as (
    select *
    from (
        select *, rank() over (partition by status order by monthly_fee desc) as row_num
        from base
    ) t
    where row_num = 1
),
metrics as (
    select
        *,
        sum(months_since_end_date) over w_recent as running_sum_months_since_end_date,
        max(months_since_end_date) over w_recent as running_max_months_since_end_date,
        avg(months_since_end_date) over w_recent as running_avg_months_since_end_date,
        min(months_since_end_date) over w_recent as running_min_months_since_end_date,
        avg(months_since_end_date) over (partition by year(start_date)) as start_date_year_avg_months_since_end_date
    from latest
    window w_recent as (partition by status, plan order by row_num asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
enriched as (
    select
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.days_start_date_to_end_date,
        s.months_since_end_date,
        s.row_num,
        s.running_sum_months_since_end_date,
        s.running_max_months_since_end_date,
        s.running_avg_months_since_end_date,
        s.start_date_year_avg_months_since_end_date,
        c.age,
        c.city,
        c.country
    from metrics s
    join customers c
        on s.customer_id = c.id
    where c.is_active = true
),
cleaned as (
    select *, floor(age) as age_whole
    from enriched
    where customer_id is not null
      and country is distinct from 'JP'
),
enriched_subscriptions as (
    select e.*, c.email
    from cleaned e
    join customers c
        on e.customer_id = c.id
),
enriched_subscriptions_2 as (
    select
        *,
        lead(running_max_months_since_end_date) over (partition by country order by running_sum_months_since_end_date asc, id asc) as next_running_max_months_since_end_date,
        lag(days_start_date_to_end_date) over (partition by country order by running_sum_months_since_end_date asc, id asc) as prev_days_start_date_to_end_date,
        row_number() over (partition by country order by running_sum_months_since_end_date asc, id asc) as seq_no,
        cume_dist() over (partition by customer_id, country order by days_start_date_to_end_date desc nulls last) as days_start_date_to_end_date_cume_dist
    from enriched_subscriptions
),
totals as (
    select
        case when seq_no >= 9 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as seq_no_tier,
        customer_id,
        approx_percentile(months_since_end_date, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as months_since_end_date_quartiles,
        round(sum(running_avg_months_since_end_date) / nullif(count(case when city = 'Berlin' then 1 end), 0), 2) as running_avg_months_since_end_date_per_berlin,
        approx_percentile(age_whole, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as age_whole_quartiles,
        size(collect_set(country)) as num_countries,
        avg(age) filter (where country = 'US') as us_avg_age,
        round(sum(age_whole) / nullif(count(case when city = 'London' then 1 end), 0), 2) as age_whole_per_london
    from enriched_subscriptions_2
    group by cube (case when seq_no >= 9 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end, customer_id)
)
select
    seq_no_tier,
    running_avg_months_since_end_date_per_berlin,
    age_whole_quartiles,
    us_avg_age,
    age_whole_per_london
from totals
order by running_avg_months_since_end_date_per_berlin asc nulls last
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("status", "plan").orderBy("row_num", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("start_date"))
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("running_sum_months_since_end_date", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "country").orderBy(F.col("days_start_date_to_end_date").desc_nulls_last())

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("start_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-07-14")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        F.datediff("end_date", "start_date").alias("days_start_date_to_end_date"),
        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "end_date") / 30).alias("months_since_end_date"),
    )
)

latest = (
    base
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("months_since_end_date").over(w_recent).alias("running_sum_months_since_end_date"),
        F.max("months_since_end_date").over(w_recent).alias("running_max_months_since_end_date"),
        F.avg("months_since_end_date").over(w_recent).alias("running_avg_months_since_end_date"),
        F.min("months_since_end_date").over(w_recent).alias("running_min_months_since_end_date"),
        F.avg("months_since_end_date").over(w3).alias("start_date_year_avg_months_since_end_date"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("c.is_active"))
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.days_start_date_to_end_date",
        "s.months_since_end_date",
        "s.row_num",
        "s.running_sum_months_since_end_date",
        "s.running_max_months_since_end_date",
        "s.running_avg_months_since_end_date",
        "s.start_date_year_avg_months_since_end_date",
        F.col("c.age"),
        F.col("c.city"),
        F.col("c.country"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & (~F.col("country").eqNullSafe(F.lit("JP"))))
    .withColumn("age_whole", F.floor("age"))
)

enriched_subscriptions = (
    cleaned
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "inner")
    .select("e.*", F.col("c.email"))
)

enriched_subscriptions_2 = (
    enriched_subscriptions
    .withColumn("next_running_max_months_since_end_date", F.lead("running_max_months_since_end_date").over(w4))
    .withColumn("prev_days_start_date_to_end_date", F.lag("days_start_date_to_end_date").over(w4))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .withColumn("days_start_date_to_end_date_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w5))
)

totals = (
    enriched_subscriptions_2
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("seq_no") >= 9, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("seq_no_tier"),
        "customer_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("months_since_end_date", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("months_since_end_date_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.sum("running_avg_months_since_end_date") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Berlin", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("running_avg_months_since_end_date_per_berlin"),
        F.percentile_approx("age_whole", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("age_whole_quartiles"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("country")).alias("num_countries"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("country") == "US", F.col("age"))).alias("us_avg_age"),
        F.round(F.sum("age_whole") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "London", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("age_whole_per_london"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "seq_no_tier",
        "running_avg_months_since_end_date_per_berlin",
        "age_whole_quartiles",
        "us_avg_age",
        "age_whole_per_london",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("running_avg_months_since_end_date_per_berlin").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

sql:
WITH not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM accounts s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions c
            WHERE c.account_id = s.id
              AND TO_DATE(c.txn_time) < '2024-05-04'
        )
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT id, status
    FROM not_flagged
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY opened_date NULLS LAST) = 1
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(status, 'unassigned') AS status_filled,
        COALESCE(status, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_status
    FROM deduped
    WHERE status NOT IN ('FROZEN', 'OPEN')
),
not_flagged_accounts AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions x
            WHERE x.account_id = s.id
              AND x.is_flagged = TRUE
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    status,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS num_status,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'OPEN' THEN 1 END) AS open_count
FROM not_flagged_accounts
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY num_status NULLS FIRST;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("opened_date").asc_nulls_last())

not_flagged = (
    df_accounts
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.to_date(F.col("c.txn_time")) < "2024-05-04"), "left_anti")
)

deduped = (
    not_flagged
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select("id", "status")
)

filtered = (
    deduped
    .filter(~F.col("status").isin(["FROZEN", "OPEN"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("status", F.lit("unassigned")).alias("status_filled"),
        F.coalesce("status", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_status"),
    )
)

not_flagged_accounts = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("x"), (F.col("x.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.is_flagged")), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    not_flagged_accounts
    .groupBy("status")
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "OPEN", 1)).alias("open_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("num_status").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        CONCAT_WS('/', country, city) country_city_key
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
      AND supplier_name IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city, country ORDER BY rating, id) next_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, country ORDER BY rating, id) event_seq
    FROM filtered
    WHERE city = 'Bangkok'
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.category IN ('Books', 'Fashion')
        )
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id, city
    FROM eligible
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id, city
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE supplier_name LIKE '%Euro%'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM eligible s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.city = k.city
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    country,
    ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(next_rating, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS next_rating_quartiles,
    SUM(event_seq) FILTER (WHERE country = 'SG') AS sg_total_event_seq,
    SUM(next_rating) FILTER (WHERE country = 'JP') AS jp_total_next_rating,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows
FROM reconciled
GROUP BY country
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy("rating", "id")

filtered = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull() & F.col("supplier_name").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "supplier_name",
        "country",
        "city",
        "rating",
        F.concat_ws("/", "country", "city").alias("country_city_key"),
    )
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("city") == "Bangkok")
    .withColumn("next_rating", F.lead("rating").over(w))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w))
)

eligible = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.category").isin(["Books", "Fashion"])), "left_anti")
)

matched_keys = (
    eligible
    .select("id", "city")
    .intersectAll(
        df_suppliers
        .filter(F.col("supplier_name").like("%Euro%"))
        .select("id", "city")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    eligible
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .groupBy("country")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("rating"), 2).alias("avg_rating"),
        F.percentile_approx("next_rating", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("next_rating_quartiles"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("country") == "SG", F.col("event_seq"))).alias("sg_total_event_seq"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("country") == "JP", F.col("next_rating"))).alias("jp_total_next_rating"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
    )
)
```

sql:
with base as (
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        round(datediff(delivered_date, shipped_date) / 30, 1) as months_shipped_date_to_delivered_date,
        concat_ws('-', status, carrier) as status_carrier_key,
        coalesce(carrier, 'OTHER') as carrier_clean
    from shipments
    where shipped_date > date '2023-09-05'
      and carrier is not null
),
with_dims as (
    select
        src.id,
        src.order_id,
        src.carrier,
        src.shipped_date,
        src.delivered_date,
        src.cost,
        src.carrier_clean,
        b.discount
    from base src
    join orders b
        on src.order_id = b.id
),
cleaned as (
    select
        *,
        date_add(delivered_date, 2) as delivered_date_plus_2d,
        case when discount >= 0.36 then 'High' when discount >= 0.08 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end as discount_level,
        coalesce(carrier, 'N/A') as resolved_carrier
    from with_dims
    where delivered_date > date '2023-05-26'
      and order_id is not null
),
with_dims_shipments as (
    select
        src.*,
        d.status,
        d.amount,
        d.channel
    from cleaned src
    join orders d
        on src.order_id = d.id
),
deduped as (
    select *
    from with_dims_shipments
    qualify row_number() over (partition by status order by amount desc, id) = 1
)
select
    date_trunc('year', shipped_date) as year_start,
    round(sum(cost) / nullif(count(case when status = 'COMPLETED' then 1 end), 0), 2) as cost_per_completed,
    count(*) filter (where channel = 'mobile') as mobile_rows,
    approx_percentile(discount, 0.5) as discount_p50,
    count(distinct carrier) as distinct_carriers
from deduped
group by date_trunc('year', shipped_date)
having discount_p50 >= 0
order by cost_per_completed desc;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")

base = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("shipped_date") > F.lit("2023-09-05").cast("date")) & F.col("carrier").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.round((F.datediff("delivered_date", "shipped_date") / 30), 1).alias("months_shipped_date_to_delivered_date"),
        F.concat_ws("-", "status", "carrier").alias("status_carrier_key"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("carrier_clean"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.order_id",
        "src.carrier",
        "src.shipped_date",
        "src.delivered_date",
        "src.cost",
        "src.carrier_clean",
        F.col("b.discount"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    with_dims
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.lit("2023-05-26").cast("date")) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("delivered_date_plus_2d", F.date_add("delivered_date", 2))
    .withColumn("discount_level", F.when(F.col("discount") >= 0.36, "High").when(F.col("discount") >= 0.08, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("resolved_carrier", F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("N/A")))
)

with_dims_shipments = (
    cleaned
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("d.status"), F.col("d.amount"), F.col("d.channel"))
)

deduped = (
    with_dims_shipments
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

result = (
    deduped
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("year", "shipped_date").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("cost") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "COMPLETED", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("cost_per_completed"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", 1)).alias("mobile_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("discount", 0.5).alias("discount_p50"),
        F.countDistinct("carrier").alias("distinct_carriers"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("discount_p50") >= 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("cost_per_completed").desc())
)
```

sql:
WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) x AS attr_key, v
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        v,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key, host ORDER BY latency_ms DESC NULLS LAST) AS latency_ms_cume_dist,
        COUNT(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(log_ts), host ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS latency_ms_count_15m,
        AVG(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY host, attr_key) AS host_avg_status_code
    FROM lines
    WHERE latency_ms >= 1145
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(host, 1, 2) AS host_prefix,
        CAST(status_code AS STRING) AS status_code_str
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE latency_ms_count_15m BETWEEN 7 AND 12
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CEIL(latency_ms_cume_dist) AS latency_ms_cume_dist_whole
    FROM filtered
    WHERE status_code = 278
),
filtered_app_logs AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN latency_ms >= 2089 THEN 'High' WHEN latency_ms >= 872 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS latency_ms_tier,
        ROUND(latency_ms_count_15m * 0.85, 2) AS latency_ms_count_15m_adjusted
    FROM valid
    WHERE latency_ms_count_15m BETWEEN 5 AND 9
)
SELECT
    id,
    latency_ms,
    v,
    latency_ms_cume_dist,
    latency_ms_count_15m,
    host_avg_status_code,
    host_prefix,
    status_code_str,
    latency_ms_cume_dist_whole
FROM filtered_app_logs
ORDER BY id DESC NULLS FIRST;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("attr_key", "host").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("log_ts"), "host").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("host", "attr_key")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("attr_key", "v"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms") >= 1145)
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "v",
        F.cume_dist().over(w).alias("latency_ms_cume_dist"),
        F.count("latency_ms").over(w2).alias("latency_ms_count_15m"),
        F.avg("status_code").over(w3).alias("host_avg_status_code"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms_count_15m").between(7, 12))
    .withColumn("host_prefix", F.substring("host", 1, 2))
    .withColumn("status_code_str", F.col("status_code").cast("string"))
)

valid = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("status_code") == 278)
    .select("*", F.ceil("latency_ms_cume_dist").alias("latency_ms_cume_dist_whole"))
)

filtered_app_logs = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms_count_15m").between(5, 9))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_tier", F.when(F.col("latency_ms") >= 2089, "High").when(F.col("latency_ms") >= 872, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_count_15m_adjusted", F.round((F.col("latency_ms_count_15m") * 0.85), 2))
)

result = (
    filtered_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "latency_ms",
        "v",
        "latency_ms_cume_dist",
        "latency_ms_count_15m",
        "host_avg_status_code",
        "host_prefix",
        "status_code_str",
        "latency_ms_cume_dist_whole",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

sql:
with remaining_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select store_id
    from orders
    intersect
    select store_id
    from orders
    where shipping_fee > 28
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from orders s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.store_id = k.store_id
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    date_trunc('year', order_date) as year_start,
    approx_percentile(discount, 0.9) as discount_p90,
    percentile_approx(amount, 0.5) as amount_p50
from kept_rows
group by date_trunc('year', order_date)
order by amount_p50 desc;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

remaining_keys = (
    df_orders
    .select("store_id")
    .intersect(
        df_orders
        .filter(F.col("shipping_fee") > 28)
        .select("store_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    df_orders
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("year", "order_date").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("discount", 0.9).alias("discount_p90"),
        F.percentile_approx("amount", 0.5).alias("amount_p50"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("amount_p50").desc())
)
```

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        TRIM(brand) AS clean_brand,
        LOWER(brand) AS brand_lower
    FROM products
    WHERE launch_date >= TO_DATE('2023-04-04')
      AND cost >= 640
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        s.supplier_name,
        s.city,
        s.rating
    FROM valid src
    LEFT JOIN suppliers s
        ON src.supplier_id = s.id
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id) AS supplier_id_sum_rating,
        ROUND(price / SUM(price) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id), 4) AS price_share
    FROM with_dims
),
metrics_products AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(supplier_id_sum_rating) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(launch_date), city ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_supplier_id_sum_rating,
        AVG(price_share) OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS price_share_avg_3,
        AVG(cost) OVER w_grp AS cost_avg_6,
        AVG(price) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY supplier_id_sum_rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS price_avg_3,
        ROUND(price / SUM(price) OVER (PARTITION BY brand), 4) AS price_share_2
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY supplier_id ORDER BY price, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        category,
        brand,
        cost,
        launch_date,
        tags,
        supplier_name,
        city,
        rating,
        price_share,
        last_known_supplier_id_sum_rating,
        price_share_avg_3,
        cost_avg_6,
        price_avg_3,
        price_share_2,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), launch_date) AS days_since_launch_date,
        CAST(stock_qty AS DOUBLE) AS stock_qty_num
    FROM metrics_products
    WHERE launch_date > DATE '2023-03-06'
      AND city IS DISTINCT FROM 'Tokyo'
)
SELECT
    id,
    product_name,
    category,
    brand,
    cost,
    tags,
    supplier_name,
    city,
    rating,
    CASE WHEN supplier_name RLIKE '^(EuroGoods GmbH|Tokyo Traders)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'GROUP_B' END AS supplier_name_zone
FROM base

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("supplier_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("launch_date"), "city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("supplier_id").orderBy("price", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("supplier_id_sum_rating", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("brand")

valid = (
    df_products
    .filter((F.col("launch_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-04-04"))) & (F.col("cost") >= 640))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.trim("brand").alias("clean_brand"),
        F.lower("brand").alias("brand_lower"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    valid
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("s"), F.col("src.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("s.supplier_name"), F.col("s.city"), F.col("s.rating"))
)

metrics = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("rating").over(w).alias("supplier_id_sum_rating"),
        F.round((F.col("price") / F.sum("price").over(w)), 4).alias("price_share"),
    )
)

metrics_products = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("supplier_id_sum_rating", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_supplier_id_sum_rating"),
        F.avg("price_share").over(w3).alias("price_share_avg_3"),
        F.avg("cost").over(w_grp).alias("cost_avg_6"),
        F.avg("price").over(w5).alias("price_avg_3"),
        F.round((F.col("price") / F.sum("price").over(w6)), 4).alias("price_share_2"),
    )
)

base = (
    metrics_products
    .filter((F.col("launch_date") > F.lit("2023-03-06").cast("date")) & (~F.col("city").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Tokyo"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_name",
        "category",
        "brand",
        "cost",
        "launch_date",
        "tags",
        "supplier_name",
        "city",
        "rating",
        "price_share",
        "last_known_supplier_id_sum_rating",
        "price_share_avg_3",
        "cost_avg_6",
        "price_avg_3",
        "price_share_2",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "launch_date").alias("days_since_launch_date"),
        F.col("stock_qty").cast("double").alias("stock_qty_num"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_name",
        "category",
        "brand",
        "cost",
        "tags",
        "supplier_name",
        "city",
        "rating",
        F.when(F.col("supplier_name").rlike("^(EuroGoods GmbH|Tokyo Traders)$"), "EXTENDED").otherwise("GROUP_B").alias("supplier_name_zone"),
    )
)
```

WITH enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY price) AS price_dense_rank,
        LEAD(cost, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id ORDER BY launch_date, id) AS next_cost,
        STDDEV_SAMP(stock_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY category, supplier_id) AS category_stddev_samp_stock_qty,
        SUM(price) OVER (ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', launch_date), brand ORDER BY stock_qty DESC, id) AS event_seq
    FROM products
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        price,
        cost,
        stock_qty,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        next_cost,
        running_price,
        CAST(category_stddev_samp_stock_qty AS DOUBLE) AS category_stddev_samp_stock_qty_num
    FROM enriched
    WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2023-08-31'
),
base_products AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        price,
        cost,
        stock_qty,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        running_price,
        category_stddev_samp_stock_qty_num,
        ROUND(category_stddev_samp_stock_qty_num * 1.15, 2) AS category_stddev_samp_stock_qty_num_scaled
    FROM base
    WHERE stock_qty = 338
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base_products s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items x
            WHERE x.product_id = s.id
              AND x.product_id IN (6, 33, 37)
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    supplier_id,
    CASE WHEN category_stddev_samp_stock_qty_num_scaled >= 68 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS category_stddev_samp_stock_qty_num_scaled_tier,
    BIT_OR(stock_qty) AS stock_qty_bit_or,
    CORR(price, stock_qty) AS corr_price_stock_qty,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid
FROM eligible
GROUP BY ROLLUP (supplier_id, CASE WHEN category_stddev_samp_stock_qty_num_scaled >= 68 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END)
ORDER BY corr_price_stock_qty

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("price")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("supplier_id").orderBy("launch_date", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("category", "supplier_id")
w4 = Window.orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "launch_date"), "brand").orderBy(F.col("stock_qty").desc(), "id")

enriched = (
    df_products
    .withColumn("price_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w))
    .withColumn("next_cost", F.lead("cost", 1, 0).over(w2))
    .withColumn("category_stddev_samp_stock_qty", F.stddev_samp("stock_qty").over(w3))
    .withColumn("running_price", F.sum("price").over(w4))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w5))
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("launch_date") >= F.lit("2023-08-31").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "category",
        "price",
        "cost",
        "stock_qty",
        "tags",
        "supplier_id",
        "next_cost",
        "running_price",
        F.col("category_stddev_samp_stock_qty").cast("double").alias("category_stddev_samp_stock_qty_num"),
    )
)

base_products = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("stock_qty") == 338)
    .select(
        "id",
        "category",
        "price",
        "cost",
        "stock_qty",
        "tags",
        "supplier_id",
        "running_price",
        "category_stddev_samp_stock_qty_num",
        F.round((F.col("category_stddev_samp_stock_qty_num") * 1.15), 2).alias("category_stddev_samp_stock_qty_num_scaled"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    base_products
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("x"), (F.col("x.product_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.product_id").isin([6, 33, 37])), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    eligible
    .withColumn("category_stddev_samp_stock_qty_num_scaled_tier", F.when(F.col("category_stddev_samp_stock_qty_num_scaled") >= 68, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .rollup("supplier_id", "category_stddev_samp_stock_qty_num_scaled_tier")
    .agg(
        F.bit_or("stock_qty").alias("stock_qty_bit_or"),
        F.corr("price", "stock_qty").alias("corr_price_stock_qty"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
    .orderBy("corr_price_stock_qty")
)
```

sql:
WITH scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(salary, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(hire_date), dept_id ORDER BY salary, id) AS prev_salary,
        AVG(salary) OVER (ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS salary_avg_5_prior,
        LAG(salary, 1, 0) OVER w_running AS prev_salary_2
    FROM employees
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY salary, id)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        is_remote,
        level,
        prev_salary,
        prev_salary_2,
        LEAD(prev_salary, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(hire_date) ORDER BY salary, id) AS next_prev_salary,
        AVG(salary_avg_5_prior) OVER (ORDER BY salary_avg_5_prior, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS salary_avg_5_prior_avg_5,
        SUM(salary_avg_5_prior) OVER (ORDER BY prev_salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_salary_avg_5_prior,
        LAST_VALUE(prev_salary, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY prev_salary_2, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_prev_salary,
        ROUND(prev_salary_2 / SUM(prev_salary_2) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(hire_date), manager_id), 4) AS prev_salary_2_share
    FROM scored
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT job_title
    FROM with_windows
    INTERSECT
    SELECT job_title
    FROM employees
    WHERE UPPER(full_name) LIKE '%OB %'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.job_title = k.job_title
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        level,
        prev_salary,
        prev_salary_2,
        next_prev_salary,
        salary_avg_5_prior_avg_5,
        last_known_prev_salary,
        prev_salary_2_share,
        AVG(prev_salary_2) OVER (PARTITION BY level) AS level_avg_prev_salary_2
    FROM verified
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach employees attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        e.salary,
        e.level AS employee_level,
        e.full_name
    FROM metrics a
    LEFT JOIN employees e
        ON a.manager_id = e.id
    WHERE e.email LIKE '%@yahoo.com'
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    job_title,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE job_title = 'Designer') AS designer_rows
FROM with_dims
GROUP BY job_title;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.month("hire_date"), "dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("hire_date", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w_running = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("hire_date")).orderBy("salary", "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("salary_avg_5_prior", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy("prev_salary", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.orderBy("prev_salary_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("hire_date"), "manager_id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("level")

scored = (
    df_employees
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("salary", 1).over(w).alias("prev_salary"),
        F.avg("salary").over(w2).alias("salary_avg_5_prior"),
        F.lag("salary", 1, 0).over(w_running).alias("prev_salary_2"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        "is_remote",
        "level",
        "prev_salary",
        "prev_salary_2",
        F.lead("prev_salary", 2, 0).over(w4).alias("next_prev_salary"),
        F.avg("salary_avg_5_prior").over(w5).alias("salary_avg_5_prior_avg_5"),
        F.sum("salary_avg_5_prior").over(w6).alias("cumulative_salary_avg_5_prior"),
        F.last("prev_salary", ignorenulls=True).over(w7).alias("last_known_prev_salary"),
        F.round((F.col("prev_salary_2") / F.sum("prev_salary_2").over(w8)), 4).alias("prev_salary_2_share"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("job_title")
    .intersect(
        df_employees
        .filter(F.upper("full_name").like("%OB %"))
        .select("job_title")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.job_title") == F.col("k.job_title")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics = (
    verified
    .select(
        "id",
        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        "level",
        "prev_salary",
        "prev_salary_2",
        "next_prev_salary",
        "salary_avg_5_prior_avg_5",
        "last_known_prev_salary",
        "prev_salary_2_share",
        F.avg("prev_salary_2").over(w9).alias("level_avg_prev_salary_2"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    metrics
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_employees.alias("e"), F.col("a.manager_id") == F.col("e.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("e.email").like("%@yahoo.com"))
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("e.salary"),
        F.col("e.level").alias("employee_level"),
        F.col("e.full_name"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .groupBy("job_title")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("job_title") == "Designer", 1)).alias("designer_rows"),
    )
)
```

WITH with_dims AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.account_id,
        e.txn_type,
        e.txn_time,
        e.merchant,
        e.is_flagged,
        d.balance
    FROM transactions e
    LEFT JOIN accounts d
        ON e.account_id = d.id
    WHERE YEAR(d.opened_date) >= 2025
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        LEAD(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, merchant ORDER BY balance, id) AS next_balance,
        LAG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, merchant ORDER BY balance, id) AS prev_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, merchant ORDER BY balance, id) AS seq_no
    FROM with_dims
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        prev_balance
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY next_balance, id) AS rn
        FROM enriched
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        is_flagged,
        LAG(prev_balance, 2) OVER (ORDER BY prev_balance, id) AS prev_prev_balance,
        MIN(prev_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant) AS merchant_min_prev_balance
    FROM ranked
),
enriched_transactions AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(prev_prev_balance) OVER (ORDER BY merchant_min_prev_balance, id) AS prev_prev_prev_balance,
        LEAD(prev_prev_balance) OVER (ORDER BY merchant_min_prev_balance, id) AS next_prev_prev_balance,
        LEAD(merchant_min_prev_balance) OVER (ORDER BY merchant_min_prev_balance, id) AS next_merchant_min_prev_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY merchant_min_prev_balance, id) AS row_seq
    FROM with_windows
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN row_seq >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS row_seq_tier,
    CASE WHEN next_merchant_min_prev_balance >= 62575 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS next_merchant_min_prev_balance_tier,
    AVG(row_seq) AS avg_row_seq,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(merchant_min_prev_balance, 0.9) AS merchant_min_prev_balance_p90,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(row_seq, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS row_seq_quartiles,
    ROUND(AVG(prev_prev_prev_balance), 2) AS avg_prev_prev_prev_balance
FROM enriched_transactions
GROUP BY CASE WHEN row_seq >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN next_merchant_min_prev_balance >= 62575 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("account_id", "merchant").orderBy("balance", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("next_balance", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("prev_balance", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("merchant")
w5 = Window.orderBy("merchant_min_prev_balance", "id")

with_dims = (
    df_transactions
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("d"), F.col("e.account_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.year(F.col("d.opened_date")) >= 2025)
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.account_id",
        "e.txn_type",
        "e.txn_time",
        "e.merchant",
        "e.is_flagged",
        F.col("d.balance"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        F.lead("balance").over(w).alias("next_balance"),
        F.lag("balance").over(w).alias("prev_balance"),
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("id", "merchant", "is_flagged", "prev_balance")
)

with_windows = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "id",
        "is_flagged",
        F.lag("prev_balance", 2).over(w3).alias("prev_prev_balance"),
        F.min("prev_balance").over(w4).alias("merchant_min_prev_balance"),
    )
)

enriched_transactions = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("prev_prev_prev_balance", F.lag("prev_prev_balance").over(w5))
    .withColumn("next_prev_prev_balance", F.lead("prev_prev_balance").over(w5))
    .withColumn("next_merchant_min_prev_balance", F.lead("merchant_min_prev_balance").over(w5))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w5))
)

result = (
    enriched_transactions
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("row_seq") >= 7, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("row_seq_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("next_merchant_min_prev_balance") >= 62575, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("next_merchant_min_prev_balance_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.avg("row_seq").alias("avg_row_seq"),
        F.percentile_approx("merchant_min_prev_balance", 0.9).alias("merchant_min_prev_balance_p90"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("row_seq", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("row_seq_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.avg("prev_prev_prev_balance"), 2).alias("avg_prev_prev_prev_balance"),
    )
)
```

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(device) device_length,
        COALESCE(country, 'OTHER') resolved_country
    FROM sessions
    WHERE country IS NOT NULL
      AND country = 'TH'
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        country,
        device_length,
        resolved_country
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY device_length DESC, id ASC) = 1
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        device_length,
        resolved_country,
        LOWER(country) country_lower
    FROM latest
    WHERE country IS DISTINCT FROM 'SG'
),
latest_sessions AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM filtered
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY device_length DESC NULLS FIRST, id ASC) = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        device_length,
        resolved_country,
        country_lower,
        AVG(device_length) OVER w_part device_length_avg_2_prior,
        FIRST_VALUE(device_length) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY device_length ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) first_known_device_length
    FROM latest_sessions
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY device_length ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(device_length_avg_2_prior * 100, 2) adjusted_device_length_avg_2_prior,
        ROUND(first_known_device_length * 100, 2) first_known_device_length_adjusted
    FROM metrics
    WHERE device_length >= 35
),
eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND x.page = '/product'
        )
)
SELECT
    id,
    device_length,
    country_lower,
    device_length_avg_2_prior,
    first_known_device_length,
    adjusted_device_length_avg_2_prior
FROM eligible;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("device_length").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("device_length").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("device_length", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w4 = Window.orderBy("device_length", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("country").isNotNull() & (F.col("country") == "TH"))
    .withColumn("device_length", F.length("device"))
    .withColumn("resolved_country", F.coalesce("country", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

latest = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "country",
        "device_length",
        "resolved_country",
    )
)

filtered = (
    latest
    .filter(~F.col("country").eqNullSafe(F.lit("SG")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "device_length",
        "resolved_country",
        F.lower("country").alias("country_lower"),
    )
)

latest_sessions = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

metrics = (
    latest_sessions
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_length",
        "resolved_country",
        "country_lower",
        F.avg("device_length").over(w_part).alias("device_length_avg_2_prior"),
        F.first("device_length", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("first_known_device_length"),
    )
)

valid = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("device_length") >= 35)
    .withColumn("adjusted_device_length_avg_2_prior", F.round((F.col("device_length_avg_2_prior") * 100), 2))
    .withColumn("first_known_device_length_adjusted", F.round((F.col("first_known_device_length") * 100), 2))
)

eligible = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("x"), (F.col("x.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.page") == "/product"), "left_semi")
)

result = (
    eligible
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_length",
        "country_lower",
        "device_length_avg_2_prior",
        "first_known_device_length",
        "adjusted_device_length_avg_2_prior",
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_prev = df_device_readings.withColumn("prev_reading_ts", F.lag("reading_ts").over(w))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_reading_ts").isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.col("prev_reading_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

        F.countDistinct("device_code").alias("distinct_device_codes"),

        F.stddev_samp("pressure").alias("pressure_stddev"),
        F.max("prev_reading_ts").alias("last_prev_reading_ts"),
        F.bit_or("status_bits").alias("status_bits_bit_or"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
    )
)
```

WITH ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS rn
        FROM payments
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.discount,
        p.shipping_fee
    FROM ranked a
    INNER JOIN orders p
        ON a.order_id = p.id
    WHERE p.shipping_fee > 21
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        o.channel,
        o.status AS order_status,
        o.shipping_fee AS order_shipping_fee
    FROM enriched src
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON src.order_id = o.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(shipping_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(paid_at), order_status ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_shipping_fee,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY order_shipping_fee DESC NULLS LAST) AS order_shipping_fee_percent_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(channel) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY shipping_fee, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_channel
    FROM with_dims
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN discount >= 0.4 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS discount_tier,
    CASE WHEN running_shipping_fee >= 179 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS running_shipping_fee_tier,
    SUM(order_shipping_fee) AS total_order_shipping_fee,
    ROUND(SUM(order_shipping_fee) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS order_shipping_fee_per_refunded,
    SUM(shipping_fee) AS total_shipping_fee
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY CASE WHEN discount >= 0.4 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, CASE WHEN running_shipping_fee >= 179 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("paid_at"), "order_status").orderBy("rn", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("order_shipping_fee").desc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

ranked = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    ranked
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("p.shipping_fee") > 21)
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.discount"), F.col("p.shipping_fee"))
)

with_dims = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("o.channel"),
        F.col("o.status").alias("order_status"),
```

WITH metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        status_bits,
        AVG(temp_c) OVER w_ordered AS running_avg_temp_c,
        MIN(temp_c) OVER w_ordered AS running_min_temp_c,
        SUM(temp_c) OVER w_ordered AS running_sum_temp_c,
        LAG(humidity, 1) OVER w_hist AS prev_humidity
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE status_bits < 4
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_hist AS (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity, id)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY status_bits DESC, id) = 1
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts) = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        prev_humidity,
        SUM(running_avg_temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_running_avg_temp_c,
        SUM(status_bits) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(reading_ts)) AS reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY running_avg_temp_c DESC, id) AS running_avg_temp_c_bucket
    FROM deduped
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        prev_humidity,
        cumulative_running_avg_temp_c,
        running_avg_temp_c_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY prev_humidity DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        LAST_VALUE(prev_humidity) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_running AS last_known_prev_humidity,
        SUM(reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits) OVER w_hist AS cumulative_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits,
        LAST_VALUE(reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_running AS last_known_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits,
        LAST_VALUE(cumulative_running_avg_temp_c) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY prev_humidity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY running_avg_temp_c_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_hist AS (ORDER BY cumulative_running_avg_temp_c, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        FLOOR(last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c) AS last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c_whole,
        FLOOR(last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c) AS last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c_whole_2
    FROM scored
    WHERE last_known_prev_humidity > 42
),
metrics_device_readings AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(last_known_prev_humidity) OVER w_running AS next_last_known_prev_humidity,
        LEAD(event_seq) OVER w_running AS next_event_seq,
        LAG(event_seq) OVER w_running AS prev_event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_running AS event_seq_2,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY event_seq DESC NULLS FIRST) AS event_seq_percent_rank
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY last_known_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits, id)
),
report AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        prev_humidity,
        running_avg_temp_c_bucket,
        event_seq,
        cumulative_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits,
        last_known_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits,
        last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c,
        last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c_whole,
        next_last_known_prev_humidity
    FROM metrics_device_readings
    ORDER BY prev_humidity DESC NULLS FIRST
)
SELECT
    id,
    prev_humidity,
    running_avg_temp_c_bucket,
    event_seq,
    last_known_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits,
    last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c,
    last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c_whole
FROM report
ORDER BY last_known_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits DESC, last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c_whole;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("humidity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("humidity", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("status_bits").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts")
w5 = Window.orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("reading_ts"))
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_avg_temp_c").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("prev_humidity").desc(), "id")
w_running = Window.orderBy("running_avg_temp_c_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.orderBy("cumulative_running_avg_temp_c", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w11 = Window.orderBy("prev_humidity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w12 = Window.orderBy("last_known_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits", "id")
w13 = Window.orderBy(F.col("event_seq").desc_nulls_first())

metrics = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("status_bits") < 4)
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "status_bits",
        F.avg("temp_c").over(w_ordered).alias("running_avg_temp_c"),
        F.min("temp_c").over(w_ordered).alias("running_min_temp_c"),
        F.sum("temp_c").over(w_ordered).alias("running_sum_temp_c"),
        F.lag("humidity", 1).over(w_hist).alias("prev_humidity"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

deduped = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

with_windows = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "prev_humidity",
        F.sum("running_avg_temp_c").over(w5).alias("cumulative_running_avg_temp_c"),
        F.sum("status_bits").over(w6).alias("reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w7).alias("running_avg_temp_c_bucket"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "prev_humidity",
        "cumulative_running_avg_temp_c",
        "running_avg_temp_c_bucket",
        F.row_number().over(w8).alias("event_seq"),
        F.last("prev_humidity", ignorenulls=True).over(w_running).alias("last_known_prev_humidity"),
        F.sum("reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits").over(w10).alias("cumulative_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits"),
        F.last("reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits", ignorenulls=True).over(w_running).alias("last_known_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits"),
        F.last("cumulative_running_avg_temp_c", ignorenulls=True).over(w11).alias("last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c"),
    )
)

base = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("last_known_prev_humidity") > 42)
    .withColumn("last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c_whole", F.floor("last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c"))
    .withColumn("last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c_whole_2", F.floor("last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c"))
)

metrics_device_readings = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("last_known_prev_humidity").over(w12).alias("next_last_known_prev_humidity"),
        F.lead("event_seq").over(w12).alias("next_event_seq"),
        F.lag("event_seq").over(w12).alias("prev_event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w12).alias("event_seq_2"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w13).alias("event_seq_percent_rank"),
    )
)

report = (
    metrics_device_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "prev_humidity",
        "running_avg_temp_c_bucket",
        "event_seq",
        "cumulative_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits",
        "last_known_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits",
        "last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c",
        "last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c_whole",
        "next_last_known_prev_humidity",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("prev_humidity").desc_nulls_first())
)

result = (
    report
    .select(
        "id",
        "prev_humidity",
        "running_avg_temp_c_bucket",
        "event_seq",
        "last_known_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits",
        "last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c",
        "last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c_whole",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("last_known_reading_ts_year_sum_status_bits").desc(),
        "last_known_cumulative_running_avg_temp_c_whole",
    )
)
```

with prev_events as (
    -- Previous event time per key
    select *, lag(reading_ts) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts asc, id asc) as prev_reading_ts
    from device_readings
),
gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    select *, case when prev_reading_ts is null or reading_ts > prev_reading_ts + interval 1 hour then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from prev_events
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as burst_id
    from gaps
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        pressure,
        prev_reading_ts,
        burst_id,
        max(is_new_burst) over w_hist is_new_burst_max_15m,
        row_number() over w_recent seq_no,
        cume_dist() over (partition by device_code order by humidity desc nulls last) humidity_cume_dist,
        count(burst_id) over (partition by device_code order by cast(reading_ts as bigint) asc range between 1800 preceding and current row) burst_id_count_30m,
        ntile(5) over (order by burst_id desc, id asc) burst_id_bucket
    from islands
    window w_hist as (partition by device_code order by cast(reading_ts as bigint) asc range between 900 preceding and current row), w_recent as (partition by device_code order by temp_c asc, id asc)
),
enriched_device_readings as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        sum(is_new_burst_max_15m) over (partition by device_code order by cast(prev_reading_ts as bigint) asc range between 604800 preceding and current row) is_new_burst_max_15m_sum_7d,
        cume_dist() over (partition by device_code order by is_new_burst_max_15m asc nulls last) is_new_burst_max_15m_cume_dist,
        ntile(5) over (partition by device_code order by seq_no asc, id asc) seq_no_bucket,
        sum(burst_id) over (partition by device_code order by burst_id asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) cumulative_burst_id,
        dense_rank() over (partition by device_code order by humidity_cume_dist desc) humidity_cume_dist_dense_rank
    from enriched
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        reading_ts,
        pressure,
        humidity_cume_dist,
        burst_id_count_30m,
        burst_id_bucket,
        is_new_burst_max_15m_sum_7d,
        seq_no_bucket,
        cumulative_burst_id,
        humidity_cume_dist_dense_rank,
        sum(humidity_cume_dist) over w_ordered running_sum_humidity_cume_dist,
        max(humidity_cume_dist) over w_ordered running_max_humidity_cume_dist,
        avg(humidity_cume_dist) over w_ordered running_avg_humidity_cume_dist,
        count(humidity_cume_dist) over w_ordered running_count_humidity_cume_dist
    from enriched_device_readings
    window w_ordered as (partition by device_code order by pressure asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
stats as (
    -- Grouped metrics
    select
        case when humidity_cume_dist >= 0.88 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as humidity_cume_dist_tier,
        cumulative_burst_id,
        case when running_avg_humidity_cume_dist >= 0.68 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as running_avg_humidity_cume_dist_tier,
        count(*) as row_count,
        percentile_approx(burst_id_bucket, 0.95) as burst_id_bucket_p95,
        approx_percentile(pressure, 0.95) as pressure_p95
    from metrics
    group by grouping sets ((case when humidity_cume_dist >= 0.88 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end, cumulative_burst_id, case when running_avg_humidity_cume_dist >= 0.68 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end), (case when humidity_cume_dist >= 0.88 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end, cumulative_burst_id), ())
    having burst_id_bucket_p95 >= 0
)
select
    humidity_cume_dist_tier,
    running_avg_humidity_cume_dist_tier,
    burst_id_bucket_p95,
    pressure_p95
from stats
order by pressure_p95 desc nulls first, burst_id_bucket_p95 desc;

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)

w5 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("humidity").desc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("burst_id").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("prev_reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("is_new_burst_max_15m").asc_nulls_last())
w10 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("seq_no", "id")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("burst_id", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w12 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("humidity_cume_dist").desc())
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("pressure", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

prev_events = df_device_readings.withColumn("prev_reading_ts", F.lag("reading_ts").over(w))

gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_reading_ts").isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.col("prev_reading_ts") + F.expr("INTERVAL 1 HOUR")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

enriched = (
    islands
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "pressure",
        "prev_reading_ts",
        "burst_id",
        F.max("is_new_burst").over(w_hist).alias("is_new_burst_max_15m"),
        F.row_number().over(w_recent).alias("seq_no"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w5).alias("humidity_cume_dist"),
        F.count("burst_id").over(w6).alias("burst_id_count_30m"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w7).alias("burst_id_bucket"),
    )
)

enriched_device_readings = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("is_new_burst_max_15m_sum_7d", F.sum("is_new_burst_max_15m").over(w8))
    .withColumn("is_new_burst_max_15m_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w9))
    .withColumn("seq_no_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(w10))
    .withColumn("cumulative_burst_id", F.sum("burst_id").over(w11))
    .withColumn("humidity_cume_dist_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w12))
)

metrics = (
    enriched_device_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "reading_ts",
        "pressure",
        "humidity_cume_dist",
        "burst_id_count_30m",
        "burst_id_bucket",
        "is_new_burst_max_15m_sum_7d",
        "seq_no_bucket",
        "cumulative_burst_id",
        "humidity_cume_dist_dense_rank",
        F.sum("humidity_cume_dist").over(w_ordered).alias("running_sum_humidity_cume_dist"),
        F.max("humidity_cume_dist").over(w_ordered).alias("running_max_humidity_cume_dist"),
        F.avg("humidity_cume_dist").over(w_ordered).alias("running_avg_humidity_cume_dist"),
        F.count("humidity_cume_dist").over(w_ordered).alias("running_count_humidity_cume_dist"),
    )
)

stats = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("humidity_cume_dist_tier", F.when(F.col("humidity_cume_dist") >= 0.88, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .withColumn("running_avg_humidity_cume_dist_tier", F.when(F.col("running_avg_humidity_cume_dist") >= 0.68, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["humidity_cume_dist_tier", "cumulative_burst_id", "running_avg_humidity_cume_dist_tier"], ["humidity_cume_dist_tier", "cumulative_burst_id"], []],
        "humidity_cume_dist_tier",
        "cumulative_burst_id",
        "running_avg_humidity_cume_dist_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("burst_id_bucket", 0.95).alias("burst_id_bucket_p95"),
        F.percentile_approx("pressure", 0.95).alias("pressure_p95"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("burst_id_bucket_p95") >= 0)
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "humidity_cume_dist_tier",
        "running_avg_humidity_cume_dist_tier",
        "burst_id_bucket_p95",
        "pressure_p95",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("pressure_p95").desc_nulls_first(),
        F.col("burst_id_bucket_p95").desc(),
    )
)
```

sql:
WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN merchant = '7-Eleven' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_7_eleven,
        COALESCE(merchant, 'NONE') AS merchant_filled
    FROM transactions
    WHERE merchant IS NOT NULL
      AND txn_time >= '2025-08-01'
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(is_7_eleven) OVER w_grp AS prev_is_7_eleven,
        LEAD(is_7_eleven) OVER w_grp AS next_is_7_eleven,
        LEAD(amount) OVER w_grp AS next_amount,
        LAG(amount) OVER w_grp AS prev_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS seq_no
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY merchant, txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY is_7_eleven, id) = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        is_7_eleven,
        merchant_filled,
        prev_amount,
        AVG(prev_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, account_id ORDER BY next_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev_amount_avg_5,
        SUM(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY prev_is_7_eleven, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_seq_no,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(txn_time) ORDER BY next_amount DESC) AS next_amount_percent_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY prev_is_7_eleven DESC, id) AS seq_no_2
    FROM deduped
),
totals AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        txn_type,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'DEBIT' THEN 1 END) AS debit_count,
        SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE merchant = 'Grab') AS grab_total_amount,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(prev_amount_avg_5, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS prev_amount_avg_5_quartiles,
        MAX(prev_amount_avg_5) FILTER (WHERE merchant = 'Grab') AS grab_max_prev_amount_avg_5
    FROM with_windows
    GROUP BY txn_type
    HAVING MAX(prev_amount_avg_5) FILTER (WHERE merchant = 'Grab') > 0
)
SELECT
    txn_type,
    debit_count,
    grab_total_amount,
    prev_amount_avg_5_quartiles,
    grab_max_prev_amount_avg_5,
    CASE WHEN txn_type RLIKE '^(REFUND|CREDIT)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'GROUP_B' END AS txn_type_zone
FROM totals;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("merchant", "txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("is_7_eleven", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "account_id").orderBy("next_amount", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("prev_is_7_eleven", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("txn_time")).orderBy(F.col("next_amount").desc())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy(F.col("prev_is_7_eleven").desc(), "id")

base = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & (F.col("txn_time") >= "2025-08-01"))
    .withColumn("is_7_eleven", F.when(F.col("merchant") == "7-Eleven", 1).otherwise(0))
    .withColumn("merchant_filled", F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("NONE")))
)

scored = (
    base
    .withColumn("prev_is_7_eleven", F.lag("is_7_eleven").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("next_is_7_eleven", F.lead("is_7_eleven").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("next_amount", F.lead("amount").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("prev_amount", F.lag("amount").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w_grp))
)

deduped = (
    scored
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

with_windows = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        "is_7_eleven",
        "merchant_filled",
        "prev_amount",
        F.avg("prev_amount").over(w3).alias("prev_amount_avg_5"),
        F.sum("seq_no").over(w4).alias("cumulative_seq_no"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w5).alias("next_amount_percent_rank"),
        F.row_number().over(w6).alias("seq_no_2"),
    )
)

totals = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy("txn_type")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "DEBIT", 1)).alias("debit_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("merchant") == "Grab", F.col("amount"))).alias("grab_total_amount"),
        F.percentile_approx("prev_amount_avg_5", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("prev_amount_avg_5_quartiles"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("merchant") == "Grab", F.col("prev_amount_avg_5"))).alias("grab_max_prev_amount_avg_5"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("grab_max_prev_amount_avg_5") > 0)
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "txn_type",
        "debit_count",
        "grab_total_amount",
        "prev_amount_avg_5_quartiles",
        "grab_max_prev_amount_avg_5",
        F.when(F.col("txn_type").rlike("^(REFUND|CREDIT)$"), "CORE").otherwise("GROUP_B").alias("txn_type_zone"),
    )
)
```

sql:
WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) x AS k, v
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        k,
        v,
        ROUND(status_code / SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY level), 4) AS status_code_share,
        COUNT(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY service) AS service_count_status_code,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY status_code DESC) AS status_code_percent_rank,
        ROUND(status_code / SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY service), 4) AS status_code_share_2
    FROM flattened
    WHERE k <> 'trace'
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, status_code_share - status_code_share_2 AS status_code_share_minus_status_code_share_2
    FROM enriched
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
      AND k IS DISTINCT FROM 'trace'
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN status_code_share >= 0.84 THEN 'High' WHEN status_code_share >= 0.14 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS status_code_share_level,
        COALESCE(k, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_k
    FROM filtered
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        k,
        v,
        service_count_status_code,
        status_code_percent_rank,
        status_code_share_minus_status_code_share_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY status_code_share_minus_status_code_share_2 NULLS LAST) AS status_code_share_minus_status_code_share_2_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY service_count_status_code DESC NULLS LAST) AS service_count_status_code_rank,
        AVG(status_code_share_2) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS k_avg_status_code_share_2
    FROM cleaned
)
SELECT
    service_count_status_code,
    status_code_percent_rank,
    status_code_share_minus_status_code_share_2_dense_rank,
    service_count_status_code_rank,
    k_avg_status_code_share_2
FROM scored
ORDER BY service_count_status_code_rank
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("level")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("service")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc())
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("status_code_share_minus_status_code_share_2").asc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("service_count_status_code").desc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("k")

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "v"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("k") != "trace")
    .select(
        "k",
        "v",
        F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(w)), 4).alias("status_code_share"),
        F.count("status_code").over(w2).alias("service_count_status_code"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("status_code_percent_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(w2)), 4).alias("status_code_share_2"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull() & (~F.col("k").eqNullSafe(F.lit("trace"))))
    .withColumn("status_code_share_minus_status_code_share_2", (F.col("status_code_share") - F.col("status_code_share_2")))
)

cleaned = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("status_code_share") >= 0.84, "High").when(F.col("status_code_share") >= 0.14, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("status_code_share_level"),
        F.coalesce("k", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_k"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "k",
        "v",
        "service_count_status_code",
        "status_code_percent_rank",
        "status_code_share_minus_status_code_share_2",
        F.dense_rank().over(w4).alias("status_code_share_minus_status_code_share_2_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w5).alias("service_count_status_code_rank"),
        F.avg("status_code_share_2").over(w6).alias("k_avg_status_code_share_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "service_count_status_code",
        "status_code_percent_rank",
        "status_code_share_minus_status_code_share_2_dense_rank",
        "service_count_status_code_rank",
        "k_avg_status_code_share_2",
    )
    .orderBy("service_count_status_code_rank")
)
```
