    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(discounts) x AS tier_value
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        plan,
        currency,
        MIN(tier_value) OVER w_recent AS currency_min_tier_value,
        COUNT(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY plan, currency) AS plan_count_tier_value,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_part AS tier_value_dense_rank
    FROM lines
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY currency), w_part AS (ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS FIRST)
),
enriched_price_tiers AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY currency_min_tier_value DESC NULLS FIRST) AS currency_min_tier_value_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY currency_min_tier_value NULLS FIRST) AS currency_min_tier_value_rank
    FROM enriched
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        plan,
        currency,
        currency_min_tier_value,
        plan_count_tier_value,
        tier_value_dense_rank,
        currency_min_tier_value_dense_rank,
        currency_min_tier_value_rank,
        ROUND(currency_min_tier_value_rank, 0) AS currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded
    FROM enriched_price_tiers
    WHERE currency_min_tier_value >= 39
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        currency,
        plan_count_tier_value,
        currency_min_tier_value_dense_rank,
        currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded,
        currency_min_tier_value_rank + tier_value_dense_rank AS currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank,
        ROUND(tier_value_dense_rank, 1) AS tier_value_dense_rank_rounded
    FROM filtered
    WHERE currency_min_tier_value_dense_rank = 6
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank >= 74 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank_tier,
        CASE WHEN tier_value_dense_rank_rounded >= 74 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS tier_value_dense_rank_rounded_tier,
        ROUND(AVG(currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded), 2) AS avg_currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded,
        ROUND(AVG(currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded), 2) AS avg_currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded_2,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 END) AS eur_count,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded_quartiles,
        GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
    FROM valid
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank >= 74 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, CASE WHEN tier_value_dense_rank_rounded >= 74 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END), (CASE WHEN currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank >= 74 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END))
    HAVING avg_currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded < 1000000
)
SELECT
    currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank_tier,
    tier_value_dense_rank_rounded_tier,
    avg_currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded_2,
    eur_count,
    currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded_quartiles,
    grouping_level
FROM grouped
ORDER BY avg_currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded_2 DESC, currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank_tier;

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("plan", "currency")
w_part = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("currency_min_tier_value").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("currency_min_tier_value").asc_nulls_first())

lines = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "plan", "currency", F.explode("discounts").alias("tier_value"))
)

enriched = (
    lines
    .select(
        "plan",
        "currency",
        F.min("tier_value").over(w_recent).alias("currency_min_tier_value"),
        F.count("tier_value").over(w2).alias("plan_count_tier_value"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_part).alias("tier_value_dense_rank"),
    )
)

enriched_price_tiers = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("currency_min_tier_value_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("currency_min_tier_value_rank", F.rank().over(w5))
)

filtered = (
    enriched_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("currency_min_tier_value") >= 39)
    .select(
        "plan",
        "currency",
        "currency_min_tier_value",
        "plan_count_tier_value",
        "tier_value_dense_rank",
        "currency_min_tier_value_dense_rank",
        "currency_min_tier_value_rank",
        F.round("currency_min_tier_value_rank", 0).alias("currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded"),
    )
)

valid = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("currency_min_tier_value_dense_rank") == 6)
    .select(
        "currency",
        "plan_count_tier_value",
        "currency_min_tier_value_dense_rank",
        "currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded",
        (F.col("currency_min_tier_value_rank") + F.col("tier_value_dense_rank")).alias("currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank"),
        F.round("tier_value_dense_rank", 1).alias("tier_value_dense_rank_rounded"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank_tier", F.when(F.col("currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank") >= 74, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .withColumn("tier_value_dense_rank_rounded_tier", F.when(F.col("tier_value_dense_rank_rounded") >= 74, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank_tier", "tier_value_dense_rank_rounded_tier"], ["currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank_tier"]],
        "currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank_tier",
        "tier_value_dense_rank_rounded_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded"), 2).alias("avg_currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded"),
        F.round(F.avg("currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded"), 2).alias("avg_currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded_2"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("currency") == "EUR", 1)).alias("eur_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded_quartiles"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded") < 1000000)
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank_tier",
        "tier_value_dense_rank_rounded_tier",
        "avg_currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded_2",
        "eur_count",
        "currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded_quartiles",
        "grouping_level",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("avg_currency_min_tier_value_rank_rounded_2").desc(),
        "currency_min_tier_value_rank_plus_tier_value_dense_rank_tier",
    )
)
```

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, COALESCE(revenue, 0) AS revenue_filled
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE sale_date > TO_DATE('2023-07-18')
      AND sale_date BETWEEN '2023-06-01' AND '2024-06-01'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(sale_date) ORDER BY revenue) AS revenue_rank,
        AVG(revenue_filled) OVER (ORDER BY sale_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS revenue_filled_avg_3,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('week', sale_date), store_id ORDER BY units DESC, id) AS units_bucket
    FROM base
    WHERE store_id = 3
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(units_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS units_bucket_avg_2,
        SUM(units) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY sale_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_units,
        LAST_VALUE(units) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_units
    FROM enriched
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        sale_date,
        revenue_rank,
        revenue_filled_avg_3,
        units_bucket_avg_2,
        cumulative_units
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM metrics
    ) t
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        revenue_filled_avg_3 * units_bucket_avg_2 AS revenue_filled_avg_3_times_units_bucket_avg_2,
        GREATEST(revenue_filled_avg_3, revenue_rank) AS greatest_revenue_filled_avg_3_revenue_rank
    FROM latest
    WHERE sale_date > TO_DATE('2023-04-22')
      AND store_id IN (1, 4, 5, 6)
),
base_store_sales AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CEIL(greatest_revenue_filled_avg_3_revenue_rank) AS greatest_revenue_filled_avg_3_revenue_rank_whole,
        revenue_filled_avg_3_times_units_bucket_avg_2 + greatest_revenue_filled_avg_3_revenue_rank AS revenue_filled_avg_3_times_units_bucket_avg_2_plus_greatest_revenue_filled_avg_3_revenue_rank
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE sale_date > TO_DATE('2023-03-30')
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    p.region,
    p.city,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    MIN(a.units_bucket_avg_2) AS min_units_bucket_avg_2,
    SUM(a.cumulative_units) AS total_cumulative_units,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid
FROM base_store_sales a
INNER JOIN stores p ON a.store_id = p.id
GROUP BY ROLLUP (p.region, p.city)

```python
w2 = Window.orderBy("sale_date", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "sale_date"), "store_id").orderBy(F.col("units").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("units", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("revenue_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("units").desc_nulls_last(), "id")

base = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter((F.col("sale_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-07-18"))) & F.col("sale_date").between("2023-06-01", "2024-06-01"))
    .select("*", F.coalesce("revenue", F.lit(0)).alias("revenue_filled"))
)

enriched = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("store_id") == 3)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "sale_date",
        "units",
        F.rank().over(w).alias("revenue_rank"),
        F.avg("revenue_filled").over(w2).alias("revenue_filled_avg_3"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w3).alias("units_bucket"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("units_bucket").over(w4).alias("units_bucket_avg_2"),
        F.sum("units").over(w5).alias("cumulative_units"),
        F.last("units", ignorenulls=True).over(w6).alias("last_known_units"),
    )
)

latest = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "sale_date",
        "revenue_rank",
        "revenue_filled_avg_3",
        "units_bucket_avg_2",
        "cumulative_units",
    )
)

cleaned = (
    latest
    .filter((F.col("sale_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-04-22"))) & F.col("store_id").isin([1, 4, 5, 6]))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("revenue_filled_avg_3") * F.col("units_bucket_avg_2")).alias("revenue_filled_avg_3_times_units_bucket_avg_2"),
        F.greatest("revenue_filled_avg_3", "revenue_rank").alias("greatest_revenue_filled_avg_3_revenue_rank"),
    )
)

base_store_sales = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("sale_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-30")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ceil("greatest_revenue_filled_avg_3_revenue_rank").alias("greatest_revenue_filled_avg_3_revenue_rank_whole"),
        (F.col("revenue_filled_avg_3_times_units_bucket_avg_2") + F.col("greatest_revenue_filled_avg_3_revenue_rank")).alias("revenue_filled_avg_3_times_units_bucket_avg_2_plus_greatest_revenue_filled_avg_3_revenue_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    base_store_sales
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_stores.alias("p"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .rollup(F.col("p.region").alias("region"), F.col("p.city").alias("city"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.min(F.col("a.units_bucket_avg_2")).alias("min_units_bucket_avg_2"),
        F.sum(F.col("a.cumulative_units")).alias("total_cumulative_units"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
)
```

WITH deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, order_id ORDER BY quantity DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM order_items
    ) ranked
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT s.*, p.brand
    FROM deduped s
    LEFT JOIN products p
        ON s.product_id = p.id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, brand ORDER BY dedup_rank DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM with_dims
    ) x
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(dedup_rank, 2) AS dedup_rank_rounded,
        COALESCE(unit_price, 0) AS unit_price_filled
    FROM ranked
    WHERE brand IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        dedup_rank,
        brand,
        LEAST(dedup_rank_rounded, unit_price) AS least_dedup_rank_rounded_unit_price
    FROM valid
    WHERE quantity BETWEEN 6 AND 7
),
with_dims_order_items AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.price,
        b.category
    FROM base src
    INNER JOIN products b
        ON src.product_id <=> b.id
    WHERE b.category = 'Grocery'
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.order_id,
        src.product_id,
        src.quantity,
        src.unit_price,
        src.dedup_rank,
        src.price,
        d.discount,
        d.amount,
        d.status
    FROM with_dims_order_items src
    LEFT JOIN orders d
        ON src.order_id = d.id
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN price >= 960 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS price_tier,
    CASE WHEN unit_price >= 360 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS unit_price_tier,
    product_id,
    ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) AS avg_quantity,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN discount ELSE 0 END) AS pending_discount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'SHIPPED' THEN 1 END) AS shipped_count,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(price, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS price_quartiles
FROM joined
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN price >= 960 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN unit_price >= 360 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, product_id), (CASE WHEN price >= 960 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN unit_price >= 360 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END), (CASE WHEN price >= 960 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END))
ORDER BY avg_quantity DESC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "brand").orderBy(F.col("dedup_rank").desc(), "id")

deduped = (
    df_order_items
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

with_dims = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("p.brand"))
)

ranked = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

valid = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("brand").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round("dedup_rank", 2).alias("dedup_rank_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("unit_price", F.lit(0)).alias("unit_price_filled"),
    )
)

base = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("quantity").between(6, 7))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "unit_price",
        "dedup_rank",
        "brand",
        F.least("dedup_rank_rounded", "unit_price").alias("least_dedup_rank_rounded_unit_price"),
    )
)

with_dims_order_items = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_products.alias("b"), F.col("src.product_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("b.id")), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("b.category") == "Grocery")
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.price"), F.col("b.category"))
)

joined = (
    with_dims_order_items
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.order_id",
        "src.product_id",
        "src.quantity",
        "src.unit_price",
        "src.dedup_rank",
        "src.price",
        F.col("d.discount"),
        F.col("d.amount"),
        F.col("d.status"),
    )
)

result = (
    joined
    .withColumn("price_tier", F.when(F.col("price") >= 960, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .withColumn("unit_price_tier", F.when(F.col("unit_price") >= 360, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["price_tier", "unit_price_tier", "product_id"], ["price_tier", "unit_price_tier"], ["price_tier"]],
        "price_tier",
        "unit_price_tier",
        "product_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("quantity"), 2).alias("avg_quantity"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "PENDING", F.col("discount")).otherwise(0)).alias("pending_discount"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "SHIPPED", 1)).alias("shipped_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("price", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("price_quartiles"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_quantity").desc())
)
```

sql:
WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        FLOOR(sqft) AS sqft_whole,
        COALESCE(region, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_region
    FROM stores
    WHERE opened_date > DATE '2023-07-31'
      AND region IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        region,
        sqft_whole,
        resolved_region,
        NTILE(3) OVER (ORDER BY sqft_whole DESC, id ASC) AS sqft_whole_bucket,
        SUM(sqft_whole) OVER (ORDER BY opened_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sqft_whole
    FROM valid
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY running_sqft_whole DESC NULLS FIRST) AS dedup_rank
        FROM enriched
    ) t
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        region,
        sqft_whole,
        resolved_region,
        running_sqft_whole,
        dedup_rank,
        COALESCE(region, 'unassigned') AS region_filled,
        COALESCE(region, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_region_2
    FROM ranked
    WHERE region IS NOT NULL
),
enriched_stores AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft_whole DESC NULLS FIRST) AS sqft_whole_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY running_sqft_whole DESC NULLS FIRST) AS running_sqft_whole_cume_dist,
        FIRST_VALUE(running_sqft_whole, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY dedup_rank ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_running_sqft_whole
    FROM base
    WHERE dedup_rank <= 1
),
daily AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        region,
        ROUND(SUM(running_sqft_whole_cume_dist) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN region = 'West' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS running_sqft_whole_cume_dist_per_west,
        AVG(running_sqft_whole_cume_dist) FILTER (WHERE region = 'Central') AS central_avg_running_sqft_whole_cume_dist,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(region)) AS num_regions,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(sqft_whole_rank, 0.5) AS sqft_whole_rank_p50,
        GROUPING_ID() AS gid
    FROM enriched_stores
    GROUP BY CUBE (region)
)
SELECT
    running_sqft_whole_cume_dist_per_west,
    central_avg_running_sqft_whole_cume_dist,
    sqft_whole_rank_p50,
    gid
FROM daily
ORDER BY running_sqft_whole_cume_dist_per_west ASC
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("sqft_whole").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("running_sqft_whole").desc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("sqft_whole").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.orderBy("dedup_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_stores
    .filter((F.col("opened_date") > F.lit("2023-07-31").cast("date")) & F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.floor("sqft").alias("sqft_whole"),
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_region"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "region",
        "sqft_whole",
        "resolved_region",
        F.ntile(3).over(w).alias("sqft_whole_bucket"),
        F.sum("sqft_whole").over(w2).alias("running_sqft_whole"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

base = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "region",
        "sqft_whole",
        "resolved_region",
        "running_sqft_whole",
        "dedup_rank",
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("unassigned")).alias("region_filled"),
        F.coalesce("region", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_region_2"),
    )
)

enriched_stores = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") <= 1)
    .withColumn("sqft_whole_rank", F.rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("running_sqft_whole_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w3))
    .withColumn("first_known_running_sqft_whole", F.first("running_sqft_whole", ignorenulls=True).over(w5))
)

daily = (
    enriched_stores
    .cube("region")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("running_sqft_whole_cume_dist") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("region") == "West", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("running_sqft_whole_cume_dist_per_west"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("region") == "Central", F.col("running_sqft_whole_cume_dist"))).alias("central_avg_running_sqft_whole_cume_dist"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("region")).alias("num_regions"),
        F.percentile_approx("sqft_whole_rank", 0.5).alias("sqft_whole_rank_p50"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("gid"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "running_sqft_whole_cume_dist_per_west",
        "central_avg_running_sqft_whole_cume_dist",
        "sqft_whole_rank_p50",
        "gid",
    )
    .orderBy("running_sqft_whole_cume_dist_per_west")
)
```

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        status,
        CONCAT(status, ' - ', plan) AS status_plan
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE monthly_fee >= 110
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY start_date DESC, id) AS seq_no
    FROM cleaned
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, ROUND(seq_no, 1) AS seq_no_rounded
    FROM scored
    WHERE start_date > DATE '2023-06-04'
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, LENGTH(plan) AS plan_length
    FROM filtered
    WHERE start_date >= DATE '2023-09-24'
)
SELECT
    id,
    start_date,
    status,
    seq_no,
    seq_no_rounded,
    plan_length
FROM base
ORDER BY seq_no, plan_length DESC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("start_date").desc(), "id")

cleaned = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 110)
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",
        "status",
        F.concat("status", F.lit(" - "), "plan").alias("status_plan"),
    )
)

scored = cleaned.withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w))

filtered = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("start_date") > F.lit("2023-06-04").cast("date"))
    .select("*", F.round("seq_no", 1).alias("seq_no_rounded"))
)

base = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("start_date") >= F.lit("2023-09-24").cast("date"))
    .select("*", F.length("plan").alias("plan_length"))
)

result = (
    base
    .select("id", "start_date", "status", "seq_no", "seq_no_rounded", "plan_length")
    .orderBy("seq_no", F.col("plan_length").desc())
)
```

WITH joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT s.*, b.channel
    FROM shipments s
    LEFT JOIN orders b
        ON s.order_id = b.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipped_date, id) AS prev_cost,
        LEAD(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipped_date, id) AS next_cost,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipped_date, id) AS seq_no,
        LAST_VALUE(cost) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipped_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_cost
    FROM joined
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(cost, 0) AS cost_filled,
        ADD_MONTHS(shipped_date, 12) AS shipped_date_plus_months
    FROM scored
    WHERE delivered_date > TO_DATE('2023-10-04')
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.order_id,
        src.carrier,
        src.status,
        src.next_cost,
        src.last_known_cost,
        src.cost_filled,
        src.shipped_date_plus_months,
        d.amount,
        d.order_date,
        d.status AS order_status
    FROM base src
    LEFT JOIN orders d
        ON src.order_id = d.id
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM with_dims
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_status, order_id ORDER BY amount, id) = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN next_cost >= 93 THEN 'High' WHEN next_cost >= 48 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS next_cost_band,
        DATEDIFF(order_date, shipped_date_plus_months) / 7 AS weeks_shipped_date_plus_months_to_order_date
    FROM deduped
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        o.status AS order_status_2,
        o.order_date AS order_order_date
    FROM cleaned src
    LEFT JOIN orders o
        ON src.order_id <=> o.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    order_id,
    carrier,
    status,
    next_cost,
    last_known_cost,
    cost_filled,
    amount,
    order_date,
    CASE WHEN carrier RLIKE '^(Kerry|FedEx)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN carrier RLIKE '^(DHL|Flash)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS carrier_zone
FROM enriched
ORDER BY order_id DESC

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("shipped_date", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("order_status", "order_id").orderBy("amount", "id")

joined = (
    df_shipments
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("b.channel"))
)

scored = (
    joined
    .withColumn("prev_cost", F.lag("cost").over(w))
    .withColumn("next_cost", F.lead("cost").over(w))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w))
    .withColumn("last_known_cost", F.last("cost", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
)

base = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("delivered_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-10-04")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("cost", F.lit(0)).alias("cost_filled"),
        F.add_months("shipped_date", 12).alias("shipped_date_plus_months"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.order_id",
        "src.carrier",
        "src.status",
        "src.next_cost",
        "src.last_known_cost",
        "src.cost_filled",
        "src.shipped_date_plus_months",
        F.col("d.amount"),
        F.col("d.order_date"),
        F.col("d.status").alias("order_status"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

cleaned = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("next_cost_band", F.when(F.col("next_cost") >= 93, "High").when(F.col("next_cost") >= 48, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("weeks_shipped_date_plus_months_to_order_date", (F.datediff("order_date", "shipped_date_plus_months") / 7))
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("src.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("o.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("o.status").alias("order_status_2"),
        F.col("o.order_date").alias("order_order_date"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "status",
        "next_cost",
        "last_known_cost",
        "cost_filled",
        "amount",
        "order_date",
        F.when(F.col("carrier").rlike("^(Kerry|FedEx)$"), "GROUP_B").when(F.col("carrier").rlike("^(DHL|Flash)$"), "EXTENDED").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("carrier_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("order_id").desc())
)
```

with flagged as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(event_time) over (partition by session_id order by event_time asc, id asc) is null
                 or event_time > lag(event_time) over (partition by session_id order by event_time asc, id asc) + interval '30' day then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from web_events
),
sessionized as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(is_new_session) over (partition by session_id order by event_time asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id_2
    from flagged
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        duration_sec,
        session_id_2,
        min(session_id_2) over (partition by session_id order by event_time asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_min_session_id_2,
        sum(session_id_2) over (partition by session_id order by event_time asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_sum_session_id_2,
        count(session_id_2) over (partition by session_id order by event_time asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_count_session_id_2,
        max(session_id_2) over (partition by session_id order by event_time asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_max_session_id_2
    from sessionized
    where duration_sec is not null
),
ranked as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select
        id,
        session_id,
        duration_sec,
        session_id_2,
        running_count_session_id_2
    from enriched
    qualify rank() over (partition by session_id, event_type order by session_id_2 desc) = 1
),
valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        duration_sec * session_id_2 as duration_sec_times_session_id_2,
        cast(running_count_session_id_2 as string) as running_count_session_id_2_str
    from ranked
    where duration_sec >= 368
),
with_dims as (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    select
        e.*,
        b.browser,
        b.country
    from valid e
    join sessions b
        on e.session_id = b.id
)
select
    id,
    session_id,
    running_count_session_id_2,
    duration_sec_times_session_id_2,
    browser,
    country
from with_dims
order by duration_sec_times_session_id_2 asc nulls first
reference:

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("session_id", "event_type").orderBy(F.col("session_id_2").desc())

flagged = (
    df_web_events
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = flagged.withColumn("session_id_2", F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2))

enriched = (
    sessionized
    .filter(F.col("duration_sec").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "duration_sec",
        "session_id_2",
        F.min("session_id_2").over(w2).alias("running_min_session_id_2"),
        F.sum("session_id_2").over(w2).alias("running_sum_session_id_2"),
        F.count("session_id_2").over(w2).alias("running_count_session_id_2"),
        F.max("session_id_2").over(w2).alias("running_max_session_id_2"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "duration_sec",
        "session_id_2",
        "running_count_session_id_2",
    )
)

valid = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("duration_sec") >= 368)
    .withColumn("duration_sec_times_session_id_2", (F.col("duration_sec") * F.col("session_id_2")))
    .withColumn("running_count_session_id_2_str", F.col("running_count_session_id_2").cast("string"))
)

with_dims = (
    valid
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("b"), F.col("e.session_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.browser"), F.col("b.country"))
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "running_count_session_id_2",
        "duration_sec_times_session_id_2",
        "browser",
        "country",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_times_session_id_2").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

sql:
with with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        lead(revenue) over w_hist as next_revenue,
        lead(units) over w_hist as next_units,
        lag(units) over w_hist as prev_units,
        row_number() over w_hist as row_seq,
        sum(units) over (partition by store_id order by units, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_units
    from store_sales
    window w_hist as (partition by product_id order by units, id)
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select store_id
    from with_windows
    intersect
    select store_id
    from store_sales
    where product_id = 6
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from with_windows s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.store_id = k.store_id
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    select
        src.*,
        s.opened_date,
        s.store_name,
        s.region
    from verified src
    inner join stores s
        on src.store_id = s.id
    where s.region not in ('North', 'East', 'West')
),
base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        next_revenue,
        next_units,
        prev_units,
        row_seq,
        opened_date,
        store_name,
        region,
        units + next_units as units_plus_next_units
    from enriched
    where sale_date > to_date('2023-08-02')
      and region is not null
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select *, rank() over (order by units) as units_rank
    from base
)
select
    s.product_id,
    s.sale_date,
    s.units,
    s.next_revenue,
    s.next_units,
    s.opened_date,
    s.store_name,
    s.region,
    s.units_plus_next_units,
    case when store_name rlike '^(Airport Kiosk|Downtown Express)$' then 'GROUP_B' when store_name rlike '^(Siam Flagship|Mall Central)$' then 'OTHER_ZONE' else 'EXTENDED' end as store_name_zone,
    (select max(t2.quantity) from inventory t2 where t2.product_id = s.product_id) as max_inventory_quantity
from scored s
order by next_revenue nulls first
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("units", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("units", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("units")
quantity_by_product_id = df_inventory.groupBy("product_id").agg(F.max("quantity").alias("max_inventory_quantity"))

with_windows = (
    df_store_sales
    .withColumn("next_revenue", F.lead("revenue").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("next_units", F.lead("units").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("prev_units", F.lag("units").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("running_units", F.sum("units").over(w2))
)

matched_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("store_id")
    .intersect(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("product_id") == 6)
        .select("store_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    verified
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("src.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .filter(~F.col("s.region").isin(["North", "East", "West"]))
    .select("src.*", F.col("s.opened_date"), F.col("s.store_name"), F.col("s.region"))
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter((F.col("sale_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-08-02"))) & F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "units",
        "next_revenue",
        "next_units",
        "prev_units",
        "row_seq",
        "opened_date",
        "store_name",
        "region",
        (F.col("units") + F.col("next_units")).alias("units_plus_next_units"),
    )
)

scored = base.withColumn("units_rank", F.rank().over(w3))

result = (
    scored
    .join(quantity_by_product_id, on="product_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "units",
        "next_revenue",
        "next_units",
        "opened_date",
        "store_name",
        "region",
        "units_plus_next_units",
        F.when(F.col("store_name").rlike("^(Airport Kiosk|Downtown Express)$"), "GROUP_B").when(F.col("store_name").rlike("^(Siam Flagship|Mall Central)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("store_name_zone"),
        F.col("max_inventory_quantity"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("next_revenue").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(discount_pct * 0.85, 2) AS adjusted_discount_pct,
        COALESCE(channel, 'NONE') AS channel_clean
    FROM promotions
    WHERE channel IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'web'
      AND channel = 'web'
),
filtered_promotions AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        promo_code,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        channel_clean,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), ends_on) / 30 AS months_since_ends_on,
        COALESCE(channel, 'UNKNOWN') AS channel_clean_2
    FROM filtered
    WHERE channel IS NOT NULL
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT promo_code, id
    FROM filtered_promotions
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT promo_code, id
    FROM promotions
    WHERE promo_code IN ('WELCOME5', 'VIP')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered_promotions s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.promo_code = k.promo_code AND s.id = k.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        promo_code,
        ends_on,
        channel_clean_2,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY months_since_ends_on DESC NULLS LAST) AS months_since_ends_on_rank,
        ROUND(discount_pct / SUM(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code), 4) AS discount_pct_share
    FROM kept_rows
    WHERE promo_code = 'BUNDLE'
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        promo_code,
        ends_on,
        channel_clean_2,
        months_since_ends_on_rank,
        discount_pct_share,
        ROUND(months_since_ends_on_rank / SUM(months_since_ends_on_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code), 4) AS months_since_ends_on_rank_share,
        MAX(discount_pct_share) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('week', ends_on)) AS ends_on_period_max_discount_pct_share
    FROM scored
),
scored_promotions AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(months_since_ends_on_rank_share) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', ends_on), promo_code) AS ends_on_period_count_months_since_ends_on_rank_share,
        COUNT(discount_pct_share) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code) AS promo_code_count_discount_pct_share,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(ends_on), promo_code ORDER BY months_since_ends_on_rank_share) AS months_since_ends_on_rank_share_dense_rank,
        STDDEV_SAMP(ends_on_period_max_discount_pct_share) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(ends_on), promo_code) AS ends_on_year_stddev_samp_ends_on_period_max_discount_pct_share,
        STDDEV_SAMP(months_since_ends_on_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code) AS promo_code_stddev_samp_months_since_ends_on_rank
    FROM metrics
)
SELECT
    promo_code,
    ends_on,
    channel_clean_2,
    months_since_ends_on_rank,
    discount_pct_share,
    months_since_ends_on_rank_share,
    ends_on_period_max_discount_pct_share,
    ends_on_period_count_months_since_ends_on_rank_share,
    promo_code_count_discount_pct_share
FROM scored_promotions
ORDER BY promo_code DESC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy(F.col("months_since_ends_on").desc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code")
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "ends_on"))
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "ends_on"), "promo_code")
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("ends_on"), "promo_code").orderBy("months_since_ends_on_rank_share")
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("ends_on"), "promo_code")

filtered = (
    df_promotions
    .filter((F.col("channel").eqNullSafe(F.lit("web"))) & (F.col("channel") == "web"))
    .withColumn("adjusted_discount_pct", F.round((F.col("discount_pct") * 0.85), 2))
    .withColumn("channel_clean", F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("NONE")))
)

filtered_promotions = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "promo_code",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "channel_clean",
        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "ends_on") / 30).alias("months_since_ends_on"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("channel_clean_2"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    filtered_promotions
    .select("promo_code", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_promotions
        .filter(F.col("promo_code").isin(["WELCOME5", "VIP"]))
        .select("promo_code", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    filtered_promotions
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.promo_code") == F.col("k.promo_code")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("promo_code") == "BUNDLE")
    .select(
        "id",
        "promo_code",
        "ends_on",
        "channel_clean_2",
        F.rank().over(w).alias("months_since_ends_on_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("discount_pct") / F.sum("discount_pct").over(w2)), 4).alias("discount_pct_share"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .select(
        "promo_code",
        "ends_on",
        "channel_clean_2",
        "months_since_ends_on_rank",
        "discount_pct_share",
        F.round((F.col("months_since_ends_on_rank") / F.sum("months_since_ends_on_rank").over(w2)), 4).alias("months_since_ends_on_rank_share"),
        F.max("discount_pct_share").over(w3).alias("ends_on_period_max_discount_pct_share"),
    )
)

scored_promotions = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("months_since_ends_on_rank_share").over(w4).alias("ends_on_period_count_months_since_ends_on_rank_share"),
        F.count("discount_pct_share").over(w2).alias("promo_code_count_discount_pct_share"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("months_since_ends_on_rank_share_dense_rank"),
        F.stddev_samp("ends_on_period_max_discount_pct_share").over(w6).alias("ends_on_year_stddev_samp_ends_on_period_max_discount_pct_share"),
        F.stddev_samp("months_since_ends_on_rank").over(w2).alias("promo_code_stddev_samp_months_since_ends_on_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_promotions
    .select(
        "promo_code",
        "ends_on",
        "channel_clean_2",
        "months_since_ends_on_rank",
        "discount_pct_share",
        "months_since_ends_on_rank_share",
        "ends_on_period_max_discount_pct_share",
        "ends_on_period_count_months_since_ends_on_rank_share",
        "promo_code_count_discount_pct_share",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("promo_code").desc())
)
```

cleaned as (

        *,

    from exploded

        percent_rank() over (order by product_id nulls last) as product_id_percent_rank,
        count(product_id) over (partition by promo) as promo_count_product_id,
        round(qty / sum(qty) over (partition by promo), 4) as qty_share_2
    from cleaned
),
with_windows_carts as (
    select *, rank() over (order by qty_cume_dist) as qty_cume_dist_rank
    from with_windows
),
with_windows_carts_2 as (
    select
        *,
        rank() over (order by qty_cume_dist_rank desc nulls first) as qty_cume_dist_rank_rank,
        rank() over (order by qty_share_2 desc) as qty_share_2_rank,
        cume_dist() over (order by product_id desc nulls last) as product_id_cume_dist
    from with_windows_carts
),
cleaned_carts as (
    select
        product_id,
        qty,
        qty_cume_dist,
        qty_share,
        product_id_percent_rank,
        qty_share_2,
        qty_cume_dist_rank,
        qty_cume_dist_rank_rank,
        qty_share_2_rank,
        cast(qty_share_2_rank as string) as qty_share_2_rank_num,
        qty_share_2_rank - product_id_cume_dist as qty_share_2_rank_minus_product_id_cume_dist
    from with_windows_carts_2
    where qty_cume_dist_rank > 3
),
valid as (
    select
        *,
        qty_share_2_rank + qty_share_2_rank_minus_product_id_cume_dist as qty_share_2_rank_plus_qty_share_2_rank_minus_product_id_cume_dist,
        coalesce(qty_share, 0) as qty_share_filled
    from cleaned_carts
    where qty_share_2_rank_minus_product_id_cume_dist between 26 and 63
)
select

    qty_share,
    qty_share_2,

from valid

```python
w = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty").asc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("promo")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("product_id").asc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.orderBy("qty_cume_dist")
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty_cume_dist_rank").desc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty_share_2").desc())
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("product_id").desc_nulls_last())

exploded = (
    df_carts
    .withColumn("item", F.explode("items"))
    .select("id", F.col("item.product_id"), F.col("item.qty"), F.col("item.promo"))

cleaned = (

    .filter(F.col("promo") == "BUNDLE")
    .withColumn("promo_group", F.when(F.col("promo").isin(["VIP", "WELCOME5"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other"))
    .withColumn("promo_filled", F.coalesce("promo", F.lit("N/A")))

with_windows = (

    .select(

        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("product_id_percent_rank"),
        F.count("product_id").over(w2).alias("promo_count_product_id"),
        F.round((F.col("qty") / F.sum("qty").over(w2)), 4).alias("qty_share_2"),
    )
)

with_windows_carts = with_windows.withColumn("qty_cume_dist_rank", F.rank().over(w4))

with_windows_carts_2 = (
    with_windows_carts
    .withColumn("qty_cume_dist_rank_rank", F.rank().over(w5))
    .withColumn("qty_share_2_rank", F.rank().over(w6))
    .withColumn("product_id_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w7))
)

cleaned_carts = (
    with_windows_carts_2
    .filter(F.col("qty_cume_dist_rank") > 3)
    .select(

        "qty_share",
        "product_id_percent_rank",
        "qty_share_2",
        "qty_cume_dist_rank",
        "qty_cume_dist_rank_rank",
        "qty_share_2_rank",

        (F.col("qty_share_2_rank") - F.col("product_id_cume_dist")).alias("qty_share_2_rank_minus_product_id_cume_dist"),
    )
)

valid = (
    cleaned_carts
    .filter(F.col("qty_share_2_rank_minus_product_id_cume_dist").between(26, 63))
    .withColumn("qty_share_2_rank_plus_qty_share_2_rank_minus_product_id_cume_dist", (F.col("qty_share_2_rank") + F.col("qty_share_2_rank_minus_product_id_cume_dist")))
    .withColumn("qty_share_filled", F.coalesce("qty_share", F.lit(0)))
)

result = (
```

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT_WS('-', promo_code, channel) AS promo_code_channel_key,
        COALESCE(channel, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_channel
    FROM promotions
    WHERE discount_pct BETWEEN 0.14 AND 0.15
      AND ends_on > DATE '2023-12-08'
),
with_window AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        s.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM valid s
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON s.channel <=> pr.channel
       AND s.starts_on BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        promo_code,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        promo_code_channel_key,
        resolved_channel,
        promo_id,
        promotion_promo_code,
        COUNT(promo_id) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY discount_pct, id, promo_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_promo_id,
        SUM(promo_id) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY discount_pct, id, promo_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_promo_id,
        MAX(promo_id) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY discount_pct, id, promo_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_promo_id,
        AVG(promo_id) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY discount_pct, id, promo_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_promo_id
    FROM with_window
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY promotion_promo_code ORDER BY running_avg_promo_id DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
        FROM metrics
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(running_avg_promo_id) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY running_count_promo_id, id, promo_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_running_avg_promo_id,
        AVG(running_avg_promo_id) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY running_count_promo_id, id, promo_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_running_avg_promo_id,
        SUM(running_avg_promo_id) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY running_count_promo_id, id, promo_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_running_avg_promo_id,
        COUNT(running_avg_promo_id) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY running_count_promo_id, id, promo_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_running_avg_promo_id,
        AVG(running_count_promo_id) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY ends_on, id, promo_id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS running_count_promo_id_avg_3_prior
    FROM ranked
),
grouped AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN running_avg_promo_id >= 10.4 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS running_avg_promo_id_tier,
        promo_id,
        CASE WHEN discount_pct >= 0.27 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS discount_pct_tier,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN promotion_promo_code = 'VIP' THEN 1 END) AS vip_count,
        COUNT_IF(promotion_promo_code = 'BUNDLE') AS bundle_events,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(promo_code)) AS promo_code_list,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(promotion_promo_code)) AS num_promotion_promo_codes
    FROM scored
    GROUP BY running_avg_promo_id_tier, promo_id, discount_pct_tier
    HAVING SIZE(COLLECT_SET(promotion_promo_code)) >= 1
)
SELECT
    running_avg_promo_id_tier,
    promo_id,
    discount_pct_tier,
    bundle_events,
    promo_code_list,
    num_promotion_promo_codes
FROM grouped
ORDER BY discount_pct_tier;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy("discount_pct", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("promotion_promo_code").orderBy(F.col("running_avg_promo_id").desc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("running_count_promo_id", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("ends_on", "id", "promo_id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)

valid = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(F.col("discount_pct").between(0.14, 0.15) & (F.col("ends_on") > F.lit("2023-12-08").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat_ws("-", "promo_code", "channel").alias("promo_code_channel_key"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("resolved_channel"),
    )
)

with_window = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("s.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & F.col("s.starts_on").between(F.col("pr.starts_on"), F.col("pr.ends_on")), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_window
    .select(
        "id",
        "promo_code",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "promo_code_channel_key",
        "resolved_channel",
        "promo_id",
        "promotion_promo_code",
        F.count("promo_id").over(w).alias("running_count_promo_id"),
        F.sum("promo_id").over(w).alias("running_sum_promo_id"),
        F.max("promo_id").over(w).alias("running_max_promo_id"),
        F.avg("promo_id").over(w).alias("running_avg_promo_id"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

scored = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("running_max_running_avg_promo_id", F.max("running_avg_promo_id").over(w3))
    .withColumn("running_avg_running_avg_promo_id", F.avg("running_avg_promo_id").over(w3))
    .withColumn("running_sum_running_avg_promo_id", F.sum("running_avg_promo_id").over(w3))
    .withColumn("running_count_running_avg_promo_id", F.count("running_avg_promo_id").over(w3))
    .withColumn("running_count_promo_id_avg_3_prior", F.avg("running_count_promo_id").over(w4))
)

grouped = (
    scored
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("running_avg_promo_id") >= 10.4, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("running_avg_promo_id_tier"),
        "promo_id",
        F.when(F.col("discount_pct") >= 0.27, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("discount_pct_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("promotion_promo_code") == "VIP", 1)).alias("vip_count"),
        F.count_if(F.col("promotion_promo_code") == "BUNDLE").alias("bundle_events"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("promo_code")).alias("promo_code_list"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("promotion_promo_code")).alias("num_promotion_promo_codes"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_promotion_promo_codes") >= 1)
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "running_avg_promo_id_tier",
        "promo_id",
        "discount_pct_tier",
        "bundle_events",
        "promo_code_list",
        "num_promotion_promo_codes",
    )
    .orderBy("discount_pct_tier")
)
```

with joined as (
    select s.*, b.job_title as employee_job_title
    from employees s
    left join employees b
        on s.manager_id = b.id
),
enriched as (
    select
        s.*,
        d.level as employee_level,
        d.salary as employee_salary
    from joined s
    join employees d
        on s.manager_id = d.id
),
kept_keys as (
    select id
    from enriched
    intersect all
    select id
    from employees
    where year(hire_date) >= 2024
),
verified as (
    select s.*
    from enriched s
    join kept_keys k on s.id = k.id
),
cleaned as (
    select *, trim(employee_level) clean_employee_level
    from verified
    where employee_level in ('L3', 'L2')
),
scored as (
    select
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        level,
        employee_salary,
        clean_employee_level,
        round(salary / sum(salary) over (partition by employee_job_title), 4) salary_share,
        cume_dist() over (order by salary asc) salary_cume_dist
    from cleaned
),
scored_employees as (
    select
        *,
        round(employee_salary / sum(employee_salary) over (partition by dept_id, level), 4) employee_salary_share,
        cume_dist() over (order by salary desc) salary_cume_dist_2,
        dense_rank() over (partition by level order by salary_cume_dist asc) salary_cume_dist_dense_rank,
        rank() over (partition by dept_id order by salary_cume_dist desc nulls last) salary_cume_dist_rank
    from scored
    where job_title != 'Analyst'
),
metrics as (
    select *, percent_rank() over (partition by level order by salary_cume_dist_2 desc nulls last) salary_cume_dist_2_percent_rank
    from scored_employees
)
select
    full_name,
    email,
    job_title,
    salary,
    level,
    employee_salary,
    clean_employee_level,
    salary_share,
    salary_cume_dist,
    case when full_name rlike '^(Grace Kim|Emma Brown)$' then 'CORE' when full_name rlike '^(Alice Wong|bob smith)$' then 'PRIORITY' else 'OTHER_ZONE' end as full_name_zone
from metrics
order by full_name_zone desc

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("employee_job_title")
w2 = Window.orderBy("salary")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id", "level")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("salary").desc())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("salary_cume_dist")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy(F.col("salary_cume_dist").desc_nulls_last())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("salary_cume_dist_2").desc_nulls_last())

joined = (
    df_employees
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("b"), F.col("s.manager_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("b.job_title").alias("employee_job_title"))
)

enriched = (
    joined
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("d"), F.col("s.manager_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("d.level").alias("employee_level"),
        F.col("d.salary").alias("employee_salary"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_employees
        .filter(F.year("hire_date") >= 2024)
        .select("id")
    )
)

verified = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("employee_level").isin(["L3", "L2"]))
    .withColumn("clean_employee_level", F.trim("employee_level"))
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "job_title",
        "salary",
        "level",
        "employee_salary",
        "clean_employee_level",
        F.round((F.col("salary") / F.sum("salary").over(w)), 4).alias("salary_share"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("salary_cume_dist"),
    )
)

scored_employees = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("job_title") != "Analyst")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("employee_salary") / F.sum("employee_salary").over(w3)), 4).alias("employee_salary_share"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w4).alias("salary_cume_dist_2"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("salary_cume_dist_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w6).alias("salary_cume_dist_rank"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored_employees
    .select("*", F.percent_rank().over(w7).alias("salary_cume_dist_2_percent_rank"))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "job_title",
        "salary",
        "level",
        "employee_salary",
        "clean_employee_level",
        "salary_share",
        "salary_cume_dist",
        F.when(F.col("full_name").rlike("^(Grace Kim|Emma Brown)$"), "CORE").when(F.col("full_name").rlike("^(Alice Wong|bob smith)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("full_name_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("full_name_zone").desc())
)
```

WITH remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT order_id
    FROM shipments
    INTERSECT
    SELECT order_id
    FROM shipments
    WHERE carrier IN ('UPS', 'FedEx', 'Kerry')
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM shipments s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.order_id = k.order_id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        RANK() OVER w_grp AS cost_rank,
        MIN(cost) OVER w_running AS carrier_min_cost,
        MIN(cost) OVER w_running AS carrier_min_cost_2
    FROM kept_rows
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY cost), w_running AS (PARTITION BY carrier)
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.orderBy("cost")

    .select("order_id")
    .intersect(

        .filter(F.col("carrier").isin(["UPS", "FedEx", "Kerry"]))

    )
)

    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")), "inner")

)

enriched = (
    kept_rows
    .select(
        "id",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        F.rank().over(w_grp).alias("cost_rank"),
        F.min("cost").over(w_running).alias("carrier_min_cost"),
        F.min("cost").over(w_running).alias("carrier_min_cost_2"),
    )
)

base = (

    .filter(F.col("delivered_date").between("2023-08-01", "2025-01-01"))

    .withColumn("cost_rank_num_int", F.col("cost_rank_num").cast("int"))

)

    .groupBy(
```

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT id, discount_pct
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code, channel ORDER BY ends_on DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM promotions
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(discount_pct) OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_count_discount_pct,
        SUM(discount_pct) OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_sum_discount_pct,
        MAX(discount_pct) OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_max_discount_pct
    FROM latest
    WHERE discount_pct < 0.31
),
base AS (
    SELECT *, CAST(last7_count_discount_pct AS DOUBLE) AS last7_count_discount_pct_num
    FROM enriched
    WHERE last7_sum_discount_pct < 1.58
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM base
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM promotions
    WHERE discount_pct >= 0.12
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
valid AS (
    SELECT *, last7_count_discount_pct_num - last7_max_discount_pct AS last7_count_discount_pct_num_minus_last7_max_discount_pct
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE last7_count_discount_pct BETWEEN 8 AND 10
)
SELECT
    id,
    discount_pct,
    last7_count_discount_pct,
    last7_count_discount_pct_num,
    last7_count_discount_pct_num_minus_last7_max_discount_pct,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY last7_sum_discount_pct) AS last7_sum_discount_pct_percent_rank,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY last7_count_discount_pct_num_minus_last7_max_discount_pct DESC NULLS LAST) AS last7_count_discount_pct_num_minus_last7_max_discount_pct_percent_rank,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY last7_count_discount_pct_num DESC NULLS LAST) AS last7_count_discount_pct_num_cume_dist,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY last7_count_discount_pct_num DESC NULLS LAST) AS last7_count_discount_pct_num_cume_dist_2,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY discount_pct) AS discount_pct_cume_dist
FROM valid;

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("promo_code", "channel").orderBy(F.col("ends_on").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("last7_sum_discount_pct")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("last7_count_discount_pct_num_minus_last7_max_discount_pct").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("last7_count_discount_pct_num").desc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.orderBy("discount_pct")

latest = (
    df_promotions
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "discount_pct")
)

enriched = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("discount_pct") < 0.31)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("discount_pct").over(w2).alias("last7_count_discount_pct"),
        F.sum("discount_pct").over(w2).alias("last7_sum_discount_pct"),
        F.max("discount_pct").over(w2).alias("last7_max_discount_pct"),
    )
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("last7_sum_discount_pct") < 1.58)
    .withColumn("last7_count_discount_pct_num", F.col("last7_count_discount_pct").cast("double"))
)

matched_keys = (
    base
    .select("id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_promotions
        .filter(F.col("discount_pct") >= 0.12)
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("last7_count_discount_pct").between(8, 10))
    .withColumn("last7_count_discount_pct_num_minus_last7_max_discount_pct", (F.col("last7_count_discount_pct_num") - F.col("last7_max_discount_pct")))
)

result = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "discount_pct",
        "last7_count_discount_pct",
        "last7_count_discount_pct_num",
        "last7_count_discount_pct_num_minus_last7_max_discount_pct",
        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("last7_sum_discount_pct_percent_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w4).alias("last7_count_discount_pct_num_minus_last7_max_discount_pct_percent_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w5).alias("last7_count_discount_pct_num_cume_dist"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w5).alias("last7_count_discount_pct_num_cume_dist_2"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w6).alias("discount_pct_cume_dist"),
    )
)
```

sql:
WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        currency,
        EXPLODE_OUTER(tier_prices) AS tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, currency
    FROM exploded
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id, currency
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE plan = 'enterprise'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM exploded s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.currency = k.currency
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN tier_value >= 69 THEN 'High' WHEN tier_value >= 20 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS tier_value_band
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE tier_value BETWEEN 54 AND 74
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, LENGTH(currency) AS currency_length
    FROM filtered
    WHERE tier_value <= 67
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    currency,
    CASE WHEN currency_length >= 70 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS currency_length_tier,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(currency)) AS currency_list,
    ROUND(AVG(currency_length), 2) AS avg_currency_length
FROM valid
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((currency, CASE WHEN currency_length >= 70 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END), (currency), ());
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "currency", F.explode_outer("tier_prices").alias("tier_value"))
)

remaining_keys = (
    exploded
    .select("id", "currency")
    .subtract(
        df_price_tiers
        .filter(F.col("plan") == "enterprise")
        .select("id", "currency")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    exploded
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.currency") == F.col("k.currency")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("tier_value").between(54, 74))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("tier_value") >= 69, "High").when(F.col("tier_value") >= 20, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("tier_value_band"),
    )
)

valid = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("tier_value") <= 67)
    .withColumn("currency_length", F.length("currency"))
)

result = (
    valid
    .withColumn("currency_length_tier", F.when(F.col("currency_length") >= 70, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["currency", "currency_length_tier"], ["currency"], []],
        "currency",
        "currency_length_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("currency")).alias("currency_list"),
        F.round(F.avg("currency_length"), 2).alias("avg_currency_length"),
    )
)
```

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        status,
        CONCAT(status, ' ', carrier) AS status_carrier,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_carrier
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date >= TO_DATE('2023-06-24')
      AND carrier IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'Flash'
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY shipped_date DESC, id) AS seq_no,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY delivered_date, id) AS event_seq,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY shipped_date, id) AS row_seq
FROM base
WHERE YEAR(delivered_date) >= 2025;

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("shipped_date").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("delivered_date", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("shipped_date", "id")

base = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-24"))) & (F.col("carrier").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Flash"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "status",
        F.concat("status", F.lit(" "), "carrier").alias("status_carrier"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_carrier"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .filter(F.year("delivered_date") >= 2025)
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w3))
)
```

    SELECT
        *,
        TRIM(store_name) AS clean_store_name,
        COALESCE(region, 'OTHER') AS region_clean
    FROM stores
    WHERE city = 'Singapore'
),
kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders x
            WHERE x.store_id = s.id
              AND x.order_date >= s.opened_date
        )
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, region ORDER BY sqft DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM kept
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY latest_rank DESC, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM deduped
    ) x
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        region,
        latest_rank,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY sqft DESC, id) AS sqft_bucket,
        LAG(sqft, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY dedup_rank, id) AS prev_sqft
    FROM latest
    WHERE region = 'South'
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    region,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(region)) AS num_regions,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE region = 'North') AS north_rows,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(region)) AS region_list,
    AVG(prev_sqft) AS avg_prev_sqft,
    COUNT_IF(region = 'East') AS east_events
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY num_regions

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city", "region").orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("latest_rank").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("dedup_rank", "id")

valid = (
    df_stores
    .filter(F.col("city") == "Singapore")
    .withColumn("clean_store_name", F.trim("store_name"))
    .withColumn("region_clean", F.coalesce("region", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

kept = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("x"), (F.col("x.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.order_date") >= F.col("s.opened_date")), "left_semi")
)

deduped = (
    kept
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

latest = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("region") == "South")
    .select(
        "id",
        "region",
        "latest_rank",
        F.ntile(3).over(w3).alias("sqft_bucket"),
        F.lag("sqft", 2).over(w4).alias("prev_sqft"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy("region")
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("region")).alias("num_regions"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("region") == "North", 1)).alias("north_rows"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("region")).alias("region_list"),
        F.avg("prev_sqft").alias("avg_prev_sqft"),
        F.count_if(F.col("region") == "East").alias("east_events"),
    )
    .orderBy("num_regions")
)
```

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        level,
        key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) t AS key, v
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        level,
        key,
        v,
        UPPER(service) AS service_upper
    FROM exploded
    WHERE key IS DISTINCT FROM 'trace'
),
filtered_app_logs AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, COALESCE(key, 'Unknown') AS key_filled
    FROM filtered
    WHERE key IS NOT NULL
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT_WS(',', key, service) AS key_service_key,
        LENGTH(service) AS service_length,
        COALESCE(key, 'OTHER') AS key_filled_2
    FROM filtered_app_logs
    WHERE key IS NOT NULL
      AND key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'trace'
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        level,
        key,
        v,
        service_upper,
        key_filled,
        key_service_key,
        service_length,
        key_filled_2
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY service_length DESC, id, key) AS rn
        FROM cleaned
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    key,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(level)) AS num_levels,
    AVG(service_length) FILTER (WHERE level = 'DEBUG') AS debug_avg_service_length,
    SUM(CASE WHEN level = 'INFO' THEN service_length ELSE 0 END) AS info_service_length
FROM deduped
GROUP BY key
ORDER BY num_levels DESC NULLS LAST;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("service_length").desc(), "id", "key")

exploded = df_app_logs.select("id", "service", "level", F.explode("context").alias("key", "v"))

filtered = (
    exploded
    .filter(~F.col("key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("trace")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "level",
        "key",
        "v",
        F.upper("service").alias("service_upper"),
    )
)

filtered_app_logs = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("key").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.coalesce("key", F.lit("Unknown")).alias("key_filled"))
)

cleaned = (
    filtered_app_logs
    .filter(F.col("key").isNotNull() & (F.col("key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("trace"))))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat_ws(",", "key", "service").alias("key_service_key"),
        F.length("service").alias("service_length"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("key_filled_2"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "level",
        "key",
        "v",
        "service_upper",
        "key_filled",
        "key_service_key",
        "service_length",
        "key_filled_2",
    )
)

result = (
    deduped
    .groupBy("key")
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("level")).alias("num_levels"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("level") == "DEBUG", F.col("service_length"))).alias("debug_avg_service_length"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("level") == "INFO", F.col("service_length")).otherwise(0)).alias("info_service_length"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("num_levels").desc_nulls_last())
)
```
