with scored as (
    select
        *,
        count(cost) over (partition by order_id order by cost, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_count_cost,
        avg(cost) over (partition by order_id order by cost, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_avg_cost,
        sum(cost) over (partition by order_id order by cost, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_sum_cost
    from shipments
    where status = 'LOST'
),
joined as (
    select e.*, b.shipping_fee
    from scored e
    left join orders b
        on e.order_id = b.id
),
with_dims as (
    select
        e.*,
        p.amount,
        p.status as order_status
    from joined e
    left join orders p
        on e.order_id = p.id
),
scored_shipments as (
    select
        id,
        carrier,
        running_avg_cost,
        shipping_fee,
        amount,
        max(shipping_fee) over (partition by order_status, status order by running_sum_cost, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_max_shipping_fee,
        min(shipping_fee) over (partition by order_status, status order by running_sum_cost, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_min_shipping_fee,
        count(shipping_fee) over (partition by order_status, status order by running_sum_cost, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_count_shipping_fee,
        cume_dist() over (partition by status, order_id order by amount desc) as amount_cume_dist
    from with_dims
),
latest as (
    select *
    from scored_shipments
    qualify rank() over (partition by carrier order by running_avg_cost desc nulls first) = 1
)
select
    id,
    running_avg_cost,
    shipping_fee,
    ntile(5) over w_part as running_max_shipping_fee_bucket,
    round(running_avg_cost / sum(running_avg_cost) over (partition by carrier), 4) as running_avg_cost_share,
    avg(running_count_shipping_fee) over w_ordered as running_count_shipping_fee_avg_6_prior
from latest
window w_part as (partition by carrier order by running_max_shipping_fee, id), w_ordered as (partition by carrier order by running_max_shipping_fee, id rows between 6 preceding and 1 preceding);
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_status", "status").orderBy("running_sum_cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("running_avg_cost").desc_nulls_first())
w_part = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("running_max_shipping_fee", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("carrier")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("running_max_shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)

scored = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("status") == "LOST")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("cost").over(w).alias("running_count_cost"),
        F.avg("cost").over(w).alias("running_avg_cost"),
        F.sum("cost").over(w).alias("running_sum_cost"),
    )
)

joined = (
    scored
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.shipping_fee"))
)

with_dims = (
    joined
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("e.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("p.amount"), F.col("p.status").alias("order_status"))
)

scored_shipments = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "running_avg_cost",
        "shipping_fee",
        "amount",
        F.max("shipping_fee").over(w2).alias("running_max_shipping_fee"),
        F.min("shipping_fee").over(w2).alias("running_min_shipping_fee"),
        F.count("shipping_fee").over(w2).alias("running_count_shipping_fee"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w3).alias("amount_cume_dist"),
    )
)

latest = (
    scored_shipments
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

result = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "running_avg_cost",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.ntile(5).over(w_part).alias("running_max_shipping_fee_bucket"),
        F.round((F.col("running_avg_cost") / F.sum("running_avg_cost").over(w6)), 4).alias("running_avg_cost_share"),
        F.avg("running_count_shipping_fee").over(w_ordered).alias("running_count_shipping_fee_avg_6_prior"),
    )
)
```

sql:
with enriched as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        e.*,
        b.email,
        b.segment,
        b.signup_date
    from subscriptions e
    inner join customers b
        on e.customer_id = b.id
    where b.age < 54
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        avg(monthly_fee) over w_ordered as running_avg_monthly_fee,
        max(monthly_fee) over w_ordered as running_max_monthly_fee,
        sum(monthly_fee) over w_ordered as running_sum_monthly_fee,
        ntile(3) over w_part as monthly_fee_bucket
    from enriched
    window w_ordered as (partition by segment, plan order by monthly_fee asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row), w_part as (partition by status, segment order by monthly_fee desc, id asc)
),
enriched_subscriptions as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        running_avg_monthly_fee,
        monthly_fee_bucket,
        cume_dist() over (partition by customer_id, segment order by running_sum_monthly_fee asc) as running_sum_monthly_fee_cume_dist,
        avg(monthly_fee_bucket) over (partition by plan order by monthly_fee_bucket asc, id asc rows between 2 preceding and current row) as monthly_fee_bucket_avg_2,
        round(running_sum_monthly_fee / sum(running_sum_monthly_fee) over (partition by month(signup_date), customer_id), 4) as running_sum_monthly_fee_share,
        row_number() over (partition by segment order by running_sum_monthly_fee desc, id asc) as row_seq,
        lag(monthly_fee, 1) over (partition by segment order by end_date asc, id asc) as prev_monthly_fee
    from metrics
),
with_dims as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        e.*,
        p.email,
        p.signup_date as customer_signup_date
    from enriched_subscriptions e
    left join customers p
        on e.customer_id = p.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    customer_id,
    case when monthly_fee_bucket >= 7 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as monthly_fee_bucket_tier,
    approx_percentile(row_seq, 0.95) as row_seq_p95,
    sum(case when segment = 'Consumer' then running_sum_monthly_fee_share else 0 end) as consumer_running_sum_monthly_fee_share,
    round(sum(monthly_fee_bucket) / nullif(count(case when segment = 'Corporate' then 1 end), 0), 2) as monthly_fee_bucket_per_corporate
from with_dims
group by rollup (customer_id, case when monthly_fee_bucket >= 7 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end)
order by consumer_running_sum_monthly_fee_share desc nulls first;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("segment", "plan").orderBy("monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_part = Window.partitionBy("status", "segment").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "segment").orderBy("running_sum_monthly_fee")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("monthly_fee_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("signup_date"), "customer_id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy(F.col("running_sum_monthly_fee").desc(), "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy("end_date", "id")

enriched = (
    df_subscriptions
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("b.age") < 54)
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.email"), F.col("b.segment"), F.col("b.signup_date"))
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        F.avg("monthly_fee").over(w_ordered).alias("running_avg_monthly_fee"),
        F.max("monthly_fee").over(w_ordered).alias("running_max_monthly_fee"),
        F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w_ordered).alias("running_sum_monthly_fee"),
        F.ntile(3).over(w_part).alias("monthly_fee_bucket"),
    )
)

enriched_subscriptions = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        "running_avg_monthly_fee",
        "monthly_fee_bucket",
        F.cume_dist().over(w3).alias("running_sum_monthly_fee_cume_dist"),
        F.avg("monthly_fee_bucket").over(w4).alias("monthly_fee_bucket_avg_2"),
        F.round((F.col("running_sum_monthly_fee") / F.sum("running_sum_monthly_fee").over(w5)), 4).alias("running_sum_monthly_fee_share"),
        F.row_number().over(w6).alias("row_seq"),
        F.lag("monthly_fee", 1).over(w7).alias("prev_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    enriched_subscriptions
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("p.email"),
        F.col("p.signup_date").alias("customer_signup_date"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .rollup(
        "customer_id",
        F.when(F.col("monthly_fee_bucket") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("monthly_fee_bucket_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("row_seq", 0.95).alias("row_seq_p95"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Consumer", F.col("running_sum_monthly_fee_share")).otherwise(0)).alias("consumer_running_sum_monthly_fee_share"),
        F.round(F.sum("monthly_fee_bucket") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Corporate", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("monthly_fee_bucket_per_corporate"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("consumer_running_sum_monthly_fee_share").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

with valid as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        name,
        city,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        replace(email, ' ', '_') as email_slug
    from customers
    where age > 48
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id, segment
    from valid
    except all
    select id, segment
    from customers
    where credit_limit <= 13700
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from valid s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.id = k.id and s.segment = k.segment
),
not_flagged as (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from verified s
    where exists (
            select 1
            from orders ch
            where ch.customer_id = s.id
              and ch.order_date <= s.signup_date
        )
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        stddev_samp(credit_limit) over w_running as segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit,
        sum(credit_limit) over w_running as segment_sum_credit_limit,
        stddev_samp(credit_limit) over w_running as segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit_2
    from not_flagged
    window w_running as (partition by segment)
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features

        city,

        signup_date,
        is_active,
        credit_limit,
        stddev_samp(segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit_2) over (partition by date_trunc('WEEK', signup_date), segment) as signup_date_period_stddev_samp_segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit_2,
        round(segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit_2 / sum(segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit_2) over (partition by city), 4) as segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit_2_share
    from with_windows
)
select
    id,
    is_active,
    credit_limit,
    signup_date_period_stddev_samp_segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit_2,
    segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit_2_share

not_flagged = (

    )
)

result = (

        "is_active",
        "credit_limit",
        "signup_date_period_stddev_samp_segment_stddev_samp_credit_limit_2",

        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY cost NULLS FIRST) cost_percent_rank,
        ROUND(cost / SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY category), 4) cost_share
    FROM base
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        brand,
        cost,
        launch_date,
        tags,
        category_brand_key,
        running_cost,
        cost_percent_rank,
        CEIL(cost_share) cost_share_whole,
        ROUND(cost_share, 0) cost_share_rounded
    FROM scored
    WHERE running_cost BETWEEN 2000 AND 2779
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY cost_percent_rank DESC, id) AS rn
    FROM filtered
    QUALIFY rn = 1
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', launch_date) AS activity_month,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'Books' THEN 1 END) AS books_count,
    AVG(cost_share_whole) FILTER (WHERE brand = 'Umbrella') AS umbrella_avg_cost_share_whole,
    COUNT(DISTINCT brand) AS distinct_brands,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(brand)) AS num_brands,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    MAX(running_cost) AS max_running_cost
FROM latest
GROUP BY activity_month
ORDER BY books_count DESC NULLS LAST;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("launch_date", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("brand", "category").orderBy("launch_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy(F.col("cost").asc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("category")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy(F.col("cost_percent_rank").desc(), "id")

base = (
    df_products
    .filter(F.col("supplier_id").isNull() & (F.col("launch_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-28"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "category",
        "brand",
        "cost",
        "launch_date",
        "tags",
        F.concat_ws(",", "category", "brand").alias("category_brand_key"),
    )
)

scored = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("cost").over(w).alias("cost_avg_3"),
        F.sum("cost").over(w2).alias("running_cost"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("cost_percent_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("cost") / F.sum("cost").over(w4)), 4).alias("cost_share"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("running_cost").between(2000, 2779))
    .select(
        "id",
        "category",
        "brand",
        "cost",
        "launch_date",
        "tags",
        "category_brand_key",
        "running_cost",
        "cost_percent_rank",
        F.ceil("cost_share").alias("cost_share_whole"),
        F.round("cost_share", 0).alias("cost_share_rounded"),
    )
)

latest = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

result = (
    latest
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "launch_date").alias("activity_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("category") == "Books", 1)).alias("books_count"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("brand") == "Umbrella", F.col("cost_share_whole"))).alias("umbrella_avg_cost_share_whole"),
        F.countDistinct("brand").alias("distinct_brands"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("brand")).alias("num_brands"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.max("running_cost").alias("max_running_cost"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("books_count").desc_nulls_last())
)

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        pos,
        item.product_id,
        item.price,
        item.promo
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(items) li AS pos, item
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        pos,
        SUM(pos) OVER w_ordered AS running_sum_pos,
        MAX(pos) OVER w_ordered AS running_max_pos,
        AVG(pos) OVER w_ordered AS running_avg_pos,
        MIN(pos) OVER w_ordered AS running_min_pos
    FROM flattened
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY customer_id, promo ORDER BY price, id, pos ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        pos,
        running_sum_pos,
        running_max_pos,
        running_avg_pos,
        running_min_pos,
        SUM(pos) OVER w_hist AS running_sum_pos_2,
        AVG(pos) OVER w_hist AS running_avg_pos_2,
        COUNT(pos) OVER w_hist AS running_count_pos,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pos, id, pos) AS event_seq
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY running_avg_pos, id, pos ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
metrics_carts AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(running_max_pos) OVER (ORDER BY running_min_pos, id, pos ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_count_running_max_pos,
        SUM(running_max_pos) OVER (ORDER BY running_min_pos, id, pos ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_sum_running_max_pos,
        AVG(running_max_pos) OVER (ORDER BY running_min_pos, id, pos ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_avg_running_max_pos
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE event_seq < 5
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(running_sum_pos_2) OVER (ORDER BY event_seq, id, pos ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_running_sum_pos_2,
        SUM(running_sum_pos_2) OVER (ORDER BY event_seq, id, pos ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_running_sum_pos_2,
        COUNT(running_sum_pos_2) OVER (ORDER BY event_seq, id, pos ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_running_sum_pos_2
    FROM metrics_carts
)
SELECT
    id,
    pos,
    running_min_pos,
    running_avg_pos_2,
    running_count_pos,
    event_seq,
    last7_sum_running_max_pos,
    last7_avg_running_max_pos,
    running_sum_running_sum_pos_2
FROM enriched;

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "promo").orderBy("price", "id", "pos").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("running_avg_pos", "id", "pos").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

w5 = Window.orderBy("event_seq", "id", "pos").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

flattened = (
    df_carts

    .select(
        "id",

        F.col("item.product_id"),

metrics = (

        F.sum("pos").over(w_ordered).alias("running_sum_pos"),
        F.max("pos").over(w_ordered).alias("running_max_pos"),
        F.avg("pos").over(w_ordered).alias("running_avg_pos"),

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, ROUND(quantity * 1.07, 2) AS quantity_adjusted
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock >= TO_DATE('2023-05-29')
      AND quantity >= 228
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        d.store_name,
        d.region,
        d.sqft
    FROM valid s
    JOIN stores d
        ON s.store_id = d.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock, id) AS prev_quantity,
        LEAD(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock, id) AS next_quantity,
        LEAD(quantity_adjusted) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock, id) AS next_quantity_adjusted,
        LAG(quantity_adjusted) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock, id) AS prev_quantity_adjusted,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock, id) AS event_seq
    FROM joined
    WHERE region <> 'Central'
),
valid_inventory AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        last_restock,
        quantity_adjusted,
        store_name,
        sqft,
        prev_quantity,
        next_quantity,
        next_quantity_adjusted,
        prev_quantity_adjusted,
        event_seq,
        CASE WHEN prev_quantity >= 199 THEN 'High' WHEN prev_quantity >= 78 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS prev_quantity_level
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE region IS NOT NULL
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY next_quantity_adjusted NULLS LAST) AS rank_in_group
        FROM valid_inventory
    ) x
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT product_id, id
    FROM deduped
    EXCEPT
    SELECT product_id, id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE store_id IN (2, 3)
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.product_id = k.product_id AND s.id = k.id
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        product_id,
        next_quantity_adjusted,
        prev_quantity_adjusted
    FROM kept_rows
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    metric_value FOR metric IN (next_quantity_adjusted, prev_quantity_adjusted)
) long_rows;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("next_quantity_adjusted").asc_nulls_last())

valid = (
    df_inventory
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-29"))) & (F.col("quantity") >= 228))
    .select("*", F.round((F.col("quantity") * 1.07), 2).alias("quantity_adjusted"))
)

joined = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_stores.alias("d"), F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("d.store_name"), F.col("d.region"), F.col("d.sqft"))
)

with_windows = (
    joined
    .filter(F.col("region") != "Central")
    .withColumn("prev_quantity", F.lag("quantity").over(w))
    .withColumn("next_quantity", F.lead("quantity").over(w))
    .withColumn("next_quantity_adjusted", F.lead("quantity_adjusted").over(w))
    .withColumn("prev_quantity_adjusted", F.lag("quantity_adjusted").over(w))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w))
)

valid_inventory = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("region").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        "quantity_adjusted",
        "store_name",
        "sqft",
        "prev_quantity",
        "next_quantity",
        "next_quantity_adjusted",
        "prev_quantity_adjusted",
        "event_seq",
        F.when(F.col("prev_quantity") >= 199, "High").when(F.col("prev_quantity") >= 78, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("prev_quantity_level"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    valid_inventory
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN is_flagged THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_flagged_label
    FROM transactions
    WHERE merchant IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.account_id,
        a.amount,
        a.txn_time,
        a.is_flagged_label,
        d.opened_date,
        d.status,
        d.balance
    FROM filtered a
    LEFT JOIN accounts d
        ON a.account_id = d.id
    WHERE d.account_type = 'LOAN'
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.account_id,
        s.is_flagged_label,
        s.opened_date,
        s.status,
        s.balance,
        a.account_type,
        a.status AS account_status,
        a.opened_date AS account_opened_date
    FROM joined s
    JOIN accounts a
        ON s.account_id = a.id
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        b.balance AS account_balance,
        b.status AS account_status_2,
        b.opened_date AS account_opened_date_2
    FROM enriched e
    LEFT JOIN accounts b
        ON e.account_id = b.id
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_status_2, status ORDER BY opened_date DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
    FROM with_dims
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        account_status_2,
        account_status,
        account_balance
    FROM deduped
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(account_balance) AS amount
    FOR account_status IN ('OPEN' AS open, 'CLOSED' AS closed)
);

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("account_status_2", "status").orderBy(F.col("opened_date").desc_nulls_last(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("is_flagged_label", F.when(F.col("is_flagged"), "Yes").otherwise("No"))
)

joined = (
    filtered
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("d"), F.col("a.account_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("d.account_type") == "LOAN")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.account_id",
        "a.amount",
        "a.txn_time",
        "a.is_flagged_label",
        F.col("d.opened_date"),
        F.col("d.status"),
        F.col("d.balance"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    joined
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("a"), F.col("s.account_id") == F.col("a.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.account_id",
        "s.is_flagged_label",
        "s.opened_date",
        "s.status",
        "s.balance",
        F.col("a.account_type"),
        F.col("a.status").alias("account_status"),
        F.col("a.opened_date").alias("account_opened_date"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    enriched
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("b"), F.col("e.account_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("b.balance").alias("account_balance"),

        F.col("b.opened_date").alias("account_opened_date_2"),
    )
)

    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)

    .groupBy("account_status_2")
    .pivot("account_status", ["OPEN", "CLOSED"])

sql:
WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        key,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS key, value
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY log_ts DESC, id, key) AS dedup_rank
    FROM exploded
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        key,
        value,
        dedup_rank,
        COUNT(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(log_ts), service ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_count_1h,
        MAX(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY level, key ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_max_1h
    FROM ranked
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM with_windows
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE TO_DATE(log_ts) < '2024-01-01'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    key,
    value,
    dedup_rank,
    status_code_count_1h,
    status_code_max_1h
FROM kept_rows
ORDER BY status_code_count_1h DESC NULLS FIRST;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").desc(), "id", "key")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("log_ts"), "service").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("level", "key").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("key", "value"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    exploded
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "key",
        "value",
        "dedup_rank",
        F.count("status_code").over(w2).alias("status_code_count_1h"),
        F.max("status_code").over(w3).alias("status_code_max_1h"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.to_date("log_ts") < "2024-01-01")
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .select(
        "id",
        "key",
        "value",
        "dedup_rank",
        "status_code_count_1h",
        "status_code_max_1h",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("status_code_count_1h").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

sql:
WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        shipping_fee,
        CASE WHEN shipping_fee >= 32 THEN 'High' WHEN shipping_fee >= 8 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS shipping_fee_band
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_date > DATE '2023-03-31'
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        shipping_fee,
        shipping_fee_band,
        LEAD(shipping_fee, 1) OVER w_running AS next_shipping_fee,
        LAST_VALUE(shipping_fee, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY shipping_fee ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_shipping_fee,
        MIN(shipping_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_min_shipping_fee,
        FIRST_VALUE(shipping_fee, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_shipping_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY shipping_fee DESC, id ASC) AS seq_no
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY shipping_fee ASC, id ASC)
),
with_windows_orders AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY shipping_fee DESC) AS shipping_fee_dense_rank,
        SUM(last_known_shipping_fee) OVER (ORDER BY first_known_shipping_fee ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_last_known_shipping_fee
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE last_known_shipping_fee IS NOT NULL
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.customer_id,
        e.next_shipping_fee,
        e.last_known_shipping_fee,
        e.status_min_shipping_fee,
        e.first_known_shipping_fee,
        e.cumulative_last_known_shipping_fee,
        c.city,
        c.name
    FROM with_windows_orders e
    LEFT JOIN customers c
        ON e.customer_id <=> c.id
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
SELECT
    *,
    AVG(status_min_shipping_fee) OVER w_part AS running_avg_status_min_shipping_fee,
    MIN(status_min_shipping_fee) OVER w_part AS running_min_status_min_shipping_fee,
    MAX(status_min_shipping_fee) OVER w_part AS running_max_status_min_shipping_fee,
    SUM(status_min_shipping_fee) OVER w_part AS running_sum_status_min_shipping_fee
FROM with_dims
WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY first_known_shipping_fee ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
reference:

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_running = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("order_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee").desc())
w7 = Window.orderBy("first_known_shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_part = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("first_known_shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_orders
    .filter((F.col("order_date") > F.lit("2023-03-31").cast("date")) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.when(F.col("shipping_fee") >= 32, "High").when(F.col("shipping_fee") >= 8, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("shipping_fee_band"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "shipping_fee",
        "shipping_fee_band",
        F.lead("shipping_fee", 1).over(w_running).alias("next_shipping_fee"),
        F.last("shipping_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_shipping_fee"),
        F.min("shipping_fee").over(w3).alias("status_min_shipping_fee"),
        F.first("shipping_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("first_known_shipping_fee"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

with_windows_orders = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("last_known_shipping_fee").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w6).alias("shipping_fee_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("last_known_shipping_fee").over(w7).alias("cumulative_last_known_shipping_fee"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    with_windows_orders
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("e.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("c.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.customer_id",
        "e.next_shipping_fee",
        "e.last_known_shipping_fee",
        "e.status_min_shipping_fee",
        "e.first_known_shipping_fee",
        "e.cumulative_last_known_shipping_fee",
        F.col("c.city"),
        F.col("c.name"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("status_min_shipping_fee").over(w_part).alias("running_avg_status_min_shipping_fee"),
        F.min("status_min_shipping_fee").over(w_part).alias("running_min_status_min_shipping_fee"),
        F.max("status_min_shipping_fee").over(w_part).alias("running_max_status_min_shipping_fee"),
        F.sum("status_min_shipping_fee").over(w_part).alias("running_sum_status_min_shipping_fee"),
    )
)

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        latency_ms,
        key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) x AS key, v
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        INITCAP(TRIM(key)) key_title,
        COALESCE(key, 'DIRECT') key_clean
    FROM exploded
    WHERE key IS DISTINCT FROM 'region'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        latency_ms,
        v,
        COUNT(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY key) key_count_latency_ms
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE latency_ms <= 1401
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_running key_count_latency_ms_percent_rank
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY key_count_latency_ms NULLS FIRST)
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM scored
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE latency_ms <> 1363
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM reconciled
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE latency_ms BETWEEN 732 AND 1746
),
reconciled_app_logs AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM reconciled s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        latency_ms,
        v,
        key_count_latency_ms,
        key_count_latency_ms_percent_rank,
        key_count_latency_ms_percent_rank - latency_ms key_count_latency_ms_percent_rank_minus_latency_ms
    FROM reconciled_app_logs
    WHERE key_count_latency_ms <= 16
)
SELECT
    latency_ms,
    v,
    key_count_latency_ms,
    key_count_latency_ms_percent_rank,
    key_count_latency_ms_percent_rank_minus_latency_ms
FROM base

w = Window.partitionBy("key")
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("key_count_latency_ms").asc_nulls_first())

exploded = df_app_logs.select("id", "latency_ms", F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "v"))

cleaned = (
    exploded
    .filter(~F.col("key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("region")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.initcap(F.trim("key")).alias("key_title"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("key_clean"),
    )

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms") <= 1401)
    .select(
        "id",

        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",

    )

    exploded
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "attr_key",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(1) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    flattened_attrs
    .select("level", "id")
    .subtract(

        .filter(F.col("log_ts") < "2025-04-01")

    )
)

verified = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.level") == F.col("k.level")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")

sql:
WITH metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(salary, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY hire_date, id) AS next_salary,
        AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('week', hire_date), manager_id ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS salary_avg_5,
        AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id, manager_id ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS salary_avg_3_prior,
        AVG(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', hire_date), dept_id ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS salary_avg_5_2,
        SUM(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY level, dept_id ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_salary
    FROM employees
),
metrics_employees AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(salary_avg_3_prior) OVER (ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS salary_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior,
        SUM(salary_avg_5_2) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY salary_avg_5, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_salary_avg_5_2,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(hire_date) ORDER BY running_salary DESC, id) AS running_salary_bucket,
        SUM(salary_avg_3_prior) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(hire_date), dept_id ORDER BY running_salary, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_salary_avg_3_prior
    FROM metrics
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(salary_avg_5 * 1.15, 2) AS adjusted_salary_avg_5,
        ROUND(running_salary_avg_3_prior / cumulative_salary_avg_5_2, 2) AS running_salary_avg_3_prior_per_cumulative_salary_avg_5_2
    FROM metrics_employees
    WHERE full_name LIKE 'Gra%'
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach employees attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.email,
        a.dept_id,
        a.manager_id,
        a.job_title,
        a.hire_date,
        a.is_remote,
        a.next_salary,
        a.salary_avg_5,
        a.salary_avg_5_2,
        a.running_salary,
        a.cumulative_salary_avg_5_2,
        a.running_salary_avg_3_prior,
        a.running_salary_avg_3_prior_per_cumulative_salary_avg_5_2,
        b.hire_date AS employee_hire_date,
        b.salary AS employee_salary
    FROM base a
    LEFT JOIN employees b
        ON a.manager_id = b.id
),
stats AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', employee_hire_date) AS week_start,
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', hire_date) AS year_start,
        dept_id,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(job_title)) AS num_job_titles,
        COUNT_IF(job_title = 'Manager') AS manager_events,
        ROUND(SUM(cumulative_salary_avg_5_2) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN job_title = 'Engineer' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS cumulative_salary_avg_5_2_per_engineer,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(job_title)) AS job_title_list,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(job_title)) AS job_title_list_2,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', employee_hire_date) ORDER BY SIZE(COLLECT_SET(job_title)) DESC) AS num_job_titles_rank
    FROM joined
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', employee_hire_date), DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', hire_date), dept_id
)
SELECT
    week_start,
    year_start,
    dept_id,
    manager_events,
    cumulative_salary_avg_5_2_per_engineer,
    num_job_titles_rank
FROM stats

w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "hire_date"), "dept_id").orderBy("hire_date", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("level", "dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

w7 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary_avg_5", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

WITH flattened AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        created_at,
        code
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(coupon_codes) e AS code
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(code, 'unassigned') AS code_filled,
        COALESCE(code, 'UNKNOWN') AS code_clean
    FROM flattened
    WHERE created_at >= DATE '2025-03-01'
      AND code IS DISTINCT FROM 'VIP'
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        created_at,
        code_filled,
        code_clean,
        LOWER(code) AS code_lower,
        CASE WHEN code IN ('WELCOME5', 'BUNDLE') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END AS code_group
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE code IS NOT NULL
),
cleaned_carts AS (
    SELECT *, CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS created_at_day
    FROM base
    WHERE created_at > TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-03-02 01:00:00')
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *, DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), created_at) AS days_since_created_at
    FROM cleaned_carts
    WHERE created_at > DATE '2025-03-01'
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', created_at) AS hour_window,
        CASE WHEN days_since_created_at >= 71 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS days_since_created_at_tier,
        MIN(days_since_created_at) AS min_days_since_created_at,
        ROUND(AVG(days_since_created_at), 2) AS avg_days_since_created_at,
        (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(created_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(created_at))) / 60 AS duration_min,
        MAX(created_at) AS last_seen,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(days_since_created_at, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS days_since_created_at_quartiles
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    hour_window,
    days_since_created_at_tier,
    min_days_since_created_at,
    avg_days_since_created_at,
    last_seen
FROM summary
ORDER BY last_seen DESC, hour_window DESC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

flattened = df_carts.select("id", "created_at", F.explode("coupon_codes").alias("code"))

cleaned = (
    flattened
    .filter((F.col("created_at") >= F.lit("2025-03-01").cast("date")) & (~F.col("code").eqNullSafe(F.lit("VIP"))))
    .withColumn("code_filled", F.coalesce("code", F.lit("unassigned")))
    .withColumn("code_clean", F.coalesce("code", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

base = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("code").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "created_at",
        "code_filled",
        "code_clean",
        F.lower("code").alias("code_lower"),
        F.when(F.col("code").isin(["WELCOME5", "BUNDLE"]), "Tier 1").otherwise("Other").alias("code_group"),
    )
)

cleaned_carts = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("created_at") > F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2025-03-02 01:00:00")))
    .withColumn("created_at_day", F.col("created_at").cast("date"))
)

filtered = (
    cleaned_carts
    .filter(F.col("created_at") > F.lit("2025-03-01").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "created_at").alias("days_since_created_at"),
    )
)

summary = (
    filtered
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("HOUR", "created_at").alias("hour_window"),
        F.when(F.col("days_since_created_at") >= 71, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("days_since_created_at_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("days_since_created_at").alias("min_days_since_created_at"),
        F.round(F.avg("days_since_created_at"), 2).alias("avg_days_since_created_at"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("created_at")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("created_at"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
        F.max("created_at").alias("last_seen"),
        F.percentile_approx("days_since_created_at", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("days_since_created_at_quartiles"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "hour_window",
        "days_since_created_at_tier",
        "min_days_since_created_at",
        "avg_days_since_created_at",
        "last_seen",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("last_seen").desc(), F.col("hour_window").desc())
)
```

WITH metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(rating / SUM(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city), 4) AS rating_share,
        SUM(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_rating
    FROM suppliers
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_grp AS cumulative_rating_cume_dist,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY rating_share DESC, id) AS rating_share_bucket,
        SUM(cumulative_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cumulative_rating,
        LAG(rating, 2) OVER w_running AS prev_rating
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY cumulative_rating NULLS LAST), w_running AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id)
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY cumulative_rating_cume_dist, id) AS rn
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.supplier_id IS NOT NULL
        )
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM eligible s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.category != 'Grocery'
        )
),
kept_suppliers AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
              AND c.category != 'Grocery'
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN rating_share >= 0.61 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS rating_share_tier,
    city,
    ROUND(SUM(cumulative_cumulative_rating) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Berlin' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS cumulative_cumulative_rating_per_berlin,
    COUNT_IF(country = 'DE') AS de_events,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Bangkok' THEN 1 END) AS bangkok_count,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS num_countries,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_id
FROM kept_suppliers
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN rating_share >= 0.61 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, city)
ORDER BY city DESC NULLS FIRST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("cumulative_rating").asc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy(F.col("rating_share").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("cumulative_rating_cume_dist", "id")

metrics = (
    df_suppliers
    .withColumn("rating_share", F.round((F.col("rating") / F.sum("rating").over(w)), 4))
    .withColumn("cumulative_rating", F.sum("rating").over(w2))
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("cumulative_rating_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("rating_share_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w4))
    .withColumn("cumulative_cumulative_rating", F.sum("cumulative_rating").over(w5))
    .withColumn("prev_rating", F.lag("rating", 2).over(w_running))
)

latest = (
    scored
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

eligible = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.supplier_id").isNotNull()), "left_anti")
)

kept = (
    eligible
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.category") != "Grocery"), "left_anti")
)

kept_suppliers = (
    kept
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.category") != "Grocery"), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    kept_suppliers
    .withColumn("rating_share_tier", F.when(F.col("rating_share") >= 0.61, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .rollup("rating_share_tier", "city")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("cumulative_cumulative_rating") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Berlin", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("cumulative_cumulative_rating_per_berlin"),
        F.count_if(F.col("country") == "DE").alias("de_events"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Bangkok", 1)).alias("bangkok_count"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("country")).alias("num_countries"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_id"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("city").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

WITH joined AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT src.*, b.location
    FROM employees src
    LEFT JOIN departments b
        ON src.dept_id = b.id
    WHERE b.budget BETWEEN 2607000 AND 3174000
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach employees attributes
    SELECT s.*, e.job_title AS employee_job_title
    FROM joined s
    LEFT JOIN employees e
        ON s.manager_id <=> e.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(salary, 2) OVER (ORDER BY salary, id) AS next_salary,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY location, level ORDER BY salary DESC, id) AS salary_bucket
    FROM with_dims
),
with_dims_employees AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.email,
        src.dept_id,
        src.hire_date,
        src.location,
        src.employee_job_title,
        src.salary_bucket,
        d.location AS department_location,
        d.budget
    FROM enriched src
    LEFT JOIN departments d
        ON src.dept_id = d.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(salary_bucket) OVER (ORDER BY salary_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS salary_bucket_avg_5_prior,
        SUM(salary_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(hire_date), location ORDER BY hire_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_salary_bucket
    FROM with_dims_employees
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', hire_date) AS year_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', hire_date) AS activity_month,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE employee_job_title = 'Analyst') AS analyst_rows,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(salary_bucket_avg_5_prior, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS salary_bucket_avg_5_prior_quartiles,
    ROUND(SUM(salary_bucket_avg_5_prior) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN location = 'Tokyo' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS salary_bucket_avg_5_prior_per_tokyo,
    COUNT_IF(employee_job_title = 'Designer') AS designer_events,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(employee_job_title)) AS employee_job_title_list,
    GROUPING(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', hire_date)) AS grouping_id
FROM metrics
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', hire_date), DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', hire_date)), (DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', hire_date)))
HAVING ROUND(SUM(salary_bucket_avg_5_prior) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN location = 'Tokyo' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) < 1000000

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("salary", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("location", "level").orderBy(F.col("salary").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("salary_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("hire_date"), "location").orderBy("hire_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

joined = (
    df_employees
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_departments.alias("b"), F.col("src.dept_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("b.budget").between(2607000, 3174000))
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.location"))
)

with_dims = (
    joined
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("e"), F.col("s.manager_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("e.id")), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("e.job_title").alias("employee_job_title"))
)

enriched = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("salary", 2).over(w).alias("next_salary"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w2).alias("salary_bucket"),
    )
)

with_dims_employees = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_departments.alias("d"), F.col("src.dept_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.email",
        "src.dept_id",
        "src.hire_date",
        "src.location",
        "src.employee_job_title",
        "src.salary_bucket",
        F.col("d.location").alias("department_location"),
        F.col("d.budget"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_dims_employees
    .withColumn("salary_bucket_avg_5_prior", F.avg("salary_bucket").over(w3))
    .withColumn("running_salary_bucket", F.sum("salary_bucket").over(w4))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("year_start", F.date_trunc("YEAR", "hire_date"))
    .withColumn("activity_month", F.date_trunc("MONTH", "hire_date"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["year_start", "activity_month"], ["year_start"]],
        "year_start",
        "activity_month",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("employee_job_title") == "Analyst", 1)).alias("analyst_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("salary_bucket_avg_5_prior", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("salary_bucket_avg_5_prior_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.sum("salary_bucket_avg_5_prior") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("location") == "Tokyo", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("salary_bucket_avg_5_prior_per_tokyo"),
        F.count_if(F.col("employee_job_title") == "Designer").alias("designer_events"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("employee_job_title")).alias("employee_job_title_list"),
        F.grouping("year_start").alias("grouping_id"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("salary_bucket_avg_5_prior_per_tokyo") < 1000000)
)

WITH matched_keys AS (
    SELECT store_id, product_id
    FROM inventory
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT store_id, product_id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE quantity IS NOT NULL
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM inventory s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.store_id = k.store_id AND s.product_id = k.product_id
)
SELECT
    store_id,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(quantity, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS quantity_quartiles,
    STDDEV_SAMP(quantity) AS quantity_stddev
FROM verified
GROUP BY store_id
HAVING STDDEV_SAMP(quantity) >= 0;

matched_keys = (
    df_inventory
    .select("store_id", "product_id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_inventory
        .filter(F.col("quantity").isNotNull())
        .select("store_id", "product_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    df_inventory
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")) & (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .groupBy("store_id")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("quantity", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("quantity_quartiles"),
        F.stddev_samp("quantity").alias("quantity_stddev"),

    .filter(F.col("quantity_stddev") >= 0)
)

with with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(txn_time) over (partition by txn_type order by txn_time, id) is null
                 or txn_time > lag(txn_time) over (partition by txn_type order by txn_time, id) + interval '30' day then 1 else 0 end as session_start_flag
    from transactions
),
sessions_transactions as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(session_start_flag) over (partition by txn_type order by txn_time, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id
    from with_gaps
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    date_trunc('week', txn_time) as week_start,
    size(collect_set(merchant)) as num_merchants,
    round(sum(session_start_flag) / nullif(count(case when merchant = 'Starbucks' then 1 end), 0), 2) as session_start_flag_per_starbucks,
    count(*) filter (where txn_type = 'FEE') as fee_rows
from sessions_transactions
group by 1
order by fee_rows desc nulls last;

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_gaps = (
    df_transactions
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_transactions = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_transactions
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("week", "txn_time").alias("week_start"))
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("merchant")).alias("num_merchants"),
        F.round(F.sum("session_start_flag") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("merchant") == "Starbucks", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("session_start_flag_per_starbucks"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "FEE", 1)).alias("fee_rows"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("fee_rows").desc_nulls_last())
)

sql:
WITH latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY location, dept_name ORDER BY budget DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
    FROM departments
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees ch
            WHERE ch.dept_id = s.id
              AND ch.dept_id = 14
        )
),
eligible_departments AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM eligible s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees ch
            WHERE ch.dept_id = s.id
              AND ch.hire_date > '2023-12-10'
        )
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_name,
        LEAD(budget, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name, location ORDER BY row_num, id) next_budget,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name, location ORDER BY budget DESC, id) budget_bucket,
        LAG(budget, 1) OVER w_ordered prev_budget,
        SUM(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cumulative_budget
    FROM eligible_departments
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget, id)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        next_budget,
        budget_bucket,
        prev_budget,
        SUM(budget_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY prev_budget, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last4_sum_budget_bucket,
        AVG(budget_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY prev_budget, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last4_avg_budget_bucket,
        MIN(budget_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY prev_budget, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last4_min_budget_bucket
    FROM scored
),
enriched_departments AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        next_budget,
        budget_bucket,
        last4_sum_budget_bucket,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY last4_avg_budget_bucket NULLS LAST) last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist,
        LAST_VALUE(last4_sum_budget_bucket, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY prev_budget, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_last4_sum_budget_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp row_seq
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_grp AS (ORDER BY last4_sum_budget_bucket, id)
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched_departments s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees x
            WHERE x.dept_id = s.id
              AND x.email IS NOT NULL
        )
),
stats AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist >= 0.86 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist_tier,
        ROUND(AVG(last_known_last4_sum_budget_bucket), 2) AS avg_last_known_last4_sum_budget_bucket,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(next_budget, 0.9) AS next_budget_p90
    FROM not_flagged
    GROUP BY last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist_tier
)
SELECT last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist_tier, next_budget_p90
FROM stats
ORDER BY next_budget_p90 DESC NULLS FIRST, last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist_tier DESC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy("row_num", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc(), "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("prev_budget", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("last4_avg_budget_bucket").asc_nulls_last())
w8 = Window.orderBy("prev_budget", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.orderBy("last4_sum_budget_bucket", "id")

latest = (
    df_departments
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

eligible = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.dept_id") == 14), "left_anti")
)

eligible_departments = (
    eligible
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.hire_date") > "2023-12-10"), "left_semi")
)

scored = (
    eligible_departments
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_name",
        F.lead("budget", 1).over(w2).alias("next_budget"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w3).alias("budget_bucket"),
        F.lag("budget", 1).over(w_ordered).alias("prev_budget"),
        F.sum("budget").over(w5).alias("cumulative_budget"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "next_budget",
        "budget_bucket",
        "prev_budget",
        F.sum("budget_bucket").over(w6).alias("last4_sum_budget_bucket"),
        F.avg("budget_bucket").over(w6).alias("last4_avg_budget_bucket"),
        F.min("budget_bucket").over(w6).alias("last4_min_budget_bucket"),
    )
)

enriched_departments = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "next_budget",
        "budget_bucket",
        "last4_sum_budget_bucket",
        F.cume_dist().over(w7).alias("last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist"),
        F.last("last4_sum_budget_bucket", ignorenulls=True).over(w8).alias("last_known_last4_sum_budget_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

not_flagged = (
    enriched_departments
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("x"), (F.col("x.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.email").isNotNull()), "left_anti")
)

stats = (
    not_flagged
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist") >= 0.86, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("last_known_last4_sum_budget_bucket"), 2).alias("avg_last_known_last4_sum_budget_bucket"),
        F.percentile_approx("next_budget", 0.9).alias("next_budget_p90"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select("last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist_tier", "next_budget_p90")
    .orderBy(
        F.col("next_budget_p90").desc_nulls_first(),
        F.col("last4_avg_budget_bucket_cume_dist_tier").desc(),
    )
)
```

WITH flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN started_at - LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id) > INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM sessions
),
sessions_sessions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN session_id >= 7 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS session_id_tier,
    COUNT_IF(browser = 'Edge') AS edge_events,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(session_id, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS session_id_quartiles,
    ROUND(AVG(new_group_flag), 2) AS avg_new_group_flag,
    MIN(started_at) AS first_seen
FROM sessions_sessions
GROUP BY CASE WHEN session_id >= 7 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
HAVING avg_new_group_flag > 0
ORDER BY avg_new_group_flag
reference:

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

flagged = (
    df_sessions
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("started_at") - F.lag("started_at").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = flagged.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_sessions
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("session_id") >= 7, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("session_id_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("browser") == "Edge").alias("edge_events"),
        F.percentile_approx("session_id", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("session_id_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.avg("new_group_flag"), 2).alias("avg_new_group_flag"),
        F.min("started_at").alias("first_seen"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_new_group_flag") > 0)
    .orderBy("avg_new_group_flag")
)

WITH joined AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.price,
        p.stock_qty
    FROM store_sales s
    INNER JOIN products p
        ON s.product_id = p.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        sale_date,
        revenue,
        LEAD(stock_qty, 1) OVER (ORDER BY price ASC, id ASC) next_stock_qty,
        ROUND(units / SUM(units) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id), 4) units_share,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cumulative_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY units ASC, id ASC) row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(sale_date), store_id ORDER BY price DESC, id ASC) event_seq
    FROM joined
    WHERE store_id = 6
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY units_share DESC, id ASC) seq_no,
        STDDEV_SAMP(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(sale_date), store_id) sale_date_year_stddev_samp_event_seq,
        AVG(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(sale_date), store_id ORDER BY units_share ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) event_seq_avg_6_prior,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue DESC) revenue_dense_rank
    FROM enriched
),
joined_store_sales AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.store_id,
        a.sale_date,
        a.revenue,
        a.next_stock_qty,
        a.units_share,
        a.row_seq,
        a.event_seq,
        a.revenue_dense_rank,
        p.store_name
    FROM scored a
    LEFT JOIN stores p
        ON a.store_id = p.id
),
enriched_store_sales AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT a.*, p.opened_date
    FROM joined_store_sales a
    INNER JOIN stores p
        ON a.store_id = p.id
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM enriched_store_sales
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY next_stock_qty ASC) = 1
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    id,
    store_id,
    measure,
    value
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        revenue,
        units_share
    FROM deduped
) src
UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
    value FOR measure IN (revenue, units_share)
);

from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("price", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("revenue", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("units", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("sale_date"), "store_id").orderBy(F.col("price").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("units_share").desc(), "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("sale_date"), "store_id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("sale_date"), "store_id").orderBy("units_share", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("revenue").desc())
w10 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("next_stock_qty")

joined = (
    df_store_sales
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("p.price"), F.col("p.stock_qty"))
)

enriched = (
    joined
    .filter(F.col("store_id") == 6)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "sale_date",
        "revenue",
        F.lead("stock_qty", 1).over(w).alias("next_stock_qty"),
        F.round((F.col("units") / F.sum("units").over(w2)), 4).alias("units_share"),
        F.sum("revenue").over(w3).alias("cumulative_revenue"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w6).alias("seq_no"),
        F.stddev_samp("event_seq").over(w7).alias("sale_date_year_stddev_samp_event_seq"),
        F.avg("event_seq").over(w8).alias("event_seq_avg_6_prior"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w9).alias("revenue_dense_rank"),
    )
)

joined_store_sales = (
    scored
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_stores.alias("p"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.store_id",
        "a.sale_date",
        "a.revenue",
        "a.next_stock_qty",
        "a.units_share",
        "a.row_seq",
        "a.event_seq",
        "a.revenue_dense_rank",
        F.col("p.store_name"),
    )
)

enriched_store_sales = (
    joined_store_sales
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_stores.alias("p"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.opened_date"))
)

deduped = (
    enriched_store_sales
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w10))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

result = (
    deduped
    .select("id", "store_id", "revenue", "units_share")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "store_id"],
        values=["revenue", "units_share"],

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        IF(is_remote, 'Yes', 'No') is_remote_label,
        LENGTH(full_name) full_name_length
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date > DATE '2023-08-03'
      AND job_title IS NOT NULL
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT dept_id
    FROM cleaned
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT dept_id
    FROM employees
    WHERE job_title IS NOT NULL
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.dept_id = k.dept_id
),
cleaned_employees AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        is_remote_label,
        full_name_length,
        LAST_DAY(hire_date) hire_date_month_end
    FROM kept_rows
    WHERE job_title IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        job_title,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        is_remote_label,
        full_name_length,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY full_name_length NULLS LAST) full_name_length_rank,
        STDDEV_SAMP(salary) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title, dept_id) job_title_stddev_samp_salary,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY salary) salary_rank
    FROM cleaned_employees
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        GREATEST(full_name_length_rank, full_name_length) greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length,
        REPLACE(full_name, ' ', '-') full_name_slug,
        COALESCE(job_title, 'N/A') resolved_job_title
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE job_title IS NOT NULL
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY full_name_length DESC NULLS FIRST) full_name_length_cume_dist,
        STDDEV_SAMP(greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title) job_title_stddev_samp_greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length,
        ROUND(job_title_stddev_samp_salary / SUM(job_title_stddev_samp_salary) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title), 4) job_title_stddev_samp_salary_share
    FROM valid
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN job_title_stddev_samp_greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length >= 81 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS job_title_stddev_samp_greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length_tier,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', hire_date) AS activity_month,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE job_title = 'Engineer') AS engineer_rows,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(job_title)) AS num_job_titles,
        COUNT(DISTINCT job_title) AS distinct_job_titles
    FROM metrics
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN job_title_stddev_samp_greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length >= 81 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', hire_date))
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE job_title = 'Engineer') > 1
)
SELECT
    job_title_stddev_samp_greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length_tier,
    activity_month,
    distinct_job_titles
FROM totals
ORDER BY distinct_job_titles DESC NULLS FIRST;

from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy(F.col("full_name_length").asc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("job_title", "dept_id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("salary")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy(F.col("full_name_length").desc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("job_title")

cleaned = (
    df_employees
    .filter((F.col("hire_date") > F.lit("2023-08-03").cast("date")) & F.col("job_title").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "job_title",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "is_remote",
        F.when(F.col("is_remote"), "Yes").otherwise("No").alias("is_remote_label"),
        F.length("full_name").alias("full_name_length"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    cleaned
    .select("dept_id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_employees
        .filter(F.col("job_title").isNotNull())
        .select("dept_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.dept_id") == F.col("k.dept_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned_employees = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("job_title").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "job_title",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "is_remote",
        "is_remote_label",
        "full_name_length",
        F.last_day("hire_date").alias("hire_date_month_end"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned_employees
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "job_title",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "is_remote",
        "is_remote_label",
        "full_name_length",
        F.rank().over(w).alias("full_name_length_rank"),
        F.stddev_samp("salary").over(w2).alias("job_title_stddev_samp_salary"),
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("salary_rank"),
    )
)

valid = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("job_title").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.greatest("full_name_length_rank", "full_name_length").alias("greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length"),
        F.regexp_replace("full_name", " ", "-").alias("full_name_slug"),
        F.coalesce("job_title", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_job_title"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(w4).alias("full_name_length_cume_dist"),
        F.stddev_samp("greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length").over(w5).alias("job_title_stddev_samp_greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length"),
        F.round((F.col("job_title_stddev_samp_salary") / F.sum("job_title_stddev_samp_salary").over(w5)), 4).alias("job_title_stddev_samp_salary_share"),
    )
)

totals = (
    metrics
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("job_title_stddev_samp_greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length") >= 81, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("job_title_stddev_samp_greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("MONTH", "hire_date").alias("activity_month"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("job_title") == "Engineer", 1)).alias("engineer_rows"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("job_title")).alias("num_job_titles"),
        F.countDistinct("job_title").alias("distinct_job_titles"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("engineer_rows") > 1)
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "job_title_stddev_samp_greatest_full_name_length_rank_full_name_length_tier",
        "activity_month",
        "distinct_job_titles",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_job_titles").desc_nulls_first())
)
