WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        coupon_codes,
        k,
        value
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(attributes) li AS k, value
),
flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        k,
        value,
        EXPLODE_OUTER(coupon_codes) AS tag
    FROM lines
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        k,
        value,
        tag,
        CONCAT_WS('-', k, tag) AS k_tag_key,
        COALESCE(tag, 'OTHER') AS resolved_tag
    FROM flattened
    WHERE k IN ('utm_source', 'device')
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        k,
        tag,
        k_tag_key,
        resolved_tag,
        CONCAT(k, ' ', tag) AS k_tag,
        COALESCE(tag, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_tag_2
    FROM valid
    WHERE tag IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        p.country,
        p.city
    FROM cleaned src
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON src.customer_id <=> p.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    customer_id,
    k,
    tag,
    resolved_tag,
    k_tag,
    resolved_tag_2,
    country,
    city,
    CASE WHEN country RLIKE '^(DE|JP)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' WHEN country RLIKE '^(TH|US)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS country_zone
FROM enriched;

```python
lines = (
    df_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.explode("attributes").alias("k", "value"),
    )
)

flattened = (
    lines
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "k",
        "value",
        F.explode_outer("coupon_codes").alias("tag"),
    )
)

valid = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("k").isin(["utm_source", "device"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "k",
        "value",
        "tag",
        F.concat_ws("-", "k", "tag").alias("k_tag_key"),
        F.coalesce("tag", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_tag"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("tag").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "k",
        "tag",
        "k_tag_key",
        "resolved_tag",
        F.concat("k", F.lit(" "), "tag").alias("k_tag"),
        F.coalesce("tag", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("resolved_tag_2"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("src.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("p.id")), "left")

        "tag",
        "resolved_tag",
        "k_tag",
        "resolved_tag_2",
        "country",
        "city",
        F.when(F.col("country").rlike("^(DE|JP)$"), "PRIORITY").when(F.col("country").rlike("^(TH|US)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("country_zone"),
    )
)
```

    SELECT
        src.*,
        p.price,
        p.category,
        p.brand
    FROM order_items src
    INNER JOIN products p
        ON src.product_id = p.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        category,
        brand,
        MIN(price) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_price,
        COUNT(price) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_price,
        SUM(price) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_price,
        AVG(price) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_price,
        AVG(price) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS price_avg_5
    FROM enriched
    WHERE product_id = 40
),
enriched_order_items AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        category,
        running_min_price,
        running_sum_price,
        SUM(price_avg_5) OVER (PARTITION BY brand) AS brand_sum_price_avg_5,
        AVG(running_avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY running_sum_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS running_avg_price_avg_2_prior,
        SUM(running_avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY running_sum_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_running_avg_price,
        SUM(price_avg_5) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, product_id ORDER BY running_sum_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_price_avg_5,
        AVG(running_sum_price) OVER (ORDER BY running_count_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS running_sum_price_avg_5_prior
    FROM metrics
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(running_running_avg_price) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY cumulative_price_avg_5, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS running_running_avg_price_avg_5_prior,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY running_sum_price, id) AS running_sum_price_bucket,
        FIRST_VALUE(cumulative_price_avg_5) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY cumulative_price_avg_5, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_cumulative_price_avg_5,
        LEAD(cumulative_price_avg_5, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY running_sum_price, id) AS next_cumulative_price_avg_5
    FROM enriched_order_items
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.product_id,
    s.running_min_price,
    s.running_sum_price,
    s.brand_sum_price_avg_5,
    s.running_avg_price_avg_2_prior,
    s.running_running_avg_price,
    s.cumulative_price_avg_5,
    s.running_running_avg_price_avg_5_prior,
    (SELECT SUM(t2.quantity) FROM inventory t2 WHERE t2.product_id = s.product_id) AS sum_inventory_quantity
FROM scored s

with cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        product_id,
        last_restock,
        last_day(last_restock) as last_restock_month_end
    from inventory
    where quantity <= 180
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        product_id,
        row_number() over (partition by product_id order by last_restock_month_end, id) as row_seq,
        row_number() over (partition by product_id order by last_restock, id) as event_seq
    from cleaned
),
joined as (
    -- Attach products attributes
    select
        e.id,
        e.product_id,
        e.event_seq,
        p.launch_date,
        p.cost
    from enriched e
    left join products p
        on e.product_id = p.id
    where p.brand in ('Acme', 'Stark')
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        event_seq,
        launch_date,
        lag(cost) over (partition by product_id order by cost, id) as prev_cost,
        lead(cost) over (partition by product_id order by cost, id) as next_cost,
        lag(event_seq) over (partition by product_id order by cost, id) as prev_event_seq,
        row_number() over (partition by product_id order by cost, id) as row_seq,
        min(event_seq) over (partition by product_id) as product_id_min_event_seq
    from joined
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        event_seq,
        next_cost,
        prev_event_seq,
        row_seq,
        product_id_min_event_seq,
        min(event_seq) over (order by prev_event_seq, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_min_event_seq,
        avg(event_seq) over (order by prev_event_seq, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_avg_event_seq,
        count(event_seq) over (order by prev_event_seq, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_count_event_seq,
        last_value(row_seq, true) over (order by launch_date, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_row_seq
    from scored
),
scored_inventory as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        sum(prev_event_seq) over (order by running_count_event_seq, id rows between 3 preceding and current row) as last4_sum_prev_event_seq,
        count(prev_event_seq) over (order by running_count_event_seq, id rows between 3 preceding and current row) as last4_count_prev_event_seq,
        min(prev_event_seq) over (order by running_count_event_seq, id rows between 3 preceding and current row) as last4_min_prev_event_seq,
        avg(prev_event_seq) over (order by running_count_event_seq, id rows between 3 preceding and current row) as last4_avg_prev_event_seq
    from metrics
),
metrics_inventory as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        avg(last4_min_prev_event_seq) over (order by last4_sum_prev_event_seq, id rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding) as last4_min_prev_event_seq_avg_2_prior,
        avg(product_id_min_event_seq) over (order by product_id_min_event_seq, id rows between 3 preceding and 1 preceding) as product_id_min_event_seq_avg_3_prior,
        first_value(last4_count_prev_event_seq, true) over (order by running_count_event_seq, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_last4_count_prev_event_seq
    from scored_inventory
),
grouped as (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    select
        case when row_seq >= 7 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as row_seq_tier,
        percentile_approx(last4_min_prev_event_seq, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as last4_min_prev_event_seq_quartiles,
        percentile_approx(event_seq, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as event_seq_quartiles
    from metrics_inventory
    group by 1
)
select row_seq_tier, last4_min_prev_event_seq_quartiles
from grouped;

sql:
WITH latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        txn_time
    FROM transactions
    QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type, account_id ORDER BY txn_time DESC) = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY txn_time DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY txn_time DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(txn_time), txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id) AS row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY txn_time, id) AS row_seq_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY txn_time, id) AS event_seq_2
    FROM latest
    WHERE account_id IN (9, 30, 37, 38)
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, account_id
    FROM enriched
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT id, account_id
    FROM transactions
    WHERE HOUR(txn_time) BETWEEN 8 AND 13
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.account_id = k.account_id
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        event_seq,
        row_seq,
        row_seq_2,
        event_seq_2,
        FLOOR(row_seq) AS row_seq_whole,
        CASE WHEN row_seq_2 >= 8 THEN 'High' WHEN row_seq_2 >= 2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS row_seq_2_band
    FROM verified
    WHERE event_seq_2 BETWEEN 5 AND 7
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.account_id,
        src.event_seq,
        src.row_seq_2,
        src.event_seq_2,
        src.row_seq_whole,
        src.row_seq_2_band,
        p.opened_date,
        p.balance,
        p.account_type
    FROM base src
    LEFT JOIN accounts p
        ON src.account_id = p.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        event_seq,
        row_seq_2,
        row_seq_2_band,
        opened_date,
        balance,
        MAX(row_seq_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type) AS account_type_max_row_seq_whole,
        COUNT(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type) AS account_type_count_balance
    FROM with_dims
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        balance,
        account_type_max_row_seq_whole,
        account_type_count_balance,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_running AS account_type_count_balance_percent_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY balance NULLS FIRST) AS balance_cume_dist,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', opened_date) ORDER BY account_type_count_balance NULLS FIRST) AS account_type_count_balance_cume_dist,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_grp AS row_seq_2_dense_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_hist AS account_type_max_row_seq_whole_cume_dist
    FROM metrics
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY account_type_count_balance DESC NULLS FIRST), w_grp AS (ORDER BY row_seq_2 DESC NULLS FIRST), w_hist AS (ORDER BY account_type_max_row_seq_whole DESC)
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN balance_cume_dist >= 0.74 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS balance_cume_dist_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(row_seq_2_dense_rank, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS row_seq_2_dense_rank_quartiles,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(account_type_max_row_seq_whole, 0.5) AS account_type_max_row_seq_whole_p50,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(balance_cume_dist, 0.95) AS balance_cume_dist_p95,
    ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS avg_balance
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY CASE WHEN balance_cume_dist >= 0.74 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
ORDER BY balance_cume_dist_tier DESC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "account_id").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").desc())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("txn_time").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("txn_time"), "txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("account_type")
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("account_type_count_balance").desc_nulls_first())
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("balance").asc_nulls_first())
w9 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "opened_date")).orderBy(F.col("account_type_count_balance").asc_nulls_first())
w_grp = Window.orderBy(F.col("row_seq_2").desc_nulls_first())
w_hist = Window.orderBy(F.col("account_type_max_row_seq_whole").desc())

latest = (
    df_transactions
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "account_id", "txn_type", "txn_time")
)

enriched = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("account_id").isin([9, 30, 37, 38]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("row_seq_2"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("event_seq_2"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("id", "account_id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_transactions
        .filter(F.hour("txn_time").between(8, 13))
        .select("id", "account_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.account_id") == F.col("k.account_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("event_seq_2").between(5, 7))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "event_seq",
        "row_seq",
        "row_seq_2",
        "event_seq_2",
        F.floor("row_seq").alias("row_seq_whole"),
        F.when(F.col("row_seq_2") >= 8, "High").when(F.col("row_seq_2") >= 2, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("row_seq_2_band"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("p"), F.col("src.account_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.account_id",
        "src.event_seq",
        "src.row_seq_2",
        "src.event_seq_2",
        "src.row_seq_whole",
        "src.row_seq_2_band",
        F.col("p.opened_date"),
        F.col("p.balance"),
        F.col("p.account_type"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "event_seq",
        "row_seq_2",
        "row_seq_2_band",
        "opened_date",
        "balance",
        F.max("row_seq_whole").over(w6).alias("account_type_max_row_seq_whole"),
        F.count("balance").over(w6).alias("account_type_count_balance"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "balance",
        "account_type_max_row_seq_whole",
        "account_type_count_balance",
        F.percent_rank().over(w_running).alias("account_type_count_balance_percent_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w8).alias("balance_cume_dist"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w9).alias("account_type_count_balance_cume_dist"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_grp).alias("row_seq_2_dense_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_hist).alias("account_type_max_row_seq_whole_cume_dist"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("balance_cume_dist") >= 0.74, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("balance_cume_dist_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("row_seq_2_dense_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("row_seq_2_dense_rank_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("account_type_max_row_seq_whole", 0.5).alias("account_type_max_row_seq_whole_p50"),
        F.percentile_approx("balance_cume_dist", 0.95).alias("balance_cume_dist_p95"),
        F.round(F.avg("balance"), 2).alias("avg_balance"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("balance_cume_dist_tier").desc())
)
```

with metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        avg(unit_price) over (partition by product_id order by unit_price, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) running_avg_unit_price,
        count(unit_price) over (partition by product_id order by unit_price, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) running_count_unit_price,
        sum(unit_price) over (partition by product_id order by unit_price, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) running_sum_unit_price,
        dense_rank() over (order by unit_price desc) unit_price_dense_rank
    from order_items
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id, product_id
    from metrics
    except distinct
    select id, product_id
    from order_items
    where order_id = 13
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from metrics s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.id = k.id and s.product_id = k.product_id
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        a.id,
        a.order_id,
        a.unit_price,
        a.running_avg_unit_price,
        a.running_count_unit_price,
        a.running_sum_unit_price,
        a.unit_price_dense_rank,
        o.status
    from kept_rows a
    inner join orders o
        on a.order_id = o.id
    where o.shipping_fee is null
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id, order_id
    from enriched
    except distinct
    select id, order_id
    from order_items
    where order_id = 35
),
kept_rows_order_items as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from enriched s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.id = k.id and s.order_id = k.order_id
),
with_dims as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select a.*, p.shipping_fee
    from kept_rows_order_items a
    inner join orders p
        on a.order_id = p.id
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select *, rank() over (partition by order_id order by running_avg_unit_price desc) running_avg_unit_price_rank
    from with_dims
),
daily as (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    select
        case when shipping_fee >= 38 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as shipping_fee_tier,
        approx_percentile(running_avg_unit_price, 0.95) as running_avg_unit_price_p95,
        max(running_avg_unit_price) as max_running_avg_unit_price,
        round(avg(shipping_fee), 2) as avg_shipping_fee
    from scored
    group by case when shipping_fee >= 38 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end
)
select
    shipping_fee_tier,
    running_avg_unit_price_p95,
    avg_shipping_fee
from daily
order by avg_shipping_fee desc

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("unit_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc())

    .withColumn("running_avg_unit_price", F.avg("unit_price").over(w))
    .withColumn("running_count_unit_price", F.count("unit_price").over(w))

)

remaining_keys = (

    .select("id", "product_id")
    .subtract(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("order_id") == 13)
        .select("id", "product_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("o.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("o.shipping_fee").isNull())
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.order_id",
        "a.unit_price",
        "a.running_avg_unit_price",
        "a.running_count_unit_price",
        "a.running_sum_unit_price",
        "a.unit_price_dense_rank",
        F.col("o.status"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("id", "order_id")
    .subtract(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("order_id") == 35)
        .select("id", "order_id")
    )
)

kept_rows_order_items = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_dims = (
    kept_rows_order_items
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.shipping_fee"))
)

scored = with_dims.withColumn("running_avg_unit_price_rank", F.rank().over(w3))

daily = (
    scored
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("shipping_fee") >= 38, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("shipping_fee_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("running_avg_unit_price", 0.95).alias("running_avg_unit_price_p95"),
        F.max("running_avg_unit_price").alias("max_running_avg_unit_price"),
```

sql:
WITH with_window AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        s.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct
    FROM promotions s
    LEFT JOIN promotions pr
        ON COALESCE(s.channel, 'web') = pr.channel
       AND s.starts_on BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
),
attributed AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        src.*,
        pr.id AS promo_id_2,
        pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code_2,
        pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct_2
    FROM with_window src
    INNER JOIN promotions pr
        ON COALESCE(src.channel, 'store') = pr.channel
       AND src.ends_on BETWEEN pr.starts_on AND pr.ends_on
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        promo_id,
        promotion_discount_pct,
        promo_id_2,
        promotion_promo_code_2,
        CAST(promotion_discount_pct_2 AS INT) AS promotion_discount_pct_2_int,
        ROUND(promotion_discount_pct_2, 0) AS promotion_discount_pct_2_rounded
    FROM attributed
    WHERE MONTH(starts_on) IN (4, 5, 9)
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        promo_id,
        promotion_discount_pct,
        promo_id_2,
        promotion_discount_pct_2_int,
        promotion_discount_pct_2_rounded,
        ROUND(promotion_discount_pct / promo_id_2, 2) AS promotion_discount_pct_per_promo_id_2
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE promotion_promo_code_2 IN ('VIP', 'BUNDLE')
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', starts_on) AS activity_month,
    CASE WHEN promotion_discount_pct_per_promo_id_2 >= 84 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS promotion_discount_pct_per_promo_id_2_tier,
    COUNT_IF(channel = 'store') AS store_events,
    COUNT_IF(channel = 'web') AS web_events,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN 1 END) AS mobile_count,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(promotion_discount_pct, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS promotion_discount_pct_quartiles,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
FROM valid
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', starts_on), CASE WHEN promotion_discount_pct_per_promo_id_2 >= 84 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END), (DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', starts_on)), ())
HAVING web_events < 1000
ORDER BY mobile_count NULLS LAST;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

with_window = (
    df_promotions
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.coalesce(F.col("s.channel"), F.lit("web")) == F.col("pr.channel")) & F.col("s.starts_on").between(F.col("pr.starts_on"), F.col("pr.ends_on")), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

attributed = (
    with_window
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.coalesce(F.col("src.channel"), F.lit("store")) == F.col("pr.channel")) & F.col("src.ends_on").between(F.col("pr.starts_on"), F.col("pr.ends_on")), "inner")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id_2"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code_2"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct_2"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    attributed
    .filter(F.month("starts_on").isin([4, 5, 9]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "promo_id",
        "promotion_discount_pct",
        "promo_id_2",
        "promotion_promo_code_2",
        F.col("promotion_discount_pct_2").cast("int").alias("promotion_discount_pct_2_int"),
        F.round("promotion_discount_pct_2", 0).alias("promotion_discount_pct_2_rounded"),
    )
)

valid = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("promotion_promo_code_2").isin(["VIP", "BUNDLE"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "starts_on",
        "promo_id",
        "promotion_discount_pct",
        "promo_id_2",
        "promotion_discount_pct_2_int",
        "promotion_discount_pct_2_rounded",
        F.round((F.col("promotion_discount_pct") / F.col("promo_id_2")), 2).alias("promotion_discount_pct_per_promo_id_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .withColumn("activity_month", F.date_trunc("MONTH", "starts_on"))
    .withColumn("promotion_discount_pct_per_promo_id_2_tier", F.when(F.col("promotion_discount_pct_per_promo_id_2") >= 84, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["activity_month", "promotion_discount_pct_per_promo_id_2_tier"], ["activity_month"], []],
        "activity_month",
        "promotion_discount_pct_per_promo_id_2_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("channel") == "store").alias("store_events"),
        F.count_if(F.col("channel") == "web").alias("web_events"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "mobile", 1)).alias("mobile_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("promotion_discount_pct", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("promotion_discount_pct_quartiles"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("web_events") < 1000)
    .orderBy(F.col("mobile_count").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

sql:
with filtered as (
    select
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        concat(merchant, ' ', txn_type) as merchant_txn_type
    from transactions
    where merchant is not null
      and is_flagged = false
),
enriched as (
    select *, last_value(merchant, true) over (partition by merchant, txn_type order by txn_time, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_merchant
    from filtered
    where is_flagged
),
latest as (
    select
        id,
        txn_type,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        merchant_txn_type,
        last_known_merchant
    from enriched
    qualify row_number() over (partition by merchant order by txn_time desc nulls last, id) = 1
),
valid as (
    select *, coalesce(merchant, 'Unknown') as merchant_filled
    from latest
    where merchant is not null
),
cleaned as (
    select
        id,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        merchant_txn_type,
        merchant_filled,
        upper(merchant) as merchant_upper,
        coalesce(merchant, 'DIRECT') as resolved_merchant
    from valid
    where merchant is not null
      and txn_type in ('REFUND', 'FEE')
),
valid_transactions as (
    select
        *,
        lower(merchant) as merchant_lower,
        cast(is_flagged as int) as is_flagged_flag
    from cleaned
    where merchant <> 'Amazon'
),
metrics as (
    select
        *,
        lag(is_flagged_flag) over w_running as prev_is_flagged_flag,
        lead(is_flagged_flag) over w_running as next_is_flagged_flag,
        row_number() over w_running as seq_no
    from valid_transactions
    window w_running as (partition by merchant order by is_flagged_flag, id)
)
select
    id,
    is_flagged,
    merchant_txn_type,
    resolved_merchant,
    is_flagged_flag,
    prev_is_flagged_flag,
    next_is_flagged_flag,
    seq_no
from metrics
order by is_flagged_flag desc nulls last, prev_is_flagged_flag
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("merchant", "txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("is_flagged_flag", "id")

filtered = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & ~F.col("is_flagged"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        F.concat("merchant", F.lit(" "), "txn_type").alias("merchant_txn_type"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("is_flagged"))
    .withColumn("last_known_merchant", F.last("merchant", ignorenulls=True).over(w))
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "txn_type",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        "merchant_txn_type",
        "last_known_merchant",
    )
)

valid = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("Unknown")).alias("merchant_filled"))
)

cleaned = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isNotNull() & F.col("txn_type").isin(["REFUND", "FEE"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        "merchant_txn_type",
        "merchant_filled",
        F.upper("merchant").alias("merchant_upper"),
        F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_merchant"),
    )
)

valid_transactions = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("merchant") != "Amazon")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lower("merchant").alias("merchant_lower"),
        F.col("is_flagged").cast("int").alias("is_flagged_flag"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    valid_transactions
    .withColumn("prev_is_flagged_flag", F.lag("is_flagged_flag").over(w_running))
    .withColumn("next_is_flagged_flag", F.lead("is_flagged_flag").over(w_running))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w_running))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "is_flagged",
        "merchant_txn_type",
        "resolved_merchant",
        "is_flagged_flag",
        "prev_is_flagged_flag",
        "next_is_flagged_flag",
        "seq_no",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("is_flagged_flag").desc_nulls_last(), "prev_is_flagged_flag")
)
```

sql:
WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        CASE WHEN page IN ('/home', '/product') THEN 'Priority' ELSE 'Other' END AS page_group,
        COALESCE(page, 'UNKNOWN') AS page_filled
    FROM web_events
    WHERE page IS NOT NULL
      AND event_type NOT IN ('page_view', 'purchase', 'search')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.session_id,
        a.page,
        a.event_time,
        a.page_filled,
        b.browser,
        b.device
    FROM base a
    LEFT JOIN sessions b
        ON a.session_id = b.id
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM enriched
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_time >= '2024-01-01'
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
base_web_events AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        session_id,
        event_time,
        device,
        TRIM(device) AS clean_device
    FROM kept_rows
    WHERE event_time > DATE '2023-06-21'
      AND device IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT
        a.session_id,
        a.event_time,
        a.device,
        a.clean_device,
        s.country,
        s.browser,
        s.device AS session_device
    FROM base_web_events a
    LEFT JOIN sessions s
        ON a.session_id = s.id
),
enriched_web_events AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        s.device AS session_device_2,
        s.browser AS session_browser,
        s.country AS session_country
    FROM joined e
    LEFT JOIN sessions s
        ON e.session_id = s.id
    WHERE s.country = 'US'
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    session_device_2,
    session_device,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_browser) AS distinct_session_browsers,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN session_browser = 'Safari' THEN 1 END) AS safari_count,
    GROUPING(session_device_2) AS grouping_level
FROM enriched_web_events
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((session_device_2, session_device), (session_device_2), ())
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN session_browser = 'Safari' THEN 1 END) > 1;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull() & ~F.col("event_type").isin(["page_view", "purchase", "search"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        F.when(F.col("page").isin(["/home", "/product"]), "Priority").otherwise("Other").alias("page_group"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("page_filled"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("b"), F.col("a.session_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.session_id",
        "a.page",
        "a.event_time",
        "a.page_filled",
        F.col("b.browser"),
        F.col("b.device"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("event_time") >= "2024-01-01")
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base_web_events = (
    kept_rows
    .filter((F.col("event_time") > F.lit("2023-06-21").cast("date")) & F.col("device").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "session_id",
        "event_time",
        "device",
        F.trim("device").alias("clean_device"),
    )
)

joined = (
    base_web_events
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("s"), F.col("a.session_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.session_id",
        "a.event_time",
        "a.device",
        "a.clean_device",
        F.col("s.country"),
        F.col("s.browser"),
        F.col("s.device").alias("session_device"),
    )
)

enriched_web_events = (
    joined
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("s"), F.col("e.session_id") == F.col("s.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("s.country") == "US")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("s.device").alias("session_device_2"),
        F.col("s.browser").alias("session_browser"),
        F.col("s.country").alias("session_country"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_web_events
    .groupingSets(
        [["session_device_2", "session_device"], ["session_device_2"], []],
        "session_device_2",
        "session_device",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.countDistinct("session_browser").alias("distinct_session_browsers"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("session_browser") == "Safari", 1)).alias("safari_count"),
        F.grouping("session_device_2").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("safari_count") > 1)
)
```

with valid as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        *,
        if(is_remote, 'Yes', 'No') as is_remote_label,
        trim(job_title) as clean_job_title
    from employees
    where hire_date >= to_date('2023-04-02')
      and manager_id is not null
),
deduped as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        hire_date,
        level,
        clean_job_title
    from valid
    qualify row_number() over (partition by manager_id order by hire_date desc nulls last, id) = 1
),
valid_employees as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        hire_date,
        level,
        clean_job_title,
        trim(full_name) as clean_full_name
    from deduped
    where lower(trim(email)) = 'kanya@mail.co.th'
),
latest as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select
        id,
        full_name,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        hire_date,
        level,
        clean_job_title
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by job_title, dept_id order by hire_date nulls last, id) as rank_in_group
        from valid_employees
    ) t
    where rank_in_group = 1
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
select
    id,
    full_name,
    dept_id,
    level,
    first_value(job_title) ignore nulls over (partition by dept_id order by hire_date, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_job_title
from latest;

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy(F.col("hire_date").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("job_title", "dept_id").orderBy(F.col("hire_date").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("hire_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_employees
    .filter((F.col("hire_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-04-02"))) & F.col("manager_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("is_remote_label", F.when(F.col("is_remote"), "Yes").otherwise("No"))
    .withColumn("clean_job_title", F.trim("job_title"))
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        "hire_date",
        "level",
        "clean_job_title",

valid_employees = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.lower(F.trim("email")) == "kanya@mail.co.th")
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        "hire_date",
        "level",
        "clean_job_title",
        F.trim("full_name").alias("clean_full_name"),
    )
)

latest = (
    valid_employees
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w2))

    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "dept_id",
        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        "hire_date",
        "level",
        "clean_job_title",
    )
)

result = (

        "full_name",
        "dept_id",
```

sql:
with lines as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        element
    from price_tiers
    lateral view explode(discounts) li as element
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        plan,
        effective_from,
        element,
        rank() over (partition by plan order by element desc nulls first) as element_rank,
        percent_rank() over (order by element nulls first) as element_percent_rank
    from lines
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select plan
    from with_windows
    except
    select plan
    from price_tiers
    where currency = 'USD'
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from with_windows s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.plan = k.plan
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select plan
    from verified
    except
    select plan
    from price_tiers
    where currency = 'USD'
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from verified s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.plan = k.plan
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    case when element >= 71 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as element_tier,
    sum(element) filter (where plan = 'basic') as basic_total_element,
    size(collect_set(plan)) as num_plans,
    approx_percentile(element_percent_rank, 0.95) as element_percent_rank_p95
from kept_rows
group by element_tier
order by element_percent_rank_p95 desc nulls first;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("element").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("element").asc_nulls_first())

lines = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        F.explode("discounts").alias("element"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    lines
    .select(
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "element",
        F.rank().over(w).alias("element_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w2).alias("element_percent_rank"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("plan")
    .subtract(
        df_price_tiers
        .filter(F.col("currency") == "USD")
        .select("plan")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.plan") == F.col("k.plan")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

remaining_keys = (
    verified
    .select("plan")
    .subtract(
        df_price_tiers
        .filter(F.col("currency") == "USD")
        .select("plan")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    verified
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.plan") == F.col("k.plan")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("element") >= 71, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("element_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "basic", F.col("element"))).alias("basic_total_element"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("plan")).alias("num_plans"),
        F.percentile_approx("element_percent_rank", 0.95).alias("element_percent_rank_p95"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("element_percent_rank_p95").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

WITH valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, INITCAP(TRIM(plan)) AS plan_title
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', start_date) AS start_date_period
    FROM valid
    WHERE end_date >= DATE '2023-09-27'
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        end_date,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status ORDER BY CAST(start_date_period AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS monthly_fee_sum_90d,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY start_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_monthly_fee,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(start_date), customer_id ORDER BY monthly_fee, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_monthly_fee,
        FIRST_VALUE(monthly_fee) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY start_date_period, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_monthly_fee,
        AVG(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY end_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS monthly_fee_avg_3_prior
    FROM base
    WHERE YEAR(end_date) = 2024

```python
w8 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("end_date")).orderBy("monthly_fee_sum_90d", "id")
w9 = Window.orderBy("first_known_monthly_fee", "id")
w10 = Window.orderBy("monthly_fee_avg_3_prior", "id")

valid = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.initcap(F.trim("plan")).alias("plan_title"))
)

base = (

)

scored = (

        F.avg("monthly_fee").over(w5).alias("monthly_fee_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

base_subscriptions = (
    scored
    .filter(F.year("end_date") == 2023)

        "end_date",

filtered = (
```

WITH scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        status,
        ROUND(monthly_fee / SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY plan), 4) AS monthly_fee_share,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_recent AS event_seq,
        NTILE(4) OVER w_recent_2 AS monthly_fee_bucket,
        LAG(monthly_fee, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY plan, customer_id ORDER BY monthly_fee, id) AS prev_monthly_fee,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered AS event_seq_2
    FROM subscriptions
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(start_date), customer_id ORDER BY start_date, id), w_recent_2 AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC, id), w_ordered AS (ORDER BY monthly_fee, id)
),
with_window AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan AS subscription_plan,
        sub.monthly_fee
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON s.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND s.start_date BETWEEN sub.start_date AND sub.end_date
),
matched AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id_2,
        sub.plan AS subscription_plan_2,
        sub.monthly_fee AS subscription_monthly_fee
    FROM with_window e
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON e.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND e.start_date BETWEEN sub.start_date AND sub.end_date
),
scored_subscriptions AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY monthly_fee_bucket NULLS LAST) AS monthly_fee_bucket_percent_rank,
        ROUND(prev_monthly_fee / SUM(prev_monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_plan), 4) AS prev_monthly_fee_share,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_plan_2, subscription_plan ORDER BY start_date, id, subscription_id, subscription_id_2 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_monthly_fee
    FROM matched
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        status,
        monthly_fee_share,
        event_seq,
        prev_monthly_fee,
        subscription_id,
        monthly_fee,
        subscription_id_2,
        monthly_fee_bucket_percent_rank,
        cumulative_monthly_fee,
        MIN(subscription_id) OVER w_part AS running_min_subscription_id,
        AVG(subscription_id) OVER w_part AS running_avg_subscription_id,
        MAX(subscription_id) OVER w_part AS running_max_subscription_id
    FROM scored_subscriptions
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY subscription_plan_2 ORDER BY monthly_fee_bucket, id, subscription_id, subscription_id_2 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status, plan ORDER BY monthly_fee_bucket_percent_rank DESC NULLS FIRST, id, subscription_id, subscription_id_2) AS latest_rank
        FROM with_windows
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT *, INITCAP(TRIM(status)) AS status_title
    FROM latest
    WHERE running_min_subscription_id <= 6.9
)
SELECT
    id,
    plan,
    status,
    monthly_fee_share,
    prev_monthly_fee,
    subscription_id,
    monthly_fee,
    subscription_id_2,
    running_min_subscription_id,
    CASE WHEN plan RLIKE '^(enterprise|premium)$' THEN 'CORE' WHEN plan RLIKE '^(basic|standard)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'PRIORITY' END AS plan_zone
FROM cleaned

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy(F.month("start_date"), "customer_id").orderBy("start_date", "id")
w_recent_2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan", "customer_id").orderBy("monthly_fee", "id")
w_ordered = Window.orderBy("monthly_fee", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee_bucket").asc_nulls_last())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("subscription_plan")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("subscription_plan_2", "subscription_plan").orderBy("start_date", "id", "subscription_id", "subscription_id_2").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_part = Window.partitionBy("subscription_plan_2").orderBy("monthly_fee_bucket", "id", "subscription_id", "subscription_id_2").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.partitionBy("status", "plan").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee_bucket_percent_rank").desc_nulls_first(), "id", "subscription_id", "subscription_id_2")

scored = (
    df_subscriptions
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",

        F.row_number().over(w_recent).alias("event_seq"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w_recent_2).alias("monthly_fee_bucket"),
        F.lag("monthly_fee", 1).over(w4).alias("prev_monthly_fee"),
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("event_seq_2"),
    )
)

with_window = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & F.col("s.start_date").between(F.col("sub.start_date"), F.col("sub.end_date")), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan").alias("subscription_plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

matched = (
    with_window
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & F.col("e.start_date").between(F.col("sub.start_date"), F.col("sub.end_date")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id_2"),
        F.col("sub.plan").alias("subscription_plan_2"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee").alias("subscription_monthly_fee"),

)

        F.round((F.col("prev_monthly_fee") / F.sum("prev_monthly_fee").over(w7)), 4).alias("prev_monthly_fee_share"),

        "id",
        "plan",
        "status",
        "monthly_fee_share",
        "event_seq",
        "prev_monthly_fee",
        "subscription_id",
        "monthly_fee",
        "subscription_id_2",
        "monthly_fee_bucket_percent_rank",

    )
)

latest = (

    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w10))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

cleaned = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("running_min_subscription_id") <= 6.9)
    .withColumn("status_title", F.initcap(F.trim("status")))
)

result = (

    .select(

        "status",
        "monthly_fee_share",
        "prev_monthly_fee",
        "subscription_id",
        "monthly_fee",
        "subscription_id_2",

    )
)
```

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), last_restock) AS days_since_last_restock
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock > DATE '2023-08-29'
      AND quantity > 113
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.store_id,
        e.product_id,
        e.quantity,
        e.last_restock,
        b.launch_date,
        b.brand
    FROM cleaned e
    JOIN products b
        ON e.product_id = b.id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM with_dims
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY launch_date DESC, id) = 1
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_FORMAT(launch_date, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS launch_date_label,
        COALESCE(brand, 'NONE') AS resolved_brand
    FROM ranked
    WHERE product_id = 4
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.store_id,
    s.product_id,
    s.last_restock,
    s.launch_date,
    s.launch_date_label,
    s.resolved_brand,
    (SELECT MAX(t2.quantity) FROM inventory t2 WHERE t2.store_id = s.store_id) AS max_inventory_quantity
FROM valid s
ORDER BY id NULLS LAST;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("launch_date").desc(), "id")
quantity_by_store_id = df_inventory.groupBy("store_id").agg(F.max("quantity").alias("max_inventory_quantity"))

cleaned = (
    df_inventory
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") > F.lit("2023-08-29").cast("date")) & (F.col("quantity") > 113))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "last_restock").alias("days_since_last_restock"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    cleaned
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("b"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.store_id",
        "e.product_id",
        "e.quantity",
        "e.last_restock",
        F.col("b.launch_date"),
        F.col("b.brand"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

valid = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("product_id") == 4)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.date_format("launch_date", "yyyy-MM-dd").alias("launch_date_label"),
        F.coalesce("brand", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_brand"),
    )
)

result = (
    valid
    .join(quantity_by_store_id, on="store_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        "launch_date",
        "launch_date_label",
        "resolved_brand",
        F.col("max_inventory_quantity"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("id").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

sql:
WITH lines AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) t AS k, value
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        value,
        CAST(log_ts AS DATE) AS log_ts_day,
        CASE WHEN k = 'trace' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_trace
    FROM lines
    WHERE log_ts >= DATE '2025-06-01'
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(latency_ms / SUM(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY service), 4) AS latency_ms_share,
        AVG(is_trace) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY latency_ms, id, k ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS is_trace_avg_6,
        MAX(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(log_ts_day), k) AS log_ts_day_month_max_latency_ms
    FROM base
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY latency_ms_share DESC, id, k) AS row_num
        FROM with_windows
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY is_trace, id, k) = 1
),
ranked_app_logs AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY latency_ms DESC NULLS FIRST, id, k) AS row_num_2
        FROM deduped
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num_2 = 1
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN is_trace_avg_6 >= 78 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS is_trace_avg_6_tier,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', log_ts_day) AS week_start,
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', log_ts_day) AS quarter_start,
    COUNT(DISTINCT k) AS distinct_ks,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'trace' THEN log_ts_day_month_max_latency_ms ELSE 0 END) AS trace_log_ts_day_month_max_latency_ms,
    ROUND(AVG(is_trace), 2) AS avg_is_trace,
    COUNT_IF(k = 'version') AS version_events
FROM ranked_app_logs
GROUP BY CASE WHEN is_trace_avg_6 >= 78 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', log_ts_day), DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', log_ts_day)
ORDER BY version_events DESC

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("service")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("latency_ms", "id", "k").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("log_ts_day"), "k")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_share").desc(), "id", "k")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("is_trace", "id", "k")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc_nulls_first(), "id", "k")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "value"),
    )
)

base = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("log_ts") >= F.lit("2025-06-01").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "latency_ms",
        "k",
        "value",
        F.col("log_ts").cast("date").alias("log_ts_day"),
        F.when(F.col("k") == "trace", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_trace"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .withColumn("latency_ms_share", F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(w)), 4))
    .withColumn("is_trace_avg_6", F.avg("is_trace").over(w2))
    .withColumn("log_ts_day_month_max_latency_ms", F.max("latency_ms").over(w3))
)

ranked = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

deduped = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

ranked_app_logs = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("row_num_2", F.row_number().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("row_num_2") == 1)
)

result = (
    ranked_app_logs
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("is_trace_avg_6") >= 78, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("is_trace_avg_6_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "log_ts_day").alias("week_start"),
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "log_ts_day").alias("quarter_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("k").alias("distinct_ks"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("k") == "trace", F.col("log_ts_day_month_max_latency_ms")).otherwise(0)).alias("trace_log_ts_day_month_max_latency_ms"),
        F.round(F.avg("is_trace"), 2).alias("avg_is_trace"),
        F.count_if(F.col("k") == "version").alias("version_events"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("version_events").desc())
)
```

```python
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & F.col("a.end_date").between(F.col("sub.start_date"), F.col("sub.end_date")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee").alias("subscription_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    matched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("monthly_fee").over(w).alias("city_avg_monthly_fee"),
        F.round((F.col("monthly_fee") / F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w2)), 4).alias("monthly_fee_share"),
        F.avg("subscription_monthly_fee").over(w3).alias("subscription_monthly_fee_avg_3"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.city",
        "s.subscription_id",
        "s.plan",
        "s.subscription_monthly_fee",
        "s.monthly_fee_share",
        "s.subscription_monthly_fee_avg_3",
        F.col("b.email"),
        F.col("b.name"),
        F.col("b.segment"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    with_dims
    .select("id", "customer_id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_subscriptions
        .filter(F.col("monthly_fee") <= 240)
        .select("id", "customer_id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    with_dims
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

stats = (
    reconciled
    .withColumn("monthly_fee_share_tier", F.when(F.col("monthly_fee_share") >= 0.67, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .cube("plan", "monthly_fee_share_tier")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Singapore", 1)).alias("singapore_rows"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("segment")).alias("num_segments"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("city") == "Chiang Mai", F.col("subscription_monthly_fee"))).alias("chiang_mai_avg_subscription_monthly_fee"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("plan")).alias("plan_list"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("plan")).alias("plan_list_2"),
        F.round(F.sum("subscription_monthly_fee_avg_3") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Consumer", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("subscription_monthly_fee_avg_3_per_consumer"),
        F.grouping("plan").alias("gid"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select(
        "plan",
        "monthly_fee_share_tier",
        "singapore_rows",
        "num_segments",
        "chiang_mai_avg_subscription_monthly_fee",
        "plan_list_2",
        "gid",
        F.when(F.col("plan").rlike("^(enterprise|basic)$"), "GROUP_A").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("plan_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee_share_tier").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

sql:
WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) li AS k, attr_value
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        latency_ms,
        k,
        attr_value,
        ROUND(latency_ms / SUM(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY k), 4) AS latency_ms_share,
        AVG(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY k) AS k_avg_status_code,
        ROUND(latency_ms / SUM(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY k), 4) AS latency_ms_share_2,
        SUM(status_code) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_sum_1h,
        ROUND(latency_ms / SUM(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(log_ts), k), 4) AS latency_ms_share_3
    FROM exploded
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        k,
        latency_ms_share,
        k_avg_status_code,
        latency_ms_share_3,
        CAST(latency_ms AS STRING) AS latency_ms_str,
        latency_ms_share_3 + k_avg_status_code AS latency_ms_share_3_plus_k_avg_status_code,
        COALESCE(k, 'N/A') AS k_clean
    FROM scored
    WHERE latency_ms >= 2007
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms_share NULLS LAST) AS latency_ms_share_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY latency_ms_share DESC) AS latency_ms_share_dense_rank_2
    FROM filtered
    WHERE latency_ms_share < 0.24
)
SELECT
    latency_ms_share,
    k_avg_status_code,
    latency_ms_share_3,
    k_clean,
    latency_ms_share_dense_rank_2
FROM enriched
ORDER BY k_avg_status_code DESC
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("log_ts"), "k")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_share").asc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_share").desc())

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

scored = (
    exploded
    .select(
        "latency_ms",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(w)), 4).alias("latency_ms_share"),
        F.avg("status_code").over(w).alias("k_avg_status_code"),
        F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(w)), 4).alias("latency_ms_share_2"),
        F.sum("status_code").over(w2).alias("status_code_sum_1h"),
        F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(w3)), 4).alias("latency_ms_share_3"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms") >= 2007)
    .select(
        "k",
        "latency_ms_share",
        "k_avg_status_code",
        "latency_ms_share_3",
        F.col("latency_ms").cast("string").alias("latency_ms_str"),
        (F.col("latency_ms_share_3") + F.col("k_avg_status_code")).alias("latency_ms_share_3_plus_k_avg_status_code"),
        F.coalesce("k", F.lit("N/A")).alias("k_clean"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms_share") < 0.24)
    .withColumn("latency_ms_share_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_share_dense_rank_2", F.dense_rank().over(w5))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "latency_ms_share",
        "k_avg_status_code",
        "latency_ms_share_3",
        "k_clean",
        "latency_ms_share_dense_rank_2",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("k_avg_status_code").desc())
)
```

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        ROUND(unit_price, 1) AS unit_price_rounded
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND product_id IN (4, 10, 19, 34)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        unit_price_rounded,
        ROUND(unit_price * 0.9, 2) AS unit_price_scaled
    FROM valid
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, COALESCE(unit_price_rounded, 0) AS unit_price_rounded_filled
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND unit_price_scaled BETWEEN 27 AND 32
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.price,
        p.brand
    FROM base a
    LEFT JOIN products p
        ON a.product_id <=> p.id
)
-- Window metrics over several different partitions
SELECT
    id,
    quantity,
    unit_price,
    unit_price_scaled,
    unit_price_rounded_filled,
    price,
    brand,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY unit_price_scaled) AS unit_price_scaled_cume_dist,
    LAST_VALUE(unit_price_scaled) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_unit_price_scaled,
    LEAD(unit_price_rounded, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, brand ORDER BY unit_price_rounded_filled, id) AS next_unit_price_rounded,
    SUM(unit_price_scaled) OVER (PARTITION BY brand, product_id ORDER BY unit_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_unit_price_scaled
FROM with_dims;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("unit_price_scaled")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("unit_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "brand").orderBy("unit_price_rounded_filled", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("brand", "product_id").orderBy("unit_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull() & F.col("product_id").isin([4, 10, 19, 34]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "unit_price",
        F.round("unit_price", 1).alias("unit_price_rounded"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "unit_price",
        "unit_price_rounded",
        F.round((F.col("unit_price") * 0.9), 2).alias("unit_price_scaled"),
    )
)

base = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull() & F.col("unit_price_scaled").between(27, 32))
    .withColumn("unit_price_rounded_filled", F.coalesce("unit_price_rounded", F.lit(0)))
)

with_dims = (
    base
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("a.product_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("p.id")), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.price"), F.col("p.brand"))
)

result = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity",
        "unit_price",
        "unit_price_scaled",
        "unit_price_rounded_filled",
        "price",
        "brand",
        F.cume_dist().over(w).alias("unit_price_scaled_cume_dist"),
        F.last("unit_price_scaled", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_unit_price_scaled"),
        F.lead("unit_price_rounded", 1).over(w3).alias("next_unit_price_rounded"),
        F.sum("unit_price_scaled").over(w4).alias("running_unit_price_scaled"),
    )
)
```

sql:
WITH flattened AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        level,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) x AS attr_key, v
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY status_code, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_avg_3,
        FIRST_VALUE(attr_key) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY status_code, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_attr_key,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY status_code DESC) AS status_code_rank
    FROM flattened
    WHERE status_code = 422
),
latest AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        level,
        attr_key,
        v,
        status_code_avg_3,
        first_known_attr_key,
        status_code_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service, level ORDER BY status_code_avg_3 DESC NULLS FIRST, id, attr_key) AS dedup_rank
        FROM enriched
    ) t
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT service, level
    FROM latest
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT service, level
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE latency_ms BETWEEN 949 AND 1538
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.service = k.service AND s.level = k.level
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COALESCE(status_code_avg_3, 0) AS status_code_avg_3_filled,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'UNKNOWN') AS attr_key_clean
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE level IN ('INFO', 'DEBUG', 'ERROR')
)
SELECT
    id,
    level,
    attr_key,
    v,
    status_code_avg_3,
    first_known_attr_key,
    status_code_rank,
    CASE WHEN attr_key RLIKE '^(version|region)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' ELSE 'GROUP_B' END AS attr_key_zone
FROM base
ORDER BY status_code_avg_3 DESC
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("status_code", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("status_code", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("service", "level").orderBy(F.col("status_code_avg_3").desc_nulls_first(), "id", "attr_key")

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "v"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("status_code") == 422)
    .withColumn("status_code_avg_3", F.avg("status_code").over(w))
    .withColumn("first_known_attr_key", F.first("attr_key", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
    .withColumn("status_code_rank", F.rank().over(w3))
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "level",
        "attr_key",
        "v",
        "status_code_avg_3",
        "first_known_attr_key",
        "status_code_rank",
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    latest
    .select("service", "level")
    .subtract(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("latency_ms").between(949, 1538))
        .select("service", "level")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.service") == F.col("k.service")) & (F.col("s.level") == F.col("k.level")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("level").isin(["INFO", "DEBUG", "ERROR"]))
    .withColumn("status_code_avg_3_filled", F.coalesce("status_code_avg_3", F.lit(0)))
    .withColumn("attr_key_clean", F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

result = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "level",
        "attr_key",
        "v",
        "status_code_avg_3",
        "first_known_attr_key",
        "status_code_rank",
        F.when(F.col("attr_key").rlike("^(version|region)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("GROUP_B").alias("attr_key_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("status_code_avg_3").desc())
)
```
