sql:
with ranked as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by end_date desc nulls last, id) as rank_in_group
        from subscriptions
    ) t
    where rank_in_group = 1
),
attributed as (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    select
        a.*,
        sub.id as subscription_id,
        sub.plan as subscription_plan,
        sub.monthly_fee as subscription_monthly_fee
    from ranked a
    left join subscriptions sub
        on a.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       and a.end_date between sub.start_date and sub.end_date
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        round(monthly_fee / sum(monthly_fee) over (partition by month(end_date), subscription_plan), 4) as monthly_fee_share,
        avg(monthly_fee) over (partition by month(end_date), status order by subscription_id, id, subscription_id rows between 2 preceding and 1 preceding) as monthly_fee_avg_2_prior,
        first_value(subscription_monthly_fee) ignore nulls over (partition by status order by start_date, id, subscription_id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_subscription_monthly_fee
    from attributed
),
scored as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        max(monthly_fee_avg_2_prior) over (partition by subscription_plan, plan order by start_date, id, subscription_id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_max_monthly_fee_avg_2_prior,
        count(monthly_fee_avg_2_prior) over (partition by subscription_plan, plan order by start_date, id, subscription_id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_count_monthly_fee_avg_2_prior,
        avg(monthly_fee_avg_2_prior) over (partition by subscription_plan, plan order by start_date, id, subscription_id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_avg_monthly_fee_avg_2_prior
    from with_windows
)
select
    id,
    customer_id,
    plan,
    start_date,
    monthly_fee,
    status,
    rank_in_group,
    subscription_id,
    subscription_plan,
    case when plan rlike '^(enterprise|premium)$' then 'GROUP_A' when plan rlike '^(basic|standard)$' then 'PRIORITY' else 'GROUP_B' end as plan_zone
from scored
order by rank_in_group nulls first;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("end_date").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("end_date"), "subscription_plan")
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("end_date"), "status").orderBy("subscription_id", "id", "subscription_id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("start_date", "id", "subscription_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("subscription_plan", "plan").orderBy("start_date", "id", "subscription_id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

ranked = (
    df_subscriptions
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

attributed = (
    ranked
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & F.col("a.end_date").between(F.col("sub.start_date"), F.col("sub.end_date")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan").alias("subscription_plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee").alias("subscription_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    attributed
    .withColumn("monthly_fee_share", F.round((F.col("monthly_fee") / F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w2)), 4))
    .withColumn("monthly_fee_avg_2_prior", F.avg("monthly_fee").over(w3))
    .withColumn("first_known_subscription_monthly_fee", F.first("subscription_monthly_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(w4))
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("monthly_fee_avg_2_prior").over(w5).alias("running_max_monthly_fee_avg_2_prior"),
        F.count("monthly_fee_avg_2_prior").over(w5).alias("running_count_monthly_fee_avg_2_prior"),
        F.avg("monthly_fee_avg_2_prior").over(w5).alias("running_avg_monthly_fee_avg_2_prior"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        "rank_in_group",
        "subscription_id",
        "subscription_plan",
        F.when(F.col("plan").rlike("^(enterprise|premium)$"), "GROUP_A").when(F.col("plan").rlike("^(basic|standard)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("GROUP_B").alias("plan_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("rank_in_group").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM payments
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY paid_at NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount DESC, id) = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        method,
        amount,
        status
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY method, order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount, id) AS prev_amount,
        LEAD(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount, id) AS next_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount, id) AS seq_no,
        LAST_VALUE(method) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_method
    FROM latest
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT status, id
    FROM metrics
    EXCEPT
    SELECT status, id
    FROM payments
    WHERE status NOT IN ('REFUNDED', 'SUCCESS')
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.status = k.status AND s.id = k.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        method,
        status,
        prev_amount,
        next_amount,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_hist AS prev_amount_percent_rank
    FROM reconciled
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY prev_amount NULLS FIRST)
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN amount_rank >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS amount_rank_tier,
    method,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(amount_rank, 0.9) AS amount_rank_p90,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(prev_amount_percent_rank, 0.5) AS prev_amount_percent_rank_p50,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(next_amount, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS next_amount_quartiles
FROM enriched
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING event_count > 1
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").asc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("method", "order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("amount", "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("amount").desc())
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("prev_amount").asc_nulls_first())

ranked = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

deduped = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

latest = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "method", "amount", "status")
)

metrics = (
    latest
    .withColumn("prev_amount", F.lag("amount").over(w4))
    .withColumn("next_amount", F.lead("amount").over(w4))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .withColumn("last_known_method", F.last("method", ignorenulls=True).over(w5))
)

matched_keys = (
    metrics
    .select("status", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_payments
        .filter(~F.col("status").isin(["REFUNDED", "SUCCESS"]))
        .select("status", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "status",
        "prev_amount",
        "next_amount",
        F.rank().over(w6).alias("amount_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_hist).alias("prev_amount_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("amount_rank") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("amount_rank_tier"),
        "method",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("amount_rank", 0.9).alias("amount_rank_p90"),
        F.percentile_approx("prev_amount_percent_rank", 0.5).alias("prev_amount_percent_rank_p50"),
        F.percentile_approx("next_amount", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("next_amount_quartiles"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("event_count") > 1)
)
```

with exploded as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        key,
        attr_value
    from app_logs
    lateral view outer explode(context) x as key, attr_value
),
cleaned as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        host,
        level,
        status_code,
        key,
        attr_value,
        cast(status_code as string) as status_code_str,
        trim(host) as clean_host,
        coalesce(key, 'N/A') as key_clean
    from exploded
    where log_ts > date '2025-06-01'
      and status_code between 379 and 433
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        level,
        status_code,
        clean_host,
        round(status_code / sum(status_code) over (partition by level), 4) as status_code_share,
        cume_dist() over (partition by key order by status_code desc) as status_code_cume_dist
    from cleaned
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select *, count(status_code_cume_dist) over (partition by level) as level_count_status_code_cume_dist
    from with_windows
    where status_code_cume_dist <= 0.5
),
with_windows_app_logs as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        rank() over (order by status_code desc) as status_code_rank,
        cume_dist() over (partition by level order by status_code_cume_dist desc nulls last) as status_code_cume_dist_cume_dist
    from enriched
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    case when status_code_cume_dist_cume_dist >= 0.61 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as status_code_cume_dist_cume_dist_tier,
    level,
    count(distinct level) as distinct_levels,
    size(collect_set(level)) as num_levels,
    count(case when level = 'ERROR' then 1 end) as error_count,
    count(distinct id) as distinct_ids,
    size(collect_set(level)) as num_levels_2,
    count(*) filter (where level = 'DEBUG') as debug_rows
from with_windows_app_logs
group by case when status_code_cume_dist_cume_dist >= 0.61 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end, level

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("level")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc())
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("status_code_cume_dist").desc_nulls_last())

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    exploded
    .filter((F.col("log_ts") > F.lit("2025-06-01").cast("date")) & F.col("status_code").between(379, 433))
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        "key",
        "attr_value",
        F.col("status_code").cast("string").alias("status_code_str"),
        F.trim("host").alias("clean_host"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("N/A")).alias("key_clean"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        "clean_host",
        F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(w)), 4).alias("status_code_share"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("status_code_cume_dist"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("status_code_cume_dist") <= 0.5)
    .withColumn("level_count_status_code_cume_dist", F.count("status_code_cume_dist").over(w))
)

with_windows_app_logs = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("status_code_rank", F.rank().over(w3))
    .withColumn("status_code_cume_dist_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w4))
)

result = (
    with_windows_app_logs
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("status_code_cume_dist_cume_dist") >= 0.61, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("status_code_cume_dist_cume_dist_tier"),
        "level",
    )
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("level").alias("distinct_levels"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("level")).alias("num_levels"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("level") == "ERROR", 1)).alias("error_count"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("level")).alias("num_levels_2"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("level") == "DEBUG", 1)).alias("debug_rows"),
    )
)
```

        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_avg_30d,
        LAG(amount, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(paid_at), status ORDER BY paid_at, id) AS prev_amount

SELECT
    s.id,
    s.order_id,
    s.method,
    s.amount,

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        paid_at,
        status,
        CASE WHEN method IN ('card', 'bank_transfer') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END AS method_group,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), paid_at) AS days_since_paid_at
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at > TO_TIMESTAMP('2023-04-23 13:00:00')
      AND method IS DISTINCT FROM 'cash'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        paid_at,
        method_group,
        days_since_paid_at,
        SUM(days_since_paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_days_since_paid_at,
        MIN(days_since_paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_days_since_paid_at,
        AVG(days_since_paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_days_since_paid_at
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE days_since_paid_at BETWEEN 41 AND 77
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        days_since_paid_at,
        running_sum_days_since_paid_at,
        running_avg_days_since_paid_at
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY days_since_paid_at DESC) AS rn
        FROM enriched

sql:
WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        COALESCE(quantity, 0) AS quantity_filled
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock >= DATE '2023-08-17'
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        quantity_filled,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(last_restock), store_id ORDER BY last_restock, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_quantity,
        LEAD(quantity_filled, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS next_quantity_filled
    FROM valid
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
ranked_inventory AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY running_quantity, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.brand,
        b.price,
        b.product_name
    FROM ranked_inventory a
    LEFT JOIN products b
        ON a.product_id = b.id
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    id,
    product_id,
    measure,
    metric_value
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        next_quantity_filled,
        quantity_filled,
        price
    FROM enriched
) src
UNPIVOT (
    metric_value FOR measure IN (next_quantity_filled AS NEXT_QUANTITY_FILLED, quantity_filled AS QUANTITY_FILLED, price)
)
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.month("last_restock"), "store_id").orderBy("last_restock", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("running_quantity", "id")

valid = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= F.lit("2023-08-17").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        F.coalesce("quantity", F.lit(0)).alias("quantity_filled"),
    )
)

scored = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        "quantity_filled",
        F.sum("quantity").over(w).alias("running_quantity"),
        F.lead("quantity_filled", 2).over(w2).alias("next_quantity_filled"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    scored
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

ranked_inventory = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    ranked_inventory
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_products.alias("b"), F.col("a.product_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("b.brand"), F.col("b.price"), F.col("b.product_name"))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        F.col("next_quantity_filled").alias("NEXT_QUANTITY_FILLED"),
        F.col("quantity_filled").alias("QUANTITY_FILLED"),
        "price",
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "product_id"],
        values=["NEXT_QUANTITY_FILLED", "QUANTITY_FILLED", "price"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="metric_value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("metric_value").isNotNull())
)
```

sql:
with base as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        session_id,
        page,
        event_time,
        date_format(event_time, 'yyyy-MM') as event_time_label,
        coalesce(page, 'OTHER') as page_filled
    from web_events
    where page is not null
      and page is distinct from '/search'
),
base_web_events as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select *, case when page in ('/checkout', '/product') then 'Priority' else 'Other' end as page_group
    from base
    where page is not null
      and session_id in (1, 17)
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        session_id,
        page,
        event_time_label,
        page_filled,
        page_group,
        row_number() over w_ordered as row_seq,
        row_number() over (partition by session_id, page order by event_time desc, id) as row_seq_2
    from base_web_events
    window w_ordered as (partition by page order by event_time, id)
),
latest as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by session_id order by row_seq_2 desc, id) as dedup_rank
        from with_windows
    ) t
    where dedup_rank = 1
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select session_id
    from latest
    except all
    select session_id
    from web_events
    where page in ('/search', '/checkout', '/cart')
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from latest s
    join matched_keys k on s.session_id = k.session_id
)
select
    page,
    page_filled,
    page_group,
    row_seq_2,
    dedup_rank
from verified
order by row_seq_2 desc
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("session_id", "page").orderBy(F.col("event_time").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("row_seq_2").desc(), "id")

base = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull() & (~F.col("page").eqNullSafe(F.lit("/search"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        F.date_format("event_time", "yyyy-MM").alias("event_time_label"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("page_filled"),
    )
)

base_web_events = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull() & F.col("session_id").isin([1, 17]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("page").isin(["/checkout", "/product"]), "Priority").otherwise("Other").alias("page_group"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base_web_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "page",
        "event_time_label",
        "page_filled",
        "page_group",
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("row_seq_2"),
    )
)

latest = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

matched_keys = (
    latest
    .select("session_id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_web_events
        .filter(F.col("page").isin(["/search", "/checkout", "/cart"]))
        .select("session_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.session_id") == F.col("k.session_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .select("page", "page_filled", "page_group", "row_seq_2", "dedup_rank")
    .orderBy(F.col("row_seq_2").desc())
)
```

```python
w3 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)

w5 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("shipping_fee", "id")

w8 = Window.orderBy("order_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("discount_avg_5").desc(), "id")
w_part_2 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "store_id").orderBy("discount_avg_5", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w11 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("amount_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w12 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("prev_discount", "id")
w13 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "status").orderBy(F.col("discount_avg_3").desc())

base = (

    .filter(F.col("order_date") >= F.lit("2023-08-19").cast("date"))
```

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) t AS key, v
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        key,
        v,
        CONCAT(host, '/', level) host_level
    FROM exploded
    WHERE key IS NOT NULL
      AND key IS DISTINCT FROM 'version'
),
base_app_logs AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        key,
        v,
        CASE WHEN key = 'version' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END is_version
    FROM base
    WHERE key IS NOT NULL
      AND log_ts >= '2025-08-01'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        v,
        SUM(is_version) OVER (PARTITION BY key) key_sum_is_version
    FROM base_app_logs
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, CAST(key_sum_is_version AS STRING) key_sum_is_version_num
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE key_sum_is_version <> 232
),
filtered_app_logs AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, CAST(key_sum_is_version AS DOUBLE) key_sum_is_version_num_2
    FROM filtered
    WHERE key_sum_is_version IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    id,
    v,
    key_sum_is_version,
    key_sum_is_version_num,
    key_sum_is_version_num_2
FROM filtered_app_logs
ORDER BY key_sum_is_version_num_2 DESC, id

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("key")

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "v"),
    )
)

base = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("key").isNotNull() & (~F.col("key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("version"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "key",
        "v",
        F.concat("host", F.lit("/"), "level").alias("host_level"),
    )
)

base_app_logs = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("key").isNotNull() & (F.col("log_ts") >= "2025-08-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "key",
        "v",
        F.when(F.col("key") == "version", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_version"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base_app_logs
    .select("id", "v", F.sum("is_version").over(w).alias("key_sum_is_version"))
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("key_sum_is_version") != 232)

)

filtered_app_logs = (

    .select(
        "*",
        F.col("key_sum_is_version").cast("double").alias("key_sum_is_version_num_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "v",
        "key_sum_is_version",
        "key_sum_is_version_num",
        "key_sum_is_version_num_2",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("key_sum_is_version_num_2").desc(), "id")
)
```

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DATE_ADD(last_restock, 66) AS last_restock_plus_66d,
        LAST_DAY(last_restock) AS last_restock_month_end
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock > DATE '2023-07-11'
      AND store_id = 3
),
latest AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock_plus_66d,
        last_restock_month_end
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY last_restock_month_end, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM filtered
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY last_restock_plus_66d NULLS FIRST, id) AS rn
    FROM latest
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(quantity) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY last_restock_plus_66d, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_quantity,
        FIRST_VALUE(quantity, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(last_restock_month_end), store_id ORDER BY rn, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_quantity,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (ORDER BY last_restock_month_end, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_quantity
    FROM ranked
    WHERE last_restock_month_end >= '2025-10-01'
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        d.store_name,
        d.region
    FROM scored src
    LEFT JOIN stores d
        ON src.store_id = d.id
)
SELECT
    store_id,
    region,
    SUM(CASE WHEN region = 'South' THEN last_known_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS south_last_known_quantity,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    ROUND(SUM(first_known_quantity) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN region = 'North' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS first_known_quantity_per_north,
    COUNT(DISTINCT region) AS distinct_regions
FROM enriched
GROUP BY store_id, region
ORDER BY distinct_regions DESC

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("last_restock_month_end", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock_plus_66d").asc_nulls_first(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("last_restock_plus_66d", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("last_restock_month_end"), "store_id").orderBy("rn", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.orderBy("last_restock_month_end", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_inventory
    .filter((F.col("last_restock") > F.lit("2023-07-11").cast("date")) & (F.col("store_id") == 3))
    .withColumn("last_restock_plus_66d", F.date_add("last_restock", 66))
    .withColumn("last_restock_month_end", F.last_day("last_restock"))
)

latest = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock_plus_66d",
        "last_restock_month_end",
    )
)

ranked = (
    latest
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

scored = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("last_restock_month_end") >= "2025-10-01")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("quantity", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("last_known_quantity"),
        F.first("quantity", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("first_known_quantity"),
        F.sum("quantity").over(w5).alias("cumulative_quantity"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_stores.alias("d"), F.col("src.store_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("d.store_name"), F.col("d.region"))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy("store_id", "region")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("region") == "South", F.col("last_known_quantity")).otherwise(0)).alias("south_last_known_quantity"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.round(F.sum("first_known_quantity") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("region") == "North", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("first_known_quantity_per_north"),
        F.countDistinct("region").alias("distinct_regions"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_regions").desc())
)
```

```python
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("val").asc_nulls_first())
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("currency_min_val").asc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("val_adjusted_dense_rank_str").desc())
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("val_rank").desc())

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "plan", "currency", F.explode_outer("tier_limits").alias("val"))
)

filtered = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("val") != 69)
    .withColumn("val_adjusted", F.round((F.col("val") * 100), 2))
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "val",
        F.count("val_adjusted").over(w_grp).alias("currency_count_val_adjusted"),
        F.min("val").over(w2).alias("currency_min_val"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w3).alias("val_adjusted_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w4).alias("val_rank"),
    )
)

filtered_price_tiers = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("currency_min_val") == 67)
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "currency_count_val_adjusted",
        "currency_min_val",
        "val_adjusted_dense_rank",
        "val_rank",
        F.col("val_adjusted_dense_rank").cast("double").alias("val_adjusted_dense_rank_str"),

)

filtered_price_tiers_2 = (
    filtered_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("val_adjusted_dense_rank_str").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "currency_min_val",
        "val_adjusted_dense_rank",
        "val_rank",
        "val_adjusted_dense_rank_str",
        F.when(F.col("val_rank") >= 9, "High").when(F.col("val_rank") >= 4, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("val_rank_level"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    filtered_price_tiers_2
    .select(
        "id",
        "val_adjusted_dense_rank",
        "val_adjusted_dense_rank_str",
        "val_rank_level",
        F.percent_rank().over(w_recent).alias("currency_min_val_percent_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w6).alias("val_adjusted_dense_rank_str_cume_dist"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w7).alias("val_rank_percent_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("currency_min_val_percent_rank_tier", F.when(F.col("currency_min_val_percent_rank") >= 0.72, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .withColumn("val_adjusted_dense_rank_str_cume_dist_tier", F.when(F.col("val_adjusted_dense_rank_str_cume_dist") >= 0.83, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["currency_min_val_percent_rank_tier", "val_adjusted_dense_rank_str_cume_dist_tier"], ["currency_min_val_percent_rank_tier"], []],
        "currency_min_val_percent_rank_tier",
        "val_adjusted_dense_rank_str_cume_dist_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("val_rank_percent_rank", 0.5).alias("val_rank_percent_rank_p50"),
        F.percentile_approx("val_adjusted_dense_rank_str_cume_dist", 0.95).alias("val_adjusted_dense_rank_str_cume_dist_p95"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.round(F.avg("currency_min_val_percent_rank"), 2).alias("avg_currency_min_val_percent_rank"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.sum("val_adjusted_dense_rank").alias("total_val_adjusted_dense_rank"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("grouping_id"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("val_adjusted_dense_rank_str_cume_dist_p95").desc())
)
```

sql:
with cleaned as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        substring(method, 1, 4) as method_prefix,
        coalesce(method, 'NONE') as resolved_method
    from payments
    where paid_at >= timestamp '2023-09-04 03:00:00'
),
joined as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        e.id,
        e.order_id,
        e.paid_at,
        e.status,
        e.method_prefix,
        p.order_date,
        p.channel,
        p.shipping_fee
    from cleaned e
    left join orders p
        on e.order_id <=> p.id
    where p.amount >= 820
),
deduped as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select
        id,
        status,
        order_date,
        channel,
        shipping_fee
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by status, order_id order by paid_at desc, id) as rank_in_group
        from joined
    ) t
    where rank_in_group = 1
),
latest as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select
        id,
        status,
        order_date,
        channel
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by status order by order_date desc, id) as dedup_rank
        from deduped
    ) ranked
    where dedup_rank = 1
),
latest_payments as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *, rank() over (partition by status order by order_date) as row_num
    from latest
    qualify row_num = 1
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    status,
    count(distinct status) as distinct_status,
    sort_array(collect_set(channel)) as channel_list,
    size(collect_set(channel)) as num_channels,
    sort_array(collect_set(status)) as status_list
from latest_payments
group by status
order by status desc
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("order_date").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("order_date")

cleaned = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2023-09-04 03:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.substring("method", 1, 4).alias("method_prefix"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_method"),
    )
)

joined = (
    cleaned
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("e.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("p.id")), "left")
    .filter(F.col("p.amount") >= 820)
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.order_id",
        "e.paid_at",
        "e.status",
        "e.method_prefix",
        F.col("p.order_date"),
        F.col("p.channel"),
        F.col("p.shipping_fee"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    joined
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "status", "order_date", "channel", "shipping_fee")
)

latest = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "status", "order_date", "channel")
)

latest_payments = (
    latest
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

result = (
    latest_payments
    .groupBy("status")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("status").alias("distinct_status"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("channel_list"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("num_channels"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status")).alias("status_list"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("status").desc())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("session_no").orderBy(F.col("session_no_per_tablet").desc())

prev_events = df_sessions.withColumn("prev_started_at", F.lag("started_at").over(w))

gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_started_at").isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.col("prev_started_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessionized
    .groupBy("session_no", F.date_trunc("WEEK", "started_at").alias("week_start"))
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("session_no") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("device") == "tablet", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("session_no_per_tablet"),
        F.max("started_at").alias("last_started_at"),
```

sql:
WITH lines AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        status_code,
        key,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) e AS key, value
),
unpacked AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        key,
        CAST((status_code & 8) != 0 AS INT) AS flag_bit8,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high
    FROM lines
    WHERE key = 'version'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY flag_bit8 DESC, id, key) AS flag_bit8_bucket,
        FIRST_VALUE(status_code_high) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY key, service ORDER BY flag_bit8, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_status_code_high
    FROM unpacked
    WHERE flag_bit8 = 0
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(flag_bit8) OVER (PARTITION BY service, key ORDER BY status_code_high, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_flag_bit8,
        MAX(flag_bit8) OVER (PARTITION BY service, key ORDER BY status_code_high, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_flag_bit8,
        MIN(flag_bit8) OVER (PARTITION BY service, key ORDER BY status_code_high, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_flag_bit8
    FROM scored
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT service, id
    FROM metrics
    INTERSECT
    SELECT service, id
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE TO_DATE(log_ts) >= '2025-05-22'
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.service = k.service AND s.id = k.id
),
metrics_app_logs AS (
    SELECT *, STDDEV_SAMP(first_known_status_code_high) OVER (PARTITION BY key, service) AS key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high
    FROM reconciled
)
SELECT
    service,
    SUM(CASE WHEN service = 'search' THEN key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high ELSE 0 END) AS search_key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high,
    AVG(key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high) AS avg_key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE service = 'search') AS search_rows,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN service = 'billing' THEN 1 END) AS billing_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT service) AS distinct_services,
    AVG(first_known_status_code_high) AS avg_first_known_status_code_high
FROM metrics_app_logs
GROUP BY service
ORDER BY search_rows
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("flag_bit8").desc(), "id", "key")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("key", "service").orderBy("flag_bit8", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("service", "key").orderBy("status_code_high", "id", "key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("key", "service")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("key", "value"),
    )
)

unpacked = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("key") == "version")
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "key",
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(8) != 0).cast("int").alias("flag_bit8"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

scored = (
    unpacked
    .filter(F.col("flag_bit8") == 0)
    .withColumn("flag_bit8_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w))
    .withColumn("first_known_status_code_high", F.first("status_code_high", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .withColumn("running_count_flag_bit8", F.count("flag_bit8").over(w3))
    .withColumn("running_max_flag_bit8", F.max("flag_bit8").over(w3))
    .withColumn("running_min_flag_bit8", F.min("flag_bit8").over(w3))
)

matched_keys = (
    metrics
    .select("service", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.to_date("log_ts") >= "2025-05-22")
        .select("service", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.service") == F.col("k.service")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

metrics_app_logs = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "*",
        F.stddev_samp("first_known_status_code_high").over(w4).alias("key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics_app_logs
    .groupBy("service")
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("service") == "search", F.col("key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high")).otherwise(0)).alias("search_key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high"),
        F.avg("key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high").alias("avg_key_stddev_samp_first_known_status_code_high"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "search", 1)).alias("search_rows"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("service") == "billing", 1)).alias("billing_count"),
        F.countDistinct("service").alias("distinct_services"),
        F.avg("first_known_status_code_high").alias("avg_first_known_status_code_high"),
    )
    .orderBy("search_rows")
)
```

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        discount_pct,
        LENGTH(channel) AS channel_length,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), ends_on) AS days_since_ends_on
    FROM promotions
    WHERE starts_on > DATE '2023-07-23'
      AND starts_on <= '2025-07-05'
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY days_since_ends_on, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_min_discount_pct,
        AVG(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY days_since_ends_on, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_avg_discount_pct,
        COUNT(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code ORDER BY days_since_ends_on, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last3_count_discount_pct,
        STDDEV_SAMP(discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY promo_code) AS promo_code_stddev_samp_discount_pct
    FROM filtered
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(last3_avg_discount_pct) OVER w_recent AS running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct,
        MAX(last3_avg_discount_pct) OVER w_recent AS running_max_last3_avg_discount_pct,
        SUM(last3_avg_discount_pct) OVER w_recent AS running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount_pct, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct DESC) AS row_num
        FROM with_windows
    ) t
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        last3_avg_discount_pct,
        last3_count_discount_pct,
        promo_code_stddev_samp_discount_pct,
        running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct,
        row_num,
        FLOOR(running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct) AS running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole,
        COALESCE(channel, 'NONE') AS channel_filled
    FROM deduped
    WHERE starts_on > DATE '2023-09-02'
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct >= 13 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct_tier,
    CASE WHEN promo_code_stddev_samp_discount_pct >= 0 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS promo_code_stddev_samp_discount_pct_tier,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(promo_code)) AS promo_code_list,
    SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole,
    ROUND(AVG(running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct), 2) AS avg_running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole_quartiles,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct >= 13 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'mobile' THEN running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS mobile_running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole_rank
FROM valid
GROUP BY CASE WHEN running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct >= 13 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN promo_code_stddev_samp_discount_pct >= 0 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("days_since_ends_on", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct_tier").orderBy(F.col("mobile_running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct_whole").desc())

filtered = (
    df_promotions
    .filter((F.col("starts_on") > F.lit("2023-07-23").cast("date")) & (F.col("starts_on") <= "2025-07-05"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "discount_pct",
        F.length("channel").alias("channel_length"),
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "ends_on").alias("days_since_ends_on"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("last3_min_discount_pct", F.min("discount_pct").over(w))
    .withColumn("last3_avg_discount_pct", F.avg("discount_pct").over(w))
    .withColumn("last3_count_discount_pct", F.count("discount_pct").over(w))
    .withColumn("promo_code_stddev_samp_discount_pct", F.stddev_samp("discount_pct").over(w2))
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("running_count_last3_avg_discount_pct", F.count("last3_avg_discount_pct").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("running_max_last3_avg_discount_pct", F.max("last3_avg_discount_pct").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("running_sum_last3_avg_discount_pct", F.sum("last3_avg_discount_pct").over(w_recent))
)

deduped = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

valid = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("starts_on") > F.lit("2023-09-02").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
```

sql:
with base as (
    select
        *,
        round(amount, 2) as amount_rounded,
        coalesce(method, 'OTHER') as method_filled
    from payments
    where paid_at > timestamp '2023-06-24 14:00:00'
      and method is distinct from 'cash'
),
deduped as (
    select
        id,
        paid_at,
        status
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by method order by paid_at nulls first, id) as latest_rank
        from base
    ) t
    where latest_rank = 1
),
valid as (
    select
        *,
        cast(paid_at as date) as paid_at_day,
        case when status in ('FAILED', 'REFUNDED') then 'Core' else 'Other' end as status_group
    from deduped
    where paid_at >= to_timestamp('2023-08-09 05:00:00')
),
latest as (
    select
        id,
        status,
        status_group
    from (
        select *, rank() over (partition by status order by paid_at_day) as rn
        from valid
    ) ranked
    where rn = 1
),
filtered as (
    select *, upper(status) as status_upper
    from latest
    where status = 'FAILED'
),
grouped as (
    select
        status,
        count(case when status = 'REFUNDED' then 1 end) as refunded_count,
        count(distinct id) as distinct_ids,
        sort_array(collect_set(status)) as status_list,
        count(case when status = 'REFUNDED' then 1 end) as refunded_count_2,
        count(distinct status) as distinct_status
    from filtered
    group by status
    having distinct_ids > 1
)
select
    status,
    refunded_count,
    distinct_ids,
    refunded_count_2
from grouped
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").asc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("paid_at_day")

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") > F.lit("2023-06-24 14:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (~F.col("method").eqNullSafe(F.lit("cash"))))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round("amount", 2).alias("amount_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("method_filled"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "paid_at", "status")
)

valid = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") >= F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2023-08-09 05:00:00")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.col("paid_at").cast("date").alias("paid_at_day"),
        F.when(F.col("status").isin(["FAILED", "REFUNDED"]), "Core").otherwise("Other").alias("status_group"),
    )
)

latest = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("id", "status", "status_group")
)

filtered = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("status") == "FAILED")
    .select("*", F.upper("status").alias("status_upper"))
)

grouped = (
    filtered
    .groupBy("status")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "REFUNDED", 1)).alias("refunded_count"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("status")).alias("status_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "REFUNDED", 1)).alias("refunded_count_2"),
        F.countDistinct("status").alias("distinct_status"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_ids") > 1)
)

result = grouped.select("status", "refunded_count", "distinct_ids", "refunded_count_2")
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("has_fault").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc())

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select("id", "status_code", F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "attr_value"))
)

parsed = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("key") == "version")
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",
        "key",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(1) != 0).cast("int").alias("has_fault"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    parsed
    .select("id")
    .intersect(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("latency_ms") != 700)
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    parsed
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("key").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("N/A")).alias("key_filled"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_key"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("status_code").between(383, 433))
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",
        "status_code_high",
        "has_fault",
        "key_filled",
        "resolved_key",
        F.rank().over(w).alias("has_fault_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("status_code_rank"),

)

    with_windows
    .select("id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("level") == "ERROR")
        .select("id")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",

        "key_filled",
        "has_fault_rank",
        "status_code_rank",
```

sql:
WITH with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        b.brand,
        b.product_name,
        b.stock_qty
    FROM store_sales e
    LEFT JOIN products b
        ON e.product_id = b.id
    WHERE b.stock_qty = 290
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(units) OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY units, id) prev_units,
        LEAD(stock_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY units, id) next_stock_qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY units, id) seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY sale_date DESC, id) event_seq
    FROM with_dims
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        d.stock_qty AS product_stock_qty,
        d.price,
        d.brand AS product_brand
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN products d
        ON s.product_id = d.id
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(product_stock_qty) OVER w_grp next_product_stock_qty,
        LAG(product_stock_qty) OVER w_grp prev_product_stock_qty,
        LAG(stock_qty) OVER w_grp prev_stock_qty,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp seq_no_2
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY event_seq, id)
),
scored_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        revenue,
        product_name,
        stock_qty,
        prev_units,
        next_stock_qty,
        event_seq,
        price,
        product_brand,
        next_product_stock_qty,
        prev_stock_qty,
        seq_no_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_ordered event_seq_2,
        LAST_VALUE(next_stock_qty) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY seq_no_2, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_next_stock_qty,
        SUM(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) cumulative_event_seq
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(sale_date), store_id ORDER BY sale_date, id)
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT id, product_id
    FROM scored_store_sales
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id, product_id
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE units BETWEEN 32 AND 37
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored_store_sales s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.product_id = k.product_id
)
SELECT
    p.brand,
    e.product_brand,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
    AVG(e.prev_stock_qty) AS avg_prev_stock_qty,
    MIN(e.seq_no_2) AS min_seq_no_2
FROM kept_rows e
LEFT JOIN products p ON e.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((p.brand, e.product_brand), (p.brand), ());
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("units", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("sale_date").desc(), "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy("event_seq", "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy(F.month("sale_date"), "store_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "store_id").orderBy("seq_no_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

with_dims = (
    df_store_sales
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("b"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("b.stock_qty") == 290)
    .select("e.*", F.col("b.brand"), F.col("b.product_name"), F.col("b.stock_qty"))
)

scored = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("prev_units", F.lag("units").over(w))
    .withColumn("next_stock_qty", F.lead("stock_qty").over(w))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w2))
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("d.stock_qty").alias("product_stock_qty"),
        F.col("d.price"),
        F.col("d.brand").alias("product_brand"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("product_stock_qty").over(w_grp).alias("next_product_stock_qty"),
        F.lag("product_stock_qty").over(w_grp).alias("prev_product_stock_qty"),
        F.lag("stock_qty").over(w_grp).alias("prev_stock_qty"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("seq_no_2"),
    )
)

scored_store_sales = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "revenue",
        "product_name",
        "stock_qty",
        "prev_units",
        "next_stock_qty",
        "event_seq",
        "price",
        "product_brand",
        "next_product_stock_qty",
        "prev_stock_qty",
        "seq_no_2",
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("event_seq_2"),
        F.last("next_stock_qty", ignorenulls=True).over(w5).alias("last_known_next_stock_qty"),
        F.sum("event_seq").over(w6).alias("cumulative_event_seq"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    scored_store_sales
    .select("id", "product_id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("units").between(32, 37))
        .select("id", "product_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    scored_store_sales
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .groupingSets(
        [["brand", "product_brand"], ["brand"], []],
        F.col("p.brand").alias("brand"),
        F.col("e.product_brand").alias("product_brand"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rows_total"),
        F.avg(F.col("e.prev_stock_qty")).alias("avg_prev_stock_qty"),
        F.min(F.col("e.seq_no_2")).alias("min_seq_no_2"),
    )
)
```

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        LENGTH(email) AS email_length
    FROM employees
    WHERE level IN ('L3', 'L2')
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        email_length,
        REGEXP_REPLACE(full_name, ' ', '_') AS full_name_slug,
        CASE WHEN job_title = 'Intern' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_intern
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE manager_id IS NOT NULL
      AND email_length = 61
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(email_length) OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id, dept_id ORDER BY email_length ASC, id ASC) AS next_email_length,
        LAG(email_length) OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id, dept_id ORDER BY email_length ASC, id ASC) AS prev_email_length,
        LEAD(is_intern) OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id, dept_id ORDER BY email_length ASC, id ASC) AS next_is_intern,
        LAG(is_intern) OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id, dept_id ORDER BY email_length ASC, id ASC) AS prev_is_intern,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id, dept_id ORDER BY email_length ASC, id ASC) AS event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title, dept_id ORDER BY email_length ASC, id ASC) AS seq_no
    FROM base
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(prev_is_intern) OVER (ORDER BY event_seq ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS prev_is_intern_avg_6_prior,
        SUM(prev_is_intern) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY seq_no ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_prev_is_intern,
        LAST_VALUE(next_is_intern, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id ORDER BY prev_email_length ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_next_is_intern
    FROM enriched
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.full_name,
    s.manager_id,
    s.job_title,
    s.email_length,
    s.full_name_slug,
    s.is_intern,
    s.next_email_length,
    s.prev_email_length,
    CASE WHEN full_name RLIKE '^(David Lee |Mia Rossi)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS full_name_zone,
    (SELECT MAX(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.manager_id = s.manager_id) AS max_employee_salary
FROM scored s
ORDER BY prev_email_length DESC NULLS LAST;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("manager_id", "dept_id").orderBy("email_length", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("job_title", "dept_id").orderBy("email_length", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy("prev_email_length", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
salary_by_manager_id = df_employees.groupBy("manager_id").agg(F.max("salary").alias("max_employee_salary"))

cleaned = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("level").isin(["L3", "L2"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        F.length("email").alias("email_length"),
    )
)

base = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("manager_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("email_length") == 61))
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "dept_id",
        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        "email_length",
        F.regexp_replace("full_name", " ", "_").alias("full_name_slug"),
        F.when(F.col("job_title") == "Intern", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_intern"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("email_length").over(w).alias("next_email_length"),
        F.lag("email_length").over(w).alias("prev_email_length"),
        F.lead("is_intern").over(w).alias("next_is_intern"),
        F.lag("is_intern").over(w).alias("prev_is_intern"),
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

scored = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("prev_is_intern").over(w3).alias("prev_is_intern_avg_6_prior"),
        F.sum("prev_is_intern").over(w4).alias("cumulative_prev_is_intern"),
        F.last("next_is_intern", ignorenulls=True).over(w5).alias("last_known_next_is_intern"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .join(salary_by_manager_id, on="manager_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        "email_length",
        "full_name_slug",
        "is_intern",
        "next_email_length",
        "prev_email_length",
        F.when(F.col("full_name").rlike("^(David Lee |Mia Rossi)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("full_name_zone"),
        F.col("max_employee_salary"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("prev_email_length").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

with valid as (
    select *, round(revenue * 1.1, 2) as revenue_adjusted
    from store_sales
    where sale_date > date '2023-05-21'
),
deduped as (
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        units,
        revenue,
        revenue_adjusted
    from valid
    qualify rank() over (partition by store_id, product_id order by revenue desc nulls last) = 1
),
cleaned as (
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        units,
        revenue,
        revenue_adjusted,
        revenue_adjusted - units as revenue_adjusted_minus_units
    from deduped
    where revenue <= 2700
),
scored as (
    select
        id,
        revenue,
        lag(units) over (partition by store_id order by revenue_adjusted asc, id asc) as prev_units,
        lag(revenue) over (partition by store_id order by revenue_adjusted asc, id asc) as prev_revenue,
        lead(revenue) over (partition by store_id order by revenue_adjusted asc, id asc) as next_revenue,
        row_number() over (partition by store_id order by revenue_adjusted asc, id asc) as seq_no,
        lead(units, 1) over (order by units asc, id asc) as next_units
    from cleaned
),
base as (
    select
        id,
        revenue,
        prev_units,
        prev_revenue,
        next_revenue,
        coalesce(prev_revenue, 0) as prev_revenue_filled,
        cast(next_units as string) as next_units_num
    from scored
    where next_units is not null
),
metrics as (
    select
        *,
        lead(prev_units) over w_hist as next_prev_units,
        lag(prev_units) over w_hist as prev_prev_units,
        lag(prev_revenue) over w_hist as prev_prev_revenue,
        lead(prev_revenue) over w_hist as next_prev_revenue,
        row_number() over w_hist as event_seq
    from base
    where prev_revenue <= 1800
    window w_hist as (order by revenue asc, id asc)
)
select
    id,
    prev_units,
    next_revenue,
    prev_revenue_filled,
    next_prev_units,
    prev_prev_revenue,
    next_prev_revenue,
    event_seq
from metrics
order by prev_units asc, prev_revenue_filled desc

```python
w = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy(F.col("revenue").desc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("revenue_adjusted", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("units", "id")
w_hist = Window.orderBy("revenue", "id")

valid = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("sale_date") > F.lit("2023-05-21").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("revenue_adjusted", F.round((F.col("revenue") * 1.1), 2))
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select("id", "store_id", "units", "revenue", "revenue_adjusted")
)

cleaned = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("revenue") <= 2700)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "units",
        "revenue",
        "revenue_adjusted",
        (F.col("revenue_adjusted") - F.col("units")).alias("revenue_adjusted_minus_units"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "revenue",
        F.lag("units").over(w2).alias("prev_units"),
        F.lag("revenue").over(w2).alias("prev_revenue"),
        F.lead("revenue").over(w2).alias("next_revenue"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no"),

    )
)

    .filter(F.col("next_units").isNotNull())

        "id",
        "revenue",
        "prev_units",
        "prev_revenue",
        "next_revenue",
        F.coalesce("prev_revenue", F.lit(0)).alias("prev_revenue_filled"),
        F.col("next_units").cast("string").alias("next_units_num"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("prev_revenue") <= 1800)

        "*",
        F.lead("prev_units").over(w_hist).alias("next_prev_units"),

        F.row_number().over(w_hist).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)
```

sql:
WITH flattened AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) t AS attr_key, value
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY log_ts DESC, id, attr_key) AS rn
        FROM flattened
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(latency_ms, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY rn, id, attr_key) AS next_latency_ms,
        ROUND(latency_ms / SUM(latency_ms) OVER (PARTITION BY service, attr_key), 4) AS latency_ms_share,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY status_code, id, attr_key) AS status_code_bucket,
        SUM(status_code) OVER (ORDER BY log_ts, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_status_code,
        AVG(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY status_code, id, attr_key ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS status_code_avg_3_prior
    FROM deduped
    WHERE attr_key = 'trace'
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        value,
        rn,
        next_latency_ms,
        latency_ms_share,
        cumulative_status_code,
        status_code_avg_3_prior,
        ROUND(status_code_bucket * 100, 2) AS status_code_bucket_scaled,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'OTHER') AS attr_key_filled
    FROM metrics
    WHERE attr_key IS NOT NULL
      AND attr_key IS DISTINCT FROM 'region'
)
SELECT
    id,
    attr_key,
    metric,
    reading
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        attr_key,
        latency_ms_share,
        status_code_bucket_scaled
    FROM cleaned
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR metric IN (latency_ms_share, status_code_bucket_scaled AS STATUS_CODE_BUCKET_SCALED)
);
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy("rn", "id", "attr_key")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("service", "attr_key")
w4 = Window.orderBy("status_code", "id", "attr_key")
w5 = Window.orderBy("log_ts", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy("status_code", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(-3, -1)

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "value"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    flattened
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("attr_key") == "trace")
    .withColumn("next_latency_ms", F.lead("latency_ms", 1).over(w2))
    .withColumn("latency_ms_share", F.round((F.col("latency_ms") / F.sum("latency_ms").over(w3)), 4))
    .withColumn("status_code_bucket", F.ntile(4).over(w4))
    .withColumn("cumulative_status_code", F.sum("status_code").over(w5))
    .withColumn("status_code_avg_3_prior", F.avg("status_code").over(w6))
)

cleaned = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull() & (~F.col("attr_key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("region"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        "value",
        "rn",
        "next_latency_ms",
        "latency_ms_share",
        "cumulative_status_code",
        "status_code_avg_3_prior",
        F.round((F.col("status_code_bucket") * 100), 2).alias("status_code_bucket_scaled"),
        F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("attr_key_filled"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "attr_key",
        "latency_ms_share",
        F.col("status_code_bucket_scaled").alias("STATUS_CODE_BUCKET_SCALED"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "attr_key"],
        values=["latency_ms_share", "STATUS_CODE_BUCKET_SCALED"],
        variableColumnName="metric",
        valueColumnName="reading",
    )
    .filter(F.col("reading").isNotNull())
)
```

sql:
with exploded as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        created_at,
        line.product_id,
        line.qty,
        line.promo
    from (
        select
            id,
            created_at,
            explode(items) as line
        from carts
    ) t
),
scored as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        created_at,
        rank() over (order by qty nulls last) as qty_rank,
        max(product_id) over w_recent as created_at_to_date_max_product_id,
        avg(qty) over w_recent as created_at_to_date_avg_qty
    from exploded
    window w_recent as (partition by to_date(created_at), promo)
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        qty_rank,
        created_at_to_date_max_product_id,
        created_at_to_date_avg_qty,
        sum(qty_rank) over (order by cast(created_at as bigint) range between 900 preceding and current row) as qty_rank_sum_15m,
        avg(created_at_to_date_max_product_id) over (order by cast(created_at as bigint) range between 3600 preceding and current row) as created_at_to_date_max_product_id_avg_1h,
        percent_rank() over (order by created_at_to_date_max_product_id desc nulls first) as created_at_to_date_max_product_id_percent_rank,
        rank() over (order by qty_rank desc) as qty_rank_rank
    from scored
),
scored_carts as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        rank() over (order by created_at_to_date_avg_qty) as created_at_to_date_avg_qty_rank,
        percent_rank() over (order by created_at_to_date_max_product_id_avg_1h desc nulls first) as created_at_to_date_max_product_id_avg_1h_percent_rank
    from metrics
),
valid as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        created_at_to_date_avg_qty,
        qty_rank_sum_15m,
        created_at_to_date_max_product_id_avg_1h,
        qty_rank_rank,
        created_at_to_date_avg_qty_rank,
        created_at_to_date_max_product_id_avg_1h_percent_rank,
        created_at_to_date_avg_qty_rank * created_at_to_date_max_product_id as created_at_to_date_avg_qty_rank_times_created_at_to_date_max_product_id,
        round(qty_rank_sum_15m / created_at_to_date_max_product_id, 2) as qty_rank_sum_15m_per_created_at_to_date_max_product_id
    from scored_carts
    where created_at_to_date_avg_qty_rank > 8
)
select
    created_at_to_date_avg_qty,
    qty_rank_sum_15m,
    created_at_to_date_max_product_id_avg_1h,
    created_at_to_date_avg_qty_rank,
    qty_rank_sum_15m_per_created_at_to_date_max_product_id
from valid;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty").asc_nulls_last())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("created_at"), "promo")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("created_at_to_date_max_product_id").desc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty_rank").desc())
w7 = Window.orderBy("created_at_to_date_avg_qty")
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("created_at_to_date_max_product_id_avg_1h").desc_nulls_first())

exploded = (
    df_carts
    .withColumn("line", F.explode("items"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "created_at",
        F.col("line.product_id"),
        F.col("line.qty"),
        F.col("line.promo"),
    )
)

scored = (
    exploded
    .select(
        "id",
        "created_at",
        F.rank().over(w).alias("qty_rank"),
        F.max("product_id").over(w_recent).alias("created_at_to_date_max_product_id"),
        F.avg("qty").over(w_recent).alias("created_at_to_date_avg_qty"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .select(
        "qty_rank",
        "created_at_to_date_max_product_id",
        "created_at_to_date_avg_qty",
        F.sum("qty_rank").over(w3).alias("qty_rank_sum_15m"),
        F.avg("created_at_to_date_max_product_id").over(w4).alias("created_at_to_date_max_product_id_avg_1h"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w5).alias("created_at_to_date_max_product_id_percent_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w6).alias("qty_rank_rank"),
    )
)
```
