sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        city,
        segment,
        is_active,
        LENGTH(segment) AS segment_length,
        COALESCE(segment, 'OTHER') AS segment_clean
    FROM customers
    WHERE country IN ('TH', 'US', 'SG')
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT city
    FROM cleaned
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT city
    FROM customers
    WHERE name LIKE 'Gra%'
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.city = k.city
),
scored AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY segment_length NULLS LAST) AS segment_length_rank
    FROM verified
),
scored_customers AS (
    SELECT
        email,
        segment,
        is_active,
        segment_length,
        segment_length_rank,
        SUM(segment_length) OVER (PARTITION BY city) AS city_sum_segment_length,
        MIN(segment_length) OVER w_part AS city_min_segment_length,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city, segment ORDER BY segment_length NULLS LAST) AS segment_length_dense_rank,
        SUM(segment_length) OVER (PARTITION BY segment, city) AS segment_sum_segment_length,
        RANK() OVER w_ordered AS segment_length_rank_2
    FROM scored
    WHERE segment IN ('SMB', 'Consumer')
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY city, segment), w_ordered AS (ORDER BY segment_length DESC NULLS LAST)
)
SELECT
    segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT segment) AS distinct_segments,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(segment)) AS num_segments,
    COUNT_IF(segment = 'SMB') AS smb_events,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(segment_sum_segment_length, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS segment_sum_segment_length_quartiles
FROM scored_customers
GROUP BY segment
ORDER BY smb_events DESC NULLS LAST;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy(F.col("segment_length").asc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("city", "segment")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city", "segment").orderBy(F.col("segment_length").asc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("segment", "city")
w_ordered = Window.orderBy(F.col("segment_length").desc_nulls_last())

cleaned = (
    df_customers
    .filter(F.col("country").isin(["TH", "US", "SG"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "city",
        "segment",
        "is_active",
        F.length("segment").alias("segment_length"),
        F.coalesce("segment", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("segment_clean"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    cleaned
    .select("city")
    .subtract(
        df_customers
        .filter(F.col("name").like("Gra%"))
        .select("city")
    )
)

verified = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = verified.withColumn("segment_length_rank", F.rank().over(w))

scored_customers = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("segment").isin(["SMB", "Consumer"]))
    .select(
        "email",
        "segment",
        "is_active",
        "segment_length",
        "segment_length_rank",
        F.sum("segment_length").over(w2).alias("city_sum_segment_length"),
        F.min("segment_length").over(w_part).alias("city_min_segment_length"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w4).alias("segment_length_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("segment_length").over(w5).alias("segment_sum_segment_length"),
        F.rank().over(w_ordered).alias("segment_length_rank_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_customers
    .groupBy("segment")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("segment").alias("distinct_segments"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("segment")).alias("num_segments"),
        F.count_if(F.col("segment") == "SMB").alias("smb_events"),
        F.percentile_approx("segment_sum_segment_length", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("segment_sum_segment_length_quartiles"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("smb_events").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

WITH flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR event_time > LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) + INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM web_events
)
-- Running sum of the flag = session number
SELECT
    id,
    session_id,
    page,
    event_time,
    duration_sec,
    SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id_2
FROM flagged;

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")

    df_web_events
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

    .select(

        "page",
        "event_time",
```

WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        tier_limits,
        tier_prices,
        ARRAY_MIN(tier_prices) AS lowest_price,
        AGGREGATE(tier_prices, 0D, (acc, p) -> acc + p, acc -> ROUND(acc / SIZE(tier_prices), 2)) AS avg_tier_price,
        ELEMENT_AT(tier_prices, 1) AS entry_price
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE currency = 'EUR'
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN entry_price >= 30 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS entry_price_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(avg_tier_price, 0.9) AS avg_tier_price_p90,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM parsed
GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN entry_price >= 30 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END);

```python
parsed = (
    df_price_tiers
    .filter(F.col("currency") == "EUR")
    .select(

        "currency",
        "tier_limits",
        "tier_prices",
        F.array_min("tier_prices").alias("lowest_price"),
        F.aggregate("tier_prices", F.lit(0.0), lambda acc, p: acc + p, lambda acc: F.round(acc / F.size("tier_prices"), 2)).alias("avg_tier_price"),
        F.element_at("tier_prices", 1).alias("entry_price"),
    )
)

result = (
    parsed
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("entry_price") >= 30, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("entry_price_tier"),

    .agg(

)
```

with cleaned as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, round(temp_c * 0.9, 2) as temp_c_scaled
    from device_readings
    where reading_ts < '2024-09-13'
),
with_windows as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        temp_c_scaled,
        sum(temp_c) over w_grp as running_temp_c,
        round(pressure / sum(pressure) over (partition by device_code), 4) as pressure_share
    from cleaned
    window w_grp as (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        temp_c,
        pressure_share,
        lag(running_temp_c) over w_ordered as prev_running_temp_c,
        lead(humidity) over w_ordered as next_humidity,
        lag(humidity) over w_ordered as prev_humidity,
        row_number() over w_ordered as event_seq,
        lag(pressure_share, 1) over w_ordered as prev_pressure_share
    from with_windows
    window w_ordered as (order by humidity, id)
),
filtered as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        temp_c,
        pressure_share,
        prev_running_temp_c,
        next_humidity,
        prev_humidity,
        prev_pressure_share,
        floor(prev_pressure_share) as prev_pressure_share_whole
    from metrics
    where next_humidity between 54 and 74
)
select
    id,
    temp_c,
    pressure_share,
    prev_running_temp_c,
    prev_pressure_share,
    prev_pressure_share_whole
from filtered
order by prev_running_temp_c

```python
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code")
w_ordered = Window.orderBy("humidity", "id")

cleaned = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") < "2024-09-13")
    .withColumn("temp_c_scaled", F.round((F.col("temp_c") * 0.9), 2))

    .select(
        "id",

        F.sum("temp_c").over(w_grp).alias("running_temp_c"),

metrics = (

    .select(
        "id",
        "temp_c",

        "temp_c",
```

WITH joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT a.*, p.email
    FROM subscriptions a
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON a.customer_id <=> p.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        MAX(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY start_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_monthly_fee,
        COUNT(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY start_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_monthly_fee,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY start_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_monthly_fee
    FROM joined
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        DATEDIFF(end_date, start_date) / 7 AS weeks_start_date_to_end_date
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE end_date > DATE '2023-06-20'
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY weeks_start_date_to_end_date DESC, id) AS weeks_start_date_to_end_date_bucket,
        LAST_VALUE(weeks_start_date_to_end_date) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY weeks_start_date_to_end_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_weeks_start_date_to_end_date
    FROM filtered
),
filtered_subscriptions AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(weeks_start_date_to_end_date, 1) AS weeks_start_date_to_end_date_rounded,
        CEIL(weeks_start_date_to_end_date) AS weeks_start_date_to_end_date_whole
    FROM metrics
    WHERE start_date > TO_DATE('2023-09-11')
      AND last_known_weeks_start_date_to_end_date > 44
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', start_date) AS activity_month,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(weeks_start_date_to_end_date, 0.95) AS weeks_start_date_to_end_date_p95,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(weeks_start_date_to_end_date_rounded, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS weeks_start_date_to_end_date_rounded_quartiles,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(weeks_start_date_to_end_date_whole, 0.9) AS weeks_start_date_to_end_date_whole_p90
FROM filtered_subscriptions
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', start_date)
HAVING num_rows < 1000
ORDER BY activity_month DESC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("weeks_start_date_to_end_date").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("weeks_start_date_to_end_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

joined = (
    df_subscriptions
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("a.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("p.id")), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("p.email"))
)

with_windows = (
    joined
    .select(
        "id",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        F.max("monthly_fee").over(w).alias("running_max_monthly_fee"),
        F.count("monthly_fee").over(w).alias("running_count_monthly_fee"),
        F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w).alias("running_sum_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("end_date") > F.lit("2023-06-20").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        (F.datediff("end_date", "start_date") / 7).alias("weeks_start_date_to_end_date"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w2))
    .withColumn("last_known_weeks_start_date_to_end_date", F.last("weeks_start_date_to_end_date", ignorenulls=True).over(w3))
)

filtered_subscriptions = (
    metrics
    .filter((F.col("start_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-11"))) & (F.col("last_known_weeks_start_date_to_end_date") > 44))
    .withColumn("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_rounded", F.round("weeks_start_date_to_end_date", 1))
    .withColumn("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_whole", F.ceil("weeks_start_date_to_end_date"))
)

result = (
    filtered_subscriptions
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "start_date").alias("activity_month"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("weeks_start_date_to_end_date", 0.95).alias("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_p95"),
        F.percentile_approx("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_rounded", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_rounded_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_whole", 0.9).alias("weeks_start_date_to_end_date_whole_p90"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_rows") < 1000)
    .orderBy(F.col("activity_month").desc())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)

    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("budget").between(1234000, 2704000))
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_name",
        "location",
        F.min("budget").over(w).alias("last7_min_budget"),
        F.avg("budget").over(w).alias("last7_avg_budget"),
        F.max("budget").over(w).alias("last7_max_budget"),
```

sql:
with eligible as (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from suppliers s
    where exists (
            select 1
            from products ch
            where ch.supplier_id = s.id
              and length(ch.product_name) >= 9
        )
),
not_flagged as (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from eligible s
    where exists (
            select 1
            from products c
            where c.supplier_id = s.id
              and c.price < 490
        )
),
scored as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        supplier_name,
        country,
        row_number() over (partition by city order by rating, id) as seq_no,
        row_number() over (partition by country, city order by rating, id) as seq_no_2,
        last_value(city, true) over (partition by country order by rating, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_city
    from not_flagged
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select country, id
    from scored
    except distinct
    select country, id
    from suppliers
    where country != 'JP'
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from scored s
    join matched_keys k on s.country = k.country and s.id = k.id
),
not_flagged_suppliers as (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from kept_rows s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from products x
            where x.supplier_id = s.id
              and array_contains(x.tags, 'bestseller')
        )
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    case when seq_no >= 7 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as seq_no_tier,
    count(*) as num_rows,
    approx_percentile(seq_no, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as seq_no_quartiles,
    sort_array(collect_set(country)) as country_list,
    sum(seq_no_2) as total_seq_no_2
from not_flagged_suppliers
group by case when seq_no >= 7 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end
having num_rows >= 1
order by seq_no_tier nulls first
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("rating", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

eligible = (
    df_suppliers
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.length(F.col("ch.product_name")) >= 9), "left_semi")
)

not_flagged = (
    eligible
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.price") < 490), "left_semi")
)

scored = (
    not_flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "supplier_name",
        "country",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no_2"),
        F.last("city", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("last_known_city"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    scored
    .select("country", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_suppliers
        .filter(F.col("country") != "JP")
        .select("country", "id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.country") == F.col("k.country")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

not_flagged_suppliers = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("x"), (F.col("x.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.array_contains(F.col("x.tags"), "bestseller")), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    not_flagged_suppliers
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("seq_no") >= 7, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("seq_no_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("seq_no", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("seq_no_quartiles"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("country")).alias("country_list"),
        F.sum("seq_no_2").alias("total_seq_no_2"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("num_rows") >= 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("seq_no_tier").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

WITH ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        amount,
        shipping_fee
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date DESC, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM orders
    ) x
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM order_items ch
            WHERE ch.order_id = s.id
              AND ch.quantity < 5
        )
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        status,
        amount,
        shipping_fee,
        CASE WHEN status = 'SHIPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_shipped
    FROM kept
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2023-05-20'
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY is_shipped, id) AS latest_rank
    FROM base
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN is_shipped >= 67 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS is_shipped_tier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS pending_amount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) AS pending_count,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(is_shipped, 0.95) AS is_shipped_p95,
    ROUND(SUM(shipping_fee) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS shipping_fee_per_pending,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(is_shipped, 0.95) AS is_shipped_p95_2
FROM latest
GROUP BY CASE WHEN is_shipped >= 67 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
ORDER BY pending_amount DESC NULLS LAST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("order_date").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("is_shipped", "id")

ranked = (
    df_orders
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "amount",
        "shipping_fee",
    )
)

kept = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_order_items.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.quantity") < 5), "left_anti")
)

base = (
    kept
    .filter(F.col("order_date") >= F.lit("2023-05-20").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "status",
        "amount",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.when(F.col("status") == "SHIPPED", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_shipped"),
    )
)

latest = (
    base
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

result = (
    latest
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("is_shipped") >= 67, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("is_shipped_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("status") == "PENDING", F.col("amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("pending_amount"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "PENDING", 1)).alias("pending_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("is_shipped", 0.95).alias("is_shipped_p95"),
        F.round(F.sum("shipping_fee") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("status") == "PENDING", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("shipping_fee_per_pending"),
        F.percentile_approx("is_shipped", 0.95).alias("is_shipped_p95_2"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("pending_amount").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

with filtered as (
    select
        id,
        method,
        paid_at,
        status,
        round(amount * 100, 2) as amount_scaled,
        length(status) as status_length
    from payments
    where order_id is not null
),
with_windows as (
    select
        *,
        avg(status_length) over (partition by status, method order by paid_at, id rows between 5 preceding and current row) as status_length_avg_5,
        row_number() over (partition by method order by status_length desc, id) as seq_no
    from filtered
),
latest as (
    select *, row_number() over (partition by status, method order by paid_at desc nulls last, id) as dedup_rank
    from with_windows
    qualify dedup_rank = 1
),
enriched as (
    select
        id,
        method,
        paid_at,
        status_length,
        status_length_avg_5,
        seq_no,
        sum(status_length) over (partition by status order by cast(paid_at as bigint) range between 2592000 preceding and current row) as status_length_sum_30d,
        max(amount_scaled) over (partition by status) as status_max_amount_scaled,
        sum(amount_scaled) over (partition by method order by dedup_rank, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_amount_scaled
    from latest
    where status_length = 23
)
select
    id,
    method,
    paid_at,
    status_length_avg_5,
    seq_no,
    status_length_sum_30d,
    cumulative_amount_scaled,
    case when method rlike '^(bank_transfer|cash)$' then 'GROUP_B' when method rlike '^(card|paypal)$' then 'EXTENDED' else 'PRIORITY' end as method_zone
from enriched
order by status_length_avg_5 desc, seq_no;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status", "method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("status_length").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status", "method").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("status")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("dedup_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        F.round((F.col("amount") * 100), 2).alias("amount_scaled"),
        F.length("status").alias("status_length"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("status_length_avg_5", F.avg("status_length").over(w))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w2))
)

latest = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("status_length") == 23)
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "paid_at",
        "status_length",
        "status_length_avg_5",
        "seq_no",
        F.sum("status_length").over(w4).alias("status_length_sum_30d"),
        F.max("amount_scaled").over(w5).alias("status_max_amount_scaled"),
        F.sum("amount_scaled").over(w6).alias("cumulative_amount_scaled"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "method",
        "paid_at",
        "status_length_avg_5",
        "seq_no",
        "status_length_sum_30d",
        "cumulative_amount_scaled",
        F.when(F.col("method").rlike("^(bank_transfer|cash)$"), "GROUP_B").when(F.col("method").rlike("^(card|paypal)$"), "EXTENDED").otherwise("PRIORITY").alias("method_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("status_length_avg_5").desc(), "seq_no")
)
```

sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        TRIM(full_name) AS clean_full_name
    FROM employees
    WHERE manager_id IN (3, 12, 25)
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM filtered
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id, job_title ORDER BY salary, id) = 1
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(full_name) AS full_name_upper,
        COALESCE(job_title, 'DIRECT') AS job_title_clean
    FROM deduped
    WHERE dept_id IN (15, 22, 23, 26)
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.email,
        a.dept_id,
        a.job_title,
        a.salary,
        a.full_name_upper,
        a.job_title_clean,
        p.dept_name
    FROM valid a
    LEFT JOIN departments p
        ON a.dept_id = p.id
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(salary) OVER w_running AS last3_count_salary,
        MIN(salary) OVER w_running AS last3_min_salary,
        MAX(salary) OVER w_running AS last3_max_salary,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY salary) AS salary_rank
    FROM joined
    WHERE LOWER(email) LIKE '%vy@%'
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
enriched_employees AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        email,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        full_name_upper,
        dept_name,
        last3_count_salary,
        last3_min_salary,
        last3_max_salary,
        MAX(salary) OVER w_hist AS last4_max_salary,
        COUNT(salary) OVER w_hist AS last4_count_salary,
        AVG(salary) OVER w_hist AS last4_avg_salary,
        SUM(salary) OVER w_hist AS last4_sum_salary
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY last3_max_salary, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM enriched_employees
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY job_title, dept_id ORDER BY last4_avg_salary DESC, id) = 1
)
SELECT
    dim.dept_name AS department_dept_name,
    src.job_title,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    MAX(src.last4_sum_salary) AS max_last4_sum_salary,
    AVG(src.last4_avg_salary) AS avg_last4_avg_salary,
    GROUPING_ID() AS level_id
FROM latest src
JOIN departments dim ON src.dept_id = dim.id
GROUP BY ROLLUP (dim.dept_name, src.job_title);

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_id", "job_title").orderBy("salary", "id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy("salary", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy("last3_max_salary", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("job_title", "dept_id").orderBy(F.col("last4_avg_salary").desc(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("manager_id").isin([3, 12, 25]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        "salary",
        F.trim("full_name").alias("clean_full_name"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

valid = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("dept_id").isin([15, 22, 23, 26]))
    .withColumn("full_name_upper", F.upper("full_name"))
    .withColumn("job_title_clean", F.coalesce("job_title", F.lit("DIRECT")))
)

joined = (
    valid
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_departments.alias("p"), F.col("a.dept_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.email",
        "a.dept_id",
        "a.job_title",
        "a.salary",
        "a.full_name_upper",
        "a.job_title_clean",
        F.col("p.dept_name"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    joined
    .filter(F.lower("email").like("%vy@%"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("salary").over(w_running).alias("last3_count_salary"),
        F.min("salary").over(w_running).alias("last3_min_salary"),
        F.max("salary").over(w_running).alias("last3_max_salary"),
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("salary_rank"),
    )
)

enriched_employees = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "job_title",
        "full_name_upper",
        "dept_name",
        "last3_count_salary",
        "last3_min_salary",
        "last3_max_salary",
        F.max("salary").over(w_hist).alias("last4_max_salary"),
        F.count("salary").over(w_hist).alias("last4_count_salary"),
        F.avg("salary").over(w_hist).alias("last4_avg_salary"),
        F.sum("salary").over(w_hist).alias("last4_sum_salary"),
    )
)

latest = (
    enriched_employees
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

result = (
    latest
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_departments.alias("dim"), F.col("src.dept_id") == F.col("dim.id"), "inner")
    .rollup(
        F.col("dim.dept_name").alias("department_dept_name"),
        F.col("src.job_title").alias("job_title"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.max(F.col("src.last4_sum_salary")).alias("max_last4_sum_salary"),
        F.avg(F.col("src.last4_avg_salary")).alias("avg_last4_avg_salary"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("level_id"),
    )
)
```

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY price DESC, id) AS seq_no_2
    FROM scored

base AS (
    SELECT *, category_stddev_samp_price + seq_no AS category_stddev_samp_price_plus_seq_no
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE stock_qty > 179
),
joined AS (

        a.*,

        p.supplier_name,

    FROM base a

with_dims AS (

        s.rating,
        s.city,
        b.city AS supplier_city,
        b.supplier_name AS supplier_supplier_name,
        b.country
    FROM joined s
    INNER JOIN suppliers b
        ON s.supplier_id = b.id
),
kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_dims s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales x
            WHERE x.product_id = s.id
              AND x.product_id IN (1, 9, 10)

kept_products AS (

    FROM kept s

            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id

sql:
with matched_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select account_id, txn_type
    from transactions
    except all
    select account_id, txn_type
    from transactions
    where txn_time < '2024-05-01'
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from transactions s
    join matched_keys k on s.account_id = k.account_id and s.txn_type = k.txn_type
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        rank() over w_hist as amount_rank
    from reconciled
    where hour(txn_time) between 7 and 10
    window w_hist as (order by amount)
),
base as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select *, to_date(txn_time) as txn_time_date
    from with_windows
    where txn_time >= timestamp '2023-10-10 22:00:00'
),
scored as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        dense_rank() over (partition by merchant order by amount_rank nulls last) as amount_rank_dense_rank,
        cume_dist() over w_recent as amount_rank_cume_dist
    from base
    window w_recent as (order by amount_rank desc)
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select txn_type, merchant
    from scored
    except
    select txn_type, merchant
    from transactions
    where not is_flagged
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from scored s
    join remaining_keys k on s.txn_type = k.txn_type and s.merchant = k.merchant
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    date_trunc('week', txn_time) as week_start,
    min(txn_time) as first_seen,
    round(avg(amount_rank), 2) as avg_amount_rank,
    approx_percentile(amount_rank_cume_dist, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as amount_rank_cume_dist_quartiles,
    approx_percentile(amount_rank_cume_dist, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as amount_rank_cume_dist_quartiles_2
from kept_rows
group by week_start
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.orderBy("amount")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy(F.col("amount_rank").asc_nulls_last())
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("amount_rank").desc())

matched_keys = (
    df_transactions
    .select("account_id", "txn_type")
    .exceptAll(
        df_transactions
        .filter(F.col("txn_time") < "2024-05-01")
        .select("account_id", "txn_type")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    df_transactions
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.account_id") == F.col("k.account_id")) & (F.col("s.txn_type") == F.col("k.txn_type")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.hour("txn_time").between(7, 10))
    .select(
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        F.rank().over(w_hist).alias("amount_rank"),
    )
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("txn_time") >= F.lit("2023-10-10 22:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .withColumn("txn_time_date", F.to_date("txn_time"))
)

scored = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w2).alias("amount_rank_dense_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_recent).alias("amount_rank_cume_dist"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    scored
    .select("txn_type", "merchant")
    .subtract(
        df_transactions
        .filter(~F.col("is_flagged"))
        .select("txn_type", "merchant")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.txn_type") == F.col("k.txn_type")) & (F.col("s.merchant") == F.col("k.merchant")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("week", "txn_time").alias("week_start"))
    .agg(
        F.min("txn_time").alias("first_seen"),
        F.round(F.avg("amount_rank"), 2).alias("avg_amount_rank"),
        F.percentile_approx("amount_rank_cume_dist", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("amount_rank_cume_dist_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("amount_rank_cume_dist", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("amount_rank_cume_dist_quartiles_2"),
    )
)
```

WITH deduped AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        cost,
        stock_qty,
        tags
    FROM products
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id ORDER BY stock_qty, id) = 1
),
not_flagged AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
              AND c.store_id IN (3, 4, 5, 6)
        )
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        cost,
        stock_qty,
        tags,
        AVG(cost) OVER (ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_avg_cost,
        SUM(cost) OVER (ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_sum_cost,
        MAX(cost) OVER (ORDER BY cost, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last7_max_cost,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cost DESC) AS cost_dense_rank
    FROM not_flagged
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        stock_qty,
        tags,
        last7_avg_cost,
        last7_sum_cost,
        cost_dense_rank,
        SUM(cost) OVER (ORDER BY last7_avg_cost, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cost,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY last7_max_cost) AS last7_max_cost_cume_dist,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY cost DESC NULLS FIRST) AS cost_cume_dist
    FROM with_windows
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN stock_qty >= 322 THEN 'High' WHEN stock_qty >= 155 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS stock_qty_band,
        CASE WHEN last7_max_cost_cume_dist >= 0.78 THEN 'High' WHEN last7_max_cost_cume_dist >= 0.22 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS last7_max_cost_cume_dist_level
    FROM metrics
    WHERE last7_max_cost_cume_dist <= 0.3
)
SELECT
    id,
    stock_qty,
    tags,
    last7_avg_cost,
    cost_dense_rank,
    cumulative_cost,
    cost_cume_dist
FROM filtered

```python
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("cost").desc())
w4 = Window.orderBy("last7_avg_cost", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.orderBy("last7_max_cost")
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("cost").desc_nulls_first())

    )

result = (

        "stock_qty",
```

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        channel,
        promo_code,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        ROUND(discount_pct, 2) AS discount_pct_rounded,
        ROUND(discount_pct * 0.9, 2) AS adjusted_discount_pct,
        COALESCE(channel, 'UNKNOWN') AS channel_filled
    FROM promotions
    WHERE channel IS NOT NULL
      AND channel IN ('mobile', 'store', 'web')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(adjusted_discount_pct) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY starts_on, id) AS next_adjusted_discount_pct,
        LEAD(discount_pct_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY starts_on, id) AS next_discount_pct_rounded,
        LAG(discount_pct_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY starts_on, id) AS prev_discount_pct_rounded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY starts_on, id) AS row_seq
    FROM filtered
    WHERE ends_on BETWEEN '2023-03-07' AND '2023-10-07'
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY prev_discount_pct_rounded NULLS FIRST) AS rn
        FROM enriched
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
latest_promotions AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM latest
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct_rounded DESC, id) = 1
)
-- Native SQL PIVOT
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        promo_code,
        channel,
        next_discount_pct_rounded
    FROM latest_promotions
) src
PIVOT (
    AVG(next_discount_pct_rounded) AS value_sum
    FOR channel IN ('mobile', 'partner', 'web')
);
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("starts_on", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("prev_discount_pct_rounded").asc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct_rounded").desc(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_promotions
    .filter(F.col("channel").isNotNull() & F.col("channel").isin(["mobile", "store", "web"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "promo_code",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        F.round("discount_pct", 2).alias("discount_pct_rounded"),
        F.round((F.col("discount_pct") * 0.9), 2).alias("adjusted_discount_pct"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("channel_filled"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("ends_on").between("2023-03-07", "2023-10-07"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("adjusted_discount_pct").over(w).alias("next_adjusted_discount_pct"),
        F.lead("discount_pct_rounded").over(w).alias("next_discount_pct_rounded"),
        F.lag("discount_pct_rounded").over(w).alias("prev_discount_pct_rounded"),
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

latest = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

latest_promotions = (
    latest
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

result = (
    latest_promotions
    .groupBy("promo_code")
    .pivot("channel", ["mobile", "partner", "web"])
    .agg(F.avg("next_discount_pct_rounded").alias("value_sum"))
)
```

with flattened as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        element
    from carts
    lateral view explode(coupon_codes) t as element
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select src.*, p.signup_date
    from flattened src
    left join customers p
        on src.customer_id = p.id
    where p.segment = 'SMB'
),
enriched_carts as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        e.id,
        e.customer_id,
        e.element,
        e.signup_date,
        p.city,
        p.credit_limit,
        p.email
    from enriched e
    left join customers p
        on e.customer_id <=> p.id
),
joined as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        s.customer_id,
        s.element,
        s.signup_date,
        s.credit_limit,
        s.email,
        p.country,
        p.name,
        p.segment
    from enriched_carts s
    inner join customers p
        on s.customer_id = p.id
),
joined_carts as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        src.customer_id,
        src.signup_date,
        src.credit_limit,
        c.age
    from joined src
    left join customers c
        on src.customer_id = c.id
),
summary as (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    select
        customer_id,
        avg(credit_limit) as avg_credit_limit,
        count(*) as cnt,
        min(credit_limit) as min_credit_limit,
        percentile_approx(age, 0.95) as age_p95,
        count(distinct customer_id) as distinct_customer_ids,
        round(avg(credit_limit), 2) as avg_credit_limit_2
    from joined_carts
    group by rollup (customer_id)
)
select
    customer_id,
    avg_credit_limit,
    cnt,
    min_credit_limit,
    age_p95,
    distinct_customer_ids,
    avg_credit_limit_2
from summary
order by avg_credit_limit desc nulls first;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

flattened = df_carts.select("id", "customer_id", F.explode("coupon_codes").alias("element"))

enriched = (
    flattened
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("p.segment") == "SMB")
    .select("src.*", F.col("p.signup_date"))
)

enriched_carts = (
    enriched
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("e.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("p.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.customer_id",
        "e.element",
        "e.signup_date",
        F.col("p.city"),
        F.col("p.credit_limit"),
        F.col("p.email"),
    )
)

joined = (
    enriched_carts
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.element",
        "s.signup_date",
        "s.credit_limit",
        "s.email",
        F.col("p.country"),
        F.col("p.name"),
        F.col("p.segment"),
    )
)

joined_carts = (
    joined
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "left")
    .select("src.customer_id", "src.signup_date", "src.credit_limit", F.col("c.age"))
)

summary = (
    joined_carts
    .rollup("customer_id")
    .agg(
        F.avg("credit_limit").alias("avg_credit_limit"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.min("credit_limit").alias("min_credit_limit"),
        F.percentile_approx("age", 0.95).alias("age_p95"),
        F.countDistinct("customer_id").alias("distinct_customer_ids"),
        F.round(F.avg("credit_limit"), 2).alias("avg_credit_limit_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "customer_id",
        "avg_credit_limit",
        "cnt",
        "min_credit_limit",
        "age_p95",
        "distinct_customer_ids",
        "avg_credit_limit_2",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_credit_limit").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

WITH scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        store_name,
        opened_date,
        sqft,
        LAG(sqft, 1, 0) OVER w_hist AS prev_sqft,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_running AS row_seq,
        LEAD(sqft, 1) OVER (ORDER BY sqft, id) AS next_sqft,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY sqft DESC, id) AS sqft_bucket
    FROM stores
    WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY opened_date, id), w_running AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY opened_date, id)
),
kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM scored s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inventory c
            WHERE c.store_id = s.id
              AND c.store_id = 5
        )
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY opened_date, id) AS seq_no,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY sqft DESC, id) AS sqft_bucket_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sqft DESC, id) AS event_seq
    FROM kept
),
kept_stores AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders x
            WHERE x.store_id = s.id
              AND x.amount BETWEEN 1180 AND 1260
        )
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    seq_no,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_date) AS activity_month,
    BIT_AND(sqft) AS sqft_bit_and,
    ROUND(AVG(sqft_bucket_2), 2) AS avg_sqft_bucket_2,
    BIT_OR(sqft) AS sqft_bit_or,
    GROUPING(seq_no) AS gid
FROM kept_stores
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((seq_no, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', opened_date)), (seq_no), ())
HAVING sqft_bit_and > 1
ORDER BY sqft_bit_and NULLS FIRST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.orderBy("opened_date", "id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("opened_date", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("sqft", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("sqft").desc(), "id")

scored = (
    df_stores
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_name",
        "opened_date",
        "sqft",
        F.lag("sqft", 1, 0).over(w_hist).alias("prev_sqft"),
        F.row_number().over(w_running).alias("row_seq"),
        F.lead("sqft", 1).over(w3).alias("next_sqft"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w4).alias("sqft_bucket"),
    )
)

kept = (
    scored
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_inventory.alias("c"), (F.col("c.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.store_id") == 5), "left_semi")
)

with_windows = (
    kept
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("sqft_bucket_2", F.ntile(5).over(w5))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w5))
)

kept_stores = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("x"), (F.col("x.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.amount").between(1180, 1260)), "left_semi")
)

result = (
    kept_stores
    .withColumn("activity_month", F.date_trunc("MONTH", "opened_date"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["seq_no", "activity_month"], ["seq_no"], []],
        "seq_no",
        "activity_month",
    )
    .agg(
        F.bit_and("sqft").alias("sqft_bit_and"),
        F.round(F.avg("sqft_bucket_2"), 2).alias("avg_sqft_bucket_2"),
        F.bit_or("sqft").alias("sqft_bit_or"),
        F.grouping("seq_no").alias("gid"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("sqft_bit_and") > 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("sqft_bit_and").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT *, ROUND(revenue * 1.15, 2) AS revenue_scaled
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE product_id = 6
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT *, revenue_scaled * revenue AS revenue_scaled_times_revenue
    FROM valid
    WHERE store_id IN (1, 2, 5, 6)
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        revenue,
        LEAD(revenue_scaled) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue, id) AS next_revenue_scaled,
        LAG(revenue_scaled) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue, id) AS prev_revenue_scaled,
        LEAD(revenue_scaled_times_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue, id) AS next_revenue_scaled_times_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue, id) AS event_seq,
        AVG(revenue_scaled) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(sale_date) ORDER BY revenue_scaled_times_revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS revenue_scaled_avg_5
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE revenue_scaled_times_revenue > 31
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(prev_revenue_scaled, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_prev_revenue_scaled,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY next_revenue_scaled, id) AS seq_no,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_scaled_avg_5 DESC) AS revenue_scaled_avg_5_dense_rank
    FROM scored
),
base AS (
    SELECT *, CEIL(revenue_scaled_avg_5_dense_rank) AS revenue_scaled_avg_5_dense_rank_whole
    FROM enriched
    WHERE prev_revenue_scaled BETWEEN 26 AND 58

    seq_no,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(next_revenue_scaled, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS next_revenue_scaled_quartiles
FROM base
GROUP BY seq_no

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("revenue", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("sale_date")).orderBy("revenue_scaled_times_revenue", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("revenue", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("next_revenue_scaled", "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("revenue_scaled_avg_5").desc())

valid = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("product_id") == 6)
    .select("*", F.round((F.col("revenue") * 1.15), 2).alias("revenue_scaled"))
)

cleaned = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("store_id").isin([1, 2, 5, 6]))
    .withColumn("revenue_scaled_times_revenue", (F.col("revenue_scaled") * F.col("revenue")))
)

    .filter(F.col("revenue_scaled_times_revenue") > 31)
    .select(

)

    scored
    .withColumn("first_known_prev_revenue_scaled", F.first("prev_revenue_scaled", ignorenulls=True).over(w3))
```

WITH deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY balance, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM accounts
    ) t
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        balance,
        status,
        rank_in_group,
        SUM(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status, customer_id ORDER BY rank_in_group, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_sum_balance,
        MAX(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status, customer_id ORDER BY rank_in_group, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_max_balance,
        MIN(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY status, customer_id ORDER BY rank_in_group, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_min_balance
    FROM deduped
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY running_sum_balance DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS row_num
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
deduped_accounts AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        rank_in_group,
        running_max_balance,
        row_num
    FROM latest
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status ORDER BY running_min_balance DESC, id) = 1
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN running_max_balance >= 65000 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS running_max_balance_tier,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    ROUND(AVG(running_max_balance), 2) AS avg_running_max_balance,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(running_max_balance, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS running_max_balance_quartiles,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(running_max_balance, 0.5) AS running_max_balance_p50
FROM deduped_accounts
GROUP BY CASE WHEN running_max_balance >= 65000 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
HAVING running_max_balance_p50 > 0
ORDER BY avg_running_max_balance NULLS LAST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("balance", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status", "customer_id").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("running_sum_balance").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("running_min_balance").desc(), "id")

deduped = (
    df_accounts
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "balance",
        "status",
        "rank_in_group",
        F.sum("balance").over(w2).alias("running_sum_balance"),
        F.max("balance").over(w2).alias("running_max_balance"),
        F.min("balance").over(w2).alias("running_min_balance"),
    )
)

latest = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

deduped_accounts = (
    latest
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("id", "rank_in_group", "running_max_balance", "row_num")
)

result = (
    deduped_accounts
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("running_max_balance") >= 65000, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("running_max_balance_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.round(F.avg("running_max_balance"), 2).alias("avg_running_max_balance"),
        F.percentile_approx("running_max_balance", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("running_max_balance_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("running_max_balance", 0.5).alias("running_max_balance_p50"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("running_max_balance_p50") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_running_max_balance").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        is_flagged,
        TRIM(txn_type) AS clean_txn_type
    FROM transactions
    WHERE merchant NOT IN ('Shell', 'Lazada', 'Amazon')
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN txn_time - LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id) > INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM filtered
),
sessions_transactions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        clean_txn_type,
        SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(txn_time), merchant ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_cume_dist,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY amount, id) AS event_seq
    FROM sessions_transactions
    WHERE merchant IN ('Grab', 'Starbucks')
),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id) AS prev_txn_time
    FROM with_windows
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_txn_time IS NULL OR txn_time > prev_txn_time + INTERVAL '60' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM prev_events
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        session_id,
        event_seq,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id_2
    FROM gaps
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        amount,
        merchant,
        session_id,
        event_seq,
        session_id_2,
        event_seq * amount AS event_seq_times_amount
    FROM islands
    WHERE txn_time > DATE '2023-10-11'
      AND merchant IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY event_seq DESC, id) AS rn
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
with_windows_transactions AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY event_seq, id) AS event_seq_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY amount DESC, id) AS event_seq_2,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY event_seq DESC, id) AS event_seq_bucket_2
    FROM ranked
)
SELECT
    id,
    amount,
    event_seq,
    session_id_2,
    event_seq_times_amount,
    event_seq_bucket_2
FROM with_windows_transactions
ORDER BY event_seq_times_amount DESC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("txn_time"), "merchant").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("amount", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy(F.col("event_seq").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("event_seq", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(~F.col("merchant").isin(["Shell", "Lazada", "Amazon"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        F.trim("txn_type").alias("clean_txn_type"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("txn_time") - F.lag("txn_time").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_transactions = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "clean_txn_type",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    sessions_transactions
    .filter(F.col("merchant").isin(["Grab", "Starbucks"]))
    .withColumn("amount_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w3))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w4))
)

prev_events = with_windows.withColumn("prev_txn_time", F.lag("txn_time").over(w))

gaps = (
    prev_events
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_txn_time").isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.col("prev_txn_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "session_id",
        "event_seq",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2).alias("session_id_2"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    islands
    .filter((F.col("txn_time") > F.lit("2023-10-11").cast("date")) & F.col("merchant").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "merchant",
        "session_id",
        "event_seq",
        "session_id_2",
        (F.col("event_seq") * F.col("amount")).alias("event_seq_times_amount"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

with_windows_transactions = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(10).over(w6).alias("event_seq_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("event_seq_2"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w5).alias("event_seq_bucket_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows_transactions
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "event_seq",
        "session_id_2",
        "event_seq_times_amount",
        "event_seq_bucket_2",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("event_seq_times_amount").desc())
)
```

WITH latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_name,
        budget
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM departments
    ) ranked
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    dept_name,
    CASE WHEN budget >= 4086000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS budget_tier,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dept_name = 'Finance' THEN 1 END) AS finance_count,
    ROUND(AVG(budget), 2) AS avg_budget,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    STDDEV_SAMP(budget) AS budget_stddev,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dept_name = 'HR') AS hr_rows,
    MIN(budget) AS min_budget
FROM latest
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((dept_name, CASE WHEN budget >= 4086000 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END), (dept_name), ())
ORDER BY avg_budget DESC NULLS FIRST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy("budget", "id")

latest = (
    df_departments
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "dept_name", "budget")
)

result = (
    latest
    .withColumn("budget_tier", F.when(F.col("budget") >= 4086000, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["dept_name", "budget_tier"], ["dept_name"], []],
        "dept_name",
        "budget_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "Finance", 1)).alias("finance_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("budget"), 2).alias("avg_budget"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.stddev_samp("budget").alias("budget_stddev"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "HR", 1)).alias("hr_rows"),
        F.min("budget").alias("min_budget"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_budget").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        level,
        IF(is_remote, 'Yes', 'No') AS is_remote_label,
        COALESCE(level, 'UNKNOWN') AS level_filled
    FROM employees
    WHERE level IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'L2'
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_id,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        level,
        is_remote_label,
        level_filled,
        CAST(is_remote AS INT) AS is_remote_flag
    FROM base
    WHERE hire_date > TO_DATE('2023-02-14')
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(is_remote_flag, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY salary, id) AS next_is_remote_flag,
        AVG(is_remote_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY salary, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS is_remote_flag_avg_2
    FROM filtered
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(is_remote_flag_avg_2) OVER (PARTITION BY level, dept_id ORDER BY next_is_remote_flag, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last4_max_is_remote_flag_avg_2,
        MIN(is_remote_flag_avg_2) OVER (PARTITION BY level, dept_id ORDER BY next_is_remote_flag, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last4_min_is_remote_flag_avg_2,
        SUM(is_remote_flag_avg_2) OVER (PARTITION BY level, dept_id ORDER BY next_is_remote_flag, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last4_sum_is_remote_flag_avg_2,
        AVG(is_remote_flag_avg_2) OVER (PARTITION BY level, dept_id ORDER BY next_is_remote_flag, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last4_avg_is_remote_flag_avg_2
    FROM scored
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.dept_id,
        a.salary,
        a.hire_date,
        a.is_remote_label,
        a.level_filled,
        a.next_is_remote_flag,
        a.last4_max_is_remote_flag_avg_2,
        a.last4_sum_is_remote_flag_avg_2,
        a.last4_avg_is_remote_flag_avg_2,
        b.dept_name
    FROM metrics a
    LEFT JOIN departments b
        ON a.dept_id = b.id
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT dept_id, id
    FROM with_dims
    INTERSECT
    SELECT dept_id, id
    FROM employees
    WHERE NOT is_remote
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_dims s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.dept_id = k.dept_id AND s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', hire_date) AS year_start,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(dept_name)) AS dept_name_list,
    ROUND(AVG(last4_max_is_remote_flag_avg_2), 2) AS avg_last4_max_is_remote_flag_avg_2
FROM verified
GROUP BY 1
HAVING ROUND(AVG(last4_max_is_remote_flag_avg_2), 2) < 1000000;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("level", "dept_id").orderBy("next_is_remote_flag", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("level").eqNullSafe(F.lit("L2")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_id",
        "manager_id",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "is_remote",
        "level",
        F.when(F.col("is_remote"), "Yes").otherwise("No").alias("is_remote_label"),
        F.coalesce("level", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("level_filled"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("hire_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-02-14")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_id",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "level",
        "is_remote_label",
        "level_filled",
        F.col("is_remote").cast("int").alias("is_remote_flag"),
    )
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("is_remote_flag", 1).over(w).alias("next_is_remote_flag"),
        F.avg("is_remote_flag").over(w2).alias("is_remote_flag_avg_2"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .withColumn("last4_max_is_remote_flag_avg_2", F.max("is_remote_flag_avg_2").over(w3))
    .withColumn("last4_min_is_remote_flag_avg_2", F.min("is_remote_flag_avg_2").over(w3))
    .withColumn("last4_sum_is_remote_flag_avg_2", F.sum("is_remote_flag_avg_2").over(w3))
    .withColumn("last4_avg_is_remote_flag_avg_2", F.avg("is_remote_flag_avg_2").over(w3))
)

with_dims = (
    metrics
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_departments.alias("b"), F.col("a.dept_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.dept_id",
        "a.salary",
        "a.hire_date",
        "a.is_remote_label",
        "a.level_filled",
        "a.next_is_remote_flag",
        "a.last4_max_is_remote_flag_avg_2",
        "a.last4_sum_is_remote_flag_avg_2",
        "a.last4_avg_is_remote_flag_avg_2",
        F.col("b.dept_name"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    with_dims
    .select("dept_id", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_employees
        .filter(~F.col("is_remote"))
        .select("dept_id", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_dims
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.dept_id") == F.col("k.dept_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "hire_date").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("dept_name")).alias("dept_name_list"),
        F.round(F.avg("last4_max_is_remote_flag_avg_2"), 2).alias("avg_last4_max_is_remote_flag_avg_2"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_last4_max_is_remote_flag_avg_2") < 1000000)
)
```

    SELECT s.*
    FROM stores s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM inventory x
            WHERE x.store_id = s.id
              AND x.last_restock >= s.opened_date
        )
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', opened_date) AS year_start,
    AVG(sqft) FILTER (WHERE region = 'South') AS south_avg_sqft,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE region = 'East') AS east_rows
FROM eligible
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', opened_date)
HAVING east_rows > 1
ORDER BY year_start DESC NULLS LAST;
reference:
```python

eligible = (
    df_stores
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_inventory.alias("x"), (F.col("x.store_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.last_restock") >= F.col("s.opened_date")), "left_semi")
)

result = (
    eligible
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "opened_date").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("region") == "South", F.col("sqft"))).alias("south_avg_sqft"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("region") == "East", 1)).alias("east_rows"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("east_rows") > 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("year_start").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

sql:
WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, ROUND(status_bits / pressure, 2) AS status_bits_per_pressure
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts > DATE '2025-09-01'
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM base
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY status_bits_per_pressure DESC NULLS LAST, id) = 1
),
prev_events AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) AS prev_reading_ts
    FROM ranked
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_reading_ts IS NULL OR reading_ts > prev_reading_ts + INTERVAL '20' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM prev_events
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        status_bits,
        status_bits_per_pressure,
        SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) IS NULL
                 OR reading_ts > LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) + INTERVAL '45' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM sessionized
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id_2
    FROM gaps
),
ranked_device_readings AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (

```python
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("status_bits").desc())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("island_id_2")
w7 = Window.orderBy("status_bits_per_pressure")

w9 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("status_bits_dense_rank", "id")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("island_id", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)

ranked = (

    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)

)

prev_events = ranked.withColumn("prev_reading_ts", F.lag("reading_ts").over(w2))

)
```

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CAST(is_active AS INT) AS is_active_flag
    FROM customers
    WHERE signup_date > TO_DATE('2023-08-02')
      AND segment IS NOT NULL
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders c
            WHERE c.customer_id = s.id
              AND c.order_date >= s.signup_date
        )
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT(email, ' - ', country) AS email_country,
        COALESCE(name, 'unassigned') AS name_filled,
        COALESCE(city, 'OTHER') AS resolved_city
    FROM not_flagged
    WHERE segment IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'SMB'
      AND signup_date >= '2023-09-01'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(credit_limit) OVER w_recent AS prev_credit_limit,
        LEAD(is_active_flag) OVER w_recent AS next_is_active_flag,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_recent AS event_seq,
        CORR(credit_limit, age) OVER (PARTITION BY segment) AS corr_credit_limit_age
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY signup_date, id)
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', signup_date) AS year_start,
    COUNT_IF(segment = 'SMB') AS smb_events,
    SUM(CASE WHEN city = 'New York' THEN age ELSE 0 END) AS new_york_age,
    SUM(event_seq) AS total_event_seq,
    CORR(age, credit_limit) AS corr_age_credit_limit,
    MIN(next_is_active_flag) AS min_next_is_active_flag,
    ROUND(AVG(corr_credit_limit_age), 2) AS avg_corr_credit_limit_age
FROM enriched
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', signup_date);
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_recent = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("signup_date", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("segment")

cleaned = (
    df_customers
    .filter((F.col("signup_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-08-02"))) & F.col("segment").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.col("is_active").cast("int").alias("is_active_flag"))
)

not_flagged = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.order_date") >= F.col("s.signup_date")), "left_anti")
)

base = (
    not_flagged
    .filter((F.col("segment").eqNullSafe(F.lit("SMB"))) & (F.col("signup_date") >= "2023-09-01"))
    .withColumn("email_country", F.concat("email", F.lit(" - "), "country"))
    .withColumn("name_filled", F.coalesce("name", F.lit("unassigned")))
    .withColumn("resolved_city", F.coalesce("city", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

enriched = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("credit_limit").over(w_recent).alias("prev_credit_limit"),
        F.lead("is_active_flag").over(w_recent).alias("next_is_active_flag"),
        F.row_number().over(w_recent).alias("event_seq"),
        F.corr("credit_limit", "age").over(w2).alias("corr_credit_limit_age"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "signup_date").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("segment") == "SMB").alias("smb_events"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("city") == "New York", F.col("age")).otherwise(0)).alias("new_york_age"),
        F.sum("event_seq").alias("total_event_seq"),
        F.corr("age", "credit_limit").alias("corr_age_credit_limit"),
        F.min("next_is_active_flag").alias("min_next_is_active_flag"),
        F.round(F.avg("corr_credit_limit_age"), 2).alias("avg_corr_credit_limit_age"),
    )
)
```

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), event_time) / 30 AS months_since_event_time,
        COALESCE(page, 'NONE') AS page_clean
    FROM web_events
    WHERE page IS NOT NULL
      AND duration_sec != 349
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
        FROM base
    ) x
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(months_since_event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY row_num, id) AS next_months_since_event_time,
        LEAD(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY row_num, id) AS next_duration_sec,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY row_num, id) AS event_seq
    FROM latest
),
latest_web_events AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY row_num, id) = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(months_since_event_time, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_months_since_event_time,
        COUNT(months_since_event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(event_time), page ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS months_since_event_time_count_30d,
        AVG(next_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(event_time), session_id ORDER BY event_seq, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS next_duration_sec_avg_6_prior,
        AVG(next_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('week', event_time) ORDER BY row_num, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS next_duration_sec_avg_3
    FROM latest_web_events
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    event_type,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_type)) AS num_event_types,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE page = '/home') AS home_rows,
    MAX(event_time) AS last_event_time,
    ROUND(SUM(event_seq) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN event_type = 'purchase' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS event_seq_per_purchase
FROM enriched
GROUP BY event_type
ORDER BY event_seq_per_purchase NULLS FIRST;
reference:

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy(F.col("event_time").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("row_num", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("event_time"), "page").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("event_time"), "session_id").orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "event_time")).orderBy("row_num", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull() & (F.col("duration_sec") != 349))
    .withColumn("months_since_event_time", (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "event_time") / 30))
    .withColumn("page_clean", F.coalesce("page", F.lit("NONE")))
)

latest = (
    base
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    latest
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("months_since_event_time").over(w2).alias("next_months_since_event_time"),
        F.lead("duration_sec").over(w2).alias("next_duration_sec"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

latest_web_events = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

enriched = (
    latest_web_events
    .withColumn("last_known_months_since_event_time", F.last("months_since_event_time", ignorenulls=True).over(w3))
    .withColumn("months_since_event_time_count_30d", F.count("months_since_event_time").over(w4))
    .withColumn("next_duration_sec_avg_6_prior", F.avg("next_duration_sec").over(w5))
    .withColumn("next_duration_sec_avg_3", F.avg("next_duration_sec").over(w6))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy("event_type")
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("event_type")).alias("num_event_types"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/home", 1)).alias("home_rows"),
        F.max("event_time").alias("last_event_time"),
        F.round(F.sum("event_seq") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("event_type") == "purchase", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("event_seq_per_purchase"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("event_seq_per_purchase").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

        a.rn,
        b.launch_date,
