        b.brand
    FROM ranked a
    LEFT JOIN products b
        ON a.product_id = b.id
),
ranked_inventory AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category, brand ORDER BY launch_date DESC, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM with_dims
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1

    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity_rounded,
        launch_date,
        rank_in_group,
        AVG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY launch_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS quantity_avg_6_prior,

    FROM ranked_inventory

deduped AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY prev_quantity_rounded NULLS FIRST, id) AS latest_rank
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY rank_in_group, id) AS rank_in_group_2
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY rank_in_group_2 = 1
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        quantity_rounded,
        prev_quantity_rounded
    FROM latest

    FROM valid_inventory

```python
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "country",

    )
)

joined = (
    base
    .alias("s")

latest_match = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))

)

with_prev = latest_match.withColumn("prev_event_time", F.lag("event_time").over(w2))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_event_time").isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.col("prev_event_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = with_gaps.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w3))

with_gaps_2 = (

    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(w4).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(w4) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions_2 = with_gaps_2.withColumn("session_no_2", F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w5))

eligible = (
    sessions_sessions_2
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.event_time") < F.col("s.prev_event_time")), "left_anti")
)

with_windows = (
    eligible
    .select(
        "*",

        F.count("duration_sec").over(w7).alias("duration_sec_count_7d"),
        F.stddev_samp("session_no").over(w_running).alias("device_stddev_samp_session_no"),
```

sql:
WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        brand,
        price,
        stock_qty,
        launch_date,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        ROUND(price, 0) AS price_rounded
    FROM products
    WHERE price <= 620
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach suppliers attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.product_name,
        src.brand,
        src.stock_qty,
        src.launch_date,
        src.tags,
        src.supplier_id,
        src.price_rounded,
        p.city,
        p.rating,
        p.supplier_name
    FROM valid src
    LEFT JOIN suppliers p
        ON src.supplier_id = p.id
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(p.supplier_name)) = 'lion city imports'
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        rating - price_rounded AS rating_minus_price_rounded,
        COALESCE(city, 'OTHER') AS city_clean
    FROM joined
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
      AND city IS DISTINCT FROM 'Chiang Mai'
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(price_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(launch_date)) AS launch_date_year_avg_price_rounded,
        LAST_VALUE(rating) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_rating,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY rating DESC, id) AS rating_bucket
    FROM base
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id, brand ORDER BY launch_date NULLS FIRST, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM metrics
    ) x
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
              AND c.sale_date <= s.launch_date
        )
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        brand,
        rating,
        rating_minus_price_rounded,
        price_rounded,
        last_known_rating
    FROM kept
) src
UNPIVOT (
    value FOR metric_name IN (rating AS RATING, rating_minus_price_rounded, price_rounded AS PRICE_ROUNDED_VAL, last_known_rating AS LAST_KNOWN_RATING)
);

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.year("launch_date"))
w2 = Window.orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("supplier_id", "brand").orderBy(F.col("launch_date").asc_nulls_first(), "id")

valid = (
    df_products
    .filter(F.col("price") <= 620)
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_name",
        "brand",
        "price",
        "stock_qty",
        "launch_date",
        "tags",
        "supplier_id",
        F.round("price", 0).alias("price_rounded"),
    )
)

joined = (
    valid
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("p"), F.col("src.supplier_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.lower(F.trim(F.col("p.supplier_name"))) == "lion city imports")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.product_name",
        "src.brand",
        "src.stock_qty",
        "src.launch_date",
        "src.tags",
        "src.supplier_id",
        "src.price_rounded",
        F.col("p.city"),
        F.col("p.rating"),
        F.col("p.supplier_name"),
    )
)

base = (
    joined
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull() & (~F.col("city").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Chiang Mai"))))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("rating") - F.col("price_rounded")).alias("rating_minus_price_rounded"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("city_clean"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    base
    .withColumn("launch_date_year_avg_price_rounded", F.avg("price_rounded").over(w))
    .withColumn("last_known_rating", F.last("rating", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
    .withColumn("rating_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w3))
)

ranked = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

kept = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_store_sales.alias("c"), (F.col("c.product_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.sale_date") <= F.col("s.launch_date")), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    kept
    .select(
        "id",
        "brand",
        F.col("rating").alias("RATING"),
        "rating_minus_price_rounded",
        F.col("price_rounded").alias("PRICE_ROUNDED_VAL"),
        F.col("last_known_rating").alias("LAST_KNOWN_RATING"),
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "brand"],
        values=["RATING", "rating_minus_price_rounded", "PRICE_ROUNDED_VAL", "LAST_KNOWN_RATING"],
        variableColumnName="metric_name",
        valueColumnName="value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("value").isNotNull())
)
```

sql:
with valid as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        round(status_bits * 1.07, 2) status_bits_scaled,
        greatest(pressure, status_bits) greatest_pressure_status_bits
    from device_readings
    where status_bits <> 3
),
deduped as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *, rank() over (partition by device_code order by temp_c nulls first) as latest_rank
    from valid
    qualify latest_rank = 1
),
latest as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits_scaled,
        greatest_pressure_status_bits,
        latest_rank
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by device_code order by latest_rank desc, id) as rank_in_group
        from deduped
    ) x
    where rank_in_group = 1
),
gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when reading_ts - lag(reading_ts) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id) > interval '15' minute then 1 else 0 end as session_start_flag
    from latest
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(session_start_flag) over (partition by device_code order by reading_ts, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id
    from gaps
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    case when pressure >= 1025 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as pressure_tier,
    device_code,
    sort_array(collect_set(device_code)) as device_code_list,
    size(collect_set(device_code)) as num_device_codes,
    percent_rank() over (partition by case when pressure >= 1025 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end order by size(collect_set(device_code)) desc) as num_device_codes_percent_rank
from islands
group by case when pressure >= 1025 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end, device_code
order by pressure_tier nulls first
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("temp_c").asc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("latest_rank").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("pressure_tier").orderBy(F.col("num_device_codes").desc())

valid = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("status_bits") != 3)
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        F.round((F.col("status_bits") * 1.07), 2).alias("status_bits_scaled"),
        F.greatest("pressure", "status_bits").alias("greatest_pressure_status_bits"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

latest = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits_scaled",
        "greatest_pressure_status_bits",
        "latest_rank",
    )
)

gaps = (
    latest
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(w3) > F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w4))

result = (
    islands
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("pressure") >= 1025, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("pressure_tier"),
        "device_code",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("device_code")).alias("device_code_list"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("device_code")).alias("num_device_codes"),
    )
    .withColumn("num_device_codes_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w5))
    .orderBy(F.col("pressure_tier").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

sql:
WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('week', txn_time), account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_amount,
        SUM(amount) OVER (ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_amount_2
    FROM transactions
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        a.status,
        a.balance,
        a.opened_date
    FROM with_windows src
    LEFT JOIN accounts a
        ON src.account_id = a.id
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT txn_type
    FROM enriched
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT txn_type
    FROM transactions
    WHERE amount >= 2200
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.txn_type = k.txn_type
),
enriched_transactions AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        txn_type,
        merchant,
        running_amount,
        balance,
        COUNT(balance) OVER w_grp AS balance_count_90d,
        SUM(running_amount_2) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(txn_time), status ORDER BY CAST(txn_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_amount_2_sum_90d
    FROM kept_rows
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY txn_type ORDER BY CAST(txn_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
    id,
    txn_type,
    running_amount,
    balance,
    balance_count_90d,
    running_amount_2_sum_90d
FROM enriched_transactions
ORDER BY running_amount DESC NULLS FIRST;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "txn_time"), "account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("txn_time"), "status").orderBy(F.col("txn_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7776000, Window.currentRow)

with_windows = (
    df_transactions
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("amount").over(w).alias("running_amount"),
        F.sum("amount").over(w2).alias("running_amount_2"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    with_windows
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("a"), F.col("src.account_id") == F.col("a.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("a.status"), F.col("a.balance"), F.col("a.opened_date"))
)

matched_keys = (
    enriched
    .select("txn_type")
    .subtract(
        df_transactions
        .filter(F.col("amount") >= 2200)
        .select("txn_type")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.txn_type") == F.col("k.txn_type")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched_transactions = (
    kept_rows
    .select(
        "id",
        "txn_type",
        "merchant",
        "running_amount",
        "balance",
        F.count("balance").over(w_grp).alias("balance_count_90d"),
        F.sum("running_amount_2").over(w4).alias("running_amount_2_sum_90d"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_transactions
    .select(
        "id",
        "txn_type",
        "running_amount",
        "balance",
        "balance_count_90d",
        "running_amount_2_sum_90d",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("running_amount").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("account_id", "txn_type").orderBy("running_min_amount")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy(F.col("amount").asc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("txn_time"), "account_id").orderBy(F.col("running_min_amount").desc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("txn_time") >= F.lit("2023-08-08").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("txn_time_day", F.col("txn_time").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("clean_merchant", F.trim("merchant"))
    .withColumn("merchant_filled", F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("txn_time_day") >= "2024-09-13")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("amount").over(w_ordered).alias("running_count_amount"),
        F.min("amount").over(w_ordered).alias("running_min_amount"),
        F.sum("amount").over(w_ordered).alias("running_sum_amount"),
        F.avg("amount").over(w2).alias("amount_avg_2"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("row_num", F.rank().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

scored = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "txn_type",
        "is_flagged",
        "merchant_filled",
        "running_min_amount",
        "amount_avg_2",
        "row_num",
        F.dense_rank().over(w4).alias("amount_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w5).alias("running_min_amount_rank"),
        F.last("running_min_amount", ignorenulls=True).over(w6).alias("last_known_running_min_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "is_flagged",
        "merchant_filled",
        "running_min_amount",
        "amount_dense_rank",
        "running_min_amount_rank",
        "last_known_running_min_amount",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("running_min_amount_rank").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
)
```

with deduped as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *, row_number() over (partition by country, segment order by signup_date nulls last, id) as rn
    from customers
    qualify rn = 1
),
enriched as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        corr(age, credit_limit) over (partition by city) as corr_age_credit_limit,
        sum(age) over w_hist as cumulative_age,
        round(age / sum(age) over (partition by country), 4) as age_share,
        ntile(10) over w_recent as credit_limit_bucket,
        max(age) over (partition by date_trunc('YEAR', signup_date)) as signup_date_period_max_age
    from deduped
    window w_hist as (partition by segment order by signup_date, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row), w_recent as (order by credit_limit desc, id)
),
with_latest as (
    -- Latest matching session per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    select
        s.id,
        s.country,
        s.segment,
        s.credit_limit,
        s.age,
        s.age_share,
        top1.session_started_at,
        top1.session_device
    from enriched s
    left join lateral (
            select c.started_at as session_started_at, c.device as session_device
            from sessions c
            where c.customer_id = s.id
              and c.started_at <= s.signup_date
            order by c.started_at desc, c.id desc
            limit 1
        ) top1 on true
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when session_started_at - lag(session_started_at) over (partition by segment order by session_started_at, id) > interval '14' day then 1 else 0 end as is_new_burst
    from with_latest
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select
        id,
        segment,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        session_started_at,
        session_device,
        sum(is_new_burst) over (partition by segment order by session_started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_no
    from with_gaps
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        first_value(segment) ignore nulls over (partition by segment order by session_started_at, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_segment,
        lead(session_no, 2) over (partition by year(session_started_at), session_device order by credit_limit, id) as next_session_no,
        round(credit_limit / sum(credit_limit) over (partition by session_device, segment), 4) as credit_limit_share
    from islands
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select segment, id
    from metrics
    intersect
    select segment, id
    from customers
    where upper(name) like '%IA %'
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from metrics s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.segment = k.segment and s.id = k.id
)
select
    id,
    segment,
    age,
    session_started_at,
    session_device,
    session_no,
    next_session_no,
    credit_limit_share
from reconciled
order by session_started_at desc nulls last;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country", "segment").orderBy(F.col("signup_date").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy("signup_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country")
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("credit_limit").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "signup_date"))
w7 = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.started_at").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w8 = Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy("session_started_at", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy("session_started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("session_started_at"), "session_device").orderBy("credit_limit", "id")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("session_device", "segment")

deduped = (
    df_customers
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("corr_age_credit_limit", F.corr("age", "credit_limit").over(w2))
    .withColumn("cumulative_age", F.sum("age").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("age_share", F.round((F.col("age") / F.sum("age").over(w4)), 4))
    .withColumn("credit_limit_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("signup_date_period_max_age", F.max("age").over(w6))
)

with_latest = (
    enriched
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.started_at") <= F.col("s.signup_date")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn_2", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("rn_2") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.country",
        "s.segment",
        "s.credit_limit",
        "s.age",
        "s.age_share",
        F.col("c.started_at").alias("session_started_at"),
        F.col("c.device").alias("session_device"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    with_latest
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("session_started_at") - F.lag("session_started_at").over(w8) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "segment",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        "session_started_at",
        "session_device",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w9).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    islands
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("segment", ignorenulls=True).over(w9).alias("first_known_segment"),
        F.lead("session_no", 2).over(w10).alias("next_session_no"),
        F.round((F.col("credit_limit") / F.sum("credit_limit").over(w11)), 4).alias("credit_limit_share"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    metrics
    .select("segment", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_customers
        .filter(F.upper("name").like("%IA %"))
        .select("segment", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.segment") == F.col("k.segment")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "id",
        "segment",
        "age",
        "session_started_at",
        "session_device",
        "session_no",
        "next_session_no",
        "credit_limit_share",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("session_started_at").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT(status, '/', carrier) AS status_carrier,
        ROUND(cost * 1.07, 2) AS cost_adjusted,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') AS resolved_carrier
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date > DATE '2023-09-25'
      AND order_id IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        cost_adjusted,
        resolved_carrier,
        SUM(cost_adjusted) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY shipped_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_cost_adjusted,
        LEAD(cost_adjusted, 1) OVER w_recent AS next_cost_adjusted,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS row_seq,
        AVG(cost) OVER w_running AS cost_avg_3_prior
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY MONTH(delivered_date), carrier ORDER BY delivered_date, id), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost DESC, id), w_running AS (ORDER BY delivered_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        cost_adjusted * next_cost_adjusted AS cost_adjusted_times_next_cost_adjusted,
        GREATEST(row_seq, running_cost_adjusted) AS greatest_row_seq_running_cost_adjusted
    FROM enriched
    WHERE shipped_date > TO_DATE('2023-05-07')
      AND carrier IN ('Kerry', 'FedEx', 'Flash')
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost_avg_3_prior, id) AS seq_no,
        AVG(cost_avg_3_prior) OVER (ORDER BY running_cost_adjusted, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior
    FROM base
    WHERE shipped_date BETWEEN '2023-09-01' AND '2024-04-21'
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY seq_no DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM scored
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,
        cost_adjusted,
        running_cost_adjusted,
        seq_no,
        cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior,
        latest_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost_adjusted_times_next_cost_adjusted) AS rank_in_group
        FROM latest
    ) x
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
scored_shipments AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_recent AS event_seq,
        AVG(cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior_avg_5_prior,
        LEAD(cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY latest_rank, id) AS next_cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_part AS cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior_percent_rank
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior DESC, id), w_part AS (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior DESC NULLS LAST)
),
summary AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        seq_no,
        ROUND(AVG(running_cost_adjusted), 2) AS avg_running_cost_adjusted,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(next_cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS next_cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior_quartiles,
        COUNT(DISTINCT carrier) AS distinct_carriers
    FROM scored_shipments
    GROUP BY seq_no
)
SELECT
    seq_no,
    avg_running_cost_adjusted,
    next_cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior_quartiles
FROM summary
ORDER BY avg_running_cost_adjusted NULLS LAST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("shipped_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy(F.month("delivered_date"), "carrier").orderBy("delivered_date", "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc(), "id")
w_running = Window.orderBy("delivered_date", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost_avg_3_prior", "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy("running_cost_adjusted", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("seq_no").desc(), "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost_adjusted_times_next_cost_adjusted")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior").desc(), "id")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w11 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("latest_rank", "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior").desc_nulls_last())

valid = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.lit("2023-09-25").cast("date")) & F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat("status", F.lit("/"), "carrier").alias("status_carrier"),
        F.round((F.col("cost") * 1.07), 2).alias("cost_adjusted"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("resolved_carrier"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "cost_adjusted",
        "resolved_carrier",
        F.sum("cost_adjusted").over(w).alias("running_cost_adjusted"),
        F.lead("cost_adjusted", 1).over(w_recent).alias("next_cost_adjusted"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("row_seq"),
        F.avg("cost").over(w_running).alias("cost_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter((F.col("shipped_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-07"))) & F.col("carrier").isin(["Kerry", "FedEx", "Flash"]))
    .withColumn("cost_adjusted_times_next_cost_adjusted", (F.col("cost_adjusted") * F.col("next_cost_adjusted")))
    .withColumn("greatest_row_seq_running_cost_adjusted", F.greatest("row_seq", "running_cost_adjusted"))
)

scored = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date").between("2023-09-01", "2024-04-21"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("seq_no"),
        F.avg("cost_avg_3_prior").over(w6).alias("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior"),
    )
)

latest = (
    scored
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

deduped = (
    latest
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.rank().over(w8))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "cost_adjusted",
        "running_cost_adjusted",
        "seq_no",
        "cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior",
        "latest_rank",
    )
)

scored_shipments = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w9).alias("event_seq"),
        F.avg("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior").over(w10).alias("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior_avg_5_prior"),
        F.lead("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior", 1).over(w11).alias("next_cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_part).alias("cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior_percent_rank"),
    )
)

summary = (
    scored_shipments
    .groupBy("seq_no")
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("running_cost_adjusted"), 2).alias("avg_running_cost_adjusted"),
        F.percentile_approx("next_cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("next_cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("carrier").alias("distinct_carriers"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "seq_no",
        "avg_running_cost_adjusted",
        "next_cost_avg_3_prior_avg_5_prior_quartiles",
    )
```

        *,
        CASE WHEN dept_name IN ('Sales', 'Finance') THEN 'Core' ELSE 'Other' END AS dept_name_group,
        COALESCE(location, 'UNKNOWN') AS location_filled
    FROM departments

not_flagged AS (

            SELECT 1
            FROM employees ch
            WHERE ch.dept_id = s.id
              AND NOT ch.is_remote
        )
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
    FROM not_flagged
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
not_flagged_departments AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees ch
            WHERE ch.dept_id = s.id
              AND ch.manager_id IS NULL
        )
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged_departments s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees x
            WHERE x.dept_id = s.id
              AND x.hire_date <= '2023-03-01'
        )
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM eligible
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY location, dept_name ORDER BY budget DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget, id) AS prev_budget,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget, id) AS seq_no
    FROM latest
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN budget >= 4487000 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS budget_tier,
    dept_name,
    ROUND(AVG(seq_no), 2) AS avg_seq_no,
    COUNT_IF(location = 'Tokyo') AS tokyo_events,
    AVG(seq_no) FILTER (WHERE dept_name = 'HR') AS hr_avg_seq_no,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dept_name = 'HR') AS hr_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dept_name = 'HR') AS hr_rows_2,
    COUNT_IF(dept_name = 'Marketing') AS marketing_events,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN budget >= 4487000 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END ORDER BY ROUND(AVG(seq_no), 2) DESC) AS avg_seq_no_percent_rank
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY budget_tier, dept_name
HAVING hr_avg_seq_no < 1000000
ORDER BY hr_rows;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("budget").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("budget_tier").orderBy(F.col("avg_seq_no").desc())

filtered = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("dept_name").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("dept_name_group", F.when(F.col("dept_name").isin(["Sales", "Finance"]), "Core").otherwise("Other"))
    .withColumn("location_filled", F.coalesce("location", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

not_flagged = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (~F.col("ch.is_remote")), "left_anti")
)

deduped = (
    not_flagged
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

not_flagged_departments = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.manager_id").isNull()), "left_anti")
)

eligible = (
    not_flagged_departments
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("x"), (F.col("x.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.hire_date") <= "2023-03-01"), "left_anti")
)

latest = (
    eligible
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

with_windows = (
    latest
    .withColumn("prev_budget", F.lag("budget").over(w3))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w3))
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("budget") >= 4487000, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("budget_tier"),
        "dept_name",
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("seq_no"), 2).alias("avg_seq_no"),
        F.count_if(F.col("location") == "Tokyo").alias("tokyo_events"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "HR", F.col("seq_no"))).alias("hr_avg_seq_no"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "HR", 1)).alias("hr_rows"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "HR", 1)).alias("hr_rows_2"),
        F.count_if(F.col("dept_name") == "Marketing").alias("marketing_events"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("hr_avg_seq_no") < 1000000)
    .withColumn("avg_seq_no_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w4))
    .orderBy("hr_rows")
)
```

    SELECT

        log_ts,
        key,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY log_ts, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no

valid AS (

    FROM lines
    WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-02 04:00:00'
      AND tag IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
    SELECT *, LENGTH(tag) AS tag_length
    FROM valid
    WHERE created_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 17:00:00'
      AND tag IS NOT NULL
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(tag_length AS DOUBLE) AS tag_length_str,
        UPPER(tag) AS tag_upper
    FROM base
    WHERE created_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 18:00:00'
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        tag,
        clean_tag,
        tag_filled,
        tag_length_str,
        tag_upper,
        STDDEV_SAMP(tag_length) OVER (PARTITION BY tag) AS tag_stddev_samp_tag_length,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tag_length DESC NULLS LAST) AS tag_length_percent_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tag_length_str DESC NULLS LAST) AS tag_length_str_rank,
        SUM(tag_length_str) OVER (PARTITION BY tag ORDER BY CAST(created_at AS BIGINT) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS tag_length_str_sum_15m
    FROM cleaned
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(tag_length_str_sum_15m, 0) AS tag_length_str_sum_15m_rounded,
        COALESCE(tag, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_tag
    FROM metrics
    WHERE tag_length_str_sum_15m >= 149
),
base_carts AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        tag,
        clean_tag,
        tag_filled,
        tag_length_str,
        tag_upper,
        tag_stddev_samp_tag_length,
        tag_length_percent_rank,
        tag_length_str_rank,
        tag_length_str_sum_15m,
        tag_length_str_sum_15m_rounded,
        resolved_tag,
        LEAST(tag_length_str_rank, tag_length_str) AS least_tag_length_str_rank_tag_length_str
    FROM filtered
    WHERE tag_length_str_rank >= 7
)
SELECT
    tag,
    clean_tag,
    tag_filled,
    tag_length_str,
    tag_length_str_rank,
    tag_length_str_sum_15m,

FROM base_carts;

sql:
with base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        round(shipping_fee / amount, 2) as amount_with_shipping,
        substring(channel, 1, 2) as channel_prefix
    from orders
    where channel is distinct from 'web'
      and amount <= 590
),
enriched as (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    select
        src.id,
        src.customer_id,
        src.store_id,
        src.order_date,
        src.channel,
        src.amount,
        src.discount,
        src.amount_with_shipping,
        src.channel_prefix,
        b.age,
        b.city
    from base src
    left join customers b
        on src.customer_id = b.id
),
ranked as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *, rank() over (partition by channel, store_id order by order_date) as row_num
    from enriched
    qualify row_num = 1
),
eligible as (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    select s.*
    from ranked s
    where exists (
            select 1
            from payments c
            where c.order_id = s.id
              and c.status = 'SUCCESS'
        )
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        channel,
        amount,
        discount,
        channel_prefix,
        row_num,
        lag(age) over (partition by customer_id order by amount_with_shipping, id) as prev_age,
        lead(age) over (partition by customer_id order by amount_with_shipping, id) as next_age,
        lag(amount_with_shipping) over (partition by customer_id order by amount_with_shipping, id) as prev_amount_with_shipping,
        row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by amount_with_shipping, id) as event_seq,
        avg(age) over (order by amount, id rows between 6 preceding and 1 preceding) as age_avg_6_prior
    from eligible
)
select

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

    df_orders
    .filter((~F.col("channel").eqNullSafe(F.lit("web"))) & (F.col("amount") <= 590))
    .withColumn("amount_with_shipping", F.round((F.col("shipping_fee") / F.col("amount")), 2))
    .withColumn("channel_prefix", F.substring("channel", 1, 2))

enriched = (
```

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        SUBSTRING(event_type, 1, 4) AS event_type_prefix,
        UPPER(page) AS page_upper
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_time >= DATE '2023-09-02'
      AND page IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        event_time,
        page_upper,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_duration_sec,
        LAST_VALUE(page) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_page
    FROM cleaned
),
with_windows_web_events AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id) AS row_seq,
        SUM(cumulative_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(event_time), session_id ORDER BY cumulative_duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_cumulative_duration_sec,
        SUM(cumulative_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', event_time), session_id ORDER BY cumulative_duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_cumulative_duration_sec,
        AVG(cumulative_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(event_time) ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS cumulative_duration_sec_avg_5_prior,
        AVG(cumulative_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_duration_sec_avg_7d
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE event_type IN ('page_view', 'search')
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        event_time,
        cumulative_duration_sec,
        last_known_page,
        running_cumulative_duration_sec,
        cumulative_duration_sec_avg_5_prior,
        ROUND(row_seq / SUM(row_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type), 4) AS row_seq_share,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, event_type ORDER BY cumulative_cumulative_duration_sec, id) AS event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time DESC, id) AS row_seq_2,
        COUNT(cumulative_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, event_type ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_duration_sec_count_7d,
        SUM(running_cumulative_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY cumulative_cumulative_duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_running_cumulative_duration_sec
    FROM with_windows_web_events
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN cumulative_duration_sec_avg_5_prior >= 2221 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS cumulative_duration_sec_avg_5_prior_tier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN event_type = 'click' THEN cumulative_duration_sec ELSE 0 END) AS click_cumulative_duration_sec,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'search') AS search_rows,
    ROUND(AVG(row_seq_share), 2) AS avg_row_seq_share,
    ROUND(AVG(row_seq_share), 2) AS avg_row_seq_share_2,
    MAX(event_time) AS ended_at
FROM metrics
GROUP BY CASE WHEN cumulative_duration_sec_avg_5_prior >= 2221 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
ORDER BY search_rows;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("event_time"), "session_id").orderBy("cumulative_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "event_time"), "session_id").orderBy("cumulative_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("event_time")).orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("event_type")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("session_id", "event_type").orderBy("cumulative_cumulative_duration_sec", "id")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("event_time").desc(), "id")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("session_id", "event_type").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w12 = Window.partitionBy("event_type").orderBy("cumulative_cumulative_duration_sec", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_web_events
    .filter((F.col("event_time") >= F.lit("2023-09-02").cast("date")) & F.col("page").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("event_type_prefix", F.substring("event_type", 1, 4))
    .withColumn("page_upper", F.upper("page"))
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "event_time",
        "page_upper",
        F.sum("duration_sec").over(w).alias("cumulative_duration_sec"),
        F.last("page", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_page"),
    )
)

with_windows_web_events = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("event_type").isin(["page_view", "search"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("row_seq"),
        F.sum("cumulative_duration_sec").over(w4).alias("cumulative_cumulative_duration_sec"),
        F.sum("cumulative_duration_sec").over(w5).alias("running_cumulative_duration_sec"),
        F.avg("cumulative_duration_sec").over(w6).alias("cumulative_duration_sec_avg_5_prior"),
        F.avg("cumulative_duration_sec").over(w7).alias("cumulative_duration_sec_avg_7d"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    with_windows_web_events
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "event_time",
        "cumulative_duration_sec",
        "last_known_page",
```

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        cost,
        status,
        CONCAT_WS('/', carrier, status) AS carrier_status_key,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'NONE') AS carrier_filled
    FROM shipments
    WHERE order_id = 7
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        shipped_date,
        status,
        carrier_status_key,
        AVG(cost) OVER w_grp AS running_avg_cost,
        MIN(cost) OVER w_grp AS running_min_cost,
        COUNT(cost) OVER w_grp AS running_count_cost,
        SUM(cost) OVER w_grp AS running_sum_cost
    FROM filtered
    WHERE status = 'IN_TRANSIT'
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY shipped_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM scored
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY running_min_cost DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM deduped
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id
    FROM shipments
    WHERE status = 'LOST'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        shipped_date,
        carrier_status_key,
        running_avg_cost,
        running_min_cost,
        running_count_cost,
        running_sum_cost,
        TRIM(status) AS clean_status
    FROM reconciled
    WHERE shipped_date > DATE '2023-04-24'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        running_avg_cost,
        running_count_cost,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY running_min_cost NULLS LAST) AS running_min_cost_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY running_sum_cost DESC NULLS LAST) AS running_sum_cost_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY running_min_cost DESC) AS running_min_cost_dense_rank_2,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', shipped_date) ORDER BY running_count_cost DESC NULLS FIRST) AS running_count_cost_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY running_count_cost DESC NULLS LAST) AS running_count_cost_rank_2
    FROM base
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY running_avg_cost DESC NULLS LAST) AS running_avg_cost_cume_dist,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY running_avg_cost NULLS LAST) AS running_avg_cost_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY running_count_cost_rank_2 DESC NULLS FIRST) AS running_count_cost_rank_2_rank
    FROM enriched
)
SELECT
    running_avg_cost,
    running_count_cost,
    running_sum_cost_rank,
    running_min_cost_dense_rank_2,
    running_count_cost_rank,
    running_count_cost_rank_2,
    running_avg_cost_cume_dist,
    running_avg_cost_rank,

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_min_cost").asc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_sum_cost").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_min_cost").desc())
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "shipped_date")).orderBy(F.col("running_count_cost").desc_nulls_first())
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_count_cost").desc_nulls_last())
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_avg_cost").desc_nulls_last())
w9 = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_avg_cost").asc_nulls_last())
w10 = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_count_cost_rank_2").desc_nulls_first())

filtered = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("order_id") == 7)
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.concat_ws("/", "carrier", "status").alias("carrier_status_key"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("NONE")).alias("carrier_filled"),

)

scored = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("status") == "IN_TRANSIT")
    .select(
        "id",
        "shipped_date",
        "status",
        "carrier_status_key",
        F.avg("cost").over(w_grp).alias("running_avg_cost"),
        F.min("cost").over(w_grp).alias("running_min_cost"),
        F.count("cost").over(w_grp).alias("running_count_cost"),
        F.sum("cost").over(w_grp).alias("running_sum_cost"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    scored
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .drop("rn")
)

matched_keys = (
    deduped
    .select("id")
    .intersect(

        .filter(F.col("status") == "LOST")

)

reconciled = (

    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    reconciled
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") > F.lit("2023-04-24").cast("date"))

        F.rank().over(w4).alias("running_sum_cost_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("running_min_cost_dense_rank_2"),
        F.rank().over(w6).alias("running_count_cost_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w7).alias("running_count_cost_rank_2"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.cume_dist().over(w8).alias("running_avg_cost_cume_dist"),
        F.rank().over(w9).alias("running_avg_cost_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w10).alias("running_count_cost_rank_2_rank"),
    )
)

result = (

        "running_sum_cost_rank",
        "running_min_cost_dense_rank_2",
        "running_count_cost_rank",
        "running_count_cost_rank_2",
```

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        brand,
        price,
        cost,
        stock_qty,
        launch_date,
        LENGTH(product_name) AS product_name_length
    FROM products
    WHERE launch_date > TO_DATE('2023-08-07')
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM filtered
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM products
    WHERE launch_date > '2024-01-01'
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_part AS cost_percent_rank
    FROM verified
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY cost DESC NULLS FIRST)
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT *, ROUND(price, 1) AS price_rounded
    FROM enriched
    WHERE brand IS DISTINCT FROM 'Acme'
),
enriched_products AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        product_name_length,
        price_rounded,
        MIN(cost_percent_rank) OVER w_part AS brand_min_cost_percent_rank,
        AVG(price_rounded) OVER w_hist AS brand_avg_price_rounded,
        SUM(price) OVER w_hist AS brand_sum_price
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE category IN ('Electronics', 'Home', 'Grocery')
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY brand), w_hist AS (PARTITION BY brand, category)
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        category,
        product_name_length,
        price_rounded,
        brand_avg_price_rounded,
        brand_sum_price,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_running AS brand_avg_price_rounded_cume_dist,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY brand_sum_price DESC NULLS LAST) AS brand_sum_price_percent_rank,
        RANK() OVER w_running AS brand_avg_price_rounded_rank,
        RANK() OVER w_recent AS brand_min_cost_percent_rank_rank
    FROM enriched_products
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY brand_avg_price_rounded DESC NULLS FIRST), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY brand_min_cost_percent_rank DESC)
)
SELECT
    id,
    category,
    price_rounded,
    brand_avg_price_rounded_cume_dist,
    brand_sum_price_percent_rank,
    brand_avg_price_rounded_rank,
    brand_min_cost_percent_rank_rank,
    CASE WHEN category RLIKE '^(Electronics|Grocery)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS category_zone
FROM with_windows
ORDER BY category DESC, brand_sum_price_percent_rank;

```python
w5 = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy(F.col("brand_sum_price").desc_nulls_last())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy(F.col("brand_min_cost_percent_rank").desc())

    df_products
    .filter(F.col("launch_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-08-07")))
    .select(
        "id",

verified = (

    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")

cleaned = (
    enriched
    .filter(~F.col("brand").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Acme")))

    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("category").isin(["Electronics", "Home", "Grocery"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "category",
        "product_name_length",
        "price_rounded",
        F.min("cost_percent_rank").over(w2).alias("brand_min_cost_percent_rank"),
        F.avg("price_rounded").over(w_hist).alias("brand_avg_price_rounded"),
        F.sum("price").over(w_hist).alias("brand_sum_price"),

with_windows = (
    enriched_products
    .select(
        "id",
        "category",
        "product_name_length",
        "price_rounded",
        "brand_avg_price_rounded",
        "brand_sum_price",
        F.cume_dist().over(w_running).alias("brand_avg_price_rounded_cume_dist"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w5).alias("brand_sum_price_percent_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w_running).alias("brand_avg_price_rounded_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w_recent).alias("brand_min_cost_percent_rank_rank"),
    )
)

result = (

    .select(

        "category",
        "price_rounded",
        "brand_avg_price_rounded_cume_dist",
        "brand_sum_price_percent_rank",
```

sql:
with filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        session_id,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        lower(page) as page_lower,
        coalesce(page, 'DIRECT') as page_clean
    from web_events
    where to_date(event_time) < '2023-11-01'
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when event_time - lag(event_time) over (partition by page order by event_time, id) > interval '7' day then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from filtered
),
sessions_web_events as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select
        id,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        page_lower,
        sum(is_new_session) over (partition by page order by event_time, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_id_2
    from with_gaps
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    case when session_id_2 >= 7 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end as session_id_2_tier,
    round(sum(duration_sec) / nullif(count(case when page = '/product' then 1 end), 0), 2) as duration_sec_per_product,
    sum(session_id_2) filter (where page = '/product') as product_total_session_id_2,
    approx_percentile(duration_sec, 0.5) as duration_sec_p50
from sessions_web_events
group by case when session_id_2 >= 7 then 'PREMIUM' else 'STANDARD' end
having duration_sec_p50 >= 0
order by duration_sec_p50 nulls last
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_web_events
    .filter(F.to_date("event_time") < "2023-11-01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        F.lower("page").alias("page_lower"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("page_clean"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("event_time") - F.lag("event_time").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_web_events = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        "page_lower",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2).alias("session_id_2"),
    )
)

result = (
    sessions_web_events
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("session_id_2") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("session_id_2_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("duration_sec") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("page") == "/product", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("duration_sec_per_product"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("page") == "/product", F.col("session_id_2"))).alias("product_total_session_id_2"),
        F.percentile_approx("duration_sec", 0.5).alias("duration_sec_p50"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("duration_sec_p50") >= 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("duration_sec_p50").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

sql:
WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        DATE_FORMAT(reading_ts, 'MMM yyyy') AS reading_ts_label
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE humidity IS NOT NULL
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN reading_ts - LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) > INTERVAL '45' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM valid
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM gaps
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(status_bits) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY is_new_burst, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_status_bits,
        MIN(status_bits) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY is_new_burst, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_status_bits,
        COUNT(status_bits) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY is_new_burst, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_status_bits,
        MAX(status_bits) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY is_new_burst, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_status_bits,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY status_bits, id) AS status_bits_bucket
    FROM islands
),
metrics_device_readings AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        reading_ts_label,
        is_new_burst,
        session_id,
        running_avg_status_bits,
        running_max_status_bits,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY running_count_status_bits DESC NULLS FIRST) AS running_count_status_bits_dense_rank,
        LAG(running_min_status_bits, 1) OVER (ORDER BY reading_ts, id) AS prev_running_min_status_bits
    FROM metrics
    WHERE device_code IN ('DV-02', 'DV-04')
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN pressure >= 1030 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS pressure_tier,
    session_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN device_code = 'DV-04' THEN 1 END) AS dv_04_count,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    GROUPING(CASE WHEN pressure >= 1030 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END) AS grouping_level
FROM metrics_device_readings
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN pressure >= 1030 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, session_id)
ORDER BY dv_04_count DESC
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("is_new_burst", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("status_bits", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("running_count_status_bits").desc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.orderBy("reading_ts", "id")

valid = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("humidity").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        F.date_format("reading_ts", "MMM yyyy").alias("reading_ts_label"),
    )
)

gaps = (
    valid
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 45 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = gaps.withColumn("session_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

metrics = (
    islands
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("status_bits").over(w3).alias("running_avg_status_bits"),
        F.min("status_bits").over(w3).alias("running_min_status_bits"),
        F.count("status_bits").over(w3).alias("running_count_status_bits"),
        F.max("status_bits").over(w3).alias("running_max_status_bits"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w4).alias("status_bits_bucket"),
    )
)

metrics_device_readings = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("device_code").isin(["DV-02", "DV-04"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "reading_ts_label",
        "is_new_burst",
        "session_id",
        "running_avg_status_bits",
        "running_max_status_bits",
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("running_count_status_bits_dense_rank"),
        F.lag("running_min_status_bits", 1).over(w6).alias("prev_running_min_status_bits"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics_device_readings
    .withColumn("pressure_tier", F.when(F.col("pressure") >= 1030, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .rollup("pressure_tier", "session_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-04", 1)).alias("dv_04_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.grouping("pressure_tier").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("dv_04_count").desc())
)
```

sql:
WITH unpacked AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        coupon_codes,
        attributes['device'] AS device,
        SIZE(items) AS num_items,
        SIZE(attributes) AS num_attributes
    FROM carts
    WHERE SIZE(coupon_codes) >= 2
)
SELECT
    id,
    coupon_codes,
    device,
    num_items,
    num_attributes,
    STDDEV_SAMP(num_attributes) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS customer_id_stddev_samp_num_attributes,
    LEAD(num_items, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY num_items, id) AS next_num_items,
    AVG(num_attributes) OVER (ORDER BY num_attributes, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS num_attributes_avg_5,
    SUM(num_attributes) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY num_attributes, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_num_attributes
FROM unpacked;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("num_items", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("num_attributes", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("num_attributes", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

unpacked = (
    df_carts
    .filter(F.size("coupon_codes") >= 2)
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.col("attributes")["device"].alias("device"),
        F.size("items").alias("num_items"),
        F.size("attributes").alias("num_attributes"),
    )
)

result = (
    unpacked
    .select(
        "id",
        "coupon_codes",
        "device",
        "num_items",
        "num_attributes",
        F.stddev_samp("num_attributes").over(w).alias("customer_id_stddev_samp_num_attributes"),
        F.lead("num_items", 1).over(w2).alias("next_num_items"),
        F.avg("num_attributes").over(w3).alias("num_attributes_avg_5"),
        F.sum("num_attributes").over(w4).alias("running_num_attributes"),
    )
)
```

WITH metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        FIRST_VALUE(pressure, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY pressure, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_pressure,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY temp_c DESC NULLS LAST) AS temp_c_cume_dist
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts < '2023-05-07'
)
SELECT
    id,
    device_code,
    temp_c_cume_dist
FROM metrics
ORDER BY temp_c_cume_dist NULLS LAST

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("pressure", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("temp_c").desc_nulls_last())

metrics = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") < "2023-05-07")
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        F.first("pressure", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("first_known_pressure"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("temp_c_cume_dist"),
    )
)

    metrics
    .select("id", "device_code", "temp_c_cume_dist")
    .orderBy(F.col("temp_c_cume_dist").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        hire_date,
        TRIM(job_title) AS clean_job_title
    FROM employees
    WHERE salary > 60000
),
ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY hire_date DESC) AS dedup_rank
        FROM filtered
    ) ranked
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        clean_job_title,
        dedup_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY hire_date ASC NULLS FIRST, id ASC) AS row_num
        FROM ranked
    ) t
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.dept_id,
        s.job_title,
        s.clean_job_title,
        p.location
    FROM latest s
    INNER JOIN departments p
        ON s.dept_id = p.id
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(job_title) AS job_title_length,
        COALESCE(job_title, 'N/A') AS job_title_clean
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE dept_id = 6
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_id,
        clean_job_title,
        job_title_clean,
        FIRST_VALUE(location, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY job_title_length ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_location,
        MIN(job_title_length) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_id) AS dept_id_min_job_title_length
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE job_title_length >= 47
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN dept_id_min_job_title_length >= 63 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS dept_id_min_job_title_length_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(dept_id_min_job_title_length), 2) AS avg_dept_id_min_job_title_length,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(dept_id_min_job_title_length, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS dept_id_min_job_title_length_quartiles
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY CASE WHEN dept_id_min_job_title_length >= 63 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy(F.col("hire_date").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy(F.col("hire_date").asc_nulls_first(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("job_title_length", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("dept_id")

filtered = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("salary") > 60000)
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "dept_id",
        "job_title",
        "hire_date",
        F.trim("job_title").alias("clean_job_title"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

latest = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select("id", "dept_id", "job_title", "clean_job_title", "dedup_rank")
)

with_dims = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_departments.alias("p"), F.col("s.dept_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.dept_id",
        "s.job_title",
        "s.clean_job_title",
        F.col("p.location"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    with_dims
    .filter(F.col("dept_id") == 6)
    .withColumn("job_title_length", F.length("job_title"))
    .withColumn("job_title_clean", F.coalesce("job_title", F.lit("N/A")))
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("job_title_length") >= 47)
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_id",
        "clean_job_title",
        "job_title_clean",
        F.first("location", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("first_known_location"),
        F.min("job_title_length").over(w4).alias("dept_id_min_job_title_length"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("dept_id_min_job_title_length") >= 63, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("dept_id_min_job_title_length_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("dept_id_min_job_title_length"), 2).alias("avg_dept_id_min_job_title_length"),
        F.percentile_approx("dept_id_min_job_title_length", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("dept_id_min_job_title_length_quartiles"),
    )
)
```

sql:
WITH remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT order_id, id
    FROM payments
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT order_id, id
    FROM payments
    WHERE HOUR(paid_at) BETWEEN 11 AND 16
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM payments s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.order_id = k.order_id AND s.id = k.id
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT src.*, d.shipping_fee
    FROM reconciled src
    JOIN orders d
        ON src.order_id <=> d.id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY shipping_fee DESC NULLS FIRST) shipping_fee_rank,
        SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY CAST(paid_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 2592000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) amount_sum_30d,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY amount DESC) amount_percent_rank,
        STDDEV_SAMP(shipping_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY method, order_id) method_stddev_samp_shipping_fee
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE method IN ('card', 'bank_transfer')
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, shipping_fee_rank / NULLIF(amount_percent_rank, 0) shipping_fee_rank_per_amount_percent_rank
    FROM enriched
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
),
cleaned_payments AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, shipping_fee_rank_per_amount_percent_rank - shipping_fee_rank shipping_fee_rank_per_amount_percent_rank_minus_shipping_fee_rank
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    order_id,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(amount_percent_rank, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS amount_percent_rank_quartiles,
    MIN(shipping_fee_rank) AS min_shipping_fee_rank,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(shipping_fee_rank, 0.5) AS shipping_fee_rank_p50,
    MIN(amount_sum_30d) AS min_amount_sum_30d
FROM cleaned_payments
GROUP BY order_id
HAVING MIN(shipping_fee_rank) > 0;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("paid_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-2592000, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("method", "order_id")

remaining_keys = (
    df_payments
    .select("order_id", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_payments
        .filter(F.hour("paid_at").between(11, 16))
        .select("order_id", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    df_payments
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_dims = (
    reconciled
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("src.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("d.id")), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("d.shipping_fee"))
)

enriched = (
    with_dims
    .filter(F.col("method").isin(["card", "bank_transfer"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        F.rank().over(w).alias("shipping_fee_rank"),
        F.sum("amount").over(w2).alias("amount_sum_30d"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("amount_percent_rank"),
        F.stddev_samp("shipping_fee").over(w4).alias("method_stddev_samp_shipping_fee"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("shipping_fee_rank_per_amount_percent_rank", (F.col("shipping_fee_rank") / F.nullif("amount_percent_rank", F.lit(0))))
)

cleaned_payments = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("shipping_fee_rank_per_amount_percent_rank_minus_shipping_fee_rank", (F.col("shipping_fee_rank_per_amount_percent_rank") - F.col("shipping_fee_rank")))
)

result = (
    cleaned_payments
    .groupBy("order_id")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("amount_percent_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("amount_percent_rank_quartiles"),
        F.min("shipping_fee_rank").alias("min_shipping_fee_rank"),
        F.percentile_approx("shipping_fee_rank", 0.5).alias("shipping_fee_rank_p50"),
        F.min("amount_sum_30d").alias("min_amount_sum_30d"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("min_shipping_fee_rank") > 0)
```

sql:
WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        currency,
        EXPLODE(tier_limits) AS tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, LOWER(currency) AS currency_lower
    FROM lines
    WHERE currency = 'USD'
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        tier_value,
        currency_lower,
        COUNT(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_count_tier_value,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_cume_dist,
        MIN(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_min_tier_value,
        AVG(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_avg_tier_value,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_rank
    FROM filtered
),
filtered_price_tiers AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        currency_lower,
        currency_count_tier_value,
        currency_min_tier_value,
        currency_avg_tier_value,
        tier_value_rank,
        LEAST(currency_count_tier_value, currency_min_tier_value) AS least_currency_count_tier_value_currency_min_tier_value
    FROM scored
    WHERE currency_min_tier_value BETWEEN 26 AND 71
),
scored_price_tiers AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        currency_count_tier_value,
        least_currency_count_tier_value_currency_min_tier_value,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY currency_avg_tier_value DESC NULLS LAST) AS currency_avg_tier_value_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY currency_min_tier_value DESC NULLS FIRST) AS currency_min_tier_value_cume_dist
    FROM filtered_price_tiers
)
SELECT currency_min_tier_value_cume_dist
FROM scored_price_tiers
ORDER BY currency_min_tier_value_cume_dist NULLS FIRST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").asc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("currency_avg_tier_value").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("currency_min_tier_value").desc_nulls_first())

lines = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "currency", F.explode("tier_limits").alias("tier_value"))
)

filtered = (
    lines
    .filter(F.col("currency") == "USD")
    .withColumn("currency_lower", F.lower("currency"))
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "tier_value",
        "currency_lower",
        F.count("tier_value").over(w).alias("currency_count_tier_value"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("tier_value_cume_dist"),
        F.min("tier_value").over(w).alias("currency_min_tier_value"),
        F.avg("tier_value").over(w).alias("currency_avg_tier_value"),
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("tier_value_rank"),
    )
)

filtered_price_tiers = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("currency_min_tier_value").between(26, 71))
    .select(
        "currency_lower",
        "currency_count_tier_value",
        "currency_min_tier_value",
        "currency_avg_tier_value",
        "tier_value_rank",
        F.least("currency_count_tier_value", "currency_min_tier_value").alias("least_currency_count_tier_value_currency_min_tier_value"),
    )
)

scored_price_tiers = (
    filtered_price_tiers
    .select(
        "currency_count_tier_value",
        "least_currency_count_tier_value_currency_min_tier_value",
        F.rank().over(w4).alias("currency_avg_tier_value_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w5).alias("currency_min_tier_value_cume_dist"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_price_tiers
    .select("currency_min_tier_value_cume_dist")
    .orderBy(F.col("currency_min_tier_value_cume_dist").asc_nulls_first())
)
```
