```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("months_since_start_date").asc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("months_since_start_date", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("months_since_start_date", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("end_date"), "customer_id").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").asc_nulls_first())
w7 = Window.orderBy("monthly_fee_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("monthly_fee", "id")
w_running = Window.orderBy("monthly_fee_avg_5", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("end_date") >= F.lit("2023-06-04").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "start_date") / 30).alias("months_since_start_date"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

valid = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("end_date") > F.lit("2023-09-19").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "months_since_start_date",
        F.ceil("monthly_fee").alias("monthly_fee_whole"),
    )
)

deduped_subscriptions = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    deduped_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id") == 2)
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "monthly_fee",
        "months_since_start_date",
        "rank_in_group",
        F.lag("monthly_fee_whole", 1).over(w3).alias("prev_monthly_fee_whole"),
        F.avg("monthly_fee").over(w4).alias("monthly_fee_avg_5"),
        F.max("monthly_fee_whole").over(w5).alias("customer_id_max_monthly_fee_whole"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w6).alias("monthly_fee_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w7).alias("cumulative_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "prev_monthly_fee_whole",
        "monthly_fee_avg_5",
        "monthly_fee_dense_rank",
        F.lead("customer_id_max_monthly_fee_whole").over(w_ordered).alias("next_customer_id_max_monthly_fee_whole"),
        F.lead("monthly_fee_avg_5").over(w_ordered).alias("next_monthly_fee_avg_5"),
        F.row_number().over(w_ordered).alias("event_seq"),
        F.last("monthly_fee_dense_rank", ignorenulls=True).over(w_running).alias("last_known_monthly_fee_dense_rank"),
    )
)

joined = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("d.segment"), F.col("d.signup_date"))
)

result = (
    joined
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("last_known_monthly_fee_dense_rank") >= 7, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("last_known_monthly_fee_dense_rank_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("WEEK", "signup_date").alias("week_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Consumer", 1)).alias("consumer_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("segment")).alias("segment_list"),
        F.percentile_approx("last_known_monthly_fee_dense_rank", 0.5).alias("last_known_monthly_fee_dense_rank_p50"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("location")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("latest_rank", "id")

filtered = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("location").isin(["New York", "Chiang Mai", "London"]))

    latest
    .withColumn("location_min_budget", F.min("budget").over(w2))
```

sql:
with flattened as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        created_at,
        value
    from carts
    lateral view outer explode(coupon_codes) x as value
),
cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        initcap(trim(value)) as value_title,
        coalesce(value, 'Unknown') as value_filled
    from flattened
    where value is not null
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select id
    from cleaned
    intersect
    select id
    from carts
    where array_contains(coupon_codes, 'SPRING10')
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from cleaned s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.id = k.id
),
base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, date_format(created_at, 'yyyy-MM-dd') as created_at_label
    from kept_rows
    where created_at >= to_timestamp('2025-03-01 14:00:00')
),
daily as (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    select
        value,
        count(distinct value) as distinct_values,
        size(collect_set(value)) as num_values,
        count(*) as cnt
    from base
    group by 1
)
select
    value,
    num_values,
    cnt
from daily
order by cnt nulls first;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

flattened = df_carts.select("id", "created_at", F.explode_outer("coupon_codes").alias("value"))

cleaned = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("value").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.initcap(F.trim("value")).alias("value_title"),
        F.coalesce("value", F.lit("Unknown")).alias("value_filled"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    cleaned
    .select("id")
    .intersect(
        df_carts
        .filter(F.array_contains("coupon_codes", "SPRING10"))
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("created_at") >= F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2025-03-01 14:00:00")))
    .withColumn("created_at_label", F.date_format("created_at", "yyyy-MM-dd"))
)

daily = (
    base
    .groupBy("value")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("value").alias("distinct_values"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("value")).alias("num_values"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select("value", "num_values", "cnt")
    .orderBy(F.col("cnt").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

sql:
with filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        substring(full_name, 1, 3) as full_name_prefix,
        initcap(trim(job_title)) as job_title_title
    from employees
    where manager_id is not null
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        manager_id,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        job_title_title,
        lead(salary) over (partition by dept_id order by salary, id) as next_salary,
        lag(salary) over (partition by dept_id order by salary, id) as prev_salary,
        row_number() over (partition by dept_id order by salary, id) as event_seq,
        sum(salary) over (partition by level order by salary, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_salary
    from filtered
),
base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, upper(email) as email_upper
    from with_windows
    where hire_date >= date '2023-05-16'
),
deduped as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *, row_number() over (partition by manager_id order by running_salary desc, id) as rn
    from base
    qualify rn = 1
),
ranked as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select
        id,
        full_name,
        is_remote,
        prev_salary,
        event_seq,
        running_salary,
        email_upper,
        rn
    from deduped
    qualify row_number() over (partition by manager_id order by next_salary desc nulls last, id) = 1
),
with_windows_employees as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        full_name,
        prev_salary,
        event_seq,
        running_salary,
        email_upper,
        ntile(5) over w_grp as running_salary_bucket,
        percent_rank() over (order by running_salary desc nulls first) as running_salary_percent_rank,
        last_value(running_salary) ignore nulls over (order by event_seq, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_running_salary
    from ranked
    window w_grp as (order by running_salary desc, id)
)
-- Running and moving aggregates
select
    id,
    prev_salary,
    event_seq,
    running_salary,
    email_upper,
    running_salary_bucket,
    last_known_running_salary,
    max(event_seq) over (order by running_salary_bucket, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_max_event_seq,
    count(event_seq) over (order by running_salary_bucket, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_count_event_seq,
    avg(event_seq) over (order by running_salary_bucket, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_avg_event_seq,
    sum(event_seq) over (order by running_salary_bucket, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_sum_event_seq,
    avg(event_seq) over (order by running_salary_percent_rank, id rows between 5 preceding and 1 preceding) as event_seq_avg_5_prior
from with_windows_employees
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_id").orderBy("salary", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("salary", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy(F.col("running_salary").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("manager_id").orderBy(F.col("next_salary").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w_grp = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_salary").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_salary").desc_nulls_first())
w7 = Window.orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.orderBy("running_salary_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.orderBy("running_salary_percent_rank", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)

filtered = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.col("manager_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.substring("full_name", 1, 3).alias("full_name_prefix"),
        F.initcap(F.trim("job_title")).alias("job_title_title"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "email",
        "manager_id",
        "salary",
        "hire_date",
        "is_remote",
        "job_title_title",
        F.lead("salary").over(w).alias("next_salary"),
        F.lag("salary").over(w).alias("prev_salary"),
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("event_seq"),
        F.sum("salary").over(w2).alias("running_salary"),
    )
)

base = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("hire_date") >= F.lit("2023-05-16").cast("date"))
    .select("*", F.upper("email").alias("email_upper"))
)

deduped = (
    base
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

ranked = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "is_remote",
        "prev_salary",
        "event_seq",
        "running_salary",
        "email_upper",
        "rn",
    )
)

with_windows_employees = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "prev_salary",
        "event_seq",
        "running_salary",
        "email_upper",
        F.ntile(5).over(w_grp).alias("running_salary_bucket"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w6).alias("running_salary_percent_rank"),
        F.last("running_salary", ignorenulls=True).over(w7).alias("last_known_running_salary"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows_employees
    .select(
        "id",
        "prev_salary",
        "event_seq",
        "running_salary",
        "email_upper",
        "running_salary_bucket",
        "last_known_running_salary",
        F.max("event_seq").over(w8).alias("running_max_event_seq"),
        F.count("event_seq").over(w8).alias("running_count_event_seq"),
        F.avg("event_seq").over(w8).alias("running_avg_event_seq"),
        F.sum("event_seq").over(w8).alias("running_sum_event_seq"),
        F.avg("event_seq").over(w9).alias("event_seq_avg_5_prior"),
    )
)
```

sql:
with remaining_keys as (
    select device_code, id
    from device_readings
    intersect
    select device_code, id
    from device_readings
    where pressure < 1028
),
verified as (
    select s.*
    from device_readings s
    join remaining_keys k on s.device_code = k.device_code and s.id = k.id
)
select
    case when pressure >= 1028 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as pressure_tier,
    date_trunc('hour', reading_ts) as hour_window,
    approx_percentile(pressure, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as pressure_quartiles,
    (unix_timestamp(max(reading_ts)) - unix_timestamp(min(reading_ts))) / 60 as duration_min,
    count(case when device_code = 'DV-04' then 1 end) as dv_04_count,
    (unix_timestamp(max(reading_ts)) - unix_timestamp(min(reading_ts))) / 60 as duration_min_2,
    grouping(case when pressure >= 1028 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end) as grouping_level
from verified
group by rollup (case when pressure >= 1028 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end, date_trunc('hour', reading_ts))
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

remaining_keys = (
    df_device_readings
    .select("device_code", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("pressure") < 1028)
        .select("device_code", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    df_device_readings
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.device_code") == F.col("k.device_code")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .withColumn("pressure_tier", F.when(F.col("pressure") >= 1028, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .withColumn("hour_window", F.date_trunc("hour", "reading_ts"))
    .rollup("pressure_tier", "hour_window")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("pressure", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("pressure_quartiles"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("reading_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("reading_ts"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-04", 1)).alias("dv_04_count"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("reading_ts")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("reading_ts"))) / 60).alias("duration_min_2"),
        F.grouping("pressure_tier").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
)
```

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *, COALESCE(method, 'Unknown') AS method_filled
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-06-03 19:00:00'
      AND order_id IN (2, 8, 12, 36)
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN paid_at - LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) > INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM base
),
islands AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        paid_at,
        status,
        method_filled,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM gaps
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN session_id >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS session_id_tier,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'REFUNDED') AS refunded_events,
    MAX(session_id) FILTER (WHERE method = 'paypal') AS paypal_max_session_id,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(session_id, 0.95) AS session_id_p95,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(session_id, 0.95) AS session_id_p95_2,
    GROUPING(CASE WHEN session_id >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END) AS grouping_level
FROM islands
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN session_id >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END)
HAVING COUNT_IF(status = 'REFUNDED') < 1000
ORDER BY session_id_tier DESC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter((F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2023-06-03 19:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & F.col("order_id").isin([2, 8, 12, 36]))
    .select("*", F.coalesce("method", F.lit("Unknown")).alias("method_filled"))
)

gaps = (
    base
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("paid_at") - F.lag("paid_at").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "method_filled",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    islands
    .withColumn("session_id_tier", F.when(F.col("session_id") >= 7, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .rollup("session_id_tier")
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("status") == "REFUNDED").alias("refunded_events"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("method") == "paypal", F.col("session_id"))).alias("paypal_max_session_id"),
        F.percentile_approx("session_id", 0.95).alias("session_id_p95"),
        F.percentile_approx("session_id", 0.95).alias("session_id_p95_2"),
        F.grouping("session_id_tier").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("refunded_events") < 1000)
    .orderBy(F.col("session_id_tier").desc())
)
```

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        currency,
        tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(discounts) e AS tier_value
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN currency = 'USD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_usd
    FROM exploded
    WHERE tier_value > 62
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY is_usd NULLS LAST) AS is_usd_cume_dist,
        MAX(is_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_max_is_usd,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY is_usd DESC NULLS LAST) AS is_usd_cume_dist_2,
        SUM(is_usd) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_sum_is_usd,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY is_usd) AS is_usd_cume_dist_3
    FROM valid
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        is_usd,
        currency_max_is_usd,
        is_usd_cume_dist_2,
        SUM(is_usd_cume_dist_3) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_sum_is_usd_cume_dist_3,
        STDDEV_SAMP(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_stddev_samp_tier_value,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY is_usd_cume_dist_3 NULLS LAST) AS is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank,
        STDDEV_SAMP(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY currency) AS currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_2
    FROM scored
    WHERE currency_sum_is_usd >= 260
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, ROUND(currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_2, 0) AS currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_2_rounded
    FROM enriched
    WHERE is_usd_cume_dist_2 >= 0.71
),
grouped AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank_tier,
        CASE WHEN is_usd >= 81 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS is_usd_tier,
        ROUND(AVG(is_usd), 2) AS avg_is_usd,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(currency_max_is_usd, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS currency_max_is_usd_quartiles,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(currency_stddev_samp_tier_value, 0.9) AS currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_p90,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END ORDER BY PERCENTILE_APPROX(currency_stddev_samp_tier_value, 0.9) DESC) AS currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_p90_percent_rank
    FROM base
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank >= 7 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN is_usd >= 81 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
    HAVING avg_is_usd >= 0
)
SELECT
    is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank_tier,
    is_usd_tier,
    currency_max_is_usd_quartiles,
    currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_p90
FROM grouped
ORDER BY is_usd_tier DESC NULLS FIRST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("is_usd").asc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("is_usd").desc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy("is_usd")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("is_usd_cume_dist_3").asc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank_tier").orderBy(F.col("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_p90").desc())

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "currency", F.explode_outer("discounts").alias("tier_value"))
)

valid = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("tier_value") > 62)
    .select("*", F.when(F.col("currency") == "USD", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_usd"))
)

scored = (
    valid
    .withColumn("is_usd_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w))
    .withColumn("currency_max_is_usd", F.max("is_usd").over(w2))
    .withColumn("is_usd_cume_dist_2", F.cume_dist().over(w3))
    .withColumn("currency_sum_is_usd", F.sum("is_usd").over(w2))
    .withColumn("is_usd_cume_dist_3", F.cume_dist().over(w4))
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("currency_sum_is_usd") >= 260)
    .select(
        "is_usd",
        "currency_max_is_usd",
        "is_usd_cume_dist_2",
        F.sum("is_usd_cume_dist_3").over(w2).alias("currency_sum_is_usd_cume_dist_3"),
        F.stddev_samp("tier_value").over(w2).alias("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value"),
        F.rank().over(w5).alias("is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank"),
        F.stddev_samp("tier_value").over(w2).alias("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_2"),
    )
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("is_usd_cume_dist_2") >= 0.71)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_2", 0).alias("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_2_rounded"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank") >= 7, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("is_usd") >= 81, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("is_usd_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("is_usd"), 2).alias("avg_is_usd"),
        F.percentile_approx("currency_max_is_usd", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("currency_max_is_usd_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value", 0.9).alias("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_p90"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("avg_is_usd") >= 0)
    .withColumn("currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_p90_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w6))
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "is_usd_cume_dist_3_rank_tier",
        "is_usd_tier",
        "currency_max_is_usd_quartiles",
        "currency_stddev_samp_tier_value_p90",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("is_usd_tier").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

WITH matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT product_id, id
    FROM order_items
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT product_id, id
    FROM order_items
    WHERE unit_price <= 340
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM order_items s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.product_id = k.product_id AND s.id = k.id
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id) AS product_id_count_unit_price,
        CORR(unit_price, quantity) OVER w_grp AS corr_unit_price_quantity,
        CORR(quantity, unit_price) OVER w_hist AS corr_quantity_unit_price,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY unit_price DESC NULLS LAST) AS unit_price_cume_dist,
        ROUND(quantity / SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id), 4) AS quantity_share
    FROM reconciled
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY order_id), w_hist AS (PARTITION BY order_id, product_id)
),
scored_order_items AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        unit_price,
        product_id_count_unit_price,
        corr_quantity_unit_price,
        unit_price_cume_dist,
        quantity_share,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY quantity DESC) AS quantity_rank,
        MAX(quantity_share) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, order_id) AS product_id_max_quantity_share
    FROM scored
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        product_id_count_unit_price,
        corr_quantity_unit_price,
        quantity_rank,
        product_id_max_quantity_share,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_running AS unit_price_cume_dist_2,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_running_2 AS quantity_share_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_recent AS unit_price_cume_dist_percent_rank
    FROM scored_order_items
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY unit_price DESC), w_running_2 AS (ORDER BY quantity_share DESC), w_recent AS (ORDER BY unit_price_cume_dist DESC)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        quantity_rank / NULLIF(corr_quantity_unit_price, 0) AS quantity_rank_per_corr_quantity_unit_price,
        CAST(unit_price_cume_dist_2 AS INT) AS unit_price_cume_dist_2_int
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE product_id_max_quantity_share <= 0
),
metrics AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY quantity_rank NULLS FIRST) AS quantity_rank_percent_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY unit_price_cume_dist_2_int NULLS FIRST) AS unit_price_cume_dist_2_int_cume_dist,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_running AS unit_price_cume_dist_2_percent_rank
    FROM cleaned
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY unit_price_cume_dist_2)
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN unit_price_cume_dist_2_int_cume_dist >= 0.62 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS unit_price_cume_dist_2_int_cume_dist_tier,
    CASE WHEN quantity_rank_percent_rank >= 0.62 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS quantity_rank_percent_rank_tier,
    CASE WHEN product_id_max_quantity_share >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS product_id_max_quantity_share_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(unit_price_cume_dist_2, 0.5) AS unit_price_cume_dist_2_p50,
    ROUND(AVG(quantity_share_percent_rank), 2) AS avg_quantity_share_percent_rank,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(quantity_rank, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS quantity_rank_quartiles,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows_2
FROM metrics
GROUP BY CASE WHEN unit_price_cume_dist_2_int_cume_dist >= 0.62 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, CASE WHEN quantity_rank_percent_rank >= 0.62 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, CASE WHEN product_id_max_quantity_share >= 1 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "order_id")
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc())
w_running_2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("quantity_share").desc())
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("unit_price_cume_dist").desc())
w10 = Window.orderBy(F.col("quantity_rank").asc_nulls_first())
w11 = Window.orderBy(F.col("unit_price_cume_dist_2_int").asc_nulls_first())
w12 = Window.orderBy("unit_price_cume_dist_2")

matched_keys = (
    df_order_items
    .select("product_id", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_order_items
        .filter(F.col("unit_price") <= 340)
        .select("product_id", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    df_order_items
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

scored = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count("unit_price").over(w).alias("product_id_count_unit_price"),
        F.corr("unit_price", "quantity").over(w_grp).alias("corr_unit_price_quantity"),
        F.corr("quantity", "unit_price").over(w_hist).alias("corr_quantity_unit_price"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w4).alias("unit_price_cume_dist"),
        F.round((F.col("quantity") / F.sum("quantity").over(w)), 4).alias("quantity_share"),
    )
)

scored_order_items = (
    scored
    .select(
        "unit_price",
        "product_id_count_unit_price",
        "corr_quantity_unit_price",
        "unit_price_cume_dist",
        "quantity_share",
        F.rank().over(w5).alias("quantity_rank"),
        F.max("quantity_share").over(w6).alias("product_id_max_quantity_share"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored_order_items
    .select(
        "product_id_count_unit_price",
        "corr_quantity_unit_price",
        "quantity_rank",
        "product_id_max_quantity_share",
        F.cume_dist().over(w_running).alias("unit_price_cume_dist_2"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_running_2).alias("quantity_share_percent_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w_recent).alias("unit_price_cume_dist_percent_rank"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("product_id_max_quantity_share") <= 0)
    .withColumn("quantity_rank_per_corr_quantity_unit_price", (F.col("quantity_rank") / F.nullif("corr_quantity_unit_price", F.lit(0))))
    .withColumn("unit_price_cume_dist_2_int", F.col("unit_price_cume_dist_2").cast("int"))
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("quantity_rank_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w10))
    .withColumn("unit_price_cume_dist_2_int_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w11))
    .withColumn("unit_price_cume_dist_2_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w12))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("unit_price_cume_dist_2_int_cume_dist") >= 0.62, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("unit_price_cume_dist_2_int_cume_dist_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("quantity_rank_percent_rank") >= 0.62, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("quantity_rank_percent_rank_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("product_id_max_quantity_share") >= 1, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("product_id_max_quantity_share_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("unit_price_cume_dist_2", 0.5).alias("unit_price_cume_dist_2_p50"),
        F.round(F.avg("quantity_share_percent_rank"), 2).alias("avg_quantity_share_percent_rank"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.percentile_approx("quantity_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("quantity_rank_quartiles"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows_2"),
    )
)
```

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        INITCAP(TRIM(country)) AS country_title,
        COALESCE(country, 'OTHER') AS resolved_country
    FROM sessions
    WHERE started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-08-14 09:00:00'
      AND country IS NOT NULL
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN started_at - LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at, id) > INTERVAL 14 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM base
),
islands AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
)
SELECT
    browser,
    MAX(started_at) AS last_started_at,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN country = 'TH' THEN 1 END) AS th_count,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(country)) AS country_list,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(session_no, 0.95) AS session_no_p95,
    SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'UK' THEN session_start_flag ELSE 0 END) AS uk_session_start_flag
FROM islands
GROUP BY browser
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN country = 'TH' THEN 1 END) > 1
ORDER BY th_count DESC NULLS FIRST;

```python
        "started_at",
```

sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN city IN ('Chiang Mai', 'New York') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END AS city_group
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IS DISTINCT FROM 'Tokyo'
      AND supplier_name LIKE '%Wholesale%'
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        city_group,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS LAST) AS rating_cume_dist,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY city, country ORDER BY rating DESC NULLS FIRST) AS rating_cume_dist_2,
        AVG(rating) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rating_avg_3
    FROM base
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        country,
        city,
        rating_cume_dist_2,
        rating_avg_3
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating_cume_dist DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM scored
    ) x
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT city
    FROM ranked
    EXCEPT
    SELECT city
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE city IN ('Singapore', 'New York', 'Bangkok')
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.city = k.city
)
SELECT
    country,
    MAX(rating_avg_3) FILTER (WHERE country = 'JP') AS jp_max_rating_avg_3,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(rating_avg_3, 0.5) AS rating_avg_3_p50,
    ROUND(AVG(rating_avg_3), 2) AS avg_rating_avg_3,
    COUNT_IF(country = 'JP') AS jp_events,
    ROUND(SUM(rating_avg_3) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'Tokyo' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS rating_avg_3_per_tokyo,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Berlin') AS berlin_rows
FROM kept_rows
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY country NULLS FIRST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("city", "country").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("rating_cume_dist").desc_nulls_last(), "id")

base = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter((~F.col("city").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Tokyo"))) & F.col("supplier_name").like("%Wholesale%"))
    .withColumn("city_group", F.when(F.col("city").isin(["Chiang Mai", "New York"]), "Tier 1").otherwise("Other"))
)

scored = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "country",
        "city",
        "rating",
        "city_group",
        F.cume_dist().over(w).alias("rating_cume_dist"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("rating_cume_dist_2"),
        F.avg("rating").over(w3).alias("rating_avg_3"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    scored
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "country", "city", "rating_cume_dist_2", "rating_avg_3")
)

remaining_keys = (
    ranked
    .select("city")
    .subtract(
        df_suppliers
        .filter(F.col("city").isin(["Singapore", "New York", "Bangkok"]))
        .select("city")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy("country")
    .agg(
        F.max(F.when(F.col("country") == "JP", F.col("rating_avg_3"))).alias("jp_max_rating_avg_3"),
        F.percentile_approx("rating_avg_3", 0.5).alias("rating_avg_3_p50"),
        F.round(F.avg("rating_avg_3"), 2).alias("avg_rating_avg_3"),
        F.count_if(F.col("country") == "JP").alias("jp_events"),
        F.round(F.sum("rating_avg_3") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Tokyo", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("rating_avg_3_per_tokyo"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "Berlin", 1)).alias("berlin_rows"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("country").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

sql:
WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        key,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) e AS key, attr_value
),
unpacked AS (
    -- Higher-order array functions
    SELECT
        service,
        log_ts,
        key,
        attr_value,
        CAST((status_code & 1) != 0 AS INT) AS is_flagged,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high
    FROM flattened
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        service,
        log_ts,
        key,
        is_flagged,
        status_code_high,
        COALESCE(key, 'unassigned') AS key_filled,
        COALESCE(key, 'NONE') AS key_clean
    FROM unpacked
    WHERE service <> 'checkout'
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN status_code_high >= 2 THEN 'High' WHEN status_code_high >= 1 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS status_code_high_tier
    FROM base
    WHERE log_ts >= TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-06-01 15:00:00')
      AND key IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', log_ts), key ORDER BY is_flagged DESC NULLS FIRST) AS is_flagged_cume_dist,
        AVG(is_flagged) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS is_flagged_avg_15m
    FROM filtered
),
with_windows_app_logs AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(log_ts), service ORDER BY is_flagged DESC) AS is_flagged_cume_dist_2,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY is_flagged ASC) AS is_flagged_rank,
        AVG(status_code_high) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) ASC RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_high_avg_30m
    FROM with_windows
)
SELECT
    key,
    is_flagged,
    key_filled,
    is_flagged_cume_dist,
    is_flagged_cume_dist_2,
    is_flagged_rank,
    status_code_high_avg_30m,
    CASE WHEN key RLIKE '^(trace|region)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS key_zone
FROM with_windows_app_logs;
reference:

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "log_ts"), "key").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("log_ts"), "service").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy("is_flagged")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("key").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

unpacked = (
    flattened
    .select(
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "key",
        "attr_value",
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(1) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

base = (
    unpacked
    .filter(F.col("service") != "checkout")
    .select(
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "key",
        "is_flagged",
        "status_code_high",
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("unassigned")).alias("key_filled"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("NONE")).alias("key_clean"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter((F.col("log_ts") >= F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2025-06-01 15:00:00"))) & F.col("key").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("status_code_high_tier", F.when(F.col("status_code_high") >= 2, "High").when(F.col("status_code_high") >= 1, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("is_flagged_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_avg_15m", F.avg("is_flagged").over(w2))
)

with_windows_app_logs = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("is_flagged_cume_dist_2", F.cume_dist().over(w3))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_rank", F.rank().over(w4))
    .withColumn("status_code_high_avg_30m", F.avg("status_code_high").over(w5))
)

result = (
    with_windows_app_logs
    .select(
        "key",
        "is_flagged",
        "key_filled",
        "is_flagged_cume_dist",
        "is_flagged_cume_dist_2",
        "is_flagged_rank",
        "status_code_high_avg_30m",
        F.when(F.col("key").rlike("^(trace|region)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("key_zone"),
    )
)
```

WITH with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_id ORDER BY stock_qty ASC, id ASC) AS stock_qty_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', launch_date), category ORDER BY price DESC, id ASC) AS seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY stock_qty DESC, id ASC) AS event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY launch_date ASC, id ASC) AS event_seq_2
    FROM products
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM with_windows
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id
    FROM products
    WHERE stock_qty BETWEEN 271 AND 326
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.product_name,
        a.category,
        a.cost,
        a.stock_qty,
        a.launch_date,
        a.tags,
        a.supplier_id,
        a.seq_no,
        s.city,
        s.country
    FROM verified a
    INNER JOIN suppliers s
        ON a.supplier_id = s.id
),
with_dims AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.supplier_name,
        b.country AS supplier_country,
        b.rating
    FROM enriched src
    LEFT JOIN suppliers b
        ON src.supplier_id <=> b.id
),
enriched_products AS (
    SELECT src.*, d.supplier_name AS supplier_supplier_name
    FROM with_dims src
    LEFT JOIN suppliers d
        ON src.supplier_id = d.id
    WHERE d.city IS NULL
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        country,
        supplier_country,
        stock_qty
    FROM enriched_products
) src
PIVOT (
    MAX(stock_qty) AS value_sum
    FOR supplier_country IN ('SG', 'US')
)
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("supplier_id").orderBy("stock_qty", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "launch_date"), "category").orderBy(F.col("price").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("brand").orderBy(F.col("stock_qty").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("launch_date", "id")

with_windows = (
    df_products
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(10).over(w).alias("stock_qty_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("event_seq_2"),
    )
)

remaining_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_products
        .filter(F.col("stock_qty").between(271, 326))
        .select("id")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    verified
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("s"), F.col("a.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.product_name",
        "a.category",
        "a.cost",
        "a.stock_qty",
        "a.launch_date",
        "a.tags",
        "a.supplier_id",
        "a.seq_no",
        F.col("s.city"),
        F.col("s.country"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("b"), F.col("src.supplier_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("b.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("b.supplier_name"),
        F.col("b.country").alias("supplier_country"),
        F.col("b.rating"),
```

WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(tier_limits) x AS tier_value
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        currency,
        tier_value,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_cume_dist,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_percent_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value DESC) AS tier_value_rank_2
    FROM lines
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        currency,
        tier_value_cume_dist,
        tier_value_percent_rank,
        tier_value_rank,
        tier_value_rank_2,
        CASE WHEN tier_value_cume_dist >= 0.68 THEN 'High' WHEN tier_value_cume_dist >= 0.36 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS tier_value_cume_dist_band
    FROM scored
    WHERE tier_value_rank <= 3
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        tier_value_cume_dist,
        tier_value_percent_rank,
        tier_value_rank,
        tier_value_rank_2,
        CASE WHEN currency IN ('THB', 'EUR') THEN 'Tier 1' ELSE 'Other' END AS currency_group
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE tier_value_rank BETWEEN 3 AND 7
),
summary AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN tier_value_rank_2 >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS tier_value_rank_2_tier,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        ROUND(AVG(tier_value_percent_rank), 2) AS avg_tier_value_percent_rank,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
        MIN(tier_value_rank) AS min_tier_value_rank,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(tier_value_percent_rank, 0.5) AS tier_value_percent_rank_p50
    FROM base
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN tier_value_rank_2 >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
    HAVING row_count > 1
)
SELECT
    tier_value_rank_2_tier,
    avg_tier_value_percent_rank,
    min_tier_value_rank
FROM summary;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").asc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").asc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").asc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc())

lines = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "currency",
        F.explode_outer("tier_limits").alias("tier_value"),
    )
)

scored = (
    lines
    .select(
        "currency",
        "tier_value",
        F.cume_dist().over(w).alias("tier_value_cume_dist"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w2).alias("tier_value_percent_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("tier_value_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w4).alias("tier_value_rank_2"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("tier_value_rank") <= 3)
    .select(
        "currency",
        "tier_value_cume_dist",
        "tier_value_percent_rank",
        "tier_value_rank",
        "tier_value_rank_2",
        F.when(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist") >= 0.68, "High").when(F.col("tier_value_cume_dist") >= 0.36, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("tier_value_cume_dist_band"),
    )
)

base = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("tier_value_rank").between(3, 7))
    .select(
        "tier_value_cume_dist",
        "tier_value_percent_rank",
        "tier_value_rank",
        "tier_value_rank_2",
        F.when(F.col("currency").isin(["THB", "EUR"]), "Tier 1").otherwise("Other").alias("currency_group"),
    )
)

summary = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("tier_value_rank_2") >= 8, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("tier_value_rank_2_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.round(F.avg("tier_value_percent_rank"), 2).alias("avg_tier_value_percent_rank"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.min("tier_value_rank").alias("min_tier_value_rank"),
        F.percentile_approx("tier_value_percent_rank", 0.5).alias("tier_value_percent_rank_p50"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("row_count") > 1)
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "tier_value_rank_2_tier",
        "avg_tier_value_percent_rank",
        "min_tier_value_rank",
    )
)
```

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT *, ROUND(quantity * 1.15, 2) AS quantity_scaled
    FROM order_items
    WHERE order_id IN (1, 30, 40)
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM valid
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT order_id
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IN (17, 28)
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.order_id = k.order_id
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        s.order_id,
        s.product_id,
        s.quantity,
        s.unit_price,
        b.amount
    FROM reconciled s
    INNER JOIN orders b
        ON s.order_id = b.id
    WHERE b.customer_id = 14
),
enriched_order_items AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        b.price,
        b.launch_date
    FROM enriched s
    LEFT JOIN products b
        ON s.product_id = b.id
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', launch_date) AS week_start,
    product_id,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(price, 0.5) AS price_p50,
    COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) AS distinct_product_ids,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(quantity, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS quantity_quartiles,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(unit_price, 0.9) AS unit_price_p90,
    BIT_AND(quantity) AS quantity_bit_and,
    CORR(quantity, unit_price) AS corr_quantity_unit_price,
    GROUPING_ID() AS grouping_level
FROM enriched_order_items
GROUP BY CUBE (DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', launch_date), product_id)
ORDER BY product_id DESC NULLS LAST;

```python
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isin([1, 30, 40]))

        .filter(F.col("product_id").isin([17, 28]))
```

sql:
WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) e AS attr_key, v
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY status_code DESC, id, attr_key) AS dedup_rank
    FROM lines
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT level
    FROM latest
    INTERSECT
    SELECT level
    FROM app_logs
    WHERE service IN ('billing', 'search', 'auth')
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.level = k.level
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        log_ts,
        attr_key,
        v,
        dedup_rank,
        AVG(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(log_ts), attr_key ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_avg_1h,
        ROUND(status_code / SUM(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key), 4) AS status_code_share,
        MAX(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY level, attr_key) AS level_max_status_code
    FROM verified
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN status_code_avg_1h >= 384 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS status_code_avg_1h_tier,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(attr_key)) AS attr_key_list,
    COUNT_IF(attr_key = 'region') AS region_events,
    COUNT(DISTINCT attr_key) AS distinct_attr_keys,
    GROUPING(CASE WHEN status_code_avg_1h >= 384 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END) AS grouping_id
FROM enriched
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN status_code_avg_1h >= 384 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END)
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT attr_key) > 1
ORDER BY status_code_avg_1h_tier NULLS FIRST;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("status_code").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("log_ts"), "attr_key").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("level", "attr_key")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "v"),
    )
)

latest = (
    lines
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

remaining_keys = (
    latest
    .select("level")
    .intersect(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("service").isin(["billing", "search", "auth"]))
        .select("level")
    )
)

verified = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.level") == F.col("k.level")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    verified
    .select(
        "log_ts",
        "attr_key",
        "v",
        "dedup_rank",
        F.avg("status_code").over(w2).alias("status_code_avg_1h"),
        F.round((F.col("status_code") / F.sum("status_code").over(w3)), 4).alias("status_code_share"),
        F.max("status_code").over(w4).alias("level_max_status_code"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("status_code_avg_1h_tier", F.when(F.col("status_code_avg_1h") >= 384, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .rollup("status_code_avg_1h_tier")
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("attr_key")).alias("attr_key_list"),
        F.count_if(F.col("attr_key") == "region").alias("region_events"),
        F.countDistinct("attr_key").alias("distinct_attr_keys"),
        F.grouping("status_code_avg_1h_tier").alias("grouping_id"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_attr_keys") > 1)
    .orderBy(F.col("status_code_avg_1h_tier").asc_nulls_first())
)
```

        LENGTH(brand) AS brand_length
    FROM products
    WHERE supplier_id IS NOT NULL

valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows

        product_name,
        category,
        brand,
        cost,
        launch_date,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        least_stock_qty_price,
        UPPER(category) AS category_upper,
        ARRAY_CONTAINS(tags, 'bestseller') AS is_bestseller
    FROM base
    WHERE launch_date > DATE '2023-06-19'
      AND brand IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        launch_date,
        tags,
        LAST_VALUE(least_stock_qty_price) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY category, supplier_id ORDER BY launch_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_least_stock_qty_price,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY least_stock_qty_price) AS least_stock_qty_price_cume_dist,
        STDDEV_SAMP(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY category) AS category_stddev_samp_cost,
        LAG(cost, 1) OVER (ORDER BY launch_date, id) AS prev_cost,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cost DESC) AS cost_dense_rank
    FROM valid
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        launch_date,
        least_stock_qty_price_cume_dist,
        cost_dense_rank,
        AVG(last_known_least_stock_qty_price) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', launch_date) ORDER BY last_known_least_stock_qty_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_least_stock_qty_price_avg_3,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY prev_cost NULLS LAST) AS prev_cost_cume_dist
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    id,
    launch_date,
    least_stock_qty_price_cume_dist,
    cost_dense_rank,
    last_known_least_stock_qty_price_avg_3,
    prev_cost_cume_dist

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(dept_name) AS dept_name_lower,
        COALESCE(dept_name, 'OTHER') AS dept_name_filled
    FROM departments
    WHERE budget < 3140000
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_name,
        ROUND(budget / SUM(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name, location), 4) AS budget_share,
        LEAD(budget, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY location, dept_name ORDER BY budget, id) AS next_budget,
        LAST_VALUE(budget) IGNORE NULLS OVER w_part AS last_known_budget,
        ROUND(budget / SUM(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY location), 4) AS budget_share_2
    FROM filtered
    WHERE dept_name NOT IN ('Marketing', 'Finance')
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY location, dept_name ORDER BY budget, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT id, dept_name
    FROM with_windows
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id, dept_name
    FROM departments
    WHERE dept_name = 'Marketing'
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.dept_name = k.dept_name
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_name,
        budget_share,
        next_budget,
        budget_share_2,
        ROUND(last_known_budget * 0.85, 2) AS last_known_budget_scaled,
        COALESCE(dept_name, 'UNKNOWN') AS dept_name_clean
    FROM verified
    WHERE dept_name IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY last_known_budget_scaled DESC NULLS FIRST) AS last_known_budget_scaled_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY last_known_budget_scaled DESC NULLS LAST) AS last_known_budget_scaled_percent_rank_2,
        MIN(budget_share_2) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name) AS dept_name_min_budget_share_2,
        ROUND(next_budget / SUM(next_budget) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name), 4) AS next_budget_share
    FROM valid
)
SELECT
    id,
    dept_name,
    budget_share,
    last_known_budget_scaled,
    last_known_budget_scaled_percent_rank,
    dept_name_min_budget_share_2,
    next_budget_share,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY dept_name_min_budget_share_2 DESC NULLS LAST) AS dept_name_min_budget_share_2_rank,
    SUM(next_budget) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name) AS dept_name_sum_next_budget,
    STDDEV_SAMP(last_known_budget_scaled) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name) AS dept_name_stddev_samp_last_known_budget_scaled
FROM scored;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("location")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("last_known_budget_scaled").desc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("last_known_budget_scaled").desc_nulls_last())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("dept_name_min_budget_share_2").desc_nulls_last())

filtered = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("budget") < 3140000)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lower("dept_name").alias("dept_name_lower"),
        F.coalesce("dept_name", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("dept_name_filled"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .filter(~F.col("dept_name").isin(["Marketing", "Finance"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_name",
        F.round((F.col("budget") / F.sum("budget").over(w)), 4).alias("budget_share"),
        F.lead("budget", 1).over(w2).alias("next_budget"),
        F.last("budget", ignorenulls=True).over(w_part).alias("last_known_budget"),
        F.round((F.col("budget") / F.sum("budget").over(w4)), 4).alias("budget_share_2"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("id", "dept_name")
    .intersectAll(
        df_departments
        .filter(F.col("dept_name") == "Marketing")
        .select("id", "dept_name")
    )
)

verified = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.dept_name") == F.col("k.dept_name")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("dept_name").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_name",
        "budget_share",
        "next_budget",
        "budget_share_2",
        F.round((F.col("last_known_budget") * 0.85), 2).alias("last_known_budget_scaled"),
        F.coalesce("dept_name", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("dept_name_clean"),
    )
)

scored = (
    valid
    .withColumn("last_known_budget_scaled_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w5))
    .withColumn("last_known_budget_scaled_percent_rank_2", F.percent_rank().over(w6))
    .withColumn("dept_name_min_budget_share_2", F.min("budget_share_2").over(w7))
    .withColumn("next_budget_share", F.round((F.col("next_budget") / F.sum("next_budget").over(w7)), 4))
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_name",
        "budget_share",
        "last_known_budget_scaled",
        "last_known_budget_scaled_percent_rank",
        "dept_name_min_budget_share_2",
        "next_budget_share",
        F.rank().over(w8).alias("dept_name_min_budget_share_2_rank"),
        F.sum("next_budget").over(w7).alias("dept_name_sum_next_budget"),
        F.stddev_samp("last_known_budget_scaled").over(w7).alias("dept_name_stddev_samp_last_known_budget_scaled"),
    )
)
```

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        city,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        CONCAT(city, '/', name) city_name
    FROM customers
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM accounts x
            WHERE x.customer_id = s.id
              AND x.opened_date >= s.signup_date
        )
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT segment, city
    FROM kept
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT segment, city
    FROM customers
    WHERE LENGTH(name) >= 6
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM kept s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.segment = k.segment AND s.city = k.city
),
kept_customers AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM verified s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM subscriptions ch
            WHERE ch.customer_id = s.id
              AND ch.start_date < s.signup_date
        )
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        city,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        credit_limit,
        age,
        city_name,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY age DESC NULLS LAST) age_dense_rank,
        ROUND(credit_limit / SUM(credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', signup_date), segment), 4) credit_limit_share,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY credit_limit) credit_limit_cume_dist
    FROM kept_customers
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        city,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        city_name,
        age_dense_rank,
        AVG(credit_limit_cume_dist) OVER (PARTITION BY city) city_avg_credit_limit_cume_dist,
        CORR(credit_limit, age) OVER (PARTITION BY city) corr_credit_limit_age,
        MIN(age_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(signup_date), segment) signup_date_month_min_age_dense_rank
    FROM scored
    WHERE credit_limit_cume_dist < 0.28
)
SELECT
    city,
    segment,
    signup_date,
    city_name,
    age_dense_rank,
    city_avg_credit_limit_cume_dist,
    corr_credit_limit_age,
    signup_date_month_min_age_dense_rank
FROM enriched
ORDER BY signup_date DESC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("age").desc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "signup_date"), "segment")
w3 = Window.orderBy("credit_limit")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city")
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("signup_date"), "segment")

cleaned = (
    df_customers
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "city",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        F.concat("city", F.lit("/"), "name").alias("city_name"),
    )
)

kept = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("x"), (F.col("x.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.opened_date") >= F.col("s.signup_date")), "left_anti")
)

remaining_keys = (
    kept
    .select("segment", "city")
    .subtract(
        df_customers
        .filter(F.length("name") >= 6)
        .select("segment", "city")
    )
)

verified = (
    kept
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.segment") == F.col("k.segment")) & (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

kept_customers = (
    verified
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.start_date") < F.col("s.signup_date")), "left_semi")
)

scored = (
    kept_customers
    .select(
        "city",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        "credit_limit",
        "age",
        "city_name",
        F.dense_rank().over(w).alias("age_dense_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("credit_limit") / F.sum("credit_limit").over(w2)), 4).alias("credit_limit_share"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w3).alias("credit_limit_cume_dist"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("credit_limit_cume_dist") < 0.28)
    .select(
        "city",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        "city_name",
        "age_dense_rank",
        F.avg("credit_limit_cume_dist").over(w4).alias("city_avg_credit_limit_cume_dist"),
        F.corr("credit_limit", "age").over(w4).alias("corr_credit_limit_age"),
        F.min("age_dense_rank").over(w5).alias("signup_date_month_min_age_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "city",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        "city_name",
        "age_dense_rank",
        "city_avg_credit_limit_cume_dist",
        "corr_credit_limit_age",
        "signup_date_month_min_age_dense_rank",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("signup_date").desc())
)
```

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, ROUND(quantity, 2) AS quantity_rounded
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        quantity,
        quantity_rounded,
        CORR(quantity, unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, product_id) AS corr_quantity_unit_price,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY quantity_rounded DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY quantity, id) AS quantity_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, order_id ORDER BY quantity, id) AS event_seq
    FROM cleaned
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        quantity,
        quantity_rounded,
        event_seq,
        AVG(corr_quantity_unit_price) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price,
        AVG(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS seq_no_avg_3_prior
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE corr_quantity_unit_price > 0.5
),
cleaned_order_items AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(seq_no_avg_3_prior, 0) AS seq_no_avg_3_prior_rounded
    FROM scored
    WHERE event_seq < 7
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN quantity_rounded >= 90 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS quantity_rounded_tier,
    CASE WHEN order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price >= 1 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(event_seq), 2) AS avg_event_seq,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(seq_no_avg_3_prior, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS seq_no_avg_3_prior_quartiles,
    ROUND(AVG(order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price), 2) AS avg_order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(seq_no_avg_3_prior, 0.95) AS seq_no_avg_3_prior_p95,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(quantity_rounded, 0.95) AS quantity_rounded_p95
FROM cleaned_order_items
GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN quantity_rounded >= 90 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price >= 1 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END)
ORDER BY avg_order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price DESC NULLS LAST;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("quantity_rounded").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("quantity", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("product_id", "order_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)

cleaned = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("quantity_rounded", F.round("quantity", 2))
)

with_windows = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "quantity",
        "quantity_rounded",
        F.corr("quantity", "unit_price").over(w).alias("corr_quantity_unit_price"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("seq_no"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w3).alias("quantity_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("corr_quantity_unit_price") > 0.5)
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity",
        "quantity_rounded",
        "event_seq",
        F.avg("corr_quantity_unit_price").over(w5).alias("order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price"),
        F.avg("seq_no").over(w6).alias("seq_no_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

cleaned_order_items = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("event_seq") < 7)
    .withColumn("seq_no_avg_3_prior_rounded", F.round("seq_no_avg_3_prior", 0))
)

result = (
    cleaned_order_items
    .rollup(
        F.when(F.col("quantity_rounded") >= 90, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("quantity_rounded_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price") >= 1, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("event_seq"), 2).alias("avg_event_seq"),
        F.percentile_approx("seq_no_avg_3_prior", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("seq_no_avg_3_prior_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.avg("order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price"), 2).alias("avg_order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price"),
        F.percentile_approx("seq_no_avg_3_prior", 0.95).alias("seq_no_avg_3_prior_p95"),
        F.percentile_approx("quantity_rounded", 0.95).alias("quantity_rounded_p95"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_order_id_avg_corr_quantity_unit_price").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

WITH flattened AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        key,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) e AS key, value
)
SELECT
    key,
    level,
    CASE WHEN latency_ms >= 2017 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS latency_ms_tier,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE level = 'ERROR') AS error_rows,
    SUM(status_code) FILTER (WHERE key = 'version') AS version_total_status_code,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN level = 'ERROR' THEN 1 END) AS error_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN level = 'ERROR' THEN status_code ELSE 0 END) AS error_status_code,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(level)) AS level_list,
    SUM(CASE WHEN level = 'INFO' THEN status_code ELSE 0 END) AS info_status_code
FROM flattened
GROUP BY key, level, CASE WHEN latency_ms >= 2017 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "value"),
    )
)

result = (
    flattened
    .groupBy(
        "key",
        "level",
        F.when(F.col("latency_ms") >= 2017, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("latency_ms_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("level") == "ERROR", 1)).alias("error_rows"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("key") == "version", F.col("status_code"))).alias("version_total_status_code"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("level") == "ERROR", 1)).alias("error_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("level") == "ERROR", F.col("status_code")).otherwise(0)).alias("error_status_code"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("level")).alias("level_list"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("level") == "INFO", F.col("status_code")).otherwise(0)).alias("info_status_code"),
    )
)
```

sql:
WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS k, attr_value
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value,
        AVG(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY log_ts, id, k ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS status_code_avg_6_prior,
        LAG(status_code, 2) OVER (ORDER BY status_code, id, k) AS prev_status_code
    FROM exploded
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        level,
        k,
        prev_status_code,
        SUM(prev_status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY status_code_avg_6_prior, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_prev_status_code,
        SUM(status_code) OVER (ORDER BY prev_status_code, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_status_code,
        NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY prev_status_code, id, k) AS prev_status_code_bucket,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', log_ts), k ORDER BY prev_status_code DESC, id, k) AS prev_status_code_bucket_2
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE status_code_avg_6_prior BETWEEN 350 AND 358
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY prev_status_code_bucket_2 DESC, id, k) AS row_num
        FROM scored
    ) t
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
daily AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN prev_status_code_bucket >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS prev_status_code_bucket_tier,
        level,
        SUM(CASE WHEN level = 'INFO' THEN cumulative_prev_status_code ELSE 0 END) AS info_cumulative_prev_status_code,
        ROUND(SUM(prev_status_code_bucket) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN k = 'region' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS prev_status_code_bucket_per_region,
        COUNT_IF(k = 'region') AS region_events
    FROM ranked
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN prev_status_code_bucket >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, level
)
SELECT
    prev_status_code_bucket_tier,
    level,
    info_cumulative_prev_status_code,
    region_events
FROM daily;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w2 = Window.orderBy("status_code", "id", "k")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy("status_code_avg_6_prior", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.orderBy("prev_status_code", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.orderBy("prev_status_code", "id", "k")
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "log_ts"), "k").orderBy(F.col("prev_status_code").desc(), "id", "k")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("prev_status_code_bucket_2").desc(), "id", "k")

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    exploded
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        F.avg("status_code").over(w).alias("status_code_avg_6_prior"),
        F.lag("status_code", 2).over(w2).alias("prev_status_code"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("status_code_avg_6_prior").between(350, 358))
    .select(
        "id",
        "level",
        "k",
        "prev_status_code",
        F.sum("prev_status_code").over(w3).alias("cumulative_prev_status_code"),
        F.sum("status_code").over(w4).alias("running_status_code"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w5).alias("prev_status_code_bucket"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w6).alias("prev_status_code_bucket_2"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    scored
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

daily = (
    ranked
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("prev_status_code_bucket") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("prev_status_code_bucket_tier"),
        "level",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("level") == "INFO", F.col("cumulative_prev_status_code")).otherwise(0)).alias("info_cumulative_prev_status_code"),
        F.round(F.sum("prev_status_code_bucket") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("k") == "region", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("prev_status_code_bucket_per_region"),
        F.count_if(F.col("k") == "region").alias("region_events"),
    )
)

result = (
    daily
    .select(
        "prev_status_code_bucket_tier",
        "level",
        "info_cumulative_prev_status_code",
        "region_events",
    )
)
```
