sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        page,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        CONCAT(page, ' ', event_type) AS page_event_type,
        COALESCE(page, 'DIRECT') AS page_filled
    FROM web_events
    WHERE page IS NOT DISTINCT FROM '/cart'
      AND page IS NOT NULL
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR event_time > LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id) + INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM filtered
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        page,
        event_time,
        page_event_type,
        page_filled,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM flagged
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN island_id >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS island_id_tier,
    island_id,
    MIN(event_time) AS first_seen,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    MIN(event_time) AS started_at
FROM islands
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN island_id >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, island_id), (CASE WHEN island_id >= 7 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END))
ORDER BY island_id_tier DESC NULLS FIRST;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

filtered = (
    df_web_events
    .filter((F.col("page").eqNullSafe(F.lit("/cart"))) & F.col("page").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        F.concat("page", F.lit(" "), "event_type").alias("page_event_type"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("page_filled"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "page_event_type",
        "page_filled",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2).alias("island_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    islands
    .withColumn("island_id_tier", F.when(F.col("island_id") >= 7, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["island_id_tier", "island_id"], ["island_id_tier"]],
        "island_id_tier",
        "island_id",
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("event_time").alias("first_seen"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.min("event_time").alias("started_at"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("island_id_tier").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

sql:
with cleaned as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, coalesce(quantity, 0) quantity_filled
    from inventory
    where last_restock >= to_date('2023-03-31')
),
base as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        product_id,
        last_restock,
        add_months(last_restock, 3) last_restock_plus_months,
        date_trunc('year', last_restock) last_restock_period
    from cleaned
    where quantity_filled between 36 and 59
),
with_dims as (
    -- Attach products attributes
    select a.*, d.product_name
    from base a
    left join products d
        on a.product_id = d.id
),
with_prev as (
    -- Previous event time per key
    select *, lag(last_restock_period) over (partition by product_id order by last_restock_period, id) as prev_last_restock_period
    from with_dims
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    select *, case when prev_last_restock_period is null or last_restock_period > prev_last_restock_period + interval 30 days then 1 else 0 end as is_new_session
    from with_prev
),
islands as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select
        id,
        product_id,
        last_restock,
        last_restock_period,
        sum(is_new_session) over (partition by product_id order by last_restock_period, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_no
    from with_gaps
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    date_trunc('year', last_restock) as year_start,
    max(session_no) as max_session_no,
    min(last_restock_period) as first_last_restock_period,
    (unix_timestamp(max(last_restock_period)) - unix_timestamp(min(last_restock_period))) / 60 as duration_min
from islands
group by date_trunc('year', last_restock)
having (unix_timestamp(max(last_restock_period)) - unix_timestamp(min(last_restock_period))) / 60 > 0
order by max_session_no desc nulls last
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_period", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("last_restock_period", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-03-31")))
    .withColumn("quantity_filled", F.coalesce("quantity", F.lit(0)))
)

base = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("quantity_filled").between(36, 59))
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        F.add_months("last_restock", 3).alias("last_restock_plus_months"),
        F.date_trunc("year", "last_restock").alias("last_restock_period"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    base
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("a.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("d.product_name"))
)

with_prev = (
    with_dims
    .withColumn("prev_last_restock_period", F.lag("last_restock_period").over(w))
)

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("prev_last_restock_period").isNull() | (F.col("last_restock_period") > F.col("prev_last_restock_period") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "last_restock",
        "last_restock_period",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(w2).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    islands
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("year", "last_restock").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.max("session_no").alias("max_session_no"),
        F.min("last_restock_period").alias("first_last_restock_period"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("last_restock_period")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("last_restock_period"))) / 60).alias("duration_min"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("duration_min") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("max_session_no").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        EXPLODE_OUTER(tier_limits) AS element
    FROM price_tiers
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, ROUND(element, 0) AS element_rounded
    FROM exploded
    WHERE YEAR(effective_from) >= 2023
),
base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(element_rounded * 1.1, 2) AS element_rounded_adjusted,
        element_rounded + element AS element_rounded_plus_element
    FROM valid
    WHERE effective_from BETWEEN '2023-08-01' AND '2025-07-27'
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM base
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM price_tiers
    WHERE MONTH(effective_from) IN (5, 6, 8)
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', effective_from) AS week_start,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(element_rounded_plus_element, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS element_rounded_plus_element_quartiles,
    MIN(element) AS min_element
FROM kept_rows
GROUP BY CUBE (DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', effective_from))
HAVING min_element > 0;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "effective_from", F.explode_outer("tier_limits").alias("element"))
)

valid = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.year("effective_from") >= 2023)
    .withColumn("element_rounded", F.round("element", 0))
)

base = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("effective_from").between("2023-08-01", "2025-07-27"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("element_rounded") * 1.1), 2).alias("element_rounded_adjusted"),
        (F.col("element_rounded") + F.col("element")).alias("element_rounded_plus_element"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    base
    .select("id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_price_tiers
        .filter(F.month("effective_from").isin([5, 6, 8]))
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .cube(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "effective_from").alias("week_start"))
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("element_rounded_plus_element", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("element_rounded_plus_element_quartiles"),
        F.min("element").alias("min_element"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("min_element") > 0)
)
```

    FROM store_sales

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        status,
        INITCAP(TRIM(carrier)) AS carrier_title,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), shipped_date) / 365.25 AS years_since_shipped_date,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'NONE') AS carrier_clean
    FROM shipments
    WHERE shipped_date >= DATE '2023-05-28'
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY years_since_shipped_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id ASC) AS latest_rank
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier_clean,
        latest_rank
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost DESC, id ASC) AS dedup_rank
        FROM ranked
    ) x
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(latest_rank * 1.15, 2) AS latest_rank_scaled,
        CAST(latest_rank AS DOUBLE) AS latest_rank_num
    FROM latest
    WHERE latest_rank != 1
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, LEAST(latest_rank_num, latest_rank_scaled) AS least_latest_rank_num_latest_rank_scaled
    FROM valid
    WHERE latest_rank_num BETWEEN 45 AND 61
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN least_latest_rank_num_latest_rank_scaled >= 86 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS least_latest_rank_num_latest_rank_scaled_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(latest_rank_scaled), 2) AS avg_latest_rank_scaled,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(least_latest_rank_num_latest_rank_scaled, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS least_latest_rank_num_latest_rank_scaled_quartiles
FROM base
GROUP BY 1;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("years_since_shipped_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("cost").desc(), "id")

cleaned = (
    df_shipments
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") >= F.lit("2023-05-28").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.initcap(F.trim("carrier")).alias("carrier_title"),
        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "shipped_date") / 365.25).alias("years_since_shipped_date"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("NONE")).alias("carrier_clean"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

latest = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "carrier_clean", "latest_rank")
)

valid = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") != 1)
    .withColumn("latest_rank_scaled", F.round((F.col("latest_rank") * 1.15), 2))
    .withColumn("latest_rank_num", F.col("latest_rank").cast("double"))
)

base = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank_num").between(45, 61))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.least("latest_rank_num", "latest_rank_scaled").alias("least_latest_rank_num_latest_rank_scaled"),
    )
)

result = (
    base
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("least_latest_rank_num_latest_rank_scaled") >= 86, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("least_latest_rank_num_latest_rank_scaled_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("latest_rank_scaled"), 2).alias("avg_latest_rank_scaled"),
        F.percentile_approx("least_latest_rank_num_latest_rank_scaled", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("least_latest_rank_num_latest_rank_scaled_quartiles"),
    )
)
```

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        status,
        TO_DATE(paid_at) AS paid_at_date,
        TRIM(status) AS clean_status
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at > TIMESTAMP '2023-06-07 16:00:00'
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        clean_status
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY amount DESC, id) AS row_num
        FROM cleaned
    ) t
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS rn
        FROM deduped
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT order_id, method
    FROM latest
    EXCEPT
    SELECT order_id, method
    FROM payments
    WHERE method IN ('card', 'promptpay')
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.order_id = k.order_id AND s.method = k.method
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        clean_status,
        rn,
        ROUND(amount * 1.1, 2) AS adjusted_amount
    FROM verified
    WHERE amount BETWEEN 690 AND 1380
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        amount,
        adjusted_amount,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY adjusted_amount DESC NULLS LAST) AS adjusted_amount_dense_rank
    FROM filtered
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN adjusted_amount >= 82 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS adjusted_amount_tier,
    CASE WHEN adjusted_amount_dense_rank >= 9 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS adjusted_amount_dense_rank_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS avg_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(adjusted_amount), 2) AS avg_adjusted_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(adjusted_amount), 2) AS avg_adjusted_amount_2
FROM enriched
GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN adjusted_amount >= 82 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN adjusted_amount_dense_rank >= 9 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END)
ORDER BY adjusted_amount_dense_rank_tier DESC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("adjusted_amount").desc_nulls_last())

cleaned = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") > F.lit("2023-06-07 16:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "status",
        F.to_date("paid_at").alias("paid_at_date"),
        F.trim("status").alias("clean_status"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select("id", "order_id", "method", "amount", "clean_status")
)

latest = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rn", F.rank().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

matched_keys = (
    latest
    .select("order_id", "method")
    .subtract(
        df_payments
        .filter(F.col("method").isin(["card", "promptpay"]))
        .select("order_id", "method")
    )
)

verified = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.order_id") == F.col("k.order_id")) & (F.col("s.method") == F.col("k.method")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("amount").between(690, 1380))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "amount",
        "clean_status",
        "rn",
        F.round((F.col("amount") * 1.1), 2).alias("adjusted_amount"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount",
        "adjusted_amount",
        F.dense_rank().over(w3).alias("adjusted_amount_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .cube(
        F.when(F.col("adjusted_amount") >= 82, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("adjusted_amount_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("adjusted_amount_dense_rank") >= 9, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("adjusted_amount_dense_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("amount"), 2).alias("avg_amount"),
        F.round(F.avg("adjusted_amount"), 2).alias("avg_adjusted_amount"),
        F.round(F.avg("adjusted_amount"), 2).alias("avg_adjusted_amount_2"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("adjusted_amount_dense_rank_tier").desc())
)
```

sql:
WITH exploded AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) e AS k, attr_value
),
parsed AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        status_code,
        k,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high,
        CAST((status_code & 4) != 0 AS INT) AS is_flagged
    FROM exploded
    WHERE k = 'region'
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(status_code) OVER w_grp status_code_avg_6_prior,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code_high ASC, id ASC, k ASC) status_code_high_bucket,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code_high DESC NULLS LAST) status_code_high_rank
    FROM parsed
    WHERE k IN ('version', 'trace')
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY is_flagged ASC, id ASC, k ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code_high_rank DESC, id ASC, k ASC) = 1
)
SELECT
    k,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(k)) AS num_ks,
    SUM(CASE WHEN k = 'region' THEN status_code_high_bucket ELSE 0 END) AS region_status_code_high_bucket,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(k)) AS k_list
FROM deduped
GROUP BY k
ORDER BY k DESC
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("is_flagged", "id", "k").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("status_code_high", "id", "k")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").desc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high_rank").desc(), "id", "k")

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

parsed = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("k") == "region")
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(4) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    parsed
    .filter(F.col("k").isin(["version", "trace"]))
    .withColumn("status_code_avg_6_prior", F.avg("status_code").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("status_code_high_bucket", F.ntile(10).over(w2))
    .withColumn("status_code_high_rank", F.rank().over(w3))
)

deduped = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

result = (
    deduped
    .groupBy("k")
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("k")).alias("num_ks"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("k") == "region", F.col("status_code_high_bucket")).otherwise(0)).alias("region_status_code_high_bucket"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("k")).alias("k_list"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("k").desc())
)
```

sql:
WITH gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN paid_at - LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id) > INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM payments
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM gaps
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        TO_DATE(paid_at) AS paid_at_date,
        CAST(burst_id AS STRING) AS burst_id_num,
        COALESCE(method, 'N/A') AS method_filled
    FROM sessionized
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
      AND method NOT IN ('card', 'bank_transfer')
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        p.discount,
        p.amount AS order_amount,
        p.order_date
    FROM base a
    LEFT JOIN orders p
        ON a.order_id = p.id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        d.order_date AS order_order_date,
        d.channel
    FROM with_dims a
    LEFT JOIN orders d
        ON a.order_id = d.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at,
        status,
        burst_id,
        paid_at_date,
        burst_id_num,
        method_filled,
        discount,
        order_amount,
        order_order_date,
        channel,
        MIN(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY order_order_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_min_amount,
        MAX(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY order_order_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_amount,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY order_order_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_amount,
        AVG(discount) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(paid_at_date), channel ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS discount_avg_5
    FROM joined
    WHERE status = 'SUCCESS'
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    d.channel AS order_channel,
    d.status AS order_status,
    src.channel AS payment_channel,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
    MIN(src.running_avg_amount) AS min_running_avg_amount,
    MAX(src.running_min_amount) AS max_running_min_amount,
    GROUPING_ID() AS level_id
FROM metrics src
INNER JOIN orders d ON src.order_id = d.id
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((d.channel, d.status, src.channel), (d.channel, d.status), (d.channel), ())
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("order_order_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("paid_at_date"), "channel").orderBy("amount", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)

gaps = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("paid_at") - F.lag("paid_at").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 14 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = gaps.withColumn("burst_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

base = (
    sessionized
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull() & ~F.col("method").isin(["card", "bank_transfer"]))
    .withColumn("paid_at_date", F.to_date("paid_at"))
    .withColumn("burst_id_num", F.col("burst_id").cast("string"))
    .withColumn("method_filled", F.coalesce("method", F.lit("N/A")))
)

with_dims = (
    base
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("p.discount"),
        F.col("p.amount").alias("order_amount"),
        F.col("p.order_date"),
    )
)

joined = (
    with_dims
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("a.*", F.col("d.order_date").alias("order_order_date"), F.col("d.channel"))
)

metrics = (
    joined
    .filter(F.col("status") == "SUCCESS")
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "burst_id",
        "paid_at_date",
        "burst_id_num",
        "method_filled",
        "discount",
        "order_amount",
        "order_order_date",
        "channel",
        F.min("amount").over(w3).alias("running_min_amount"),
        F.max("amount").over(w3).alias("running_max_amount"),
        F.avg("amount").over(w3).alias("running_avg_amount"),
        F.avg("discount").over(w4).alias("discount_avg_5"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("d"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .groupingSets(
        [["order_channel", "order_status", "payment_channel"], ["order_channel", "order_status"], ["order_channel"], []],
        F.col("d.channel").alias("order_channel"),
        F.col("d.status").alias("order_status"),
        F.col("src.channel").alias("payment_channel"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rows_total"),
        F.min(F.col("src.running_avg_amount")).alias("min_running_avg_amount"),
        F.max(F.col("src.running_min_amount")).alias("max_running_min_amount"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("level_id"),
    )
)
```

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        IF(is_remote, 'Yes', 'No') AS is_remote_label,
        WEEKOFYEAR(hire_date) AS hire_date_weekofyear
    FROM employees
    WHERE level IS DISTINCT FROM 'L3'
      AND hire_date >= DATE '2023-08-24'
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        dept_id,
        manager_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        is_remote,
        level,
        is_remote_label,
        hire_date_weekofyear
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY manager_id ORDER BY hire_date ASC NULLS FIRST, id ASC) = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        salary,
        is_remote,
        LAG(salary) OVER w_running AS prev_salary,
        LAG(hire_date_weekofyear) OVER w_running AS prev_hire_date_weekofyear,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_running AS seq_no,
        FIRST_VALUE(job_title) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY hire_date_weekofyear ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_job_title
    FROM latest
    WHERE full_name LIKE 'O%'
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY salary ASC, id ASC)
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach departments attributes
    SELECT s.*, p.location
    FROM with_windows s
    LEFT JOIN departments p
        ON s.dept_id = p.id
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN salary >= 140000 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS salary_tier,
    MAX(salary) AS max_salary,
    MAX(salary) FILTER (WHERE location = 'New York') AS new_york_max_salary,

WITH base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_DAY(end_date) AS end_date_month_end,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), start_date) / 30 AS months_since_start_date
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE start_date > TO_DATE('2023-06-20')
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY end_date_month_end, id) AS seq_no,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status ORDER BY months_since_start_date NULLS FIRST) AS months_since_start_date_cume_dist
    FROM base
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status, plan ORDER BY start_date NULLS FIRST, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM metrics
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
with_window AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        a.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan AS subscription_plan,
        sub.monthly_fee AS subscription_monthly_fee
    FROM deduped a
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON a.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND a.start_date >= sub.start_date
       AND a.start_date <= DATE_ADD(sub.end_date, 10)
),
totals AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN months_since_start_date_cume_dist >= 0.83 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS months_since_start_date_cume_dist_tier,
        CASE WHEN seq_no >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS seq_no_tier,
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(subscription_plan)) AS subscription_plan_list,
        GROUPING(CASE WHEN months_since_start_date_cume_dist >= 0.83 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END) AS grouping_level
    FROM with_window
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (CASE WHEN months_since_start_date_cume_dist >= 0.83 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, CASE WHEN seq_no >= 8 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, customer_id)
)
SELECT
    months_since_start_date_cume_dist_tier,
    seq_no_tier,
    customer_id,
    row_count,
    subscription_plan_list,
    grouping_level
FROM totals
ORDER BY seq_no_tier DESC

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("end_date_month_end", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "status").orderBy(F.col("months_since_start_date").asc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status", "plan").orderBy(F.col("start_date").asc_nulls_first(), "id")

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("start_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-20")))
    .withColumn("end_date_month_end", F.last_day("end_date"))
    .withColumn("months_since_start_date", (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "start_date") / 30))
)

metrics = (
    base
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w))
    .withColumn("months_since_start_date_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w2))
)

deduped = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

with_window = (
    deduped
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("a.start_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("a.start_date") <= F.date_add(F.col("sub.end_date"), 10)), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan").alias("subscription_plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee").alias("subscription_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

totals = (
    with_window
    .withColumn("months_since_start_date_cume_dist_tier", F.when(F.col("months_since_start_date_cume_dist") >= 0.83, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .withColumn("seq_no_tier", F.when(F.col("seq_no") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
    .rollup("months_since_start_date_cume_dist_tier", "seq_no_tier", "customer_id")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("subscription_plan")).alias("subscription_plan_list"),
        F.grouping("months_since_start_date_cume_dist_tier").alias("grouping_level"),
    )
)

result = (
    totals
    .select(
        "months_since_start_date_cume_dist_tier",
        "seq_no_tier",
        "customer_id",
        "row_count",
        "subscription_plan_list",
        "grouping_level",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("seq_no_tier").desc())
)
```

WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        email,
        salary,
        hire_date,
        is_remote,
        level,
        LENGTH(full_name) AS full_name_length
    FROM employees
    WHERE hire_date >= DATE '2023-04-13'
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY full_name_length DESC, id ASC) AS full_name_length_bucket,
        AVG(full_name_length) OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY hire_date ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS full_name_length_avg_6
    FROM cleaned
),
ranked AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER

    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY rn = 1
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT level, id
    FROM ranked
    EXCEPT
    SELECT level, id
    FROM employees

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        key,
        v
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) e AS key, v
),
unpacked AS (
    -- Semi-structured parsing
    SELECT
        id,
        status_code,
        key,
        CAST((status_code & 8) != 0 AS INT) AS flag_bit8,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high
    FROM flattened
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        key,
        status_code_high,
        LEAD(status_code) OVER w_hist next_status_code,
        LAG(status_code) OVER w_hist prev_status_code,
        LAG(status_code_high) OVER w_hist prev_status_code_high,
        LEAD(status_code_high) OVER w_hist next_status_code_high,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist seq_no,
        LAG(status_code, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY flag_bit8, id, key) prev_status_code_2
    FROM unpacked
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY status_code, id, key)
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(next_status_code AS DOUBLE) next_status_code_num,
        COALESCE(key, 'NONE') resolved_key
    FROM enriched
    WHERE key IS NOT NULL
),
enriched_app_logs AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(key, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY next_status_code_num, id, key ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_key,
        MIN(status_code_high) OVER (PARTITION BY key) key_min_status_code_high,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_ordered prev_status_code_percent_rank
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY prev_status_code DESC NULLS LAST)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY key ORDER BY seq_no DESC, id, key) AS row_num
    FROM enriched_app_logs
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
)
SELECT
    id,
    key,
    status_code_high,
    next_status_code,
    prev_status_code,
    prev_status_code_high,
    next_status_code_high,
    seq_no,
    next_status_code_num
FROM deduped
ORDER BY status_code_high DESC

sql:
WITH metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY reading_ts, id) AS seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY pressure, id) AS event_seq
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE status_bits > 10
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) IS NULL
                 OR reading_ts > LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) + INTERVAL 15 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM metrics
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        seq_no,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last4_sum_seq_no,
        MIN(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last4_min_seq_no,
        AVG(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last4_avg_seq_no,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY seq_no DESC, id) AS seq_no_bucket
    FROM islands
),
with_windows_device_readings AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(last4_min_seq_no) OVER w_hist AS last4_count_last4_min_seq_no,
        MIN(last4_min_seq_no) OVER w_hist AS last4_min_last4_min_seq_no,
        MAX(last4_min_seq_no) OVER w_hist AS last4_max_last4_min_seq_no,
        SUM(status_bits) OVER w_ordered AS cumulative_status_bits
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY humidity, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY last4_avg_seq_no, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_windows_device_readings_2 AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        session_id,
        last4_min_seq_no,
        last4_avg_seq_no,
        last4_count_last4_min_seq_no,
        last4_max_last4_min_seq_no,
        cumulative_status_bits,
        SUM(pressure) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS pressure_sum_2h,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY last4_avg_seq_no, id) AS row_seq,
        SUM(pressure) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code) AS device_code_sum_pressure
    FROM with_windows_device_readings
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        pressure,
        last4_max_last4_min_seq_no
    FROM with_windows_device_readings_2
) src
UNPIVOT (
    value FOR measure IN (pressure, last4_max_last4_min_seq_no)
);
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("pressure", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("seq_no").desc(), "id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("humidity", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("last4_avg_seq_no", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)
w10 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("last4_avg_seq_no", "id")
w11 = Window.partitionBy("device_code")

metrics = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("status_bits") > 10)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(w3).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(w3) + F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "seq_no",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w4).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    islands
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("seq_no").over(w5).alias("last4_sum_seq_no"),
        F.min("seq_no").over(w5).alias("last4_min_seq_no"),
        F.avg("seq_no").over(w5).alias("last4_avg_seq_no"),
        F.ntile(10).over(w6).alias("seq_no_bucket"),
    )
)

with_windows_device_readings = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("last4_count_last4_min_seq_no", F.count("last4_min_seq_no").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("last4_min_last4_min_seq_no", F.min("last4_min_seq_no").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("last4_max_last4_min_seq_no", F.max("last4_min_seq_no").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("cumulative_status_bits", F.sum("status_bits").over(w_ordered))
)

with_windows_device_readings_2 = (
    with_windows_device_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "session_id",
        "last4_min_seq_no",
        "last4_avg_seq_no",
        "last4_count_last4_min_seq_no",
        "last4_max_last4_min_seq_no",
        "cumulative_status_bits",
        F.sum("pressure").over(w9).alias("pressure_sum_2h"),
        F.row_number().over(w10).alias("row_seq"),
        F.sum("pressure").over(w11).alias("device_code_sum_pressure"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows_device_readings_2
    .select("id", "device_code", "pressure", "last4_max_last4_min_seq_no")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "device_code"],
        values=["pressure", "last4_max_last4_min_seq_no"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("value").isNotNull())
)
```

with base as (
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        status,
        cast(amount as int) as amount_int,
        date_format(paid_at, 'MMM yyyy') as paid_at_label,
        coalesce(method, 'DIRECT') as method_clean
    from payments
    where order_id is not null
),
enriched as (
    select
        src.id,
        src.order_id,
        src.method,
        src.amount,
        src.paid_at_label,
        src.method_clean,
        b.order_date,
        b.amount as order_amount
    from base src
    left join orders b
        on src.order_id = b.id
),
deduped as (
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by order_id order by order_date desc nulls first, id) as latest_rank
        from enriched
    ) ranked
    where latest_rank = 1
),
metrics as (
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        amount,
        paid_at_label,
        method_clean,
        latest_rank,
        ntile(4) over (partition by method, order_id order by amount desc, id) as amount_bucket,
        lead(order_amount, 2) over (partition by method order by order_amount, id) as next_order_amount
    from deduped
    where method != 'cash'
),
with_windows as (
    select
        id,
        paid_at_label,
        method_clean,
        latest_rank,
        amount_bucket,
        next_order_amount,
        cume_dist() over (order by next_order_amount nulls first) as next_order_amount_cume_dist,
        sum(amount_bucket) over (order by amount_bucket, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_amount_bucket,
        stddev_samp(next_order_amount) over (partition by method) as method_stddev_samp_next_order_amount,
        round(amount / sum(amount) over (partition by method), 4) as amount_share
    from metrics
),
filtered as (
    select
        id,
        paid_at_label,
        latest_rank,
        amount_bucket,
        next_order_amount,
        next_order_amount_cume_dist,
        running_amount_bucket,
        method_stddev_samp_next_order_amount,
        next_order_amount_cume_dist - next_order_amount as next_order_amount_cume_dist_minus_next_order_amount,
        case when running_amount_bucket >= 40 then 'High' when running_amount_bucket >= 16 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end as running_amount_bucket_band
    from with_windows
    where next_order_amount_cume_dist between 0.41 and 0.64
),
enriched_payments as (
    select
        id,
        paid_at_label,
        latest_rank,
        next_order_amount,
        method_stddev_samp_next_order_amount,
        next_order_amount_cume_dist_minus_next_order_amount,
        lag(next_order_amount_cume_dist_minus_next_order_amount) over (order by next_order_amount_cume_dist, id) as prev_next_order_amount_cume_dist_minus_next_order_amount,
        lead(amount_bucket) over (order by next_order_amount_cume_dist, id) as next_amount_bucket,
        row_number() over (order by next_order_amount_cume_dist, id) as seq_no
    from filtered
)
select
    id,
    paid_at_label,
    next_order_amount,
    method_stddev_samp_next_order_amount,
    next_amount_bucket,
    seq_no
from enriched_payments;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy(F.col("order_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("method", "order_id").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("order_amount", "id")
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("next_order_amount").asc_nulls_first())
w5 = Window.orderBy("amount_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("method")
w7 = Window.orderBy("next_order_amount_cume_dist", "id")

base = (
    df_payments
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "status",
        F.col("amount").cast("int").alias("amount_int"),
        F.date_format("paid_at", "MMM yyyy").alias("paid_at_label"),
        F.coalesce("method", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("method_clean"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_orders.alias("b"), F.col("src.order_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.order_id",
        "src.method",
        "src.amount",
        "src.paid_at_label",
        "src.method_clean",
        F.col("b.order_date"),
        F.col("b.amount").alias("order_amount"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("method") != "cash")
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at_label",
        "method_clean",
        "latest_rank",
        F.ntile(4).over(w2).alias("amount_bucket"),
        F.lead("order_amount", 2).over(w3).alias("next_order_amount"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "paid_at_label",
        "method_clean",
        "latest_rank",
        "amount_bucket",
        "next_order_amount",
        F.cume_dist().over(w4).alias("next_order_amount_cume_dist"),
        F.sum("amount_bucket").over(w5).alias("running_amount_bucket"),
        F.stddev_samp("next_order_amount").over(w6).alias("method_stddev_samp_next_order_amount"),
        F.round((F.col("amount") / F.sum("amount").over(w6)), 4).alias("amount_share"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("next_order_amount_cume_dist").between(0.41, 0.64))
    .select(
        "id",
        "paid_at_label",
        "latest_rank",
        "amount_bucket",
        "next_order_amount",
        "next_order_amount_cume_dist",
        "running_amount_bucket",
        "method_stddev_samp_next_order_amount",
        (F.col("next_order_amount_cume_dist") - F.col("next_order_amount")).alias("next_order_amount_cume_dist_minus_next_order_amount"),
        F.when(F.col("running_amount_bucket") >= 40, "High").when(F.col("running_amount_bucket") >= 16, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("running_amount_bucket_band"),
    )
)

enriched_payments = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "paid_at_label",
        "latest_rank",
        "next_order_amount",
        "method_stddev_samp_next_order_amount",
        "next_order_amount_cume_dist_minus_next_order_amount",
        F.lag("next_order_amount_cume_dist_minus_next_order_amount").over(w7).alias("prev_next_order_amount_cume_dist_minus_next_order_amount"),
        F.lead("amount_bucket").over(w7).alias("next_amount_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w7).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_payments
    .select(
        "id",
        "paid_at_label",
        "next_order_amount",
        "method_stddev_samp_next_order_amount",
        "next_amount_bucket",
        "seq_no",
    )
)
```

with base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, cast(status_bits as string) as status_bits_num
    from device_readings
    where reading_ts >= timestamp '2025-09-01 02:00:00'
),
filtered as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        device_code,
        reading_ts,
        temp_c,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        substring(firmware, 1, 4) as firmware_prefix
    from base
    where pressure < 994
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select device_code
    from filtered
    intersect all
    select device_code
    from device_readings
    where device_code in ('DV-04', 'DV-02')
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from filtered s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.device_code = k.device_code
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        max(temp_c) over (partition by device_code) as device_code_max_temp_c,
        max(pressure) over (partition by date_trunc('week', reading_ts), device_code) as reading_ts_period_max_pressure,
        percent_rank() over (partition by device_code order by temp_c desc) as temp_c_percent_rank
    from kept_rows
),
metrics as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        count(temp_c_percent_rank) over (partition by date_trunc('WEEK', reading_ts)) as reading_ts_period_count_temp_c_percent_rank,
        count(status_bits) over (partition by device_code order by cast(reading_ts as bigint) range between 7200 preceding and current row) as status_bits_count_2h,
        sum(pressure) over w_part as device_code_sum_pressure,
        count(reading_ts_period_max_pressure) over w_part as device_code_count_reading_ts_period_max_pressure,
        cume_dist() over w_running as status_bits_cume_dist
    from enriched
    where temp_c <= 25
    window w_part as (partition by device_code), w_running as (order by status_bits desc)
),
base_device_readings as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, datediff(current_date(), reading_ts) / 365.25 as years_since_reading_ts
    from metrics
    where reading_ts > date '2025-09-01'
      and device_code_count_reading_ts_period_max_pressure between 8 and 15
)
-- Grouped metrics
select
    date_trunc('hour', reading_ts) as hour_window,
    sum(case when device_code = 'DV-03' then humidity else 0 end) as dv_03_humidity,
    count(*) as cnt,
    count(distinct firmware) as distinct_firmwares
from base_device_readings
group by date_trunc('hour', reading_ts);
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "reading_ts"), "device_code")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("temp_c").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "reading_ts"))
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("status_bits").desc())

base = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") >= F.lit("2025-09-01 02:00:00").cast("timestamp"))
    .select("*", F.col("status_bits").cast("string").alias("status_bits_num"))
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("pressure") < 994)
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "reading_ts",
        "temp_c",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        F.substring("firmware", 1, 4).alias("firmware_prefix"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    filtered
    .select("device_code")
    .intersectAll(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("device_code").isin(["DV-04", "DV-02"]))
        .select("device_code")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.device_code") == F.col("k.device_code")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    kept_rows
    .withColumn("device_code_max_temp_c", F.max("temp_c").over(w))
    .withColumn("reading_ts_period_max_pressure", F.max("pressure").over(w2))
    .withColumn("temp_c_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w3))
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("temp_c") <= 25)
    .withColumn("reading_ts_period_count_temp_c_percent_rank", F.count("temp_c_percent_rank").over(w4))
    .withColumn("status_bits_count_2h", F.count("status_bits").over(w5))
    .withColumn("device_code_sum_pressure", F.sum("pressure").over(w))
    .withColumn("device_code_count_reading_ts_period_max_pressure", F.count("reading_ts_period_max_pressure").over(w))
    .withColumn("status_bits_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w_running))
)

base_device_readings = (
    metrics
    .filter((F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01").cast("date")) & F.col("device_code_count_reading_ts_period_max_pressure").between(8, 15))
    .withColumn("years_since_reading_ts", (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "reading_ts") / 365.25))
)

result = (
    base_device_readings
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("hour", "reading_ts").alias("hour_window"))
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("device_code") == "DV-03", F.col("humidity")).otherwise(0)).alias("dv_03_humidity"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.countDistinct("firmware").alias("distinct_firmwares"),
    )
)
```

WITH kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT city
    FROM suppliers
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT city
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE rating <= 4.1
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM suppliers s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.city = k.city
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    country,
    CASE WHEN rating >= 3.5 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS rating_tier,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(rating, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS rating_quartiles,
    SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'JP' THEN rating ELSE 0 END) AS jp_rating,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN country = 'JP' THEN rating ELSE 0 END) DESC) AS jp_rating_dense_rank
FROM kept_rows
GROUP BY country, CASE WHEN rating >= 3.5 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END;

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("jp_rating").desc())

kept_keys = (
    df_suppliers
    .select("city")
    .exceptAll(
        df_suppliers
        .filter(F.col("rating") <= 4.1)
        .select("city")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    df_suppliers
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    kept_rows
    .groupBy(
        "country",
        F.when(F.col("rating") >= 3.5, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("rating_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("rating", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("rating_quartiles"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("country") == "JP", F.col("rating")).otherwise(0)).alias("jp_rating"),
    )
    .withColumn("jp_rating_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w))
)
```

sql:
WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        started_at,
        country,
        LOWER(device) AS device_lower
    FROM sessions
    WHERE country IS NOT NULL
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(country, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_country,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id) AS row_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS seq_no
    FROM base
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY country, device ORDER BY started_at, id)
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id) + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM enriched
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        started_at,
        country,
        seq_no,
        SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT customer_id, id
    FROM sessionized
    INTERSECT
    SELECT customer_id, id
    FROM sessions
    WHERE TO_DATE(started_at) >= '2025-03-01'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM sessionized s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id AND s.id = k.id
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    dim.segment,
    e.country AS session_country,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    SUM(e.seq_no) AS total_seq_no
FROM verified e
INNER JOIN customers dim ON e.customer_id = dim.id
GROUP BY dim.segment, e.country;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("country", "device").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_sessions
    .filter(F.col("country").isNotNull() & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        F.lower("device").alias("device_lower"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("country", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("first_known_country"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("row_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(w2).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(w2) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "seq_no",
        F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w4).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    sessionized
    .select("customer_id", "id")
    .intersect(
        df_sessions
        .filter(F.to_date("started_at") >= "2025-03-01")
        .select("customer_id", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    sessionized
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("dim"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("dim.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(
        F.col("dim.segment").alias("segment"),
        F.col("e.country").alias("session_country"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.sum(F.col("e.seq_no")).alias("total_seq_no"),
    )
)
```

WITH with_prev AS (
    SELECT *, LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id) AS prev_event_time
    FROM web_events
),
with_gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_time IS NULL OR event_time > prev_event_time + INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_duration_sec,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_duration_sec,
        COUNT(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_duration_sec,
        MAX(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_duration_sec,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY duration_sec DESC, id) AS seq_no
    FROM sessionized
    WHERE burst_id < 6
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR event_time > LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id) + INTERVAL '60' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM metrics
),
islands AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM flagged
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        running_count_duration_sec,
        running_max_duration_sec,
        seq_no,
        LAG(island_id, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY is_new_burst, id) AS prev_island_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp AS event_seq,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY running_max_duration_sec DESC NULLS LAST) AS running_max_duration_sec_dense_rank
    FROM islands
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY running_count_duration_sec, id)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY running_count_duration_sec DESC, id) = 1
),
flagged_2 AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN event_time - LAG(event_time) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id) > INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM ranked
),
sessions_web_events AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_time,
        running_max_duration_sec,
        prev_island_id,
        running_max_duration_sec_dense_rank,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged_2
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        s.*,
        d.device,
        d.country,
        d.browser
    FROM sessions_web_events s
    LEFT JOIN sessions d
        ON s.session_id = d.id
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', event_time) AS week_start,
    browser,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(browser)) AS browser_list,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN device = 'desktop' THEN 1 END) AS desktop_count,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(device)) AS num_devices
FROM joined
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY browser DESC

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("is_new_burst", "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("running_count_duration_sec", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("running_max_duration_sec").desc_nulls_last())
w7 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("running_count_duration_sec").desc(), "id")

with_prev = df_web_events.withColumn("prev_event_time", F.lag("event_time").over(w))

with_gaps = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("prev_event_time").isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.col("prev_event_time") + F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    sessionized
    .filter(F.col("burst_id") < 6)
    .withColumn("running_avg_duration_sec", F.avg("duration_sec").over(w2))
    .withColumn("running_sum_duration_sec", F.sum("duration_sec").over(w2))
    .withColumn("running_count_duration_sec", F.count("duration_sec").over(w2))
    .withColumn("running_max_duration_sec", F.max("duration_sec").over(w2))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w3))
)

flagged = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("event_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("event_time") > F.lag("event_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w2))

with_windows = (
    islands
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_time",
        "duration_sec",
        "running_count_duration_sec",
        "running_max_duration_sec",
        "seq_no",
        F.lag("island_id", 2, 0).over(w4).alias("prev_island_id"),
        F.row_number().over(w_grp).alias("event_seq"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w6).alias("running_max_duration_sec_dense_rank"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

flagged_2 = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.col("event_time") - F.lag("event_time").over(w) > F.expr("INTERVAL 30 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_web_events = (
    flagged_2
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_time",
        "running_max_duration_sec",
        "prev_island_id",
        "running_max_duration_sec_dense_rank",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w2).alias("burst_id"),
    )
)

joined = (
    sessions_web_events
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("d"), F.col("s.session_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select("s.*", F.col("d.device"), F.col("d.country"), F.col("d.browser"))
)

result = (
    joined
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "event_time").alias("week_start"), "browser")
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("browser")).alias("browser_list"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("device") == "desktop", 1)).alias("desktop_count"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("device")).alias("num_devices"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("browser").desc())
)
```

sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(budget * 1.07, 2) AS budget_scaled,
        COALESCE(dept_name, 'UNKNOWN') AS resolved_dept_name
    FROM departments
    WHERE dept_name IS NOT NULL
      AND budget IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(budget, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY location, dept_name ORDER BY budget_scaled, id) AS next_budget,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY location, dept_name ORDER BY budget NULLS FIRST) AS budget_percent_rank
    FROM filtered
    WHERE budget > 3034000
),
eligible AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM with_windows s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees x
            WHERE x.dept_id = s.id
              AND x.is_remote
        )
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM eligible
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY location ORDER BY budget DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
totals AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN budget_percent_rank >= 0.63 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS budget_percent_rank_tier,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN location = 'New York' THEN 1 END) AS new_york_count,
        SUM(next_budget) AS total_next_budget
    FROM latest
    GROUP BY CASE WHEN budget_percent_rank >= 0.63 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
)
SELECT
    budget_percent_rank_tier,
    new_york_count,
    total_next_budget
FROM totals

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name").orderBy("budget_scaled", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("location", "dept_name").orderBy(F.col("budget").asc_nulls_first())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("location").orderBy(F.col("budget").desc_nulls_first(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("dept_name").isNotNull() & F.col("budget").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("budget") * 1.07), 2).alias("budget_scaled"),
        F.coalesce("dept_name", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("resolved_dept_name"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("budget") > 3034000)
    .withColumn("next_budget", F.lead("budget", 1, 0).over(w))
    .withColumn("budget_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w2))
)

eligible = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("x"), (F.col("x.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.is_remote")), "left_anti")
)

latest = (
    eligible
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

totals = (
    latest
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("budget_percent_rank") >= 0.63, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("budget_percent_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("location") == "New York", 1)).alias("new_york_count"),
        F.sum("next_budget").alias("total_next_budget"),
    )
)

result = totals.select("budget_percent_rank_tier", "new_york_count", "total_next_budget")
```

sql:
WITH flattened AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        coupon_codes,
        INLINE(items)
    FROM carts
),
flattened_carts AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        qty,
        promo,
        EXPLODE_OUTER(coupon_codes) AS code
    FROM flattened
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        STDDEV_SAMP(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY promo) AS promo_stddev_samp_qty,
        ROUND(product_id / SUM(product_id) OVER (PARTITION BY code), 4) AS product_id_share
    FROM flattened_carts
    WHERE product_id != 8
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY promo ORDER BY promo_stddev_samp_qty DESC) AS promo_stddev_samp_qty_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY product_id NULLS LAST) AS product_id_percent_rank,
        AVG(product_id) OVER (PARTITION BY code) AS code_avg_product_id
    FROM metrics
),
valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        qty,
        code,
        promo_stddev_samp_qty,
        product_id_share,
        promo_stddev_samp_qty_percent_rank,
        product_id_percent_rank,
        code_avg_product_id,
        COALESCE(promo, 'N/A') AS promo_filled,
        COALESCE(code, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_code
    FROM scored
    WHERE code IS DISTINCT FROM 'BUNDLE'
      AND product_id < 9
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(product_id_percent_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY code) AS code_max_product_id_percent_rank,
        ROUND(qty / SUM(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY code), 4) AS qty_share,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY code ORDER BY product_id_percent_rank DESC NULLS LAST) AS product_id_percent_rank_cume_dist
    FROM valid
),
report AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        code,
        promo_stddev_samp_qty,
        product_id_share,
        product_id_percent_rank,
        code_avg_product_id,
        promo_filled,
        resolved_code,
        CASE WHEN code RLIKE '^(WELCOME5|BUNDLE)$' THEN 'OTHER_ZONE' WHEN code RLIKE '^(SPRING10|VIP)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS code_zone
    FROM with_windows
    ORDER BY product_id_share DESC NULLS LAST
)
SELECT
    id,
    product_id,
    code,
    promo_filled,
    resolved_code,
    code_zone,
    CASE WHEN code_zone RLIKE '^(PRIORITY|OTHER_ZONE)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS code_zone_zone
FROM report;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("promo")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("code")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("promo").orderBy(F.col("promo_stddev_samp_qty").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("code").orderBy(F.col("product_id").asc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("code").orderBy(F.col("product_id_percent_rank").desc_nulls_last())

flattened = df_carts.select("id", "coupon_codes", F.inline("items"))

flattened_carts = (
    flattened
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "qty",
        "promo",
        F.explode_outer("coupon_codes").alias("code"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    flattened_carts
    .filter(F.col("product_id") != 8)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.stddev_samp("qty").over(w).alias("promo_stddev_samp_qty"),
        F.round((F.col("product_id") / F.sum("product_id").over(w2)), 4).alias("product_id_share"),
    )
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.percent_rank().over(w3).alias("promo_stddev_samp_qty_percent_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w4).alias("product_id_percent_rank"),
        F.avg("product_id").over(w2).alias("code_avg_product_id"),
    )
)

valid = (
    scored
    .filter((~F.col("code").eqNullSafe(F.lit("BUNDLE"))) & (F.col("product_id") < 9))
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "qty",
        "code",
        "promo_stddev_samp_qty",
        "product_id_share",
        "promo_stddev_samp_qty_percent_rank",
        "product_id_percent_rank",
        "code_avg_product_id",
        F.coalesce("promo", F.lit("N/A")).alias("promo_filled"),
        F.coalesce("code", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_code"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .select(
        "*",
        F.max("product_id_percent_rank").over(w2).alias("code_max_product_id_percent_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("qty") / F.sum("qty").over(w2)), 4).alias("qty_share"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w5).alias("product_id_percent_rank_cume_dist"),
    )
)

report = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "code",
        "promo_stddev_samp_qty",
        "product_id_share",
        "product_id_percent_rank",
        "code_avg_product_id",
        "promo_filled",
        "resolved_code",
        F.when(F.col("code").rlike("^(WELCOME5|BUNDLE)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").when(F.col("code").rlike("^(SPRING10|VIP)$"), "PRIORITY").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("code_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("product_id_share").desc_nulls_last())
)

result = (
    report
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "code",
        "promo_filled",
        "resolved_code",
        "code_zone",
        F.when(F.col("code_zone").rlike("^(PRIORITY|OTHER_ZONE)$"), "GROUP_A").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("code_zone_zone"),
    )
)
```
