WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        EXPLODE(tier_limits) AS tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
),
base AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        plan,
        effective_from,
        tier_value,
        CONCAT(plan, ' ', currency) AS plan_currency
    FROM flattened
    WHERE YEAR(effective_from) = 2024
),
base_price_tiers AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(plan) AS plan_length,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', effective_from) AS effective_from_period
    FROM base
    WHERE tier_value < 44
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        plan,
        effective_from,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS LAST) AS tier_value_dense_rank,
        MIN(plan_length) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_min_plan_length,
        STDDEV_SAMP(tier_value) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', effective_from)) AS effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value
    FROM base_price_tiers
),
with_windows_price_tiers AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        plan,
        effective_from,
        plan_min_plan_length,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value NULLS LAST) AS effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value DESC NULLS FIRST) AS effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY tier_value_dense_rank DESC) AS tier_value_dense_rank_percent_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(effective_from), plan ORDER BY effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value NULLS LAST) AS effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_3
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE plan = 'enterprise'
),
grouped AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN plan_min_plan_length >= 61 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS plan_min_plan_length_tier,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
        AVG(effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2) FILTER (WHERE plan = 'basic') AS basic_avg_effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'pro' THEN effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2 ELSE 0 END) AS pro_effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'enterprise' THEN 1 END) AS enterprise_count
    FROM with_windows_price_tiers
    GROUP BY 1
    HAVING pro_effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2 > 0
)
SELECT
    plan_min_plan_length_tier,
    num_rows,
    basic_avg_effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2,
    event_count,
    pro_effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2,
    enterprise_count
FROM grouped
ORDER BY num_rows DESC, pro_effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_last())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "effective_from"))
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value").asc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value").desc_nulls_first())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("tier_value_dense_rank").desc())
w7 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("effective_from"), "plan").orderBy(F.col("effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value").asc_nulls_last())

flattened = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        F.explode("tier_limits").alias("tier_value"),
    )
)

base = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.year("effective_from") == 2024)
    .select(
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "tier_value",
        F.concat("plan", F.lit(" "), "currency").alias("plan_currency"),
    )
)

base_price_tiers = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("tier_value") < 44)
    .withColumn("plan_length", F.length("plan"))
    .withColumn("effective_from_period", F.date_trunc("month", "effective_from"))
)

with_windows = (
    base_price_tiers
    .select(
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        F.dense_rank().over(w).alias("tier_value_dense_rank"),
        F.min("plan_length").over(w2).alias("plan_min_plan_length"),
        F.stddev_samp("tier_value").over(w3).alias("effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value"),
    )
)

with_windows_price_tiers = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("plan") == "enterprise")
    .select(
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "plan_min_plan_length",
        F.percent_rank().over(w4).alias("effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w5).alias("effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w6).alias("tier_value_dense_rank_percent_rank"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w7).alias("effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_3"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    with_windows_price_tiers
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("plan_min_plan_length") >= 61, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("plan_min_plan_length_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("plan") == "basic", F.col("effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2"))).alias("basic_avg_effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "pro", F.col("effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2")).otherwise(0)).alias("pro_effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "enterprise", 1)).alias("enterprise_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("pro_effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2") > 0)
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "plan_min_plan_length_tier",
        "num_rows",
        "basic_avg_effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2",
        "event_count",
        "pro_effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2",
        "enterprise_count",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("num_rows").desc(),
        "pro_effective_from_period_stddev_samp_tier_value_percent_rank_2",
    )
)
```

```python
w3 = Window.orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

    df_inventory
    .filter(F.col("last_restock") > F.lit("2023-07-17").cast("date"))
```

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(duration_sec * 1.15, 2) duration_sec_scaled,
        CAST(duration_sec AS STRING) duration_sec_num,
        COALESCE(page, 'UNKNOWN') page_filled
    FROM web_events
    WHERE page IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        event_time,
        duration_sec,
        page_filled,
        TO_DATE(event_time) event_time_date
    FROM valid
    WHERE page IS NOT NULL
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(duration_sec) OVER w_grp prev_duration_sec,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_grp event_seq,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(event_time_date), session_id) event_time_date_year_sum_duration_sec
    FROM filtered
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY event_time, id)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(event_time_date_year_sum_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last7_avg_event_time_date_year_sum_duration_sec,
        SUM(event_time_date_year_sum_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last7_sum_event_time_date_year_sum_duration_sec,
        MAX(event_time_date_year_sum_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last7_max_event_time_date_year_sum_duration_sec,
        AVG(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY prev_duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) event_seq_avg_6_prior
    FROM enriched
),
enriched_web_events AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_recent duration_sec_dense_rank,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY last7_avg_event_time_date_year_sum_duration_sec, id) last7_avg_event_time_date_year_sum_duration_sec_bucket,
        SUM(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id) session_id_sum_duration_sec
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY duration_sec DESC NULLS LAST)
),
stats AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', event_time_date) AS year_start,
        SUM(duration_sec_dense_rank) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'page_view') AS page_view_total_duration_sec_dense_rank,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(event_type)) AS num_event_types
    FROM enriched_web_events
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', event_time_date)
)
SELECT
    year_start,
    page_view_total_duration_sec_dense_rank,
    num_event_types
FROM stats;

```python
    .filter(F.col("page").isNotNull())

        F.round((F.col("duration_sec") * 1.15), 2).alias("duration_sec_scaled"),
```

    FROM with_dims s

        ON s.session_id = p.id
    WHERE p.started_at < '2025-05-01'

with_windows AS (

    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(event_time_hour) OVER (PARTITION BY session_device ORDER BY event_time_hour, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_event_time_hour,
        AVG(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY event_time_hour, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS duration_sec_avg_5_prior,

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, units + revenue AS revenue_per_unit
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2023-07-21'
),
remaining_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT product_id
    FROM cleaned
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT product_id
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE store_id = 5
),
kept_rows AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.product_id = k.product_id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach products attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.product_id,
        src.sale_date,
        src.units,
        d.cost,
        d.product_name,
        d.brand
    FROM kept_rows src
    LEFT JOIN products d
        ON src.product_id = d.id
),
cleaned_store_sales AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_DAY(sale_date) AS sale_date_month_end,
        COALESCE(brand, 'NONE') AS brand_filled
    FROM joined
    WHERE sale_date > DATE '2023-09-24'
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    product_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', sale_date) AS week_start,
    MAX(cost) AS max_cost,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN brand = 'Umbrella' THEN 1 END) AS umbrella_count,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(cost, 0.95) AS cost_p95,
    ROUND(AVG(units), 2) AS avg_units,
    BIT_AND(units) AS units_bit_and
FROM cleaned_store_sales
GROUP BY product_id, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', sale_date)
ORDER BY umbrella_count DESC NULLS LAST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("sale_date") >= F.lit("2023-07-21").cast("date"))
    .select("*", (F.col("units") + F.col("revenue")).alias("revenue_per_unit"))
)

remaining_keys = (
    cleaned
    .select("product_id")
    .subtract(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("store_id") == 5)
        .select("product_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

joined = (
    kept_rows
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("src.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.product_id",
        "src.sale_date",
        "src.units",
        F.col("d.cost"),
        F.col("d.product_name"),
        F.col("d.brand"),
    )
)

cleaned_store_sales = (
    joined
    .filter(F.col("sale_date") > F.lit("2023-09-24").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("sale_date_month_end", F.last_day("sale_date"))
    .withColumn("brand_filled", F.coalesce("brand", F.lit("NONE")))
)

result = (
    cleaned_store_sales
    .groupBy("product_id", F.date_trunc("WEEK", "sale_date").alias("week_start"))
    .agg(
        F.max("cost").alias("max_cost"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("brand") == "Umbrella", 1)).alias("umbrella_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("cost", 0.95).alias("cost_p95"),
        F.round(F.avg("units"), 2).alias("avg_units"),
        F.bit_and("units").alias("units_bit_and"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("umbrella_count").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

with cleaned as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        cost,
        date_trunc('month', delivered_date) delivered_date_period
    from shipments
    where carrier is distinct from 'FedEx'
      and carrier in ('DHL', 'UPS')
),
joined as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        a.id,
        a.order_id,
        a.shipped_date,
        a.cost,
        a.delivered_date_period,
        p.channel,
        p.amount
    from cleaned a
    inner join orders p
        on a.order_id = p.id
),
filtered as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        add_months(shipped_date, 6) shipped_date_plus_months,
        coalesce(channel, 'OTHER') resolved_channel
    from joined
    where order_id is not null
),
joined_shipments as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        s.id,
        s.order_id,
        s.cost,
        s.delivered_date_period,
        s.channel,
        s.amount,
        s.shipped_date_plus_months,
        s.resolved_channel,
        o.channel as order_channel
    from filtered s
    left join orders o
        on s.order_id <=> o.id
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    date_trunc('quarter', shipped_date_plus_months) as quarter_start,
    case when amount >= 1590 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as amount_tier,
    order_channel,
    min(delivered_date_period) as first_seen,
    count(case when channel = 'store' then 1 end) as store_count,
    (unix_timestamp(max(delivered_date_period)) - unix_timestamp(min(delivered_date_period))) / 60 as span_minutes,
    (unix_timestamp(max(delivered_date_period)) - unix_timestamp(min(delivered_date_period))) / 60 as span_minutes_2
from joined_shipments
group by quarter_start, amount_tier, order_channel
order by quarter_start desc nulls last
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

cleaned = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((~F.col("carrier").eqNullSafe(F.lit("FedEx"))) & F.col("carrier").isin(["DHL", "UPS"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "cost",
        F.date_trunc("month", "delivered_date").alias("delivered_date_period"),
    )
)

joined = (
    cleaned
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_orders.alias("p"), F.col("a.order_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.order_id",
        "a.shipped_date",
        "a.cost",
        "a.delivered_date_period",
        F.col("p.channel"),
        F.col("p.amount"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    joined
    .filter(F.col("order_id").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("shipped_date_plus_months", F.add_months("shipped_date", 6))
    .withColumn("resolved_channel", F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("OTHER")))
)

joined_shipments = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("o"), F.col("s.order_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("o.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.order_id",
        "s.cost",
        "s.delivered_date_period",
        "s.channel",
        "s.amount",
        "s.shipped_date_plus_months",
        "s.resolved_channel",
        F.col("o.channel").alias("order_channel"),
    )
)

result = (
    joined_shipments
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("quarter", "shipped_date_plus_months").alias("quarter_start"),
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 1590, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("amount_tier"),
        "order_channel",
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("delivered_date_period").alias("first_seen"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("channel") == "store", 1)).alias("store_count"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("delivered_date_period")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("delivered_date_period"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes"),
        ((F.unix_timestamp(F.max("delivered_date_period")) - F.unix_timestamp(F.min("delivered_date_period"))) / 60).alias("span_minutes_2"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("quarter_start").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

WITH deduped AS (
    SELECT id, dept_name
    FROM departments
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY budget, id) = 1
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *, LOWER(dept_name) AS dept_name_lower
    FROM deduped
    WHERE dept_name IS NOT NULL
),
not_flagged AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees ch
            WHERE ch.dept_id = s.id
              AND ch.is_remote
        )
),
filtered_departments AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(dept_name) AS dept_name_upper,
        CASE WHEN dept_name = 'HR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_hr,
        COALESCE(dept_name, 'NONE') AS resolved_dept_name
    FROM not_flagged
    WHERE dept_name = 'HR'
)
SELECT
    dept_name,
    CASE WHEN is_hr >= 74 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS is_hr_tier,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN dept_name = 'Engineering' THEN 1 END) AS engineering_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dept_name = 'Legal') AS legal_rows,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS row_count_rank
FROM filtered_departments
GROUP BY dept_name, CASE WHEN is_hr >= 74 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("row_count").desc())

deduped = (
    df_departments
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "dept_name")
)

filtered = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("dept_name").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("dept_name_lower", F.lower("dept_name"))
)

not_flagged = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.dept_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.is_remote")), "left_anti")
)

filtered_departments = (
    not_flagged
    .filter(F.col("dept_name") == "HR")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.upper("dept_name").alias("dept_name_upper"),
        F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "HR", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_hr"),
        F.coalesce("dept_name", F.lit("NONE")).alias("resolved_dept_name"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered_departments
    .groupBy(
        "dept_name",
        F.when(F.col("is_hr") >= 74, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("is_hr_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "Engineering", 1)).alias("engineering_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("dept_name") == "Legal", 1)).alias("legal_rows"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
    )
    .withColumn("row_count_rank", F.rank().over(w2))
)
```

sql:
with lines as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        v
    from app_logs
    lateral view explode(context) li as attr_key, v
),
parsed as (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    select
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        shiftright(status_code, 2) as status_code_high,
        cast((status_code & 4) != 0 as int) as is_flagged
    from lines
),
deduped as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by service, attr_key order by is_flagged desc nulls first, id, attr_key) as rn
        from parsed
    ) ranked
    where rn = 1
),
ranked as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by level order by rn desc, id, attr_key) as rn_2
        from deduped
    ) x
    where rn_2 = 1
),
metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        status_code_high,
        rn,
        rn_2,
        cume_dist() over w_hist as is_flagged_cume_dist,
        first_value(attr_key) ignore nulls over (partition by date_trunc('WEEK', log_ts), level order by is_flagged, id, attr_key rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_attr_key,
        lead(status_code_high, 1, 0) over (partition by service order by rn, id, attr_key) as next_status_code_high
    from ranked
    window w_hist as (partition by attr_key, service order by is_flagged desc)
),
filtered as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        *,
        status_code_high + next_status_code_high as status_code_high_plus_next_status_code_high,
        coalesce(attr_key, 'N/A') as attr_key_clean
    from metrics
    where attr_key is distinct from 'version'
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    attr_key,
    min(status_code_high_plus_next_status_code_high) as min_status_code_high_plus_next_status_code_high,
    count_if(attr_key = 'version') as version_events,
    max(is_flagged_cume_dist) filter (where attr_key = 'version') as version_max_is_flagged_cume_dist
from filtered
group by attr_key
order by version_max_is_flagged_cume_dist desc nulls first;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("service", "attr_key").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").desc_nulls_first(), "id", "attr_key")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("rn").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("attr_key", "service").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").desc())
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "log_ts"), "level").orderBy("is_flagged", "id", "attr_key").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("rn", "id", "attr_key")

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("attr_key", "v"),
    )
)

parsed = (
    lines
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(4) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    parsed
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

ranked = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rn_2", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn_2") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    ranked
    .select(
        "id",
        "status_code",
        "attr_key",
        "status_code_high",
        "rn",
        "rn_2",
        F.cume_dist().over(w_hist).alias("is_flagged_cume_dist"),
        F.first("attr_key", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("first_known_attr_key"),
        F.lead("status_code_high", 1, 0).over(w5).alias("next_status_code_high"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    metrics
    .filter(~F.col("attr_key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("version")))
    .withColumn("status_code_high_plus_next_status_code_high", (F.col("status_code_high") + F.col("next_status_code_high")))
    .withColumn("attr_key_clean", F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("N/A")))
)

result = (
    filtered
    .groupBy("attr_key")
    .agg(
        F.min("status_code_high_plus_next_status_code_high").alias("min_status_code_high_plus_next_status_code_high"),
        F.count_if(F.col("attr_key") == "version").alias("version_events"),
        F.max(F.when(F.col("attr_key") == "version", F.col("is_flagged_cume_dist"))).alias("version_max_is_flagged_cume_dist"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("version_max_is_flagged_cume_dist").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

WITH kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT device_code, id
    FROM device_readings
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT device_code, id
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE pressure BETWEEN 992 AND 1010
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM device_readings s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.device_code = k.device_code AND s.id = k.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    reading_ts,
    pressure
FROM reconciled
ORDER BY reading_ts DESC NULLS LAST

```python
    df_device_readings
    .select("device_code", "id")
    .subtract(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("pressure").between(992, 1010))
        .select("device_code", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    df_device_readings
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.device_code") == F.col("k.device_code")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .select("id", "reading_ts", "pressure")
    .orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

WITH kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM customers s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM accounts x
            WHERE x.customer_id = s.id
              AND x.opened_date >= s.signup_date
        )
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        email,
        city,
        segment,
        is_active,
        age,
        CORR(age, credit_limit) OVER (PARTITION BY city, segment) corr_age_credit_limit,
        ROUND(age / SUM(age) OVER (PARTITION BY country), 4) age_share,
        CORR(credit_limit, age) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(signup_date)) corr_credit_limit_age
    FROM kept
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY corr_age_credit_limit, id) seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY age_share, id) event_seq,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY age_share) age_share_rank
    FROM metrics
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        city,
        segment,
        corr_age_credit_limit,
        age_share,
        corr_credit_limit_age,
        event_seq
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY age_share_rank NULLS FIRST, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM enriched
    ) x
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT city
    FROM ranked
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT city
    FROM customers
    WHERE age < 47
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM ranked s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.city = k.city
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM reconciled s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders ch
            WHERE ch.customer_id = s.id
              AND ch.order_date >= '2025-04-01'
        )
),
wide AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            city,
            segment,
            event_seq
        FROM eligible
    ) src
    PIVOT (
        MAX(event_seq) AS value_sum
        FOR segment IN ('Consumer' AS consumer, 'Corporate' AS corporate)
    )
)
SELECT city, CASE WHEN city RLIKE '^(Singapore|Berlin)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' WHEN city RLIKE '^(Bangkok|Chiang Mai)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS city_zone
FROM wide;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("city", "segment")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("country")
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("signup_date"))
w4 = Window.orderBy("corr_age_credit_limit", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("age_share", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("age_share")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("segment").orderBy(F.col("age_share_rank").asc_nulls_first(), "id")

kept = (
    df_customers
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("x"), (F.col("x.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.opened_date") >= F.col("s.signup_date")), "left_anti")
)

metrics = (
    kept
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "email",
        "city",
        "segment",
        "is_active",
        "age",
        F.corr("age", "credit_limit").over(w).alias("corr_age_credit_limit"),
        F.round((F.col("age") / F.sum("age").over(w2)), 4).alias("age_share"),
        F.corr("credit_limit", "age").over(w3).alias("corr_credit_limit_age"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(w5).alias("event_seq"),
        F.rank().over(w6).alias("age_share_rank"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "name",
        "city",
        "segment",
        "corr_age_credit_limit",
        "age_share",
        "corr_credit_limit_age",
        "event_seq",
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    ranked
    .select("city")
    .subtract(
        df_customers
        .filter(F.col("age") < 47)
        .select("city")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    ranked
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.city") == F.col("k.city")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

eligible = (
    reconciled
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_orders.alias("ch"), (F.col("ch.customer_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("ch.order_date") >= "2025-04-01"), "left_semi")
)

wide = (
    eligible
    .groupBy("city")
    .pivot("segment", ["Consumer", "Corporate"])
    .agg(F.max("event_seq").alias("value_sum"))
    .select(
        "city",
        F.col("Consumer").alias("consumer"),
        F.col("Corporate").alias("corporate"),
    )
)

result = (
    wide
    .select(
        "city",
        F.when(F.col("city").rlike("^(Singapore|Berlin)$"), "GROUP_A").when(F.col("city").rlike("^(Bangkok|Chiang Mai)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("city_zone"),
    )
)
```

```python
        "full_name",

        "manager_id",
        "job_title",
        "hire_date",
```

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(monthly_fee, 1) AS monthly_fee_rounded
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE end_date >= DATE '2023-04-25'
      AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
latest AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status, customer_id ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM filtered
    ) x
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', end_date) AS end_date_period
    FROM latest
    WHERE end_date > TO_DATE('2023-10-08')
),
filtered_subscriptions AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        monthly_fee_rounded,
        end_date_period,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', start_date) AS start_date_period,
        dedup_rank - monthly_fee_rounded AS dedup_rank_minus_monthly_fee_rounded
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE customer_id IS NULL
      AND end_date >= TO_DATE('2023-05-23')
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', end_date_period) AS year_start,
    ROUND(AVG(dedup_rank_minus_monthly_fee_rounded), 2) AS avg_dedup_rank_minus_monthly_fee_rounded,
    ROUND(SUM(monthly_fee_rounded) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'premium' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS monthly_fee_rounded_per_premium,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(plan)) AS num_plans,
    COUNT_IF(plan = 'enterprise') AS enterprise_events,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(plan)) AS num_plans_2
FROM filtered_subscriptions
GROUP BY 1
reference:

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status", "customer_id").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter((F.col("end_date") >= F.lit("2023-04-25").cast("date")) & F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select("*", F.round("monthly_fee", 1).alias("monthly_fee_rounded"))
)

latest = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

cleaned = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("end_date") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-10-08")))
    .withColumn("end_date_period", F.date_trunc("YEAR", "end_date"))
)

filtered_subscriptions = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNull() & (F.col("end_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-23"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",
        "monthly_fee_rounded",
        "end_date_period",
        F.date_trunc("year", "start_date").alias("start_date_period"),
        (F.col("dedup_rank") - F.col("monthly_fee_rounded")).alias("dedup_rank_minus_monthly_fee_rounded"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered_subscriptions
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "end_date_period").alias("year_start"))
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("dedup_rank_minus_monthly_fee_rounded"), 2).alias("avg_dedup_rank_minus_monthly_fee_rounded"),
        F.round(F.sum("monthly_fee_rounded") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "premium", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("monthly_fee_rounded_per_premium"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("plan")).alias("num_plans"),
        F.count_if(F.col("plan") == "enterprise").alias("enterprise_events"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("plan")).alias("num_plans_2"),
```

    JOIN customers d
        ON src.customer_id = d.id

        ON e.customer_id = b.id

),
enriched_carts_2 AS (

    FROM enriched_carts a

        ON a.customer_id = d.id

    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.name,
        s.customer_email,

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        units - revenue AS revenue_per_unit,
        ADD_MONTHS(sale_date, 1) AS sale_date_plus_months
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE sale_date >= TO_DATE('2023-09-17')
      AND product_id IN (5, 8, 9)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        MAX(units) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue_per_unit, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_units,
        COUNT(units) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue_per_unit, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_units,
        SUM(units) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY revenue_per_unit, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_units
    FROM cleaned
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(running_sum_units) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_running_sum_units,
        LAST_VALUE(running_max_units) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(sale_date), product_id ORDER BY units, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_running_max_units,
        FIRST_VALUE(revenue, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_revenue,
        LEAD(revenue_per_unit, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', sale_date_plus_months), store_id ORDER BY units, id) AS next_revenue_per_unit,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY units DESC, id) AS row_seq
    FROM metrics
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY sale_date DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS rn
        FROM enriched
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.store_id,
        a.sale_date,
        a.units,
        a.revenue,
        a.sale_date_plus_months,
        a.running_count_units,
        a.last_known_running_sum_units,
        a.first_known_revenue,
        a.row_seq,
        a.rn,
        p.sqft
    FROM deduped a
    LEFT JOIN stores p
        ON a.store_id = p.id
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    store_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    MAX(units) AS max_units
FROM joined
GROUP BY store_id;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("revenue_per_unit", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("units", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("sale_date"), "product_id").orderBy("units", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy("revenue", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "sale_date_plus_months"), "store_id").orderBy("units", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("units").desc(), "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("sale_date").desc_nulls_first(), "id")

cleaned = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter((F.col("sale_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-09-17"))) & F.col("product_id").isin([5, 8, 9]))
    .withColumn("revenue_per_unit", (F.col("units") - F.col("revenue")))
    .withColumn("sale_date_plus_months", F.add_months("sale_date", 1))
)

metrics = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("running_max_units", F.max("units").over(w))
    .withColumn("running_count_units", F.count("units").over(w))
    .withColumn("running_sum_units", F.sum("units").over(w))
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "*",
        F.last("running_sum_units", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_running_sum_units"),
        F.last("running_max_units", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("last_known_running_max_units"),
        F.first("revenue", ignorenulls=True).over(w4).alias("first_known_revenue"),
        F.lead("revenue_per_unit", 1).over(w5).alias("next_revenue_per_unit"),
        F.row_number().over(w6).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

joined = (
    deduped
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_stores.alias("p"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.store_id",
        "a.sale_date",
        "a.units",
        "a.revenue",
        "a.sale_date_plus_months",
        "a.running_count_units",
        "a.last_known_running_sum_units",
        "a.first_known_revenue",
        "a.row_seq",
        "a.rn",
        F.col("p.sqft"),
    )
)

result = (
    joined
    .groupBy("store_id")
    .agg(
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.max("units").alias("max_units"),
    )
)
```

sql:
WITH unpacked AS (
    -- Struct fields, map lookups and JSON extraction
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        tier_limits,
        tier_prices,
        discounts,
        ELEMENT_AT(tier_prices, 1) AS entry_price,
        ARRAY_MIN(tier_prices) AS lowest_price,
        TRANSFORM(tier_prices, (p, i) -> ROUND(p * tier_limits[i], 2)) AS tier_revenue_caps,
        ZIP_WITH(tier_prices, discounts, (p, d) -> ROUND(p * (1 - d), 2)) AS net_prices
    FROM price_tiers
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', effective_from) AS quarter_start,
    CASE WHEN lowest_price >= 36 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS lowest_price_tier,
    MAX(entry_price) AS max_entry_price,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(currency)) AS num_currencies,
    SUM(CASE WHEN plan = 'starter' THEN lowest_price ELSE 0 END) AS starter_lowest_price,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows
FROM unpacked
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', effective_from), CASE WHEN lowest_price >= 36 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END
ORDER BY quarter_start NULLS LAST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

unpacked = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        "tier_limits",
        "tier_prices",
        "discounts",
        F.element_at("tier_prices", 1).alias("entry_price"),
        F.array_min("tier_prices").alias("lowest_price"),
        F.transform("tier_prices", lambda p, i: F.round(p * F.col("tier_limits")[i], 2)).alias("tier_revenue_caps"),
        F.zip_with("tier_prices", "discounts", lambda p, d: F.round(p * (1 - d), 2)).alias("net_prices"),
    )
)

result = (
    unpacked
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "effective_from").alias("quarter_start"),
        F.when(F.col("lowest_price") >= 36, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("lowest_price_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.max("entry_price").alias("max_entry_price"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("currency")).alias("num_currencies"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("plan") == "starter", F.col("lowest_price")).otherwise(0)).alias("starter_lowest_price"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("quarter_start").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        effective_from,
        currency,
        EXPLODE_OUTER(tier_limits) AS tier_value
    FROM price_tiers
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        currency,
        tier_value,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value DESC NULLS FIRST) AS tier_value_cume_dist,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY currency ORDER BY tier_value DESC) AS tier_value_percent_rank
    FROM exploded
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, tier_value_percent_rank * tier_value AS tier_value_percent_rank_times_tier_value
    FROM enriched
    WHERE tier_value BETWEEN 41 AND 54
),
cleaned_price_tiers AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, CAST(tier_value_percent_rank AS INT) AS tier_value_percent_rank_int
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE tier_value_percent_rank <= 0.63
)
SELECT
    tier_value,
    tier_value_cume_dist,
    tier_value_percent_rank,
    tier_value_percent_rank_times_tier_value,
    tier_value_percent_rank_int
FROM cleaned_price_tiers
ORDER BY tier_value_percent_rank_int DESC;
reference:

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("currency").orderBy(F.col("tier_value").desc())

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select(
        "id",
        "effective_from",
        "currency",
        F.explode_outer("tier_limits").alias("tier_value"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    exploded
    .select(
        "currency",
        "tier_value",
        F.cume_dist().over(w).alias("tier_value_cume_dist"),
        F.percent_rank().over(w2).alias("tier_value_percent_rank"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("tier_value").between(41, 54))
    .withColumn("tier_value_percent_rank_times_tier_value", (F.col("tier_value_percent_rank") * F.col("tier_value")))
)

cleaned_price_tiers = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("tier_value_percent_rank") <= 0.63)
    .withColumn("tier_value_percent_rank_int", F.col("tier_value_percent_rank").cast("int"))
)

result = (
    cleaned_price_tiers
    .select(
        "tier_value",
        "tier_value_cume_dist",
        "tier_value_percent_rank",
        "tier_value_percent_rank_times_tier_value",
        "tier_value_percent_rank_int",

)
```

```python
w = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
```

        avg(balance) over w_part running_avg_balance,
        min(balance) over w_part running_min_balance,
        dense_rank() over w_recent balance_dense_rank
    from accounts
    window w_part as (partition by customer_id, status order by balance, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row), w_recent as (partition by customer_id order by balance nulls last)

    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by account_type, status order by balance_dense_rank desc, id) as rank_in_group
        from enriched
    ) t
    where rank_in_group = 1

kept as (

    select s.*
    from deduped s
    where not exists (
            select 1
            from transactions c
            where c.account_id = s.id
              and c.txn_time >= s.opened_date
        )
),
enriched_accounts as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        lag(balance_dense_rank) over (partition by customer_id, account_type order by opened_date, id) prev_balance_dense_rank,
        lead(running_max_balance) over (partition by customer_id, account_type order by opened_date, id) next_running_max_balance,
        lag(running_max_balance) over (partition by customer_id, account_type order by opened_date, id) prev_running_max_balance,

    from kept

    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select *, rank() over (partition by status, plan order by rank_in_group desc) as dedup_rank
    from attributed

ranked as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *
    from latest
    qualify row_number() over (partition by plan order by next_running_max_balance desc, id, subscription_id) = 1

pivoted as (
    -- Native SQL PIVOT
    select *
    from (
        select
            status,
            plan,
            account_type,
            next_running_max_balance
        from ranked
    ) src
    pivot (
        max(next_running_max_balance) as total,
        count(1) as cnt
        for account_type in ('SAVINGS' as savings, 'LOAN' as loan)
    )

    status,
    plan,
    savings_total,
    savings_cnt,
    loan_total,
    loan_cnt,
    case when plan rlike '^(standard|enterprise)$' then 'EXTENDED' when plan rlike '^(basic|premium)$' then 'GROUP_A' else 'GROUP_B' end as plan_zone
from pivoted
order by plan desc nulls last, savings_cnt desc

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "status").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("balance").asc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("account_type", "status").orderBy(F.col("balance_dense_rank").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "account_type").orderBy("opened_date", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("status", "plan").orderBy(F.col("rank_in_group").desc())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("next_running_max_balance").desc(), "id", "subscription_id")

enriched = (
    df_accounts
    .withColumn("running_count_balance", F.count("balance").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_max_balance", F.max("balance").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_avg_balance", F.avg("balance").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("running_min_balance", F.min("balance").over(w_part))
    .withColumn("balance_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w_recent))
)

deduped = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

kept = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("c"), (F.col("c.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.txn_time") >= F.col("s.opened_date")), "left_anti")
)

enriched_accounts = (
    kept
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isin([5, 34, 35, 38]))
    .withColumn("prev_balance_dense_rank", F.lag("balance_dense_rank").over(w4))
    .withColumn("next_running_max_balance", F.lead("running_max_balance").over(w4))
    .withColumn("prev_running_max_balance", F.lag("running_max_balance").over(w4))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w4))
)

attributed = (
    enriched_accounts
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_subscriptions.alias("sub"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("sub.customer_id")) & (F.col("s.opened_date") >= F.col("sub.start_date")) & (F.col("s.opened_date") <= F.date_add(F.col("sub.end_date"), 7)), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("sub.id").alias("subscription_id"),
        F.col("sub.plan"),
        F.col("sub.monthly_fee"),
    )
)

latest = (
    attributed
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

ranked = (
    latest
    .withColumn("dedup_rank_2", F.row_number().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank_2") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank_2")
)

pivoted = (
    ranked
    .groupBy("status", "plan")
    .pivot("account_type", ["SAVINGS", "LOAN"])
    .agg(
        F.max("next_running_max_balance").alias("total"),
        F.count(F.lit(1)).alias("cnt"),
    )
    .select(
        "status",
        "plan",
        F.col("SAVINGS_total").alias("savings_total"),
        F.col("SAVINGS_cnt").alias("savings_cnt"),
        F.col("LOAN_total").alias("loan_total"),
        F.col("LOAN_cnt").alias("loan_cnt"),
    )
)

result = (
    pivoted
    .select(
        "status",
        "plan",
        "savings_total",
        "savings_cnt",
        "loan_total",
        "loan_cnt",
        F.when(F.col("plan").rlike("^(standard|enterprise)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("plan").rlike("^(basic|premium)$"), "GROUP_A").otherwise("GROUP_B").alias("plan_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("plan").desc_nulls_last(), F.col("savings_cnt").desc())
)
```

with flattened as (
    select
        id,
        effective_from,
        explode(tier_limits) as val
    from price_tiers
),
kept_keys as (
    select id
    from flattened
    except
    select id
    from price_tiers
    where plan in ('basic', 'pro', 'enterprise')
),
kept_rows as (
    select s.*
    from flattened s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.id = k.id
),
base as (
    select *, date_add(effective_from, 65) as effective_from_plus_65d
    from kept_rows
    where effective_from >= date '2024-06-02'
),
enriched as (
    select
        id,
        effective_from,
        dense_rank() over w_part as val_dense_rank,
        cume_dist() over w_recent as val_cume_dist,
        rank() over w_recent_2 as val_rank,
        dense_rank() over w_recent as val_dense_rank_2,
        dense_rank() over (order by val desc nulls last) as val_dense_rank_3
    from base
    window w_part as (order by val asc), w_recent as (order by val desc), w_recent_2 as (order by val asc nulls first)
)
select
    case when val_dense_rank_2 >= 7 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as val_dense_rank_2_tier,
    date_trunc('year', effective_from) as year_start,
    sum(val_rank) as total_val_rank,
    count(*) as num_rows,
    count(*) as cnt,
    min(val_rank) as min_val_rank
from enriched
group by 1, 2
having cnt > 1

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_part = Window.orderBy("val")
w_recent = Window.orderBy(F.col("val").desc())
w_recent_2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("val").asc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("val").desc_nulls_last())

flattened = df_price_tiers.select("id", "effective_from", F.explode("tier_limits").alias("val"))

kept_keys = (
    flattened
    .select("id")
    .subtract(
        df_price_tiers
        .filter(F.col("plan").isin(["basic", "pro", "enterprise"]))
        .select("id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    flattened
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

base = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("effective_from") >= F.lit("2024-06-02").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("effective_from_plus_65d", F.date_add("effective_from", 65))
)

enriched = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "effective_from",
        F.dense_rank().over(w_part).alias("val_dense_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_recent).alias("val_cume_dist"),
        F.rank().over(w_recent_2).alias("val_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_recent).alias("val_dense_rank_2"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w4).alias("val_dense_rank_3"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("val_dense_rank_2") >= 7, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("val_dense_rank_2_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("year", "effective_from").alias("year_start"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum("val_rank").alias("total_val_rank"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.min("val_rank").alias("min_val_rank"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("cnt") > 1)
)
```

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT *, CONCAT(device_code, ' ', firmware) AS device_code_firmware
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts > DATE '2025-09-01'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts DESC, id) = 1
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        pressure + status_bits AS pressure_plus_status_bits,
        pressure + humidity AS pressure_plus_humidity
    FROM ranked
    WHERE device_code NOT IN ('DV-03', 'DV-02', 'DV-01')
),
with_gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN reading_ts - LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) > INTERVAL '20' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM base
),
sessionized AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT device_code, id
    FROM sessionized
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT device_code, id
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE firmware NOT IN ('1.1.0', '2.0.1')
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM sessionized s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.device_code = k.device_code AND s.id = k.id
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        device_code_firmware,
        pressure_plus_humidity,
        session_start_flag,
        island_id,
        ROUND(humidity / SUM(humidity) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', reading_ts)), 4) AS humidity_share,
        MIN(temp_c) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code) AS device_code_min_temp_c,
        MAX(humidity) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS humidity_max_1h
    FROM verified
    WHERE humidity > 65
),
valid AS (
    SELECT *, pressure + humidity_max_1h AS pressure_plus_humidity_max_1h
    FROM enriched
    WHERE session_start_flag = 0
)
SELECT
    id,
    device_code_firmware,
    pressure_plus_humidity,
    humidity_share,
    device_code_min_temp_c,
    humidity_max_1h,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pressure_plus_humidity_max_1h NULLS LAST) AS pressure_plus_humidity_max_1h_percent_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY device_code_min_temp_c DESC NULLS FIRST) AS device_code_min_temp_c_dense_rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pressure) AS pressure_rank,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY humidity_share DESC NULLS FIRST) AS humidity_share_cume_dist
FROM valid;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "reading_ts"))
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device_code")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("pressure_plus_humidity_max_1h").asc_nulls_last())
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("device_code_min_temp_c").desc_nulls_first())
w9 = Window.orderBy("pressure")
w10 = Window.orderBy(F.col("humidity_share").desc_nulls_first())

cleaned = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") > F.lit("2025-09-01").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.concat("device_code", F.lit(" "), "firmware").alias("device_code_firmware"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .drop("rank_in_group")
)

base = (
    ranked
    .filter(~F.col("device_code").isin(["DV-03", "DV-02", "DV-01"]))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("pressure") + F.col("status_bits")).alias("pressure_plus_status_bits"),
        (F.col("pressure") + F.col("humidity")).alias("pressure_plus_humidity"),
    )
)

with_gaps = (
    base
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.col("reading_ts") - F.lag("reading_ts").over(w2) > F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES"), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessionized = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w3))

remaining_keys = (
    sessionized
    .select("device_code", "id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(~F.col("firmware").isin(["1.1.0", "2.0.1"]))
        .select("device_code", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    sessionized
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.device_code") == F.col("k.device_code")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("humidity") > 65)
    .select(
        "id",
        "humidity",
        "pressure",
        "device_code_firmware",
        "pressure_plus_humidity",
        "session_start_flag",
        "island_id",
        F.round((F.col("humidity") / F.sum("humidity").over(w4)), 4).alias("humidity_share"),
        F.min("temp_c").over(w5).alias("device_code_min_temp_c"),
        F.max("humidity").over(w6).alias("humidity_max_1h"),
    )
)

valid = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("session_start_flag") == 0)
    .withColumn("pressure_plus_humidity_max_1h", (F.col("pressure") + F.col("humidity_max_1h")))
)

result = (
    valid
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code_firmware",
        "pressure_plus_humidity",
        "humidity_share",
        "device_code_min_temp_c",
        "humidity_max_1h",
        F.percent_rank().over(w7).alias("pressure_plus_humidity_max_1h_percent_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w8).alias("device_code_min_temp_c_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w9).alias("pressure_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w10).alias("humidity_share_cume_dist"),
    )
)
```

sql:
with base as (
    select
        *,
        add_months(sale_date, 12) as sale_date_plus_months,
        floor(units) as units_whole
    from store_sales
    where revenue <= 1500
),
metrics as (
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        sale_date_plus_months,
        units_whole,
        sum(revenue) over (partition by date_trunc('WEEK', sale_date_plus_months), product_id order by sale_date_plus_months, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_revenue,
        sum(revenue) over w_recent as running_revenue_2,
        sum(revenue) over (order by sale_date, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_revenue_3
    from base
    window w_recent as (partition by store_id order by sale_date_plus_months, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
base_store_sales as (
    select
        id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        sale_date_plus_months,
        units_whole,
        running_revenue,
        running_revenue_3,
        running_revenue_2 * units_whole as running_revenue_2_times_units_whole
    from metrics
    where sale_date <= '2023-11-01'
),
with_dims as (
    select
        e.id,
        e.product_id,
        e.sale_date,
        e.sale_date_plus_months,
        e.units_whole,
        e.running_revenue,
        e.running_revenue_3,
        e.running_revenue_2_times_units_whole,
        d.product_name
    from base_store_sales e
    inner join products d
        on e.product_id = d.id
    where d.price >= 450
),
metrics_store_sales as (
    select
        *,
        min(running_revenue) over w_recent as running_min_running_revenue,
        count(running_revenue) over w_recent as running_count_running_revenue,
        max(running_revenue) over w_recent as running_max_running_revenue,
        avg(running_revenue) over w_recent as running_avg_running_revenue,
        max(running_revenue_2_times_units_whole) over (partition by year(sale_date)) as sale_date_year_max_running_revenue_2_times_units_whole
    from with_dims
    window w_recent as (partition by product_id order by running_revenue_2_times_units_whole, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
)
select
    id,
    product_id,
    sale_date,
    sale_date_plus_months,
    running_revenue,
    product_name,
    running_min_running_revenue,
    running_count_running_revenue,
    running_max_running_revenue,
    lag(running_revenue_2_times_units_whole) over (partition by product_id order by running_revenue_3, id) as prev_running_revenue_2_times_units_whole,
    lag(running_min_running_revenue) over (partition by product_id order by running_revenue_3, id) as prev_running_min_running_revenue,
    row_number() over (partition by product_id order by running_revenue_3, id) as row_seq
from metrics_store_sales;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "sale_date_plus_months"), "product_id").orderBy("sale_date_plus_months", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy("sale_date_plus_months", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("sale_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("running_revenue_2_times_units_whole", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("sale_date"))
w6 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("running_revenue_3", "id")

base = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter(F.col("revenue") <= 1500)
    .withColumn("sale_date_plus_months", F.add_months("sale_date", 12))
    .withColumn("units_whole", F.floor("units"))
)

metrics = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "sale_date_plus_months",
        "units_whole",
        F.sum("revenue").over(w).alias("running_revenue"),
        F.sum("revenue").over(w_recent).alias("running_revenue_2"),
        F.sum("revenue").over(w3).alias("running_revenue_3"),
    )
)

base_store_sales = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("sale_date") <= "2023-11-01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "sale_date_plus_months",
        "units_whole",
        "running_revenue",
        "running_revenue_3",
        (F.col("running_revenue_2") * F.col("units_whole")).alias("running_revenue_2_times_units_whole"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    base_store_sales
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("d"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("d.price") >= 450)
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.product_id",
        "e.sale_date",
        "e.sale_date_plus_months",
        "e.units_whole",
        "e.running_revenue",
        "e.running_revenue_3",
        "e.running_revenue_2_times_units_whole",
        F.col("d.product_name"),
    )
)

metrics_store_sales = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("running_revenue").over(w4).alias("running_min_running_revenue"),
        F.count("running_revenue").over(w4).alias("running_count_running_revenue"),
        F.max("running_revenue").over(w4).alias("running_max_running_revenue"),
        F.avg("running_revenue").over(w4).alias("running_avg_running_revenue"),
        F.max("running_revenue_2_times_units_whole").over(w5).alias("sale_date_year_max_running_revenue_2_times_units_whole"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics_store_sales
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "sale_date_plus_months",
        "running_revenue",
        "product_name",
        "running_min_running_revenue",
        "running_count_running_revenue",
        "running_max_running_revenue",
        F.lag("running_revenue_2_times_units_whole").over(w6).alias("prev_running_revenue_2_times_units_whole"),
        F.lag("running_min_running_revenue").over(w6).alias("prev_running_min_running_revenue"),
        F.row_number().over(w6).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)
```

WITH exploded AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(context) x AS k, value
),
flattened_attrs AS (
    -- Semi-structured parsing
    SELECT
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        value,
        CAST((status_code & 2) != 0 AS INT) AS is_flagged,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high
    FROM exploded
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        service,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        value,
        is_flagged,
        ROUND(latency_ms, 0) latency_ms_rounded,
        SUBSTRING(service, 1, 2) service_prefix
    FROM flattened_attrs
    WHERE log_ts >= DATE '2025-06-01'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY level ORDER BY latency_ms DESC) latency_ms_cume_dist,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY is_flagged DESC NULLS LAST) is_flagged_rank,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service, level ORDER BY is_flagged ASC NULLS FIRST) is_flagged_rank_2
    FROM base
),
base_app_logs AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, TO_DATE(log_ts) log_ts_date
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE log_ts > TO_TIMESTAMP('2025-06-01 04:00:00')
)
-- Ranking and gap features
SELECT
    service,
    latency_ms,
    latency_ms_rounded,
    service_prefix,
    latency_ms_cume_dist,
    is_flagged_rank,
    log_ts_date,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY latency_ms_rounded ASC) latency_ms_rounded_rank,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY latency_ms_cume_dist DESC NULLS LAST) latency_ms_cume_dist_dense_rank,
    SUM(latency_ms_rounded) OVER (PARTITION BY service) service_sum_latency_ms_rounded
FROM base_app_logs
WHERE latency_ms IS NOT NULL;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("level").orderBy(F.col("latency_ms").desc())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").desc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.partitionBy("service", "level").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged").asc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("latency_ms_rounded")
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("latency_ms_cume_dist").desc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.partitionBy("service")

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("k", "value"),
    )
)

flattened_attrs = (
    exploded
    .select(
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "value",
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(2) != 0).cast("int").alias("is_flagged"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

base = (
    flattened_attrs
    .filter(F.col("log_ts") >= F.lit("2025-06-01").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "value",
        "is_flagged",
        F.round("latency_ms", 0).alias("latency_ms_rounded"),
        F.substring("service", 1, 2).alias("service_prefix"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base
    .withColumn("latency_ms_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_rank", F.rank().over(w2))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_rank_2", F.rank().over(w3))
)

base_app_logs = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("log_ts") > F.to_timestamp(F.lit("2025-06-01 04:00:00")))
    .select("*", F.to_date("log_ts").alias("log_ts_date"))
)

result = (
    base_app_logs
    .filter(F.col("latency_ms").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "service",
        "latency_ms",
        "latency_ms_rounded",
        "service_prefix",
        "latency_ms_cume_dist",
        "is_flagged_rank",
        "log_ts_date",
        F.rank().over(w4).alias("latency_ms_rounded_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("latency_ms_cume_dist_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("latency_ms_rounded").over(w6).alias("service_sum_latency_ms_rounded"),
    )
)
```

WITH metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        ROUND(units / SUM(units) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id), 4) AS units_share,
        LAG(revenue, 2) OVER w_part AS prev_revenue,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY units NULLS FIRST) AS units_rank,
        AVG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY sale_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS revenue_avg_2
    FROM store_sales
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('week', sale_date), product_id ORDER BY sale_date, id)
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.product_id,
        e.prev_revenue,
        p.launch_date,
        p.price
    FROM metrics e
    JOIN products p
        ON e.product_id = p.id
    WHERE p.product_name LIKE 'Lap%'
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        prev_revenue,
        launch_date,
        price,
        SUM(prev_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY prev_revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_prev_revenue,
        SUM(prev_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_prev_revenue,
        LEAD(price, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(launch_date), product_id ORDER BY prev_revenue, id) AS next_price,
        LAST_VALUE(price) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_price,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY price, id) AS price_bucket
    FROM enriched
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.product_id,
        e.price,
        e.cumulative_prev_revenue,
        e.last_known_price,
        e.price_bucket,
        p.category,
        p.stock_qty,
        p.launch_date AS product_launch_date
    FROM with_windows e
    JOIN products p
        ON e.product_id = p.id
),
metrics_store_sales AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_hist AS price_dense_rank,
        SUM(last_known_price) OVER w_running AS running_last_known_price,
        CUME_DIST() OVER w_running_2 AS stock_qty_cume_dist
    FROM joined
    WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY price NULLS FIRST), w_running AS (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY stock_qty, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_running_2 AS (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY stock_qty NULLS FIRST)
)
SELECT
    *,
    SUM(stock_qty_cume_dist) OVER (ORDER BY last_known_price, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_stock_qty_cume_dist,
    AVG(stock_qty) OVER w_running AS stock_qty_avg_5_prior,
    ROUND(running_last_known_price / SUM(running_last_known_price) OVER (PARTITION BY category), 4) AS running_last_known_price_share
FROM metrics_store_sales
WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY running_last_known_price, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING);

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id")
w_part = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("week", "sale_date"), "product_id").orderBy("sale_date", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("units").asc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.orderBy("sale_date", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("prev_revenue", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("launch_date"), "product_id").orderBy("prev_revenue", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("price", "id")
w_hist = Window.orderBy(F.col("price").asc_nulls_first())
w_running = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy("stock_qty", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_running_2 = Window.partitionBy("category").orderBy(F.col("stock_qty").asc_nulls_first())
w12 = Window.orderBy("last_known_price", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w13 = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("running_last_known_price", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w14 = Window.partitionBy("category")

metrics = (
    df_store_sales
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        F.round((F.col("units") / F.sum("units").over(w)), 4).alias("units_share"),
        F.lag("revenue", 2).over(w_part).alias("prev_revenue"),
        F.rank().over(w3).alias("units_rank"),
        F.avg("revenue").over(w4).alias("revenue_avg_2"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("p.product_name").like("Lap%"))
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.product_id",
        "e.prev_revenue",
        F.col("p.launch_date"),
        F.col("p.price"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "id",
        "product_id",
        "prev_revenue",
        "launch_date",
        "price",
        F.sum("prev_revenue").over(w5).alias("cumulative_prev_revenue"),
        F.sum("prev_revenue").over(w6).alias("running_prev_revenue"),
        F.lead("price", 2).over(w7).alias("next_price"),
        F.last("price", ignorenulls=True).over(w6).alias("last_known_price"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w8).alias("price_bucket"),
    )
)

joined = (
    with_windows
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_products.alias("p"), F.col("e.product_id") == F.col("p.id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "e.id",
        "e.product_id",
        "e.price",
        "e.cumulative_prev_revenue",
        "e.last_known_price",
        "e.price_bucket",
        F.col("p.category"),
        F.col("p.stock_qty"),
        F.col("p.launch_date").alias("product_launch_date"),
    )
)

metrics_store_sales = (
    joined
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w_hist).alias("price_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("last_known_price").over(w_running).alias("running_last_known_price"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_running_2).alias("stock_qty_cume_dist"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics_store_sales
    .withColumn("running_stock_qty_cume_dist", F.sum("stock_qty_cume_dist").over(w12))
    .withColumn("stock_qty_avg_5_prior", F.avg("stock_qty").over(w13))
    .withColumn("running_last_known_price_share", F.round((F.col("running_last_known_price") / F.sum("running_last_known_price").over(w14)), 4))
)
```
