with flattened as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        customer_id,
        coupon_codes,
        pos,
        li_item.product_id,
        li_item.qty
    from carts
    lateral view outer posexplode(items) x as pos, li_item
),
flattened_carts as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select pos, code
    from flattened
    lateral view outer explode(coupon_codes) li as code
),
cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        case when code = 'VIP' then 1 else 0 end as is_vip,
        lower(code) as code_lower
    from flattened_carts
    where pos between 1 and 3
),
enriched as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select *, max(pos) over w_grp as code_max_pos
    from cleaned
    window w_grp as (partition by code)
),
base as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        upper(code) as code_upper,
        coalesce(code, 'DIRECT') as code_clean
    from enriched
    where code is not null
      and code_max_pos > 3
),
scored as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        pos,
        code,
        code_lower,
        code_max_pos,
        code_clean,
        min(pos) over (partition by code) as code_min_pos,
        percent_rank() over (partition by code order by code_max_pos desc) as code_max_pos_percent_rank,
        percent_rank() over (partition by code order by pos asc nulls last) as pos_percent_rank,
        cume_dist() over (partition by code order by code_max_pos asc) as code_max_pos_cume_dist,
        rank() over (order by code_max_pos asc nulls last) as code_max_pos_rank
    from base
)
select
    pos,
    code,
    code_lower,
    code_max_pos,
    code_clean,
    code_max_pos_percent_rank,
    code_max_pos_cume_dist,
    case when code rlike '^(VIP|WELCOME5)$' then 'GROUP_B' else 'OTHER_ZONE' end as code_zone
from scored
order by code_max_pos_cume_dist desc;

WITH eligible AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM sessions s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_type <> 'add_to_cart'
        )
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.customer_id,
        e.browser,
        c.segment
    FROM eligible e
    LEFT JOIN customers c
        ON e.customer_id <=> c.id
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM joined s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
              AND c.event_time < '2024-12-01'
        )
),
eligible_sessions AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND x.event_type IN ('add_to_cart', 'search')
        )
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    browser,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(segment)) AS segment_list,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(segment)) AS num_segments,
    COUNT(DISTINCT browser) AS distinct_browsers
FROM eligible_sessions
GROUP BY browser
HAVING SIZE(COLLECT_SET(segment)) < 1000
ORDER BY num_segments DESC

```python
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.event_type") != "add_to_cart"), "left_semi")

    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("e.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("c.id")), "left")

not_flagged = (
    joined
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("c.event_time") < "2024-12-01"), "left_anti")

    .join(df_web_events.alias("x"), (F.col("x.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.event_type").isin(["add_to_cart", "search"])), "left_anti")
)

    .groupBy("browser")
    .agg(
```

    from valid_device_readings
    except all

verified as (

    from valid_device_readings s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.firmware = k.firmware and s.id = k.id
),
valid_device_readings_2 as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        temp_c,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        pressure_filled,
        status_bits_adjusted,
        trim(firmware) clean_firmware
    from verified
    where status_bits between 11 and 12
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select *, dense_rank() over (order by status_bits_adjusted nulls last) status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank
    from valid_device_readings_2
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    case when status_bits_adjusted >= 75 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as status_bits_adjusted_tier,
    case when pressure_filled >= 70 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as pressure_filled_tier,
    case when status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank >= 9 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank_tier,
    bit_and(status_bits) as status_bits_bit_and,
    round(avg(status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank), 2) as avg_status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank,
    sum(status_bits) as total_status_bits,
    bit_and(status_bits) as status_bits_bit_and_2,
    percentile_approx(status_bits_adjusted, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as status_bits_adjusted_quartiles,
    avg(pressure_filled) as avg_pressure_filled
from metrics
group by 1, 2, 3
order by status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank_tier desc

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("status_bits_adjusted").asc_nulls_last())

valid = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("temp_c") >= 33)
    .select(
        "id",
        "temp_c",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        F.coalesce("pressure", F.lit(0)).alias("pressure_filled"),
    )
)

valid_device_readings = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("pressure_filled").between(68, 69))
    .withColumn("status_bits_adjusted", F.round((F.col("status_bits") * 0.9), 2))
)

matched_keys = (
    valid_device_readings
    .select("firmware", "id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("status_bits") == 8)
        .select("firmware", "id")
    )
)

verified = (
    valid_device_readings
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.firmware") == F.col("k.firmware")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

valid_device_readings_2 = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("status_bits").between(11, 12))
    .select(
        "temp_c",
        "status_bits",
        "firmware",
        "pressure_filled",
        "status_bits_adjusted",
        F.trim("firmware").alias("clean_firmware"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    valid_device_readings_2
    .withColumn("status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w))
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("status_bits_adjusted") >= 75, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("status_bits_adjusted_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("pressure_filled") >= 70, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("pressure_filled_tier"),
        F.when(F.col("status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank") >= 9, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.bit_and("status_bits").alias("status_bits_bit_and"),
        F.round(F.avg("status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank"), 2).alias("avg_status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("status_bits").alias("total_status_bits"),
        F.bit_and("status_bits").alias("status_bits_bit_and_2"),
        F.percentile_approx("status_bits_adjusted", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("status_bits_adjusted_quartiles"),
        F.avg("pressure_filled").alias("avg_pressure_filled"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("status_bits_adjusted_dense_rank_tier").desc())
)
```

        dim.category,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
        MAX(a.quantity) AS max_quantity,
        GROUPING_ID() AS gid
    FROM inventory a

sql:
WITH exploded AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS k, attr_value
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY host, service ORDER BY status_code, id, k) AS dedup_rank
    FROM exploded
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY host, service ORDER BY log_ts, id, k) AS rn
        FROM deduped
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(status_code) OVER w_hist AS prev_status_code,
        LEAD(status_code) OVER w_hist AS next_status_code,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist AS event_seq,
        COUNT(status_code) OVER (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY CAST(log_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7200 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS status_code_count_2h
    FROM ranked
    WHERE HOUR(log_ts) BETWEEN 9 AND 13
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY service ORDER BY status_code, id, k)
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY host, service ORDER BY prev_status_code NULLS FIRST, id, k) AS row_num
        FROM metrics
    ) x
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
stats AS (
    SELECT
        host,
        MIN(log_ts) AS started_at,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(host)) AS host_list
    FROM latest
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    host,
    started_at,
    host_list
FROM stats
ORDER BY started_at DESC
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("host", "service").orderBy("status_code", "id", "k")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("host", "service").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy("status_code", "id", "k")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("service").orderBy(F.col("log_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-7200, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("host", "service").orderBy(F.col("prev_status_code").asc_nulls_first(), "id", "k")

exploded = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    exploded
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

ranked = (
    deduped
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

metrics = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.hour("log_ts").between(9, 13))
    .withColumn("prev_status_code", F.lag("status_code").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("next_status_code", F.lead("status_code").over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("status_code_count_2h", F.count("status_code").over(w4))
)

latest = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w5))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

stats = (
    latest
    .groupBy("host")
    .agg(
        F.min("log_ts").alias("started_at"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("host")).alias("host_list"),
    )
)

result = (
    stats
    .select("host", "started_at", "host_list")
    .orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc())
)
```

WITH scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        paid_at,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS amount_avg_6_prior,
        AVG(amount) OVER w_part AS method_avg_amount
    FROM payments
    WINDOW w_part AS (PARTITION BY method)
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id) AS prev_paid_at
    FROM scored
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_paid_at IS NULL OR paid_at > prev_paid_at + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM with_prev
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY paid_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM flagged
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        is_new_burst + island_id AS is_new_burst_plus_island_id,
        island_id / NULLIF(is_new_burst, 0) AS island_id_per_is_new_burst
    FROM islands
    WHERE paid_at >= DATE '2023-06-27'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        amount_avg_6_prior,
        method_avg_amount,
        prev_paid_at,
        is_new_burst,
        is_new_burst_plus_island_id,
        island_id_per_is_new_burst,
        FIRST_VALUE(amount_avg_6_prior) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY is_new_burst, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_amount_avg_6_prior,
        LEAD(amount_avg_6_prior, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', prev_paid_at), order_id ORDER BY amount_avg_6_prior, id) AS next_amount_avg_6_prior,
        AVG(island_id) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id) AS order_id_avg_island_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(paid_at), order_id ORDER BY island_id, id) AS seq_no
    FROM cleaned
),
cleaned_payments AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, next_amount_avg_6_prior - is_new_burst_plus_island_id AS next_amount_avg_6_prior_minus_is_new_burst_plus_island_id
    FROM enriched
    WHERE is_new_burst < 1
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    id,
    metric_name,
    reading
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        is_new_burst_plus_island_id,
        island_id_per_is_new_burst
    FROM cleaned_payments
) src
UNPIVOT (
    reading FOR metric_name IN (is_new_burst_plus_island_id, island_id_per_is_new_burst)
) unp;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("method").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w_part = Window.partitionBy("method")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("is_new_burst", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "prev_paid_at"), "order_id").orderBy("amount_avg_6_prior", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("order_id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("paid_at"), "order_id").orderBy("island_id", "id")

scored = (
    df_payments
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "paid_at",
        F.avg("amount").over(w).alias("amount_avg_6_prior"),
        F.avg("amount").over(w_part).alias("method_avg_amount"),
    )
)

with_prev = scored.withColumn("prev_paid_at", F.lag("paid_at").over(w3))

flagged = (
    with_prev
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.col("prev_paid_at").isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.col("prev_paid_at") + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = flagged.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w4))

cleaned = (
    islands
    .filter(F.col("paid_at") >= F.lit("2023-06-27").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("is_new_burst") + F.col("island_id")).alias("is_new_burst_plus_island_id"),
        (F.col("island_id") / F.nullif("is_new_burst", F.lit(0))).alias("island_id_per_is_new_burst"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "amount_avg_6_prior",
        "method_avg_amount",
        "prev_paid_at",
        "is_new_burst",
        "is_new_burst_plus_island_id",
        "island_id_per_is_new_burst",
        F.first("amount_avg_6_prior", ignorenulls=True).over(w5).alias("first_known_amount_avg_6_prior"),
        F.lead("amount_avg_6_prior", 1).over(w6).alias("next_amount_avg_6_prior"),
        F.avg("island_id").over(w7).alias("order_id_avg_island_id"),
        F.row_number().over(w8).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

cleaned_payments = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("is_new_burst") < 1)
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("next_amount_avg_6_prior") - F.col("is_new_burst_plus_island_id")).alias("next_amount_avg_6_prior_minus_is_new_burst_plus_island_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    cleaned_payments
    .select("id", "is_new_burst_plus_island_id", "island_id_per_is_new_burst")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id"],
        values=["is_new_burst_plus_island_id", "island_id_per_is_new_burst"],
        variableColumnName="metric_name",
        valueColumnName="reading",
    )
    .filter(F.col("reading").isNotNull())
)
```

        UPPER(dept_name) AS dept_name_upper
    FROM departments
    WHERE budget BETWEEN 1414000 AND 3210000
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees ch
            WHERE ch.dept_id = s.id
              AND ch.manager_id = 30
        )
),
kept AS (
    -- Semi-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM not_flagged s
    WHERE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM employees c
            WHERE c.dept_id = s.id
              AND c.full_name LIKE '%Olivi%'
        )
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        location,
        budget,
        budget_whole,
        dept_name_upper,
        LENGTH(location) AS location_length,
        ROUND(budget_whole, 2) AS budget_whole_rounded
    FROM kept
    WHERE location IN ('New York', 'Singapore', 'Berlin')
),
cleaned_departments AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        location,
        budget,
        budget_whole,
        dept_name_upper,
        location_length,
        budget_whole * budget AS budget_whole_times_budget,
        COALESCE(location, 'DIRECT') AS location_clean
    FROM filtered
    WHERE location IS NOT NULL
      AND budget_whole = 28
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        location,
        budget_whole_times_budget,
        budget
    FROM cleaned_departments
) src
UNPIVOT (
    value FOR measure IN (budget_whole_times_budget AS BUDGET_WHOLE_TIMES_BUDGET, budget AS BUDGET_VAL)
);

WITH deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity NULLS FIRST, id) AS row_num
        FROM inventory
    ) t
    WHERE row_num = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        row_num,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_running AS quantity_dense_rank,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_recent AS quantity_percent_rank,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity DESC, id) AS quantity_bucket
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(last_restock), product_id ORDER BY quantity NULLS LAST), w_recent AS (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY quantity DESC NULLS LAST)
),
deduped_inventory AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock) AS latest_rank
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(quantity, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id, store_id ORDER BY quantity_percent_rank, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_quantity,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(last_restock), product_id ORDER BY quantity_dense_rank DESC, id) AS quantity_dense_rank_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY quantity_bucket, id) AS seq_no,
        AVG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY store_id ORDER BY last_restock, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS quantity_avg_3_prior
    FROM deduped_inventory
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.store_id,
        s.quantity,
        s.last_restock,
        s.quantity_percent_rank,
        s.quantity_bucket,
        s.latest_rank,
        s.first_known_quantity,
        s.seq_no,
        s.quantity_avg_3_prior,
        p.region,
        p.store_name
    FROM scored s
    LEFT JOIN stores p
        ON s.store_id = p.id
)
SELECT
    id,
    last_restock,
    quantity_percent_rank,
    latest_rank,
    first_known_quantity,
    seq_no
FROM joined
ORDER BY seq_no DESC, quantity_percent_rank DESC

sql:
WITH lines AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS k, attr_value
),
unpacked AS (
    -- Higher-order array functions
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        attr_value,
        CAST((status_code & 2) != 0 AS INT) AS flag_bit2,
        SHIFTRIGHT(status_code, 2) AS status_code_high
    FROM lines
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(status_code_high) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code_high, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_status_code_high,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code_high DESC NULLS LAST) AS status_code_high_dense_rank,
        FIRST_VALUE(status_code_high, TRUE) OVER (ORDER BY log_ts, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_status_code_high,
        SUM(flag_bit2) OVER w_hist AS running_flag_bit2
    FROM unpacked
    WHERE host IN ('h4', 'h1')
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY k, host ORDER BY log_ts, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        status_code_high * running_flag_bit2 AS status_code_high_times_running_flag_bit2,
        COALESCE(k, 'UNKNOWN') AS k_filled
    FROM enriched
    WHERE k IS NOT NULL
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY log_ts, id, k) IS NULL
                 OR log_ts > LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY log_ts, id, k) + INTERVAL 15 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM filtered
),
islands AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        k,
        attr_value,
        status_code_high,
        running_status_code_high,
        status_code_high_times_running_flag_bit2,
        k_filled,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY host ORDER BY log_ts, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
    FROM flagged
)
SELECT
    id,
    host,
    log_ts,
    k,
    attr_value,
    status_code_high,
    running_status_code_high,
    status_code_high_times_running_flag_bit2
FROM islands
ORDER BY host DESC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("status_code_high", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy(F.col("status_code_high").desc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("k", "host").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("host").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

unpacked = (
    lines
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        (F.col("status_code").bitwiseAND(2) != 0).cast("int").alias("flag_bit2"),
        F.shiftright("status_code", 2).alias("status_code_high"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    unpacked
    .filter(F.col("host").isin(["h4", "h1"]))
    .withColumn("running_status_code_high", F.sum("status_code_high").over(w))
    .withColumn("status_code_high_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w2))
    .withColumn("first_known_status_code_high", F.first("status_code_high", ignorenulls=True).over(w3))
    .withColumn("running_flag_bit2", F.sum("flag_bit2").over(w_hist))
)

filtered = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("k").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("status_code_high") * F.col("running_flag_bit2")).alias("status_code_high_times_running_flag_bit2"),
        F.coalesce("k", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("k_filled"),
    )
)

flagged = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("log_ts").over(w5).isNull() | (F.col("log_ts") > F.lag("log_ts").over(w5) + F.expr("INTERVAL 15 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        "status_code_high",
        "running_status_code_high",
        "status_code_high_times_running_flag_bit2",
        "k_filled",
        F.sum("new_group_flag").over(w6).alias("island_id"),
    )
)

result = (
    islands
    .select(
        "id",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        "status_code_high",
        "running_status_code_high",
        "status_code_high_times_running_flag_bit2",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("host").desc())
)
```

sql:
WITH flattened AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value
    FROM app_logs
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(context) li AS k, attr_value
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY status_code) AS latest_rank
        FROM flattened
    ) t
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
with_gaps AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY log_ts, id, k) IS NULL
                 OR log_ts > LAG(log_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY log_ts, id, k) + INTERVAL 1 HOUR THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM ranked
),
islands AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        attr_value,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY k ORDER BY log_ts, id, k ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
),
ranked_app_logs AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service, k ORDER BY log_ts, id, k) AS rn
        FROM islands
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', log_ts) AS hour_window,
        CASE WHEN status_code >= 410 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS status_code_tier,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE k = 'version') AS version_rows,
        BIT_OR(status_code) AS status_code_bit_or,
        ROUND(AVG(session_id), 2) AS avg_session_id,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(session_id, 0.95) AS session_id_p95
    FROM ranked_app_logs
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    hour_window,
    status_code_tier,
    status_code_bit_or,
    avg_session_id
FROM summary
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("status_code")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("service", "k").orderBy("log_ts", "id", "k")

flattened = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "host",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode("context").alias("k", "attr_value"),
    )
)

ranked = (
    flattened
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

with_gaps = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("log_ts").over(w2).isNull() | (F.col("log_ts") > F.lag("log_ts").over(w2) + F.expr("INTERVAL 1 HOUR")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

islands = (
    with_gaps
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "log_ts",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        "k",
        "attr_value",
        F.sum("is_new_session").over(w3).alias("session_id"),
    )
)

ranked_app_logs = (
    islands
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
)

summary = (
    ranked_app_logs
    .groupBy(
        F.date_trunc("HOUR", "log_ts").alias("hour_window"),
        F.when(F.col("status_code") >= 410, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("status_code_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("k") == "version", 1)).alias("version_rows"),
        F.bit_or("status_code").alias("status_code_bit_or"),
        F.round(F.avg("session_id"), 2).alias("avg_session_id"),
        F.percentile_approx("session_id", 0.95).alias("session_id_p95"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select("hour_window", "status_code_tier", "status_code_bit_or", "avg_session_id")
)
```

WITH latest_match AS (
    -- Latest matching web_event per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT s.*, latest.event_type
    FROM sessions s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.event_type
            FROM web_events c
            WHERE c.session_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.duration_sec DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) latest ON TRUE
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN started_at - LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) > INTERVAL '60' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM latest_match
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        device,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        event_type,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM gaps
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.customer_id,
        a.started_at,
        a.country,
        d.segment,
        d.signup_date
    FROM sessionized a
    INNER JOIN customers d
        ON a.customer_id = d.id
    WHERE NOT d.is_active
),
gaps_2 AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) IS NULL
                 OR started_at > LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC) + INTERVAL 90 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM enriched
),
sessions_sessions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        started_at,
        country,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY segment ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM gaps_2
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        started_at,
        country,
        segment,
        signup_date,
        AVG(session_no) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(started_at), customer_id ORDER BY started_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no_avg_3,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, segment ORDER BY session_no DESC) AS session_no_dense_rank,
        SUM(session_no) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS country_sum_session_no,
        AVG(session_no) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(started_at) ORDER BY session_no ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS session_no_avg_6_prior,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, segment ORDER BY session_no ASC, id ASC) AS session_no_bucket
    FROM sessions_sessions
)
SELECT
    id,
    started_at,
    country,
    segment,
    signup_date,
    session_no_dense_rank,
    country_sum_session_no,
    session_no_bucket,
    CASE WHEN country RLIKE '^(US|DE)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN country RLIKE '^(TH|SG)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'OTHER_ZONE' END AS country_zone
FROM scored
ORDER BY session_no_dense_rank ASC NULLS FIRST, signup_date ASC;

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.duration_sec").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy("started_at", "id")

latest_match = (
    df_sessions
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("c"), (F.col("c.session_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.*", F.col("c.event_type"))
)

gaps = (
    latest_match
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.col("started_at") - F.lag("started_at").over(w2) > F.expr("INTERVAL 60 DAYS"), 1).otherwise(0))

sessionized = (
    gaps

        "customer_id",
        "device",
        "browser",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "event_type",

    )

enriched = (
    sessionized
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("d"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")

    .select(
        "a.id",
        "a.customer_id",
        "a.started_at",
        "a.country",
        F.col("d.segment"),

    )

gaps_2 = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("is_new_burst", F.when(F.lag("started_at").over(w4).isNull() | (F.col("started_at") > F.lag("started_at").over(w4) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_sessions = (
    gaps_2
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        F.sum("is_new_burst").over(w5).alias("session_no"),
    )
)

scored = (
    sessions_sessions
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        F.avg("session_no").over(w6).alias("session_no_avg_3"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w7).alias("session_no_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("session_no").over(w8).alias("country_sum_session_no"),
        F.avg("session_no").over(w9).alias("session_no_avg_6_prior"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w10).alias("session_no_bucket"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "started_at",
        "country",
        "segment",
        "signup_date",
        "session_no_dense_rank",
        "country_sum_session_no",
        "session_no_bucket",
        F.when(F.col("country").rlike("^(US|DE)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("country").rlike("^(TH|SG)$"), "GROUP_B").otherwise("OTHER_ZONE").alias("country_zone"),
```

WITH deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM shipments
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status, order_id ORDER BY delivered_date, id) = 1
),
deduped_shipments AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY shipped_date DESC, id) AS row_num
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT
        e.*,
        p.order_date,
        p.channel,
        p.discount
    FROM deduped_shipments e
    LEFT JOIN orders p
        ON e.order_id = p.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost, id) AS cost_bucket,
        AVG(cost) OVER (ORDER BY row_num, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cost_avg_2
    FROM with_dims
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    id,
    carrier,
    metric,
    val
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,

    FROM metrics

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status", "order_id").orderBy("delivered_date", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy(F.col("shipped_date").desc(), "id")
```

    SELECT dept_id, level
    FROM employees
    INTERSECT ALL

    FROM employees

),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM employees s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.dept_id = k.dept_id AND s.level = k.level
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', hire_date) AS year_start,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN level = 'L3' THEN 1 END) AS l3_count,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(job_title)) AS num_job_titles,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(salary, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS salary_quartiles,

FROM reconciled

ORDER BY year_start DESC

    select
        id,

        discounts,
        aggregate(tier_prices, 0D, (acc, p) -> acc + p, acc -> round(acc / size(tier_prices), 2)) as avg_tier_price,
        element_at(tier_prices, 1) as entry_price,
        slice(tier_limits, 1, 2) as first_two_limits,
        array_min(tier_prices) as lowest_price
    from price_tiers
    where plan = 'pro'

-- Running and moving aggregates
select
    id,
    avg_tier_price,
    entry_price,
    lead(lowest_price, 2) over (partition by plan order by avg_tier_price, id) as next_lowest_price,
    first_value(entry_price, true) over (order by avg_tier_price, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_entry_price
from unpacked;

sql:
WITH valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        status,
        channel,
        amount,
        discount,
        GREATEST(shipping_fee, discount) AS greatest_shipping_fee_discount
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2023-09-02'
      AND MONTH(order_date) IN (1, 2, 9)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY amount DESC, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT s.*, p.city
    FROM deduped s
    LEFT JOIN stores p
        ON s.store_id = p.id
    WHERE p.city <> 'Chiang Mai'
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT channel, status
    FROM joined
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT channel, status
    FROM orders
    WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'RETURNED', 'CANCELLED')
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM joined s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.channel = k.channel AND s.status = k.status
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    channel,
    CASE WHEN amount >= 1430 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS amount_tier,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_events,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'COMPLETED') AS completed_events_2,
    AVG(amount) FILTER (WHERE city = 'Tokyo') AS tokyo_avg_amount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'New York' THEN 1 END) AS new_york_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'web' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS web_amount,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY COUNT_IF(status = 'COMPLETED') DESC) AS completed_events_2_percent_rank
FROM verified
GROUP BY channel, amount_tier;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("completed_events_2").desc())

valid = (
    df_orders
    .filter((F.col("order_date") >= F.lit("2023-09-02").cast("date")) & F.month("order_date").isin([1, 2, 9]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "status",
        "channel",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        F.greatest("shipping_fee", "discount").alias("greatest_shipping_fee_discount"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

joined = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_stores.alias("p"), F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("p.city") != "Chiang Mai")
    .select("s.*", F.col("p.city"))
)

kept_keys = (
    joined
    .select("channel", "status")
    .intersectAll(
        df_orders
        .filter(F.col("status").isin(["PENDING", "RETURNED", "CANCELLED"]))
        .select("channel", "status")
    )
)

verified = (
    joined
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.channel") == F.col("k.channel")) & (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    verified
    .groupBy(
        "channel",
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 1430, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("amount_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("status") == "COMPLETED").alias("completed_events"),
        F.count_if(F.col("status") == "COMPLETED").alias("completed_events_2"),
        F.avg(F.when(F.col("city") == "Tokyo", F.col("amount"))).alias("tokyo_avg_amount"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("city") == "New York", 1)).alias("new_york_count"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("channel") == "web", F.col("amount")).otherwise(0)).alias("web_amount"),
    )
    .withColumn("completed_events_2_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w2))
)
```

sql:
WITH joined AS (
    SELECT src.*, b.name
    FROM subscriptions src
    JOIN customers b
        ON src.customer_id = b.id
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LAST_VALUE(monthly_fee, TRUE) OVER w_grp AS last_known_monthly_fee,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (ORDER BY start_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_monthly_fee,
        AVG(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY start_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS monthly_fee_avg_2_prior
    FROM joined
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY end_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        monthly_fee_avg_2_prior + last_known_monthly_fee AS monthly_fee_avg_2_prior_plus_last_known_monthly_fee,
        LOWER(status) AS status_lower
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE start_date >= TO_DATE('2023-05-10')
),
joined_subscriptions AS (
    SELECT src.*, b.signup_date
    FROM filtered src
    LEFT JOIN customers b
        ON src.customer_id = b.id
    WHERE b.credit_limit >= 9500
)
SELECT
    c.segment,
    e.plan,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
    MAX(e.monthly_fee) AS max_monthly_fee
FROM joined_subscriptions e
JOIN customers c ON e.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.segment, e.plan
ORDER BY plan DESC NULLS LAST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("end_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)

joined = (
    df_subscriptions
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.name"))
)

with_windows = (
    joined
    .withColumn("last_known_monthly_fee", F.last("monthly_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("running_monthly_fee", F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w2))
    .withColumn("monthly_fee_avg_2_prior", F.avg("monthly_fee").over(w3))
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("start_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-05-10")))
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("monthly_fee_avg_2_prior") + F.col("last_known_monthly_fee")).alias("monthly_fee_avg_2_prior_plus_last_known_monthly_fee"),
        F.lower("status").alias("status_lower"),
    )
)

joined_subscriptions = (
    filtered
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("b.credit_limit") >= 9500)
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.signup_date"))
)

result = (
    joined_subscriptions
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("e.customer_id") == F.col("c.id"), "inner")
    .groupBy(F.col("c.segment").alias("segment"), F.col("e.plan").alias("plan"))
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.max(F.col("e.monthly_fee")).alias("max_monthly_fee"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("plan").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

WITH parsed AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        service,
        host,
        log_ts,
        latency_ms,
        context,
        context['version'] AS version,
        COALESCE(context['version'], 'direct') AS version_or_default,

        FROM_JSON(payload_json, 'STRUCT<user: STRUCT<id: INT, tier: STRING>, duration: DOUBLE, retries: INT, tags: ARRAY<STRING>>').user.tier AS tier
    FROM app_logs

SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', log_ts) AS activity_day,
    DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', log_ts) AS hour_window,
    MIN(log_ts) AS first_log_ts,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(service)) AS service_list
FROM parsed

ORDER BY activity_day DESC;

```python
    df_app_logs

        "id",
        "service",
```

with metrics_long as (
    -- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
    select
        id,
        status,
        measure,
        value
    from (
        select
            id,
            status,
            discount,
            shipping_fee,
            amount
        from orders
    ) src
    unpivot (
        value for measure in (discount, shipping_fee, amount)
    ) long_rows
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    measure,
    case when value >= 63 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as value_tier,
    max(value) filter (where measure = 'shipping_fee') as shipping_fee_max_value,
    max(value) filter (where measure = 'discount') as discount_max_value,
    grouping(measure) as grouping_id
from metrics_long
group by cube (measure, case when value >= 63 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end)
having shipping_fee_max_value >= 0
order by shipping_fee_max_value desc nulls first

```python
metrics_long = (
    df_orders
    .select("id", "status", "discount", "shipping_fee", "amount")

        ids=["id", "status"],
        values=["discount", "shipping_fee", "amount"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="value",
    )
    .filter(F.col("value").isNotNull())
)

result = (
    metrics_long
    .withColumn("value_tier", F.when(F.col("value") >= 63, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW"))
```

    FROM with_dims

    FROM metrics
    WHERE product_id_dense_rank BETWEEN 4 AND 7

SELECT

    ROUND(AVG(product_id), 2) AS avg_product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
    MAX(product_id) AS max_product_id
FROM filtered
GROUP BY product_id, CASE WHEN qty >= 5 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END

```python
w5 = Window.orderBy("running_amount_bucket_2")

    df_transactions
    .select(
        "id",
        "txn_time",
        "is_flagged",
        F.lag("amount").over(w).alias("prev_amount"),
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("row_seq"),
        F.sum("amount").over(w2).alias("running_amount"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("row_seq").between(4, 7))
    .select(
        "id",
        "is_flagged",
        "row_seq",

        F.ntile(5).over(w3).alias("running_amount_bucket_2"),
```

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT *, CEIL(cost) AS cost_whole
    FROM products
    WHERE launch_date >= DATE '2023-05-13'
      AND brand IS DISTINCT FROM 'Umbrella'
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        s.country,
        s.city
    FROM valid e
    LEFT JOIN suppliers s
        ON e.supplier_id <=> s.id
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city, supplier_id ORDER BY cost DESC, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM joined
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
latest AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        product_name,
        category,
        price,
        cost,
        launch_date,
        tags,
        supplier_id,
        country
    FROM deduped
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY cost, id) = 1
),
with_last AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.tags,
        x.revenue
    FROM latest s
    JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.revenue
            FROM store_sales c
            WHERE c.product_id = s.id
              AND c.sale_date <= s.launch_date
            ORDER BY c.sale_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
)
SELECT
    id,
    tags,
    revenue,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist AS row_seq,
    LEAD(revenue, 1) OVER w_hist AS next_revenue,
    LAST_VALUE(revenue) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY revenue, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_revenue
FROM with_last
WHERE ARRAY_CONTAINS(tags, 'premium')
WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY revenue, id);

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.orderBy("revenue", "id")

valid = (
    df_products
    .filter((F.col("launch_date") >= F.lit("2023-05-13").cast("date")) & (~F.col("brand").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Umbrella"))))
    .select("*", F.ceil("cost").alias("cost_whole"))
)

joined = (
    valid
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_suppliers.alias("s"), F.col("e.supplier_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .select("e.*", F.col("s.country"), F.col("s.city"))
)

deduped = (
    joined
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)

latest = (

    .withColumn("rank_in_group_2", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group_2") == 1)

        "product_name",
        "category",
        "price",
        "cost",
        "launch_date",
        "tags",
        "supplier_id",
        "country",
    )
)

    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w3))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select("s.id", "s.tags", F.col("c.revenue"))
)

result = (

    .filter(F.array_contains("tags", "premium"))
```

sql:
with base as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        plan,
        monthly_fee,
        case when status = 'ACTIVE' then 1 else 0 end as is_active,
        round(monthly_fee * 1.07, 2) as monthly_fee_scaled
    from subscriptions
    where customer_id is not null
),
filtered as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        *,
        round(is_active, 1) as is_active_rounded,
        case when plan in ('basic', 'enterprise') then 'Group A' else 'Other' end as plan_group
    from base
    where monthly_fee < 240
),
ranked as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by plan order by monthly_fee_scaled desc nulls first, id) as latest_rank
        from filtered
    ) ranked
    where latest_rank = 1
),
base_subscriptions as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, case when monthly_fee >= 255 then 'High' when monthly_fee >= 116 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end as monthly_fee_band
    from ranked
    where monthly_fee_scaled >= 25
),
with_windows as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        plan,
        monthly_fee,
        is_active,
        plan_group,
        latest_rank,
        monthly_fee_band,
        ntile(10) over (partition by plan order by is_active desc, id) as is_active_bucket,
        ntile(4) over (order by monthly_fee, id) as monthly_fee_bucket,
        row_number() over (partition by plan order by latest_rank, id) as event_seq,
        ntile(4) over (partition by plan order by monthly_fee_scaled desc, id) as monthly_fee_scaled_bucket,
        last_value(monthly_fee, true) over (partition by plan order by latest_rank, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_monthly_fee
    from base_subscriptions
    where monthly_fee between 140 and 200
),
ranked_subscriptions as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select
        id,
        plan,
        is_active,
        latest_rank,
        monthly_fee_band,
        is_active_bucket,
        monthly_fee_bucket,
        event_seq,
        monthly_fee_scaled_bucket
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by plan order by last_known_monthly_fee desc, id) as row_num
        from with_windows
    ) t
    where row_num = 1
)
select
    id,
    plan,
    is_active,
    latest_rank,
    monthly_fee_band,
    is_active_bucket,
    monthly_fee_bucket,
    monthly_fee_scaled_bucket,
    case when plan rlike '^(basic|premium)$' then 'OTHER_ZONE' else 'EXTENDED' end as plan_zone
from ranked_subscriptions
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee_scaled").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("is_active").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy("monthly_fee", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("latest_rank", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee_scaled").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("latest_rank", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("last_known_monthly_fee").desc(), "id")

base = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "monthly_fee",
        F.when(F.col("status") == "ACTIVE", 1).otherwise(0).alias("is_active"),
        F.round((F.col("monthly_fee") * 1.07), 2).alias("monthly_fee_scaled"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("monthly_fee") < 240)
    .withColumn("is_active_rounded", F.round("is_active", 1))
    .withColumn("plan_group", F.when(F.col("plan").isin(["basic", "enterprise"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other"))
)

ranked = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

base_subscriptions = (
    ranked
    .filter(F.col("monthly_fee_scaled") >= 25)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 255, "High").when(F.col("monthly_fee") >= 116, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("monthly_fee_band"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    base_subscriptions
    .filter(F.col("monthly_fee").between(140, 200))
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "monthly_fee",
        "is_active",
        "plan_group",
        "latest_rank",
        "monthly_fee_band",
        F.ntile(10).over(w2).alias("is_active_bucket"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w3).alias("monthly_fee_bucket"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("event_seq"),
        F.ntile(4).over(w5).alias("monthly_fee_scaled_bucket"),
        F.last("monthly_fee", ignorenulls=True).over(w6).alias("last_known_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

ranked_subscriptions = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "is_active",
        "latest_rank",
        "monthly_fee_band",
        "is_active_bucket",
        "monthly_fee_bucket",
        "event_seq",
        "monthly_fee_scaled_bucket",
    )
)

result = (
    ranked_subscriptions
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "is_active",
        "latest_rank",
        "monthly_fee_band",
        "is_active_bucket",
        "monthly_fee_bucket",
        "monthly_fee_scaled_bucket",
        F.when(F.col("plan").rlike("^(basic|premium)$"), "OTHER_ZONE").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("plan_zone"),
    )
)
```

with lines as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        attr_key,
        value
    from app_logs
    lateral view outer explode(context) t as attr_key, value
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    attr_key,
    case when latency_ms >= 2127 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as latency_ms_tier,
    level,
    sum(case when level = 'INFO' then status_code else 0 end) as info_status_code,
    percentile_approx(status_code, 0.9) as status_code_p90,
    min(log_ts) as started_at,
    count(*) filter (where level = 'DEBUG') as debug_rows,
    dense_rank() over (partition by attr_key order by count(*) filter (where level = 'DEBUG') desc) as debug_rows_dense_rank
from lines
group by 1, 2, 3
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("debug_rows").desc())

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select(
        "id",
        "log_ts",
        "level",
        "latency_ms",
        "status_code",
        F.explode_outer("context").alias("attr_key", "value"),
    )
)

result = (
    lines
    .groupBy(
        "attr_key",
        F.when(F.col("latency_ms") >= 2127, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("latency_ms_tier"),
        "level",
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("level") == "INFO", F.col("status_code")).otherwise(0)).alias("info_status_code"),
        F.percentile_approx("status_code", 0.9).alias("status_code_p90"),
        F.min("log_ts").alias("started_at"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("level") == "DEBUG", 1)).alias("debug_rows"),
    )
    .withColumn("debug_rows_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w))
)
```

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(amount * 1.1, 2) AS amount_scaled,
        COALESCE(method, 'UNKNOWN') AS method_clean
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2023-08-27 20:00:00'
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN paid_at - LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC) > INTERVAL '14' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_burst
    FROM filtered
),
islands AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        method,
        paid_at,
        method_clean,
        SUM(is_new_burst) OVER (PARTITION BY method ORDER BY paid_at ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
)
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at) AS activity_month,
    method,
    AVG(session_id) AS avg_session_id,
    COUNT_IF(method = 'cash') AS cash_events,
    GROUPING_ID() AS gid
FROM islands
GROUP BY CUBE (DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', paid_at), method)

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, CONCAT_WS('-', plan, status) plan_status_key
    FROM subscriptions
    WHERE end_date > DATE '2023-05-10'
      AND monthly_fee > 150
),
filtered_subscriptions AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        plan_status_key,
        ROUND(monthly_fee * 100, 2) adjusted_monthly_fee
    FROM filtered
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_hist event_seq,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY start_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) running_monthly_fee,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY adjusted_monthly_fee, id) adjusted_monthly_fee_bucket
    FROM filtered_subscriptions
    WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY end_date, id)
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        start_date,
        plan_status_key,
        adjusted_monthly_fee,
        event_seq,
        adjusted_monthly_fee_bucket,
        AVG(adjusted_monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY running_monthly_fee, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) adjusted_monthly_fee_avg_6,
        LAG(monthly_fee, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(end_date), customer_id ORDER BY adjusted_monthly_fee, id) prev_monthly_fee
    FROM with_windows
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.start_date,
        s.adjusted_monthly_fee,
        s.event_seq,
        c.age
    FROM metrics s
    LEFT JOIN customers c
        ON s.customer_id <=> c.id
),
metrics_subscriptions AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(age / SUM(age) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id), 4) age_share,
        LAG(age, 1) OVER w_hist prev_age,
        NTILE(3) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY event_seq DESC, id) event_seq_bucket,
        RANK() OVER w_hist_2 adjusted_monthly_fee_rank
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE event_seq <= 3
    WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY start_date, id), w_hist_2 AS (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY adjusted_monthly_fee DESC)
),
daily AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', start_date) AS quarter_start,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(event_seq_bucket, 0.95) AS event_seq_bucket_p95,
        COUNT(*) AS num_rows,
        COUNT(*) AS row_count
    FROM metrics_subscriptions
    GROUP BY 1
    HAVING APPROX_PERCENTILE(event_seq_bucket, 0.95) >= 0
)
SELECT
    quarter_start,
    event_seq_bucket_p95,
    num_rows
FROM daily
ORDER BY event_seq_bucket_p95 DESC NULLS LAST;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.orderBy("end_date", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("start_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("adjusted_monthly_fee", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("running_monthly_fee", "id").rowsBetween(-6, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("end_date"), "customer_id").orderBy("adjusted_monthly_fee", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id")
w7 = Window.orderBy("start_date", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("event_seq").desc(), "id")
w_hist_2 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("adjusted_monthly_fee").desc())

filtered = (
    df_subscriptions
    .filter((F.col("end_date") > F.lit("2023-05-10").cast("date")) & (F.col("monthly_fee") > 150))
    .withColumn("plan_status_key", F.concat_ws("-", "plan", "status"))
)

filtered_subscriptions = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "start_date",
        "end_date",
        "monthly_fee",
        "status",
        "plan_status_key",
        F.round((F.col("monthly_fee") * 100), 2).alias("adjusted_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    filtered_subscriptions
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w_hist))
    .withColumn("running_monthly_fee", F.sum("monthly_fee").over(w2))
    .withColumn("adjusted_monthly_fee_bucket", F.ntile(5).over(w3))
)

metrics = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "start_date",
        "plan_status_key",
        "adjusted_monthly_fee",
        "event_seq",
        "adjusted_monthly_fee_bucket",
        F.avg("adjusted_monthly_fee").over(w4).alias("adjusted_monthly_fee_avg_6"),
        F.lag("monthly_fee", 1, 0).over(w5).alias("prev_monthly_fee"),
    )
)

with_dims = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("s.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("c.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.customer_id",
        "s.start_date",
        "s.adjusted_monthly_fee",
        "s.event_seq",
        F.col("c.age"),
    )
)

metrics_subscriptions = (
    with_dims
    .filter(F.col("event_seq") <= 3)
    .withColumn("age_share", F.round((F.col("age") / F.sum("age").over(w6)), 4))
    .withColumn("prev_age", F.lag("age", 1).over(w7))
    .withColumn("event_seq_bucket", F.ntile(3).over(w8))
    .withColumn("adjusted_monthly_fee_rank", F.rank().over(w_hist_2))
)

daily = (
    metrics_subscriptions
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "start_date").alias("quarter_start"))
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("event_seq_bucket", 0.95).alias("event_seq_bucket_p95"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("event_seq_bucket_p95") >= 0)
)

result = (
    daily
    .select("quarter_start", "event_seq_bucket_p95", "num_rows")
    .orderBy(F.col("event_seq_bucket_p95").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

sql:
WITH enriched AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        e.id,
        e.store_id,
        e.quantity,
        e.last_restock,
        d.region
    FROM inventory e
    JOIN stores d
        ON e.store_id = d.id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(region) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(last_restock) ORDER BY quantity, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_region,
        MIN(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_min_quantity,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY quantity DESC, id) AS quantity_bucket
    FROM enriched
    WHERE store_id IN (2, 3, 4, 6)
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY quantity_bucket, id) AS latest_rank
    FROM metrics
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        region,
        first_known_region,
        LAG(region_min_quantity, 2) OVER w_grp AS prev_region_min_quantity,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(last_restock), store_id ORDER BY quantity_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_quantity
    FROM latest
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', last_restock), region ORDER BY latest_rank, id)
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        region,
        first_known_region,
        DATE_ADD(last_restock, 74) AS last_restock_plus_74d,
        COALESCE(cumulative_quantity, 0) AS cumulative_quantity_filled
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE last_restock > DATE '2023-09-06'
      AND cumulative_quantity = 660
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_restock) AS activity_month,
    region,
    ROUND(SUM(quantity) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN region = 'North' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS quantity_per_north,
    SUM(CASE WHEN region = 'East' THEN cumulative_quantity_filled ELSE 0 END) AS east_cumulative_quantity_filled,
    STDDEV_SAMP(quantity) AS quantity_stddev,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE region = 'East') AS east_rows,
    BIT_AND(quantity) AS quantity_bit_and
FROM base
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_restock), region
HAVING STDDEV_SAMP(quantity) < 1000000;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.year("last_restock")).orderBy("quantity", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("region")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy(F.col("quantity").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("region").orderBy("quantity_bucket", "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "last_restock"), "region").orderBy("latest_rank", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("last_restock"), "store_id").orderBy("quantity_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

enriched = (
    df_inventory
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_stores.alias("d"), F.col("e.store_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .select("e.id", "e.store_id", "e.quantity", "e.last_restock", F.col("d.region"))
)

metrics = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("store_id").isin([2, 3, 4, 6]))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("region", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("first_known_region"),
        F.min("quantity").over(w2).alias("region_min_quantity"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w3).alias("quantity_bucket"),
    )
)

latest = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    latest
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        "region",
        "first_known_region",
        F.lag("region_min_quantity", 2).over(w_grp).alias("prev_region_min_quantity"),
        F.sum("quantity").over(w6).alias("cumulative_quantity"),
    )
)
```

WITH enriched AS (
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.full_name,
        s.dept_id,
        s.job_title,
        s.hire_date,
        s.is_remote,
        s.level,
        d.location,
        d.dept_name,
        d.budget
    FROM employees s
    LEFT JOIN departments d
        ON s.dept_id = d.id
    WHERE d.location = 'Bangkok'
),
enriched_employees AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', hire_date), dept_name ORDER BY budget, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS budget_avg_3,
        LAG(budget, 2) OVER w_recent AS prev_budget
    FROM enriched
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY YEAR(hire_date) ORDER BY budget, id)
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.budget AS department_budget,
        b.location AS department_location,
        b.dept_name AS department_dept_name
    FROM enriched_employees a
    LEFT JOIN departments b
        ON a.dept_id = b.id
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title) AS job_title_avg_budget,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY department_budget DESC, id) AS row_seq,
        FIRST_VALUE(department_dept_name) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(hire_date), dept_id ORDER BY budget_avg_3, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_department_dept_name,
        LAG(prev_budget, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY job_title ORDER BY prev_budget, id) AS prev_prev_budget
    FROM joined
),
enriched_employees_2 AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        full_name,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        level,
        budget,
        prev_budget,
        department_location,
        department_dept_name,
        job_title_avg_budget,
        prev_prev_budget,
        MAX(budget_avg_3) OVER w_grp AS running_max_budget_avg_3,
        SUM(budget_avg_3) OVER w_grp AS running_sum_budget_avg_3,
        AVG(budget_avg_3) OVER w_grp AS running_avg_budget_avg_3
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY job_title, dept_name ORDER BY budget_avg_3, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
with_windows_employees AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_id,
        job_title,
        level,
        prev_budget,
        department_dept_name,
        job_title_avg_budget,
        running_max_budget_avg_3,
        running_sum_budget_avg_3,
        COUNT(running_sum_budget_avg_3) OVER w_grp AS running_count_running_sum_budget_avg_3,
        MAX(running_sum_budget_avg_3) OVER w_grp AS running_max_running_sum_budget_avg_3,
        AVG(running_sum_budget_avg_3) OVER w_grp AS running_avg_running_sum_budget_avg_3,
        LAG(job_title_avg_budget, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY department_dept_name, dept_id ORDER BY running_avg_budget_avg_3, id) AS prev_job_title_avg_budget
    FROM enriched_employees_2
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY department_location, level ORDER BY prev_prev_budget, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        department_dept_name,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(running_max_budget_avg_3, 0.95) AS running_max_budget_avg_3_p95,
        SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(job_title)) AS job_title_list,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(prev_budget, 0.9) AS prev_budget_p90,
        ROUND(SUM(running_avg_running_sum_budget_avg_3) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN job_title = 'Director' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS running_avg_running_sum_budget_avg_3_per_director
    FROM with_windows_employees
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (department_dept_name)
)
SELECT
    department_dept_name,
    job_title_list,
    running_avg_running_sum_budget_avg_3_per_director,
    CASE WHEN department_dept_name RLIKE '^(Marketing|HR)$' THEN 'PRIORITY' WHEN department_dept_name RLIKE '^(Engineering|Sales)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'CORE' END AS department_dept_name_zone
FROM summary;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "hire_date"), "dept_name").orderBy("budget", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w_recent = Window.partitionBy(F.year("hire_date")).orderBy("budget", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("job_title")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy(F.col("department_budget").desc(), "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("hire_date"), "dept_id").orderBy("budget_avg_3", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("job_title").orderBy("prev_budget", "id")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("job_title", "dept_name").orderBy("budget_avg_3", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("department_location", "level").orderBy("prev_prev_budget", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.partitionBy("department_dept_name", "dept_id").orderBy("running_avg_budget_avg_3", "id")

enriched = (
    df_employees
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_departments.alias("d"), F.col("s.dept_id") == F.col("d.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("d.location") == "Bangkok")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.full_name",
        "s.dept_id",
        "s.job_title",
        "s.hire_date",
        "s.is_remote",
        "s.level",
        F.col("d.location"),
        F.col("d.dept_name"),
        F.col("d.budget"),
    )
)

enriched_employees = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("budget").over(w).alias("budget_avg_3"),
        F.lag("budget", 2).over(w_recent).alias("prev_budget"),
    )
)

joined = (
    enriched_employees
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_departments.alias("b"), F.col("a.dept_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "a.*",
        F.col("b.budget").alias("department_budget"),
        F.col("b.location").alias("department_location"),
        F.col("b.dept_name").alias("department_dept_name"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    joined
    .withColumn("job_title_avg_budget", F.avg("budget").over(w3))
    .withColumn("row_seq", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .withColumn("first_known_department_dept_name", F.first("department_dept_name", ignorenulls=True).over(w5))
    .withColumn("prev_prev_budget", F.lag("prev_budget", 2).over(w6))
)

enriched_employees_2 = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "full_name",
        "dept_id",
        "job_title",
        "level",
        "budget",
        "prev_budget",
        "department_location",
        "department_dept_name",
        "job_title_avg_budget",
        "prev_prev_budget",
        F.max("budget_avg_3").over(w_grp).alias("running_max_budget_avg_3"),
        F.sum("budget_avg_3").over(w_grp).alias("running_sum_budget_avg_3"),
        F.avg("budget_avg_3").over(w_grp).alias("running_avg_budget_avg_3"),
    )
)

with_windows_employees = (
    enriched_employees_2
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_id",
        "job_title",
        "level",
        "prev_budget",
        "department_dept_name",
        "job_title_avg_budget",
        "running_max_budget_avg_3",
        "running_sum_budget_avg_3",
        F.count("running_sum_budget_avg_3").over(w8).alias("running_count_running_sum_budget_avg_3"),
        F.max("running_sum_budget_avg_3").over(w8).alias("running_max_running_sum_budget_avg_3"),
        F.avg("running_sum_budget_avg_3").over(w8).alias("running_avg_running_sum_budget_avg_3"),
        F.lag("job_title_avg_budget", 2).over(w9).alias("prev_job_title_avg_budget"),
    )
)

summary = (
    with_windows_employees
    .rollup("department_dept_name")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("running_max_budget_avg_3", 0.95).alias("running_max_budget_avg_3_p95"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("job_title")).alias("job_title_list"),
        F.percentile_approx("prev_budget", 0.9).alias("prev_budget_p90"),
        F.round(F.sum("running_avg_running_sum_budget_avg_3") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("job_title") == "Director", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("running_avg_running_sum_budget_avg_3_per_director"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select(
        "department_dept_name",
        "job_title_list",
        "running_avg_running_sum_budget_avg_3_per_director",
        F.when(F.col("department_dept_name").rlike("^(Marketing|HR)$"), "PRIORITY").when(F.col("department_dept_name").rlike("^(Engineering|Sales)$"), "EXTENDED").otherwise("CORE").alias("department_dept_name_zone"),
    )
)
```

WITH unpivoted AS (
    -- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            id,
            status,
            discount,
            amount,
            shipping_fee
        FROM orders
    ) src
    UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS (
        val FOR metric_name IN (discount AS DISCOUNT_VAL, amount AS AMOUNT, shipping_fee)
    ) unp
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN val >= 63 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS val_tier,
    status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT status) AS distinct_status,
    COUNT(DISTINCT status) AS distinct_status_2,
    COUNT_IF(metric_name = 'DISCOUNT_VAL') AS discount_val_events,
    COUNT_IF(metric_name = 'DISCOUNT_VAL') AS discount_val_events_2,
    GROUPING(CASE WHEN val >= 63 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END) AS grouping_id
FROM unpivoted
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((CASE WHEN val >= 63 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END, status), (CASE WHEN val >= 63 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END), ())

```python
    df_orders
    .select(
        "id",

        F.col("discount").alias("DISCOUNT_VAL"),

        "shipping_fee",
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "status"],
        values=["DISCOUNT_VAL", "AMOUNT", "shipping_fee"],
        variableColumnName="metric_name",

    )
)
```
