sql:
with base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        quarter(ends_on) as ends_on_quarter,
        datediff(starts_on, ends_on) / 7 as weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on
    from promotions
    where channel = 'store'
      and channel is not null
),
base_promotions as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct,
        ends_on_quarter,
        weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on,
        round(ends_on_quarter, 2) as ends_on_quarter_rounded,
        discount_pct / nullif(weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on, 0) as discount_pct_per_weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on
    from base
    where ends_on > date '2023-09-09'
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        count(discount_pct) over (partition by channel) as channel_count_discount_pct,
        first_value(weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on, true) over (partition by channel order by ends_on_quarter_rounded, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on
    from base_promotions
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        channel,
        starts_on,
        discount_pct,
        discount_pct_per_weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on,
        first_known_weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on,
        last_value(ends_on_quarter, true) over w_running as last_known_ends_on_quarter,
        sum(ends_on_quarter) over (partition by channel order by ends_on_quarter_rounded, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_ends_on_quarter
    from metrics
    window w_running as (partition by channel order by channel_count_discount_pct, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row)
),
enriched as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        *,
        avg(discount_pct_per_weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on) over (partition by year(starts_on) order by last_known_ends_on_quarter, id rows between 6 preceding and 1 preceding) as discount_pct_per_weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on_avg_6_prior,
        last_value(channel) ignore nulls over (partition by channel order by discount_pct, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as last_known_channel
    from scored
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    channel,
    sort_array(collect_set(channel)) as channel_list,
    sort_array(collect_set(channel)) as channel_list_2
from enriched
group by channel
order by channel desc;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("ends_on_quarter_rounded", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("channel_count_discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("starts_on")).orderBy("last_known_ends_on_quarter", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy("discount_pct", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_promotions
    .filter((F.col("channel") == "store") & F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.quarter("ends_on").alias("ends_on_quarter"),
        (F.datediff("starts_on", "ends_on") / 7).alias("weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on"),
    )
)

base_promotions = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("ends_on") > F.lit("2023-09-09").cast("date"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "ends_on_quarter",
        "weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on",
        F.round("ends_on_quarter", 2).alias("ends_on_quarter_rounded"),
        (F.col("discount_pct") / F.nullif("weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on", F.lit(0))).alias("discount_pct_per_weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    base_promotions
    .withColumn("channel_count_discount_pct", F.count("discount_pct").over(w))
    .withColumn("first_known_weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on", F.first("weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on", ignorenulls=True).over(w2))
)

scored = (
    metrics
    .select(
        "id",
        "channel",
        "starts_on",
        "discount_pct",
        "discount_pct_per_weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on",
        "first_known_weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on",
        F.last("ends_on_quarter", ignorenulls=True).over(w_running).alias("last_known_ends_on_quarter"),
        F.sum("ends_on_quarter").over(w2).alias("cumulative_ends_on_quarter"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "*",
        F.avg("discount_pct_per_weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on").over(w4).alias("discount_pct_per_weeks_ends_on_to_starts_on_avg_6_prior"),
        F.last("channel", ignorenulls=True).over(w5).alias("last_known_channel"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy("channel")
    .agg(
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("channel_list"),
        F.sort_array(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("channel_list_2"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("channel").desc())
)
```

WITH enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        browser,
        LAST_VALUE(browser) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_browser,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at DESC, id) AS event_seq,
        LAST_VALUE(country, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(started_at), browser ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_country,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, id) AS seq_no,
        FIRST_VALUE(country, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_country
    FROM sessions
),
enriched_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.segment,
        b.country
    FROM enriched src
    JOIN customers b
        ON src.customer_id = b.id
),
kept AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM enriched_sessions s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM web_events x
            WHERE x.session_id = s.id
              AND x.event_type = 'page_view'
        )
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        browser,
        last_known_country,
        seq_no,
        first_known_country,
        segment,
        country,
        seq_no + event_seq AS seq_no_plus_event_seq,
        CONCAT_WS(',', browser, country) AS browser_country_key
    FROM kept
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
enriched_sessions_2 AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LEAD(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY segment, browser ORDER BY seq_no_plus_event_seq, id) AS next_seq_no,
        LEAD(seq_no_plus_event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY segment, browser ORDER BY seq_no_plus_event_seq, id) AS next_seq_no_plus_event_seq,
        LAG(seq_no_plus_event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY segment, browser ORDER BY seq_no_plus_event_seq, id) AS prev_seq_no_plus_event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment, browser ORDER BY seq_no_plus_event_seq, id) AS event_seq
    FROM filtered
),
latest AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM enriched_sessions_2
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY segment, country ORDER BY next_seq_no DESC, id) = 1
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN prev_seq_no_plus_event_seq >= 73 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS prev_seq_no_plus_event_seq_tier,
    country,
    CASE WHEN seq_no_plus_event_seq >= 65 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS seq_no_plus_event_seq_tier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN segment = 'Consumer' THEN seq_no_plus_event_seq ELSE 0 END) AS consumer_seq_no_plus_event_seq,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(seq_no_plus_event_seq, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS seq_no_plus_event_seq_quartiles,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(next_seq_no_plus_event_seq, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS next_seq_no_plus_event_seq_quartiles,
    ROUND(SUM(next_seq_no_plus_event_seq) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN browser = 'Firefox' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS next_seq_no_plus_event_seq_per_firefox
FROM latest
GROUP BY CASE WHEN prev_seq_no_plus_event_seq >= 73 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, country, CASE WHEN seq_no_plus_event_seq >= 65 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy(F.col("started_at").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("started_at"), "browser").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("started_at", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("device").orderBy("started_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("segment", "browser").orderBy("seq_no_plus_event_seq", "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("segment", "country").orderBy(F.col("next_seq_no").desc(), "id")

enriched = (
    df_sessions
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "browser",
        F.last("browser", ignorenulls=True).over(w).alias("last_known_browser"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
        F.last("country", ignorenulls=True).over(w3).alias("last_known_country"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("seq_no"),
        F.first("country", ignorenulls=True).over(w5).alias("first_known_country"),
    )
)

enriched_sessions = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.segment"), F.col("b.country"))
)

kept = (
    enriched_sessions
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_web_events.alias("x"), (F.col("x.session_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.event_type") == "page_view"), "left_anti")
)

filtered = (
    kept
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "browser",
        "last_known_country",
        "seq_no",
        "first_known_country",
        "segment",
        "country",
        (F.col("seq_no") + F.col("event_seq")).alias("seq_no_plus_event_seq"),
        F.concat_ws(",", "browser", "country").alias("browser_country_key"),
    )
)

enriched_sessions_2 = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lead("seq_no").over(w6).alias("next_seq_no"),
        F.lead("seq_no_plus_event_seq").over(w6).alias("next_seq_no_plus_event_seq"),
        F.lag("seq_no_plus_event_seq").over(w6).alias("prev_seq_no_plus_event_seq"),
        F.row_number().over(w6).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

latest = (
    enriched_sessions_2
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w7))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

result = (
    latest
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("prev_seq_no_plus_event_seq") >= 73, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("prev_seq_no_plus_event_seq_tier"),
        "country",
        F.when(F.col("seq_no_plus_event_seq") >= 65, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("seq_no_plus_event_seq_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("segment") == "Consumer", F.col("seq_no_plus_event_seq")).otherwise(0)).alias("consumer_seq_no_plus_event_seq"),
        F.percentile_approx("seq_no_plus_event_seq", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("seq_no_plus_event_seq_quartiles"),
        F.percentile_approx("next_seq_no_plus_event_seq", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("next_seq_no_plus_event_seq_quartiles"),
        F.round(F.sum("next_seq_no_plus_event_seq") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("browser") == "Firefox", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("next_seq_no_plus_event_seq_per_firefox"),
    )
)
```

WITH with_last AS (
    -- Latest matching product per row (LATERAL ... LIMIT 1)
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.city,
        s.rating,
        x.product_stock_qty,
        x.product_price
    FROM suppliers s
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT c.stock_qty AS product_stock_qty, c.price AS product_price
            FROM products c
            WHERE c.supplier_id = s.id
            ORDER BY c.launch_date DESC, c.id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) x ON TRUE
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        city,
        rating,
        product_stock_qty,
        product_price,
        CASE WHEN product_stock_qty >= 326 THEN 'High' WHEN product_stock_qty >= 146 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS product_stock_qty_band,
        product_price / NULLIF(product_stock_qty, 0) AS product_price_per_product_stock_qty,
        COALESCE(city, 'OTHER') AS city_clean
    FROM with_last
    WHERE city <> 'Singapore'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY product_price, id) AS seq_no,
        AVG(product_stock_qty) OVER w_recent AS product_stock_qty_avg_2,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id) AS seq_no_2,
        AVG(rating) OVER w_ordered AS rating_avg_6_prior,
        SUM(product_stock_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY product_stock_qty, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_product_stock_qty
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_ordered AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)
),
filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, CAST(cumulative_product_stock_qty AS STRING) AS cumulative_product_stock_qty_str
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE rating_avg_6_prior <> 2
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        rating,
        product_stock_qty,
        product_price,
        seq_no,
        seq_no_2,
        rating_avg_6_prior,
        cumulative_product_stock_qty_str,
        SUM(product_price_per_product_stock_qty) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_product_price_per_product_stock_qty,
        SUM(seq_no) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY cumulative_product_stock_qty, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY product_stock_qty_avg_2, id) AS seq_no_3,
        LAST_VALUE(product_price) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY product_stock_qty_avg_2, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_product_price,
        AVG(product_price) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating_avg_6_prior, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS product_price_avg_5_prior
    FROM filtered
)
SELECT
    id,
    rating,
    product_stock_qty,
    product_price,
    seq_no,
    seq_no_2,
    rating_avg_6_prior,
    cumulative_seq_no,
    seq_no_3
FROM scored
ORDER BY rating_avg_6_prior DESC NULLS FIRST

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.col("s.id")).orderBy(F.col("c.launch_date").desc(), F.col("c.id").desc())
w2 = Window.orderBy("product_price", "id")
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-2, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id")
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("product_stock_qty", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("cumulative_product_stock_qty", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w9 = Window.orderBy("product_stock_qty_avg_2", "id")
w10 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("product_stock_qty_avg_2", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w11 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating_avg_6_prior", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)

with_last = (
    df_suppliers
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_products.alias("c"), (F.col("c.supplier_id") == F.col("s.id")), "left")
    .withColumn("rn", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rn") == 1)
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.city",
        "s.rating",
        F.col("c.stock_qty").alias("product_stock_qty"),
        F.col("c.price").alias("product_price"),
    )
)

valid = (
    with_last
    .filter(F.col("city") != "Singapore")
    .select(
        "id",
        "city",
        "rating",
        "product_stock_qty",
        "product_price",
        F.when(F.col("product_stock_qty") >= 326, "High").when(F.col("product_stock_qty") >= 146, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("product_stock_qty_band"),
        (F.col("product_price") / F.nullif("product_stock_qty", F.lit(0))).alias("product_price_per_product_stock_qty"),
        F.coalesce("city", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("city_clean"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("product_stock_qty_avg_2", F.avg("product_stock_qty").over(w_recent))
    .withColumn("seq_no_2", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .withColumn("rating_avg_6_prior", F.avg("rating").over(w_ordered))
    .withColumn("cumulative_product_stock_qty", F.sum("product_stock_qty").over(w6))
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("rating_avg_6_prior") != 2)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.col("cumulative_product_stock_qty").cast("string").alias("cumulative_product_stock_qty_str"),
    )
)

scored = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "rating",
        "product_stock_qty",
        "product_price",
        "seq_no",
        "seq_no_2",
        "rating_avg_6_prior",
        "cumulative_product_stock_qty_str",
        F.sum("product_price_per_product_stock_qty").over(w7).alias("running_product_price_per_product_stock_qty"),
        F.sum("seq_no").over(w8).alias("cumulative_seq_no"),
        F.row_number().over(w9).alias("seq_no_3"),
        F.last("product_price", ignorenulls=True).over(w10).alias("last_known_product_price"),
        F.avg("product_price").over(w11).alias("product_price_avg_5_prior"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "rating",
        "product_stock_qty",
        "product_price",
        "seq_no",
        "seq_no_2",
        "rating_avg_6_prior",
        "cumulative_seq_no",
        "seq_no_3",
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("rating_avg_6_prior").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

WITH deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY started_at DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS row_num
    FROM sessions
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
deduped_sessions AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        browser,
        started_at,
        country,
        row_num
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY row_num DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM deduped
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT s.*, c.age
    FROM deduped_sessions s
    JOIN customers c
        ON s.customer_id = c.id
    WHERE UPPER(c.name) LIKE '%MMA%'
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(age AS STRING) age_str,
        ROUND(age / row_num, 2) age_per_row_num,
        COALESCE(country, 'NONE') country_clean
    FROM enriched
    WHERE started_at > DATE '2023-05-10'
      AND country = 'DE'
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.name,
        p.segment
    FROM valid s
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON s.customer_id = p.id
),
stats AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN age_per_row_num >= 60 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS age_per_row_num_tier,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', started_at) AS activity_month,
        ROUND(AVG(age_per_row_num), 2) AS avg_age_per_row_num,

        GROUPING(CASE WHEN age_per_row_num >= 60 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END) AS gid
    FROM with_dims
    GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN age_per_row_num >= 60 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', started_at))
)

    activity_month,
    age_per_row_num_per_smb,

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        store_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        amount,
        discount,
        shipping_fee,
        CONCAT(channel, ', ', status) AS channel_status,
        COALESCE(channel, 'DIRECT') AS resolved_channel
    FROM orders
    WHERE shipping_fee > 27
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM cleaned s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM payments x
            WHERE x.order_id = s.id
              AND x.paid_at >= s.order_date
        )
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        discount,
        channel_status,
        resolved_channel
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY shipping_fee DESC, id) AS dedup_rank
        FROM eligible
    ) t
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM deduped
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE shipping_fee IS NULL
),
kept_rows AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM deduped s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.customer_id = k.customer_id
),
summary AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        CASE WHEN discount >= 0.31 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS discount_tier,
        STDDEV_SAMP(discount) AS discount_stddev,
        APPROX_PERCENTILE(discount, 0.5) AS discount_p50
    FROM kept_rows
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((customer_id, CASE WHEN discount >= 0.31 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END), (customer_id), ())
)
SELECT customer_id
FROM summary
ORDER BY customer_id DESC NULLS LAST;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy(F.col("shipping_fee").desc(), "id")

cleaned = (
    df_orders
    .filter(F.col("shipping_fee") > 27)
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "store_id",
        "order_date",
        "status",
        "amount",
        "discount",
        "shipping_fee",
        F.concat("channel", F.lit(", "), "status").alias("channel_status"),
        F.coalesce("channel", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("resolved_channel"),
    )
)

eligible = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_payments.alias("x"), (F.col("x.order_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.paid_at") >= F.col("s.order_date")), "left_anti")
)

deduped = (
    eligible
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "customer_id", "discount", "channel_status", "resolved_channel")
)

kept_keys = (
    deduped
    .select("customer_id")
    .subtract(
        df_orders
        .filter(F.col("shipping_fee").isNull())
        .select("customer_id")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    deduped
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("k.customer_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

summary = (
    kept_rows
    .withColumn("discount_tier", F.when(F.col("discount") >= 0.31, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD"))
    .groupingSets(
        [["customer_id", "discount_tier"], ["customer_id"], []],
        "customer_id",
        "discount_tier",
    )
    .agg(
        F.stddev_samp("discount").alias("discount_stddev"),
        F.percentile_approx("discount", 0.5).alias("discount_p50"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .select("customer_id")
    .orderBy(F.col("customer_id").desc_nulls_last())
)
```

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        coupon_codes,
        li_item.product_id,
        li_item.qty,
        li_item.price
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW OUTER EXPLODE(items) li AS li_item
),
filtered AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        coupon_codes,
        qty,
        ARRAY_CONTAINS(coupon_codes, 'BUNDLE') AS is_bundle,
        qty - price AS qty_minus_price
    FROM flattened
    WHERE product_id BETWEEN 4 AND 8
),
valid AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, CAST(is_bundle AS INT) AS is_bundle_flag
    FROM filtered
    WHERE qty >= 4
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        coupon_codes,
        is_bundle,
        qty_minus_price,
        is_bundle_flag,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY qty DESC NULLS FIRST) AS qty_percent_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY qty_minus_price DESC) AS qty_minus_price_cume_dist
    FROM valid
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        coupon_codes,
        qty_percent_rank,
        qty_minus_price_cume_dist,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY qty_minus_price_cume_dist ASC NULLS LAST) AS qty_minus_price_cume_dist_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY qty_minus_price_cume_dist DESC NULLS LAST) AS qty_minus_price_cume_dist_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY qty_minus_price ASC NULLS LAST) AS qty_minus_price_rank
    FROM scored
    WHERE qty_minus_price > 36
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY qty_minus_price_cume_dist_dense_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) AS qty_minus_price_cume_dist_dense_rank_percent_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY qty_minus_price_rank DESC) AS qty_minus_price_rank_cume_dist,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY qty_minus_price_cume_dist_percent_rank DESC NULLS FIRST) AS qty_minus_price_cume_dist_percent_rank_percent_rank,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY qty_minus_price_cume_dist ASC NULLS FIRST) AS qty_minus_price_cume_dist_rank
    FROM metrics
)
SELECT
    qty_minus_price_cume_dist,
    qty_minus_price_rank,
    qty_minus_price_cume_dist_dense_rank_percent_rank,
    qty_minus_price_cume_dist_percent_rank_percent_rank,
    qty_minus_price_cume_dist_rank
FROM enriched
ORDER BY qty_minus_price_rank ASC

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty_minus_price").desc())
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty_minus_price_cume_dist").asc_nulls_last())
w4 = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty_minus_price_cume_dist").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty_minus_price").asc_nulls_last())
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty_minus_price_cume_dist_dense_rank").desc_nulls_first())
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty_minus_price_rank").desc())
w8 = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty_minus_price_cume_dist_percent_rank").desc_nulls_first())
w9 = Window.orderBy(F.col("qty_minus_price_cume_dist").asc_nulls_first())

flattened = (
    df_carts
    .withColumn("li_item", F.explode_outer("items"))
    .select(

filtered = (

    .filter(F.col("product_id").between(4, 8))
    .select(
        "coupon_codes",
        "qty",
        F.array_contains("coupon_codes", "BUNDLE").alias("is_bundle"),

valid = (

scored = (
    valid
    .select(

        "is_bundle",
        "qty_minus_price",
        "is_bundle_flag",
        F.percent_rank().over(w).alias("qty_percent_rank"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w2).alias("qty_minus_price_cume_dist"),
    )

metrics = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("qty_minus_price") > 36)

    )
)

enriched = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("qty_minus_price_cume_dist_dense_rank_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w6))
    .withColumn("qty_minus_price_rank_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w7))
    .withColumn("qty_minus_price_cume_dist_percent_rank_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w8))
    .withColumn("qty_minus_price_cume_dist_rank", F.rank().over(w9))
)

result = (
    enriched
    .select(
        "qty_minus_price_cume_dist",
        "qty_minus_price_rank",
        "qty_minus_price_cume_dist_dense_rank_percent_rank",
        "qty_minus_price_cume_dist_percent_rank_percent_rank",
        "qty_minus_price_cume_dist_rank",
```

sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM subscriptions
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC NULLS LAST, id) = 1
),
deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC NULLS FIRST, id) = 1
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        end_date,
        status,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), end_date) AS days_since_end_date,
        DATE_SUB(end_date, 57) AS end_date_minus_57d
    FROM deduped
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND end_date BETWEEN '2023-06-01' AND '2024-01-01'
),
base AS (
    SELECT *, DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), end_date_minus_57d) / 30 AS months_since_end_date_minus_57d
    FROM filtered
    WHERE days_since_end_date < 53
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        end_date,
        status,
        months_since_end_date_minus_57d,
        MAX(days_since_end_date) OVER (PARTITION BY status) AS status_max_days_since_end_date,
        AVG(months_since_end_date_minus_57d) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY end_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS months_since_end_date_minus_57d_avg_5_prior,
        FIRST_VALUE(days_since_end_date) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY end_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_days_since_end_date
    FROM base
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', end_date), plan ORDER BY months_since_end_date_minus_57d_avg_5_prior DESC, id) AS months_since_end_date_minus_57d_avg_5_prior_bucket,
        LAG(months_since_end_date_minus_57d, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY first_known_days_since_end_date, id) AS prev_months_since_end_date_minus_57d
    FROM scored
    WHERE end_date BETWEEN '2023-11-01' AND '2024-03-01'
)
SELECT
    plan,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'PAUSED') AS paused_events,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(status)) AS num_status
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY plan;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("monthly_fee").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("status")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("end_date", "id").rowsBetween(-5, -1)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("end_date", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "end_date"), "plan").orderBy(F.col("months_since_end_date_minus_57d_avg_5_prior").desc(), "id")
w7 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy("first_known_days_since_end_date", "id")

ranked = (
    df_subscriptions
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .drop("latest_rank")
)

deduped = (
    ranked
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .drop("dedup_rank")
)

filtered = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & F.col("end_date").between("2023-06-01", "2024-01-01"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "plan",
        "end_date",
        "status",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "end_date").alias("days_since_end_date"),
        F.date_sub("end_date", 57).alias("end_date_minus_57d"),
    )
)

base = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("days_since_end_date") < 53)
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "end_date_minus_57d") / 30).alias("months_since_end_date_minus_57d"),
    )
)

scored = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        "end_date",
        "status",
        "months_since_end_date_minus_57d",
        F.max("days_since_end_date").over(w3).alias("status_max_days_since_end_date"),
        F.avg("months_since_end_date_minus_57d").over(w4).alias("months_since_end_date_minus_57d_avg_5_prior"),
        F.first("days_since_end_date", ignorenulls=True).over(w5).alias("first_known_days_since_end_date"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("end_date").between("2023-11-01", "2024-03-01"))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(10).over(w6).alias("months_since_end_date_minus_57d_avg_5_prior_bucket"),
        F.lag("months_since_end_date_minus_57d", 2, 0).over(w7).alias("prev_months_since_end_date_minus_57d"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy("plan")
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("status") == "PAUSED").alias("paused_events"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("status")).alias("num_status"),
    )
)
```

WITH valid AS (
    SELECT *, COALESCE(dept_name, 'N/A') AS dept_name_filled
    FROM departments
    WHERE dept_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'Finance'
),
cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(dept_name) AS dept_name_length,
        COALESCE(budget, 0) AS budget_filled,
        COALESCE(location, 'N/A') AS resolved_location
    FROM valid
    WHERE budget > 2313000
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_name,
        location,
        budget_filled,
        STDDEV_SAMP(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name, location) AS dept_name_stddev_samp_budget,
        AVG(budget) OVER (ORDER BY dept_name_length ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS budget_avg_2_prior,
        ROUND(budget / SUM(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name), 4) AS budget_share,
        AVG(dept_name_length) OVER (ORDER BY budget_filled ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS dept_name_length_avg_5,
        AVG(budget) OVER (PARTITION BY location) AS location_avg_budget
    FROM cleaned
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        dept_name,
        location,
        budget_filled,
        dept_name_stddev_samp_budget,
        budget_avg_2_prior,
        budget_share,
        location_avg_budget,
        MIN(dept_name_length_avg_5) OVER (PARTITION BY location) AS location_min_dept_name_length_avg_5,
        AVG(budget_avg_2_prior) OVER (PARTITION BY dept_name ORDER BY location_avg_budget ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS budget_avg_2_prior_avg_3_prior
    FROM scored
),
kept_keys AS (
    SELECT dept_name, location
    FROM metrics
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT dept_name, location
    FROM departments
    WHERE location != 'Tokyo'
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.dept_name = k.dept_name AND s.location = k.location
)
SELECT
    id,
    dept_name,
    budget_avg_2_prior,
    budget_share,
    location_avg_budget,
    location_min_dept_name_length_avg_5,
    budget_avg_2_prior_avg_3_prior
FROM reconciled
ORDER BY budget_share ASC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("dept_name", "location")
w2 = Window.orderBy("dept_name_length", "id").rowsBetween(-2, -1)
w3 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name")
w4 = Window.orderBy("budget_filled", "id").rowsBetween(-5, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("location")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("dept_name").orderBy("location_avg_budget", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)

valid = (
    df_departments
    .filter(F.col("dept_name").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Finance")))
    .withColumn("dept_name_filled", F.coalesce("dept_name", F.lit("N/A")))
)

cleaned = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("budget") > 2313000)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.length("dept_name").alias("dept_name_length"),
        F.coalesce("budget", F.lit(0)).alias("budget_filled"),
        F.coalesce("location", F.lit("N/A")).alias("resolved_location"),
    )
)

scored = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_name",
        "location",
        "budget_filled",
        F.stddev_samp("budget").over(w).alias("dept_name_stddev_samp_budget"),
        F.avg("budget").over(w2).alias("budget_avg_2_prior"),
        F.round((F.col("budget") / F.sum("budget").over(w3)), 4).alias("budget_share"),
        F.avg("dept_name_length").over(w4).alias("dept_name_length_avg_5"),
        F.avg("budget").over(w5).alias("location_avg_budget"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_name",
        "location",
        "budget_filled",
        "dept_name_stddev_samp_budget",
        "budget_avg_2_prior",
        "budget_share",
        "location_avg_budget",
        F.min("dept_name_length_avg_5").over(w5).alias("location_min_dept_name_length_avg_5"),
        F.avg("budget_avg_2_prior").over(w6).alias("budget_avg_2_prior_avg_3_prior"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    metrics
    .select("dept_name", "location")
    .exceptAll(
        df_departments
        .filter(F.col("location") != "Tokyo")
        .select("dept_name", "location")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.dept_name") == F.col("k.dept_name")) & (F.col("s.location") == F.col("k.location")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "id",
        "dept_name",
        "budget_avg_2_prior",
        "budget_share",
        "location_avg_budget",
        "location_min_dept_name_length_avg_5",
        "budget_avg_2_prior_avg_3_prior",
    )
    .orderBy("budget_share")
)
```

        on a.store_id = b.id

),

    from verified
    intersect all

    from store_sales
    where store_id in (2, 5, 6)

    select s.*
    from verified s
    inner join matched_keys_2 k on s.id = k.id and s.product_id = k.product_id
),

```python
    .filter(F.year("sale_date") == 2025)
    .withColumn("revenue_per_unit", F.round((F.col("revenue") / F.col("units")), 2))
)

with_dims = (
    cleaned
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_stores.alias("b"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("b.sqft") >= 7517)

    .select("store_id", "id")

    .join(matched_keys_2.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.product_id") == F.col("k.product_id")), "inner")
```

with metrics as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        *,
        lag(cost) over w_grp as prev_cost,
        lead(cost) over w_grp as next_cost,
        row_number() over w_grp as event_seq
    from shipments
    where order_id is null
    window w_grp as (partition by carrier order by shipped_date asc, id asc)
),
metrics_shipments as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        event_seq,
        ntile(10) over (partition by carrier order by prev_cost asc, id asc) as prev_cost_bucket,
        sum(prev_cost) over (partition by year(shipped_date), order_id order by prev_cost asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_prev_cost
    from metrics
),
matched_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id, carrier
    from metrics_shipments
    except
    select id, carrier
    from shipments
    where shipped_date < '2024-03-30'
),
kept_rows as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from metrics_shipments s
    inner join matched_keys k on s.id = k.id and s.carrier = k.carrier
),
matched_keys_2 as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select id, carrier
    from kept_rows
    intersect all
    select id, carrier
    from shipments
    where order_id is not null
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from kept_rows s
    inner join matched_keys_2 k on s.id = k.id and s.carrier = k.carrier
),
cleaned as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        event_seq,
        prev_cost_bucket,
        cumulative_prev_cost,
        round(cumulative_prev_cost / event_seq, 2) as cumulative_prev_cost_per_event_seq,
        least(cumulative_prev_cost, prev_cost_bucket) as least_cumulative_prev_cost_prev_cost_bucket
    from reconciled
    where carrier is not null
),
valid as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        shipped_date,
        prev_cost_bucket,
        cumulative_prev_cost,
        cumulative_prev_cost_per_event_seq,
        greatest(prev_cost_bucket, least_cumulative_prev_cost_prev_cost_bucket) as greatest_prev_cost_bucket_least_cumulative_prev_cost_prev_cost_bucket,
        round(prev_cost_bucket / cumulative_prev_cost, 2) as prev_cost_bucket_per_cumulative_prev_cost,
        coalesce(carrier, 'UNKNOWN') as carrier_filled
    from cleaned
    where shipped_date > to_date('2023-06-01')
      and carrier is not null
),
base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        shipped_date,
        cumulative_prev_cost,
        cumulative_prev_cost_per_event_seq,
        greatest_prev_cost_bucket_least_cumulative_prev_cost_prev_cost_bucket,
        carrier_filled,
        round(prev_cost_bucket, 1) as prev_cost_bucket_rounded,
        add_months(shipped_date, 3) as shipped_date_plus_months
    from valid
    where cumulative_prev_cost_per_event_seq <= 51
)

        INITCAP(TRIM(event_type)) event_type_title,
        COALESCE(page, 'OTHER') page_clean
    FROM web_events
    WHERE event_time >= TO_DATE('2023-06-11')
      AND page IS NOT NULL
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        LAG(months_since_event_time, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id, event_type ORDER BY months_since_event_time, id) prev_months_since_event_time,
        LAST_VALUE(duration_sec, TRUE) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type ORDER BY duration_sec, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last_known_duration_sec,
        COUNT(duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', event_time), event_type ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) duration_sec_count_7d
    FROM valid
    WHERE months_since_event_time <= 51
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY months_since_event_time DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS row_num
    FROM with_windows
    QUALIFY row_num = 1
),
with_windows_web_events AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        id,
        session_id,
        event_type,
        page,
        event_time,
        event_type_title,
        page_clean,
        last_known_duration_sec,
        row_num,
        FIRST_VALUE(months_since_event_time) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY prev_months_since_event_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) first_known_months_since_event_time,
        COUNT(last_known_duration_sec) OVER (PARTITION BY event_type) event_type_count_last_known_duration_sec,
        LAG(prev_months_since_event_time, 2, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', event_time), event_type ORDER BY months_since_event_time, id) prev_prev_months_since_event_time,
        LAG(months_since_event_time, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY months_since_event_time, id) prev_months_since_event_time_2,
        LEAD(months_since_event_time, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY page ORDER BY duration_sec_count_7d, id) next_months_since_event_time
    FROM deduped
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN first_known_months_since_event_time >= 62 THEN 'High' WHEN first_known_months_since_event_time >= 10 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END first_known_months_since_event_time_level,
        COALESCE(page, 'UNKNOWN') page_clean_2
    FROM with_windows_web_events

```python
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("MONTH", "event_time"), "event_type").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy(F.col("months_since_event_time").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy("prev_months_since_event_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("event_type")
w7 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("YEAR", "event_time"), "event_type").orderBy("months_since_event_time", "id")
w8 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy("months_since_event_time", "id")
w9 = Window.partitionBy("page").orderBy("duration_sec_count_7d", "id")

valid = (
    df_web_events
    .filter((F.col("event_time") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-11"))) & F.col("page").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "event_time") / 30).alias("months_since_event_time"),
        F.initcap(F.trim("event_type")).alias("event_type_title"),
        F.coalesce("page", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("page_clean"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("months_since_event_time") <= 51)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lag("months_since_event_time", 1, 0).over(w).alias("prev_months_since_event_time"),
        F.last("duration_sec", ignorenulls=True).over(w2).alias("last_known_duration_sec"),
        F.count("duration_sec").over(w3).alias("duration_sec_count_7d"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    with_windows
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

with_windows_web_events = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "id",
        "session_id",
        "event_type",
        "page",
        "event_time",
        "event_type_title",
        "page_clean",
        "last_known_duration_sec",
        "row_num",
        F.first("months_since_event_time", ignorenulls=True).over(w5).alias("first_known_months_since_event_time"),
        F.count("last_known_duration_sec").over(w6).alias("event_type_count_last_known_duration_sec"),
        F.lag("prev_months_since_event_time", 2, 0).over(w7).alias("prev_prev_months_since_event_time"),
        F.lag("months_since_event_time", 1, 0).over(w8).alias("prev_months_since_event_time_2"),
        F.lead("months_since_event_time", 1).over(w9).alias("next_months_since_event_time"),
    )
)

cleaned = (
    with_windows_web_events
    .filter(F.col("first_known_months_since_event_time").between(43, 79))
    .withColumn("first_known_months_since_event_time_level", F.when(F.col("first_known_months_since_event_time") >= 62, "High").when(F.col("first_known_months_since_event_time") >= 10, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("page_clean_2", F.coalesce("page", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

result = (
    cleaned
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("dim"), F.col("src.session_id") == F.col("dim.id"), "inner")
    .rollup(
        F.col("dim.device").alias("device"),
        F.col("dim.country").alias("country"),
        F.col("src.event_type").alias("event_type"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rows_total"),
```

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, LENGTH(channel) AS channel_length
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2023-09-28'
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        status,
        channel,
        channel_length
    FROM valid
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel ORDER BY discount DESC NULLS FIRST, id ASC) = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        s.city,
        s.sqft
    FROM latest src
    JOIN stores s
        ON src.store_id = s.id
),
ranked AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY channel_length DESC) AS dedup_rank
        FROM joined
    ) t
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.store_id,
    s.channel,
    s.channel_length,
    s.city,
    s.dedup_rank,
    CASE WHEN city RLIKE '^(Bangkok|Tokyo)$' THEN 'CORE' WHEN city RLIKE '^(Chiang Mai|New York)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'GROUP_B' END AS city_zone,
    (SELECT MAX(s2.revenue) FROM store_sales s2 WHERE s2.store_id = s.store_id) AS max_store_sale_revenue
FROM ranked s
ORDER BY channel ASC, channel_length ASC

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("discount").desc_nulls_first(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("channel_length").desc())

    df_orders

    valid
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
    .select("id", "store_id", "status", "channel", "channel_length")
)

joined = (
    latest
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("src.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .select("src.*", F.col("s.city"), F.col("s.sqft"))
)

    joined
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w2))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)

    ranked
    .join(revenue_by_store_id, on="store_id", how="left")

        "store_id",

        "channel_length",
        "city",

        F.col("max_store_sale_revenue"),
```

with flagged as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(paid_at) over (partition by order_id order by paid_at asc, id asc) is null
                 or paid_at > lag(paid_at) over (partition by order_id order by paid_at asc, id asc) + interval '90' day then 1 else 0 end as session_start_flag
    from payments
),
sessions_payments as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(session_start_flag) over (partition by order_id order by paid_at asc, id asc rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as session_no
    from flagged
)
select
    s.id,
    s.order_id,
    s.method,
    s.amount,
    s.paid_at,
    s.status,
    s.session_start_flag,
    (select max(p2.amount) from payments p2 where p2.order_id = s.order_id) as max_payment_amount
from sessions_payments s;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("paid_at", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
amount_by_order_id = df_payments.groupBy("order_id").agg(F.max("amount").alias("max_payment_amount"))

flagged = (
    df_payments
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("paid_at").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("paid_at") > F.lag("paid_at").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 90 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_payments = flagged.withColumn("session_no", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_payments
    .join(amount_by_order_id, on="order_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "method",
        "amount",
        "paid_at",
        "status",
        "session_start_flag",

)
```

```python
w4 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc())
w_ordered = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct", "id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct_percent_rank", "id")
```

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, TRIM(supplier_name) AS clean_supplier_name
    FROM suppliers
    WHERE UPPER(supplier_name) LIKE '%URO%'
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        country,
        city,
        rating,
        clean_supplier_name
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY rating DESC, id) AS latest_rank
        FROM filtered
    ) ranked
    WHERE latest_rank = 1
),
scored AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        MIN(rating) OVER w_running AS last4_min_rating,
        AVG(rating) OVER w_running AS last4_avg_rating,
        COUNT(rating) OVER w_running AS last4_count_rating,
        MAX(rating) OVER w_running AS last4_max_rating,
        LEAD(rating, 1) OVER w_grp AS next_rating
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY rating, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), w_grp AS (PARTITION BY country, city ORDER BY rating, id)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        city,
        last4_max_rating,
        next_rating,
        LAG(last4_max_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY last4_max_rating, id) AS prev_last4_max_rating,
        LEAD(last4_max_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY last4_max_rating, id) AS next_last4_max_rating,
        LAG(last4_avg_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY last4_max_rating, id) AS prev_last4_avg_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY last4_max_rating, id) AS row_seq
    FROM scored
),
filtered_suppliers AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        city,
        last4_max_rating,
        next_rating,
        prev_last4_max_rating,
        prev_last4_avg_rating,
        ROUND(row_seq, 0) AS row_seq_rounded,
        row_seq * next_rating AS row_seq_times_next_rating
    FROM enriched
    WHERE city IS NOT NULL
      AND city IS DISTINCT FROM 'Chiang Mai'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(next_rating) OVER (PARTITION BY city) AS city_count_next_rating,
        FIRST_VALUE(prev_last4_max_rating) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY city ORDER BY prev_last4_max_rating, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_prev_last4_max_rating,
        LEAD(row_seq_times_next_rating, 1) OVER (ORDER BY prev_last4_avg_rating, id) AS next_row_seq_times_next_rating
    FROM filtered_suppliers
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    city,
    CASE WHEN next_row_seq_times_next_rating >= 73 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS next_row_seq_times_next_rating_tier,
    COUNT_IF(city = 'Bangkok') AS bangkok_events,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    MIN(row_seq_rounded) AS min_row_seq_rounded
FROM with_windows
GROUP BY city, CASE WHEN next_row_seq_times_next_rating >= 73 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
HAVING min_row_seq_rounded > 0
ORDER BY city NULLS LAST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("rating").desc(), "id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("rating", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("country", "city").orderBy("rating", "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("last4_max_rating", "id")
w5 = Window.partitionBy("city")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("city").orderBy("prev_last4_max_rating", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.orderBy("prev_last4_avg_rating", "id")

filtered = (
    df_suppliers
    .filter(F.upper("supplier_name").like("%URO%"))
    .withColumn("clean_supplier_name", F.trim("supplier_name"))
)

deduped = (
    filtered
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "country", "city", "rating", "clean_supplier_name")
)

scored = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.min("rating").over(w_running).alias("last4_min_rating"),
        F.avg("rating").over(w_running).alias("last4_avg_rating"),
        F.count("rating").over(w_running).alias("last4_count_rating"),
        F.max("rating").over(w_running).alias("last4_max_rating"),
        F.lead("rating", 1).over(w_grp).alias("next_rating"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "city",
        "last4_max_rating",
        "next_rating",
        F.lag("last4_max_rating").over(w4).alias("prev_last4_max_rating"),
        F.lead("last4_max_rating").over(w4).alias("next_last4_max_rating"),
        F.lag("last4_avg_rating").over(w4).alias("prev_last4_avg_rating"),
        F.row_number().over(w4).alias("row_seq"),
    )
)

filtered_suppliers = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("city").isNotNull() & (~F.col("city").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Chiang Mai"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "city",
        "last4_max_rating",
        "next_rating",
        "prev_last4_max_rating",
        "prev_last4_avg_rating",
        F.round("row_seq", 0).alias("row_seq_rounded"),
        (F.col("row_seq") * F.col("next_rating")).alias("row_seq_times_next_rating"),
    )
)

with_windows = (
    filtered_suppliers
    .withColumn("city_count_next_rating", F.count("next_rating").over(w5))
    .withColumn("first_known_prev_last4_max_rating", F.first("prev_last4_max_rating", ignorenulls=True).over(w6))
    .withColumn("next_row_seq_times_next_rating", F.lead("row_seq_times_next_rating", 1).over(w7))
)

result = (
    with_windows
    .groupBy(
        "city",
        F.when(F.col("next_row_seq_times_next_rating") >= 73, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("next_row_seq_times_next_rating_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("city") == "Bangkok").alias("bangkok_events"),
        F.count("*").alias("event_count"),
        F.min("row_seq_rounded").alias("min_row_seq_rounded"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("min_row_seq_rounded") > 0)
    .orderBy(F.col("city").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        LOWER(job_title) AS job_title_lower,
        CAST(is_remote AS INT) AS is_remote_flag
    FROM employees
    WHERE YEAR(hire_date) >= 2024
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.dept_name,
        b.budget
    FROM cleaned src
    INNER JOIN departments b
        ON src.dept_id = b.id
    WHERE b.location IN ('New York', 'Singapore', 'Tokyo')
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT job_title
    FROM joined
    INTERSECT
    SELECT job_title
    FROM employees
    WHERE salary > 103000
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM joined s
    INNER JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.job_title = k.job_title
),
joined_employees AS (
    SELECT s.*, d.job_title AS employee_job_title
    FROM reconciled s
    INNER JOIN employees d
        ON s.manager_id = d.id
),
scored AS (
    SELECT *, SUM(is_remote_flag) OVER w_grp AS manager_id_sum_is_remote_flag
    FROM joined_employees
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY manager_id)
)
SELECT
    d.location,
    src.job_title,
    COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
    MIN(src.is_remote_flag) AS min_is_remote_flag,
    SUM(src.budget) AS total_budget,
    GROUPING_ID() AS level_id
FROM scored src
INNER JOIN departments d ON src.dept_id = d.id
GROUP BY ROLLUP (d.location, src.job_title);
reference:

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("manager_id")

cleaned = (
    df_employees
    .filter(F.year("hire_date") >= 2024)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.lower("job_title").alias("job_title_lower"),
        F.col("is_remote").cast("int").alias("is_remote_flag"),
    )
)

joined = (
    cleaned
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_departments.alias("b"), F.col("src.dept_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("b.location").isin(["New York", "Singapore", "Tokyo"]))
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.dept_name"), F.col("b.budget"))
)

remaining_keys = (
    joined
    .select("job_title")
    .intersect(
        df_employees
        .filter(F.col("salary") > 103000)
        .select("job_title")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    joined
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.job_title") == F.col("k.job_title")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

joined_employees = (
    reconciled
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_employees.alias("d"), F.col("s.manager_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .select("s.*", F.col("d.job_title").alias("employee_job_title"))
)

scored = (
    joined_employees
    .withColumn("manager_id_sum_is_remote_flag", F.sum("is_remote_flag").over(w_grp))
)

result = (
    scored
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_departments.alias("d"), F.col("src.dept_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .rollup(
        F.col("d.location").alias("location"),
        F.col("src.job_title").alias("job_title"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("rows_total"),
        F.min(F.col("src.is_remote_flag")).alias("min_is_remote_flag"),
        F.sum(F.col("src.budget")).alias("total_budget"),
        F.grouping_id().alias("level_id"),
    )
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy("started_at", "id")
```

```python
    df_device_readings
    .withColumn("new_group_flag", F.when(F.lag("reading_ts").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("reading_ts") > F.lag("reading_ts").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 20 MINUTES")), 1).otherwise(0))
```

WITH deduped AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM transactions
    ) t
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        rank_in_group,
        LEAST(amount, rank_in_group) AS least_amount_rank_in_group
    FROM deduped
    WHERE txn_type = 'CREDIT'
      AND merchant IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'Starbucks'
),
deduped_transactions AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY least_amount_rank_in_group DESC, id) AS rank_in_group_2
    FROM base
    QUALIFY rank_in_group_2 = 1
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        rank_in_group_2,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id, merchant ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS FIRST) AS amount_dense_rank,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(txn_time) ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS amount_avg_5_prior,
        AVG(least_amount_rank_in_group) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY CAST(txn_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 7776000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS least_amount_rank_in_group_avg_90d,
        LEAD(least_amount_rank_in_group, 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY amount, id) AS next_least_amount_rank_in_group,
        AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(txn_time), merchant ORDER BY rank_in_group_2, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_avg_3
    FROM deduped_transactions
    WHERE least_amount_rank_in_group > 23
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN txn_time - LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id) > INTERVAL 30 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM metrics
),
sessionized AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        amount_dense_rank,
        amount_avg_5_prior,
        amount_avg_3,
        SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_no
    FROM flagged
),
deduped_transactions_2 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY amount_dense_rank DESC NULLS FIRST, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM sessionized
    ) t
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN amount_avg_5_prior >= 4052 THEN 'High' WHEN amount_avg_5_prior >= 1920 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS amount_avg_5_prior_level
    FROM deduped_transactions_2
    WHERE txn_time >= TIMESTAMP '2023-10-31 11:00:00'
)
SELECT
    session_no,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(amount_dense_rank, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS amount_dense_rank_quartiles,
    MIN(txn_time) AS started_at,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(txn_time)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(txn_time))) / 60 AS duration_min,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(merchant)) AS merchant_list,

FROM filtered

WITH flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id) IS NULL
                 OR txn_time > LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id) + INTERVAL 7 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM transactions
)
-- Running sum of the flag = session number
SELECT
    id,
    account_id,
    txn_type,
    amount,
    txn_time,
    is_flagged,
    SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
FROM flagged;

```python
w = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id")

    df_transactions
    .withColumn("is_new_session", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

    .select(

        "txn_type",
        "amount",

)
```

WITH rollup_totals AS (

        p.category,
        p.brand,
        COUNT(*) AS rows_total,
        ROUND(SUM(s.quantity), 2) AS total_quantity
    FROM inventory s
    LEFT JOIN products p ON s.product_id = p.id
    GROUP BY p.category, p.brand

    brand,

WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        line.price,
        line.promo
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(items) e AS line
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        a.*,
        b.signup_date,
        b.email,
        b.age
    FROM flattened a
    JOIN customers b
        ON a.customer_id = b.id
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        price,
        promo,
        signup_date,
        email,
        age,
        INITCAP(TRIM(promo)) AS promo_title,
        DATE_TRUNC('year', created_at) AS created_at_period
    FROM with_dims
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND customer_id = 32
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT *, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY age) AS age_cume_dist
    FROM cleaned
),
with_dims_carts AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        b.segment,
        b.name,
        b.city
    FROM enriched src
    LEFT JOIN customers b
        ON src.customer_id = b.id
),
with_dims_carts_2 AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        a.customer_id,
        a.email,
        a.name,
        c.country,
        c.name AS customer_name
    FROM with_dims_carts a
    LEFT JOIN customers c
        ON a.customer_id <=> c.id
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach customers attributes
    SELECT
        s.*,
        p.country AS customer_country,
        p.email AS customer_email
    FROM with_dims_carts_2 s
    LEFT JOIN customers p
        ON s.customer_id = p.id
)
SELECT
    customer_id,
    email,
    name,
    customer_name,
    customer_country,
    customer_email,
    CASE WHEN customer_name RLIKE '^(bob smith|David Lee )$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'EXTENDED' END AS customer_name_zone
FROM joined
ORDER BY customer_id NULLS LAST;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("age")

flattened = (
    df_carts
    .withColumn("line", F.explode("items"))
    .select("id", "customer_id", "created_at", F.col("line.price"), F.col("line.promo"))
)

with_dims = (
    flattened
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("a.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "inner")
    .select("a.*", F.col("b.signup_date"), F.col("b.email"), F.col("b.age"))
)

cleaned = (
    with_dims
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("customer_id") == 32))
    .select(
        "customer_id",
        "price",
        "promo",
        "signup_date",
        "email",
        "age",
        F.initcap(F.trim("promo")).alias("promo_title"),
        F.date_trunc("year", "created_at").alias("created_at_period"),
    )
)

enriched = cleaned.withColumn("age_cume_dist", F.cume_dist().over(w))

with_dims_carts = (
    enriched
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_customers.alias("b"), F.col("src.customer_id") == F.col("b.id"), "left")
    .select("src.*", F.col("b.segment"), F.col("b.name"), F.col("b.city"))
)

with_dims_carts_2 = (
    with_dims_carts
    .alias("a")
    .join(df_customers.alias("c"), F.col("a.customer_id").eqNullSafe(F.col("c.id")), "left")
    .select(
        "a.customer_id",
        "a.email",
        "a.name",
        F.col("c.country"),
        F.col("c.name").alias("customer_name"),
    )
)

joined = (
    with_dims_carts_2
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_customers.alias("p"), F.col("s.customer_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("p.country").alias("customer_country"),
        F.col("p.email").alias("customer_email"),
    )
)

result = (
    joined
    .select(
        "customer_id",
        "email",
        "name",
        "customer_name",
        "customer_country",
        "customer_email",
        F.when(F.col("customer_name").rlike("^(bob smith|David Lee )$"), "CORE").otherwise("EXTENDED").alias("customer_name_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("customer_id").asc_nulls_last())
)
```

WITH base AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), started_at) AS days_since_started_at,
        COALESCE(country, 'NONE') AS country_filled
    FROM sessions
    WHERE device IN ('desktop', 'tablet')
      AND started_at > TO_TIMESTAMP('2023-02-27 04:00:00')
),
with_gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN started_at - LAG(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id) > INTERVAL '90' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS session_start_flag
    FROM base
),
sessions_sessions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(session_start_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY started_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM with_gaps
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    device,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE browser = 'Firefox') AS firefox_rows,
    ROUND(AVG(session_id), 2) AS avg_session_id,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE browser = 'Edge') AS edge_rows
FROM sessions_sessions
GROUP BY device
HAVING avg_session_id < 1000000

```python
    df_sessions

)

result = (
    sessions_sessions
    .groupBy("device")
    .agg(
        F.count(F.when(F.col("browser") == "Firefox", 1)).alias("firefox_rows"),
        F.round(F.avg("session_id"), 2).alias("avg_session_id"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("browser") == "Edge", 1)).alias("edge_rows"),
```

WITH filtered AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        last_restock,
        ROUND(quantity * 0.85, 2) AS quantity_adjusted
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock >= TO_DATE('2023-04-05')
),
with_dims AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        src.*,
        s.sqft,
        s.store_name
    FROM filtered src
    LEFT JOIN stores s
        ON src.store_id = s.id
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        product_id,
        quantity_adjusted,
        sqft
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY store_id, product_id ORDER BY quantity_adjusted DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC) AS dedup_rank
        FROM with_dims
    ) t
    WHERE dedup_rank = 1
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, product_id
    FROM latest
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id, product_id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock >= '2023-12-01'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM latest s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.product_id = k.product_id
)
-- Join a dimension and aggregate
SELECT
    d.category,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    AVG(src.sqft) AS avg_sqft,
    AVG(src.quantity_adjusted) AS avg_quantity_adjusted
FROM reconciled src
LEFT JOIN products d ON src.product_id = d.id
GROUP BY d.category
ORDER BY category DESC NULLS LAST

    select

        ntile(10) over (order by pressure desc, id) as pressure_bucket,
        row_number() over (partition by device_code order by status_bits, id) as row_seq,
        avg(humidity) over (order by reading_ts, id rows between 3 preceding and current row) as humidity_avg_3
    from device_readings

cleaned as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select
        id,
        reading_ts,
        humidity,
        pressure,
        status_bits,
        pressure_bucket,
        row_seq,
        humidity_avg_3,
        round(humidity, 1) as humidity_rounded
    from with_windows
    where reading_ts > timestamp '2025-09-01 03:00:00'
),
valid as (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    select *, ceil(humidity) as humidity_whole
    from cleaned
    where reading_ts > date '2025-09-01'
),
valid_device_readings as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        case when pressure >= 1019 then 'High' when pressure >= 999 then 'Medium' else 'Low' end as pressure_tier,
        round(row_seq / humidity, 2) as row_seq_per_humidity
    from valid
    where pressure_bucket between 7 and 8
)
select
    id,
    reading_ts,
    humidity,
    pressure,
    row_seq,
    humidity_rounded,

    pressure_tier
from valid_device_readings

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("txn_type", "merchant").orderBy("txn_time_day", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("merchant").orderBy("txn_time_day", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.partitionBy(F.year("txn_time"), "account_id").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("txn_time"), "merchant").orderBy("amount", "id")
w_hist = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy(F.col("amount").desc())

valid = (
    df_transactions
    .filter(F.col("is_flagged"))
    .withColumn("txn_time_day", F.dayofmonth("txn_time"))
)

deduped = (
    valid
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

metrics = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("txn_time") < "2023-11-13")
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_id",
        "txn_type",
        "amount",
        "txn_time",
        "merchant",
        "is_flagged",
        F.sum("amount").over(w2).alias("running_amount"),
        F.sum("txn_time_day").over(w3).alias("running_txn_time_day"),
        F.ntile(5).over(w4).alias("amount_bucket"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w_hist).alias("amount_cume_dist"),
    )
)

filtered = (
    metrics
    .filter(F.col("txn_time") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-10")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("amount_cume_dist") / F.col("running_amount")), 2).alias("amount_cume_dist_per_running_amount"),
    )
)

result = (
    filtered
    .select(
        "id",
        "merchant",
        "amount",
        "amount_cume_dist_per_running_amount",
        "amount_cume_dist",
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "merchant"],
        values=["amount", "amount_cume_dist_per_running_amount", "amount_cume_dist"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="val",
    )
    .filter(F.col("val").isNotNull())
)
```

    WHERE delivered_date > DATE '2023-07-14'
      AND YEAR(shipped_date) >= 2024
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN status = 'LOST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_lost,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'UNKNOWN') AS carrier_filled
    FROM filtered
    WHERE carrier IS DISTINCT FROM 'FedEx'
),
latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY is_lost DESC NULLS LAST, id) AS rank_in_group
    FROM cleaned
    QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        cost,
        status,
        shipped_date_plus_months,
        rank_in_group,
        CEIL(is_lost) AS is_lost_whole,
        ROUND(DATEDIFF(shipped_date_plus_months, shipped_date) / 30, 1) AS months_shipped_date_to_shipped_date_plus_months,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'OTHER') AS carrier_filled_2
    FROM latest
    WHERE carrier IS NOT NULL
      AND shipped_date > DATE '2023-09-14'
)
-- Native SQL UNPIVOT (wide to long)
SELECT
    id,
    carrier,
    metric,
    val
FROM (
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,
        months_shipped_date_to_shipped_date_plus_months,
        cost

) src
UNPIVOT (

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("is_lost").desc_nulls_last(), "id")

filtered = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.lit("2023-07-14").cast("date")) & (F.year("shipped_date") >= 2024))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "cost",
        "status",
        F.add_months("shipped_date", 3).alias("shipped_date_plus_months"),
    )
)

cleaned = (

    .filter(~F.col("carrier").eqNullSafe(F.lit("FedEx")))
    .withColumn("is_lost", F.when(F.col("status") == "LOST", 1).otherwise(0))
    .withColumn("carrier_filled", F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("UNKNOWN")))
)

latest = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)

valid = (

    .filter(F.col("carrier").isNotNull() & (F.col("shipped_date") > F.lit("2023-09-14").cast("date")))

        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("OTHER")).alias("carrier_filled_2"),
    )
)

result = (

    .select("id", "carrier", "months_shipped_date_to_shipped_date_plus_months", "cost")
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id", "carrier"],
        values=["months_shipped_date_to_shipped_date_plus_months", "cost"],
```

WITH flattened AS (
    SELECT
        c.id,
        c.coupon_codes,
        pos + 1 AS position,
        li_item.product_id,
        li_item.price,
        li_item.promo
    FROM carts c
    LATERAL VIEW POSEXPLODE(c.items) e AS pos, li_item
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM flattened
    INTERSECT ALL
    SELECT id
    FROM carts
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM flattened s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        position,
        product_id,
        price,
        promo,
        MAX(product_id) OVER w_hist AS promo_max_product_id,
        STDDEV_SAMP(price) OVER w_hist AS promo_stddev_samp_price,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY product_id DESC NULLS LAST) AS product_id_dense_rank,
        RANK() OVER w_ordered AS price_rank
    FROM verified
    WHERE product_id BETWEEN 7 AND 8
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY promo), w_ordered AS (ORDER BY price DESC NULLS FIRST)
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        position,
        product_id,
        promo_stddev_samp_price,
        product_id_dense_rank,
        price_rank,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY promo ORDER BY position) AS position_cume_dist
    FROM with_windows
),
base AS (
    SELECT *, COALESCE(position, 0) AS position_filled
    FROM scored
    WHERE promo_stddev_samp_price BETWEEN 165 AND 174
),
base_carts AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        position,
        promo_stddev_samp_price,
        product_id_dense_rank,
        position_filled,
        CAST(product_id_dense_rank AS STRING) AS product_id_dense_rank_num,
        CASE WHEN promo_stddev_samp_price >= 264 THEN 'High' WHEN promo_stddev_samp_price >= 53 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS promo_stddev_samp_price_level
    FROM base
    WHERE position_cume_dist <= 0.34
),
with_windows_carts AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        promo_stddev_samp_price,
        product_id_dense_rank,
        position_filled,
        promo_stddev_samp_price_level,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_hist AS position_filled_percent_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER w_running AS product_id_dense_rank_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY position DESC NULLS FIRST) AS position_dense_rank
    FROM base_carts
    WINDOW w_hist AS (ORDER BY position_filled DESC NULLS LAST), w_running AS (ORDER BY product_id_dense_rank DESC NULLS LAST)
)
SELECT
    promo_stddev_samp_price,
    promo_stddev_samp_price_level,
    position_filled_percent_rank,
    position_dense_rank
FROM with_windows_carts
ORDER BY promo_stddev_samp_price;
