```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_hist = Window.partitionBy("promo")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("product_id").desc_nulls_last())
w_ordered = Window.orderBy(F.col("price").desc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("promo").orderBy("position")
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("position_filled").desc_nulls_last())
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("product_id_dense_rank").desc_nulls_last())
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("position").desc_nulls_first())

flattened = (
    df_carts
    .select("*", F.posexplode("items").alias("pos", "li_item"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "coupon_codes",
        (F.col("pos") + 1).alias("position"),
        F.col("li_item.product_id"),
        F.col("li_item.price"),
        F.col("li_item.promo"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    flattened
    .select("id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_carts
        .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
        .select("id")
    )
)

verified = (
    flattened
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("product_id").between(7, 8))
    .select(
        "id",
        "position",
        "product_id",
        "price",
        "promo",
        F.max("product_id").over(w_hist).alias("promo_max_product_id"),
        F.stddev_samp("price").over(w_hist).alias("promo_stddev_samp_price"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w2).alias("product_id_dense_rank"),
        F.rank().over(w_ordered).alias("price_rank"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "position",
        "product_id",
        "promo_stddev_samp_price",
        "product_id_dense_rank",
        "price_rank",
        F.cume_dist().over(w4).alias("position_cume_dist"),
    )
)

base = (
    scored
    .filter(F.col("promo_stddev_samp_price").between(165, 174))
    .select("*", F.coalesce("position", F.lit(0)).alias("position_filled"))
)

base_carts = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("position_cume_dist") <= 0.34)
    .select(
        "id",
        "position",
        "promo_stddev_samp_price",
        "product_id_dense_rank",
        "position_filled",
        F.col("product_id_dense_rank").cast("string").alias("product_id_dense_rank_num"),
        F.when(F.col("promo_stddev_samp_price") >= 264, "High").when(F.col("promo_stddev_samp_price") >= 53, "Medium").otherwise("Low").alias("promo_stddev_samp_price_level"),
    )
)

with_windows_carts = (
    base_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "promo_stddev_samp_price",
        "product_id_dense_rank",
        "position_filled",
        "promo_stddev_samp_price_level",
        F.percent_rank().over(w5).alias("position_filled_percent_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w_running).alias("product_id_dense_rank_dense_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w7).alias("position_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_windows_carts
    .select(
        "promo_stddev_samp_price",
        "promo_stddev_samp_price_level",
        "position_filled_percent_rank",
        "position_dense_rank",

)
```

```python
    .select(
```

```python
        "product_id",
```

    select

        temp_c,
        firmware,
        running_count_temp_c,
        round(humidity / sum(humidity) over (partition by device_code), 4) as humidity_share,

        sum(humidity) over (partition by device_code order by temp_c, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cumulative_humidity,
        sum(running_min_temp_c) over (partition by device_code order by running_min_temp_c, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as running_running_min_temp_c
    from with_windows

sql:
with deduped as (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    select
        id,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        discount_pct
    from promotions
    qualify row_number() over (partition by channel order by starts_on desc, id) = 1
),
scored as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        sum(discount_pct) over (order by ends_on, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) running_discount_pct,
        row_number() over (order by ends_on, id) seq_no
    from deduped
    where discount_pct between 0.2 and 0.29
),
scored_promotions as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        starts_on,
        ends_on,
        running_discount_pct,
        lead(running_discount_pct) over w_part next_running_discount_pct,
        lag(running_discount_pct) over w_part prev_running_discount_pct,
        lag(discount_pct) over w_part prev_discount_pct,
        lead(discount_pct) over w_part next_discount_pct,
        row_number() over w_part event_seq
    from scored
    window w_part as (order by seq_no, id)
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        ntile(3) over (order by running_discount_pct desc, id) running_discount_pct_bucket,
        cume_dist() over (order by event_seq desc) event_seq_cume_dist
    from scored_promotions
),
base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        ends_on,
        running_discount_pct,
        next_running_discount_pct,
        prev_running_discount_pct,
        prev_discount_pct,
        next_discount_pct,
        event_seq,
        running_discount_pct_bucket,
        event_seq_cume_dist,
        event_seq_cume_dist - running_discount_pct_bucket event_seq_cume_dist_minus_running_discount_pct_bucket
    from enriched
    where ends_on >= date '2023-08-17'
      and prev_discount_pct between 0.12 and 0.28
),
base_promotions as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select *, round(prev_running_discount_pct / next_running_discount_pct, 2) prev_running_discount_pct_per_next_running_discount_pct
    from base
    where ends_on > to_date('2023-07-09')
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    case when next_discount_pct >= 0.29 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as next_discount_pct_tier,
    round(avg(next_running_discount_pct), 2) as avg_next_running_discount_pct,
    round(avg(prev_running_discount_pct_per_next_running_discount_pct), 2) as avg_prev_running_discount_pct_per_next_running_discount_pct,
    percentile_approx(event_seq, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as event_seq_quartiles,
    count(distinct id) as distinct_ids,
    percentile_approx(running_discount_pct_bucket, 0.95) as running_discount_pct_bucket_p95,
    count(distinct id) as distinct_ids_2
from base_promotions
group by 1
order by distinct_ids_2 desc;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel").orderBy(F.col("starts_on").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("ends_on", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w3 = Window.orderBy("ends_on", "id")
w_part = Window.orderBy("seq_no", "id")
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("running_discount_pct").desc(), "id")
w6 = Window.orderBy(F.col("event_seq").desc())

deduped = (
    df_promotions
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "starts_on", "ends_on", "discount_pct")
)

scored = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("discount_pct").between(0.2, 0.29))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("discount_pct").over(w2).alias("running_discount_pct"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("seq_no"),
    )
)

scored_promotions = (
    scored
    .select(
        "id",
        "starts_on",
        "ends_on",
        "running_discount_pct",
        F.lead("running_discount_pct").over(w_part).alias("next_running_discount_pct"),
        F.lag("running_discount_pct").over(w_part).alias("prev_running_discount_pct"),
        F.lag("discount_pct").over(w_part).alias("prev_discount_pct"),
        F.lead("discount_pct").over(w_part).alias("next_discount_pct"),
        F.row_number().over(w_part).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    scored_promotions
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(3).over(w5).alias("running_discount_pct_bucket"),
        F.cume_dist().over(w6).alias("event_seq_cume_dist"),
    )
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter((F.col("ends_on") >= F.lit("2023-08-17").cast("date")) & F.col("prev_discount_pct").between(0.12, 0.28))
    .select(
        "id",
        "ends_on",
        "running_discount_pct",
        "next_running_discount_pct",
        "prev_running_discount_pct",
        "prev_discount_pct",
        "next_discount_pct",
        "event_seq",
        "running_discount_pct_bucket",
        "event_seq_cume_dist",
        (F.col("event_seq_cume_dist") - F.col("running_discount_pct_bucket")).alias("event_seq_cume_dist_minus_running_discount_pct_bucket"),
    )
)

base_promotions = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("ends_on") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-07-09")))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("prev_running_discount_pct") / F.col("next_running_discount_pct")), 2).alias("prev_running_discount_pct_per_next_running_discount_pct"),
    )
)

result = (
    base_promotions
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("next_discount_pct") >= 0.29, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("next_discount_pct_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("next_running_discount_pct"), 2).alias("avg_next_running_discount_pct"),
        F.round(F.avg("prev_running_discount_pct_per_next_running_discount_pct"), 2).alias("avg_prev_running_discount_pct_per_next_running_discount_pct"),
        F.percentile_approx("event_seq", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("event_seq_quartiles"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("running_discount_pct_bucket", 0.95).alias("running_discount_pct_bucket_p95"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids_2"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("distinct_ids_2").desc())
)
```

WITH valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        account_type,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        SUBSTRING(status, 1, 2) AS status_prefix,
        DATE_SUB(opened_date, 44) AS opened_date_minus_44d
    FROM accounts
    WHERE status IS NOT NULL
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        account_type,
        balance,
        opened_date,
        opened_date_minus_44d,
        AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_balance,
        MAX(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_balance,
        COUNT(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY balance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_balance,
        LEAD(balance, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY balance, id) AS next_balance
    FROM valid
    WHERE balance < 77000
),
metrics AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(running_max_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY opened_date, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS running_max_balance_avg_6_prior,
        SUM(running_count_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY account_type ORDER BY running_count_balance, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_running_count_balance
    FROM scored
),
not_flagged AS (
    -- Anti-join via a correlated subquery
    SELECT s.*
    FROM metrics s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM transactions x
            WHERE x.account_id = s.id
              AND x.txn_time < s.opened_date_minus_44d
        )
)
SELECT
    id,
    account_type,
    opened_date,
    opened_date_minus_44d,
    running_avg_balance,
    running_max_balance,
    running_count_balance,
    next_balance,
    running_max_balance_avg_6_prior,
    CASE WHEN account_type RLIKE '^(CHECKING|SAVINGS)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN account_type RLIKE '^(CREDIT|LOAN)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS account_type_zone
FROM not_flagged
ORDER BY account_type;

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id").orderBy("balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("balance", "id")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("opened_date", "id").rowsBetween(-6, -1)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("account_type").orderBy("running_count_balance", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

valid = (
    df_accounts
    .filter(F.col("status").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "account_type",
        "balance",
        "opened_date",
        F.substring("status", 1, 2).alias("status_prefix"),
        F.date_sub("opened_date", 44).alias("opened_date_minus_44d"),
    )
)

scored = (
    valid
    .filter(F.col("balance") < 77000)
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_type",
        "balance",
        "opened_date",
        "opened_date_minus_44d",
        F.avg("balance").over(w).alias("running_avg_balance"),
        F.max("balance").over(w).alias("running_max_balance"),
        F.count("balance").over(w).alias("running_count_balance"),
        F.lead("balance", 2).over(w2).alias("next_balance"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    scored
    .withColumn("running_max_balance_avg_6_prior", F.avg("running_max_balance").over(w3))
    .withColumn("cumulative_running_count_balance", F.sum("running_count_balance").over(w4))
)

not_flagged = (
    metrics
    .alias("s")
    .join(df_transactions.alias("x"), (F.col("x.account_id") == F.col("s.id")) & (F.col("x.txn_time") < F.col("s.opened_date_minus_44d")), "left_anti")
)

result = (
    not_flagged
    .select(
        "id",
        "account_type",
        "opened_date",
        "opened_date_minus_44d",
        "running_avg_balance",
        "running_max_balance",
        "running_count_balance",
        "next_balance",
        "running_max_balance_avg_6_prior",
        F.when(F.col("account_type").rlike("^(CHECKING|SAVINGS)$"), "GROUP_B").when(F.col("account_type").rlike("^(CREDIT|LOAN)$"), "EXTENDED").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("account_type_zone"),
    )
    .orderBy("account_type")
)
```

        MIN(temp_c) OVER w_grp last4_min_temp_c,
        SUM(temp_c) OVER w_grp last4_sum_temp_c,
        MAX(temp_c) OVER w_grp last4_max_temp_c,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pressure NULLS LAST) pressure_rank
    FROM valid
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
filtered AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        last4_max_temp_c + pressure_rank last4_max_temp_c_plus_pressure_rank,
        CASE WHEN status_bits >= 12 THEN 'High' WHEN status_bits >= 3 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END status_bits_level
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE pressure BETWEEN 1016 AND 1019
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, device_code
    FROM filtered
    EXCEPT
    SELECT id, device_code
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE status_bits > 10
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.device_code = k.device_code
),
filtered_device_readings AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN pressure >= 1022 THEN 'High' WHEN pressure >= 999 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END pressure_band
    FROM verified
    WHERE humidity >= 49
),
scored AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        device_code,
        pressure,
        last4_min_temp_c,
        pressure_rank,
        last4_max_temp_c_plus_pressure_rank,
        pressure_band,
        COUNT(last4_min_temp_c) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(reading_ts AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) last4_min_temp_c_count_30m,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY greatest_temp_c_pressure DESC NULLS LAST) greatest_temp_c_pressure_rank
    FROM filtered_device_readings
),
scored_device_readings AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        pressure,
        last4_min_temp_c,
        pressure_rank,
        last4_min_temp_c_count_30m,
        greatest_temp_c_pressure_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pressure DESC NULLS FIRST) pressure_dense_rank
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    last4_min_temp_c,
    pressure_rank,
    greatest_temp_c_pressure_rank
FROM scored_device_readings;

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w_grp = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy("reading_ts", "id").rowsBetween(-3, Window.currentRow)
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("pressure").asc_nulls_last())
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("reading_ts").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)
w4 = Window.partitionBy("device_code").orderBy(F.col("greatest_temp_c_pressure").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.orderBy(F.col("pressure").desc_nulls_first())

valid = (
    df_device_readings
    .filter(F.col("reading_ts") >= F.lit("2025-09-01").cast("date"))
    .withColumn("greatest_temp_c_pressure", F.greatest("temp_c", "pressure"))
)

with_windows = (
    valid
    .withColumn("last4_min_temp_c", F.min("temp_c").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("last4_sum_temp_c", F.sum("temp_c").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("last4_max_temp_c", F.max("temp_c").over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("pressure_rank", F.rank().over(w2))
)

filtered = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("pressure").between(1016, 1019))
    .withColumn("last4_max_temp_c_plus_pressure_rank", (F.col("last4_max_temp_c") + F.col("pressure_rank")))
    .withColumn("status_bits_level", F.when(F.col("status_bits") >= 12, "High").when(F.col("status_bits") >= 3, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
)

kept_keys = (
    filtered
    .select("id", "device_code")
    .subtract(
        df_device_readings
        .filter(F.col("status_bits") > 10)
        .select("id", "device_code")
    )
)

verified = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.device_code") == F.col("k.device_code")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered_device_readings = (
    verified
    .filter(F.col("humidity") >= 49)
    .withColumn("pressure_band", F.when(F.col("pressure") >= 1022, "High").when(F.col("pressure") >= 999, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
)

scored = (
    filtered_device_readings
    .select(
        "id",
        "device_code",
        "pressure",
        "last4_min_temp_c",
        "pressure_rank",
        "last4_max_temp_c_plus_pressure_rank",
        "pressure_band",
        F.count("last4_min_temp_c").over(w3).alias("last4_min_temp_c_count_30m"),
        F.rank().over(w4).alias("greatest_temp_c_pressure_rank"),
    )
)

scored_device_readings = (
    scored
    .select(
        "pressure",
        "last4_min_temp_c",
        "pressure_rank",
        "last4_min_temp_c_count_30m",
        "greatest_temp_c_pressure_rank",
        F.dense_rank().over(w5).alias("pressure_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_device_readings
    .select("last4_min_temp_c", "pressure_rank", "greatest_temp_c_pressure_rank")
)
```

sql: WITH base AS (SELECT *, FLOOR(discount_pct) AS discount_pct_whole FROM promotions WHERE discount_pct >= 0.12 AND channel IS NOT NULL), metrics AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct, id) AS row_seq, SUM(discount_pct_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code) AS channel_sum_discount_pct_whole, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct DESC, id) AS event_seq, LEAD(discount_pct_whole, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code ORDER BY discount_pct, id) AS next_discount_pct_whole FROM base WHERE discount_pct >= 0.25), latest AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY channel, promo_code ORDER BY ends_on DESC, id) AS rank_in_group FROM metrics QUALIFY rank_in_group = 1), with_window AS (SELECT src.*, pr.id AS promo_id, pr.promo_code AS promotion_promo_code, pr.discount_pct AS promotion_discount_pct FROM latest src LEFT JOIN promotions pr ON src.channel <=> pr.channel AND src.starts_on >= pr.starts_on AND src.starts_on <= DATE_ADD(pr.ends_on, 10)) SELECT promo_id, SIZE(COLLECT_SET(channel)) AS num_channels, ROUND(SUM(channel_sum_discount_pct_whole) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN promo_code = 'SPRING10' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS channel_sum_discount_pct_whole_per_spring10, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SIZE(COLLECT_SET(channel)) AS num_channels_2, COUNT_IF(promo_code = 'SPRING10') AS spring10_events, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM with_window GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY num_channels_2 DESC NULLS FIRST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code").orderBy("discount_pct", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code")
w3 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code").orderBy(F.col("discount_pct").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("channel", "promo_code").orderBy(F.col("ends_on").desc(), "id")

base = (
    df_promotions
    .filter((F.col("discount_pct") >= 0.12) & F.col("channel").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("discount_pct_whole", F.floor("discount_pct"))
)

metrics = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("discount_pct") >= 0.25)
    .select(
        "*",
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("row_seq"),
        F.sum("discount_pct_whole").over(w2).alias("channel_sum_discount_pct_whole"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("event_seq"),
        F.lead("discount_pct_whole", 1).over(w).alias("next_discount_pct_whole"),
    )
)

latest = (
    metrics
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w4))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

with_window = (
    latest
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_promotions.alias("pr"), (F.col("src.channel").eqNullSafe(F.col("pr.channel"))) & (F.col("src.starts_on") >= F.col("pr.starts_on")) & (F.col("src.starts_on") <= F.date_add(F.col("pr.ends_on"), 10)), "left")
    .select(
        "src.*",
        F.col("pr.id").alias("promo_id"),
        F.col("pr.promo_code").alias("promotion_promo_code"),
        F.col("pr.discount_pct").alias("promotion_discount_pct"),
    )
)

result = (
    with_window
    .groupBy("promo_id")
    .agg(
        F.size(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("num_channels"),
        F.round(F.sum("channel_sum_discount_pct_whole") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("promo_code") == "SPRING10", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("channel_sum_discount_pct_whole_per_spring10"),
        F.count("*").alias("cnt"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("channel")).alias("num_channels_2"),
        F.count_if(F.col("promo_code") == "SPRING10").alias("spring10_events"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("num_channels_2").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

with flattened as (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    select
        id,
        host,
        log_ts,
        level,
        latency_ms,
        status_code,
        k,
        v
    from app_logs
    lateral view explode(context) li as k, v
),
with_windows as (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    select
        id,
        host,
        status_code,
        k,
        first_value(latency_ms) ignore nulls over (partition by k order by log_ts, id, k rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as first_known_latency_ms,
        row_number() over (partition by k order by status_code, id, k) as row_seq
    from flattened
),
with_windows_app_logs as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        id,
        status_code,
        k,
        first_known_latency_ms,
        row_seq,
        min(row_seq) over (partition by host order by row_seq, id, k rows between 3 preceding and current row) as last4_min_row_seq,
        count(row_seq) over (partition by host order by row_seq, id, k rows between 3 preceding and current row) as last4_count_row_seq,
        sum(row_seq) over (partition by host order by row_seq, id, k rows between 3 preceding and current row) as last4_sum_row_seq,
        row_number() over (partition by host order by first_known_latency_ms desc, id, k) as row_seq_2
    from with_windows
),
enriched as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        status_code,
        k,
        first_known_latency_ms,
        row_seq,
        last4_min_row_seq,
        last4_count_row_seq,
        last4_sum_row_seq,
        row_seq_2,
        sum(last4_min_row_seq) over (partition by k order by row_seq, id, k rows between 6 preceding and current row) as last7_sum_last4_min_row_seq,
        max(last4_min_row_seq) over (partition by k order by row_seq, id, k rows between 6 preceding and current row) as last7_max_last4_min_row_seq,
        min(last4_min_row_seq) over (partition by k order by row_seq, id, k rows between 6 preceding and current row) as last7_min_last4_min_row_seq
    from with_windows_app_logs
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    k,
    sort_array(collect_set(k)) as k_list,
    round(sum(last4_sum_row_seq) / nullif(count(case when k = 'version' then 1 end), 0), 2) as last4_sum_row_seq_per_version,
    bit_and(status_code) as status_code_bit_and,
    avg(last4_count_row_seq) filter (where k = 'region') as region_avg_last4_count_row_seq
from enriched
group by k
having status_code_bit_and >= 1
order by region_avg_last4_count_row_seq desc

with base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        *,
        cast(is_flagged as int) as is_flagged_flag,
        coalesce(merchant, 'NONE') as resolved_merchant
    from transactions
    where txn_time > to_date('2023-08-07')
      and merchant is not null
),
with_gaps as (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > interval)
    select *, case when lag(txn_time) over (partition by txn_type order by txn_time, id) is null
                 or txn_time > lag(txn_time) over (partition by txn_type order by txn_time, id) + interval '7' day then 1 else 0 end as session_start_flag
    from base
),
sessions_transactions as (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    select *, sum(session_start_flag) over (partition by txn_type order by txn_time, id rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as island_id
    from with_gaps
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
select
    case when island_id >= 8 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as island_id_tier,
    date_trunc('quarter', txn_time) as quarter_start,
    case when amount >= 4200 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end as amount_tier,
    round(avg(is_flagged_flag), 2) as avg_is_flagged_flag,
    count(*) as num_rows,
    round(avg(session_start_flag), 2) as avg_session_start_flag,
    approx_percentile(is_flagged_flag, 0.5) as is_flagged_flag_p50,
    round(sum(is_flagged_flag) / nullif(count(case when txn_type = 'DEBIT' then 1 end), 0), 2) as is_flagged_flag_per_debit,
    min(session_start_flag) as min_session_start_flag
from sessions_transactions
group by case when island_id >= 8 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end, date_trunc('quarter', txn_time), case when amount >= 4200 then 'LARGE' else 'SMALL' end
order by avg_is_flagged_flag;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("txn_type").orderBy("txn_time", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_transactions
    .filter((F.col("txn_time") > F.to_date(F.lit("2023-08-07"))) & F.col("merchant").isNotNull())
    .withColumn("is_flagged_flag", F.col("is_flagged").cast("int"))
    .withColumn("resolved_merchant", F.coalesce("merchant", F.lit("NONE")))
)

with_gaps = (
    base
    .withColumn("session_start_flag", F.when(F.lag("txn_time").over(w).isNull() | (F.col("txn_time") > F.lag("txn_time").over(w) + F.expr("INTERVAL 7 DAYS")), 1).otherwise(0))
)

sessions_transactions = with_gaps.withColumn("island_id", F.sum("session_start_flag").over(w2))

result = (
    sessions_transactions
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("island_id") >= 8, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("island_id_tier"),
        F.date_trunc("quarter", "txn_time").alias("quarter_start"),
        F.when(F.col("amount") >= 4200, "LARGE").otherwise("SMALL").alias("amount_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("is_flagged_flag"), 2).alias("avg_is_flagged_flag"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
        F.round(F.avg("session_start_flag"), 2).alias("avg_session_start_flag"),
        F.percentile_approx("is_flagged_flag", 0.5).alias("is_flagged_flag_p50"),
        F.round(F.sum("is_flagged_flag") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "DEBIT", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("is_flagged_flag_per_debit"),
        F.min("session_start_flag").alias("min_session_start_flag"),
    )
    .orderBy("avg_is_flagged_flag")
)
```

with base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        sale_date,
        units,
        revenue,
        revenue * units as revenue_per_unit
    from store_sales
    where sale_date >= date '2023-05-07'
      and revenue < 1600
),
base_store_sales as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        product_id,
        revenue,
        revenue_per_unit,
        revenue_per_unit * units as revenue_per_unit_times_units
    from base
    where sale_date >= date '2023-03-20'
      and revenue_per_unit between 46 and 75
),
latest as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select *
    from (
        select *, row_number() over (partition by store_id order by revenue desc nulls last, id) as latest_rank
        from base_store_sales
    ) t
    where latest_rank = 1
),
with_windows as (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    select
        id,
        store_id,
        revenue,
        revenue_per_unit,
        revenue_per_unit_times_units,
        latest_rank,
        lead(revenue) over (partition by store_id, product_id order by revenue, id) as next_revenue,
        lag(revenue_per_unit_times_units) over (partition by store_id, product_id order by revenue, id) as prev_revenue_per_unit_times_units,
        lead(revenue_per_unit_times_units) over (partition by store_id, product_id order by revenue, id) as next_revenue_per_unit_times_units,
        row_number() over (partition by store_id, product_id order by revenue, id) as event_seq
    from latest
    where product_id = 4
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    select store_id, id
    from with_windows
    intersect all
    select store_id, id
    from store_sales
    where revenue is not null
),
reconciled as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from with_windows s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.store_id = k.store_id and s.id = k.id
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    store_id,
    case when next_revenue >= 3500 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end as next_revenue_tier,
    approx_percentile(next_revenue_per_unit_times_units, 0.5) as next_revenue_per_unit_times_units_p50,
    count(distinct id) as distinct_ids,
    percentile_approx(revenue_per_unit, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as revenue_per_unit_quartiles
from reconciled
group by rollup (store_id, case when next_revenue >= 3500 then 'HIGH' else 'LOW' end)
order by store_id
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("store_id").orderBy(F.col("revenue").desc_nulls_last(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("store_id", "product_id").orderBy("revenue", "id")

base = (
    df_store_sales
    .filter((F.col("sale_date") >= F.lit("2023-05-07").cast("date")) & (F.col("revenue") < 1600))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "sale_date",
        "units",
        "revenue",
        (F.col("revenue") * F.col("units")).alias("revenue_per_unit"),
    )
)

base_store_sales = (
    base
    .filter((F.col("sale_date") >= F.lit("2023-03-20").cast("date")) & F.col("revenue_per_unit").between(46, 75))
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "product_id",
        "revenue",
        "revenue_per_unit",
        (F.col("revenue_per_unit") * F.col("units")).alias("revenue_per_unit_times_units"),
    )
)

latest = (
    base_store_sales
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
)

with_windows = (
    latest
    .filter(F.col("product_id") == 4)
    .select(
        "id",
        "store_id",
        "revenue",
        "revenue_per_unit",
        "revenue_per_unit_times_units",
        "latest_rank",
        F.lead("revenue").over(w2).alias("next_revenue"),
        F.lag("revenue_per_unit_times_units").over(w2).alias("prev_revenue_per_unit_times_units"),
        F.lead("revenue_per_unit_times_units").over(w2).alias("next_revenue_per_unit_times_units"),
        F.row_number().over(w2).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    with_windows
    .select("store_id", "id")
    .intersectAll(
        df_store_sales
        .filter(F.col("revenue").isNotNull())
        .select("store_id", "id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    with_windows
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")) & (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .rollup(
        "store_id",
        F.when(F.col("next_revenue") >= 3500, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("next_revenue_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("next_revenue_per_unit_times_units", 0.5).alias("next_revenue_per_unit_times_units_p50"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
        F.percentile_approx("revenue_per_unit", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("revenue_per_unit_quartiles"),
    )
    .orderBy("store_id")
)
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

lines = (
    df_app_logs
    .select("id", "service", "level", F.explode_outer("context").alias("key", "value"))
)

valid = (
    lines
    .filter(~F.col("key").eqNullSafe(F.lit("version")))
    .withColumn("clean_key", F.trim("key"))
)

matched_keys = (
    valid
    .select("level", "service")
    .subtract(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("level") == "DEBUG")
        .select("level", "service")
    )
)

kept_rows = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.level") == F.col("k.level")) & (F.col("s.service") == F.col("k.service")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

cleaned = (
    kept_rows
    .filter(F.col("level") == "DEBUG")
    .select(
        "*",
        F.substring("key", 1, 2).alias("key_prefix"),
        F.upper("key").alias("key_upper"),
        F.coalesce("key", F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("key_filled"),
    )
)

matched_keys_2 = (
    cleaned
    .select("level")
    .intersect(
        df_app_logs
        .filter(F.col("host") == "h1")
        .select("level")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    cleaned
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys_2.alias("k"), (F.col("s.level") == F.col("k.level")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

result = (
    reconciled
    .select(
        "id",
        "service",
        "key",
        "clean_key",
        "key_prefix",
        "key_upper",
        "key_filled",
    )
)
```

sql:
WITH exploded AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        currency,
        EXPLODE_OUTER(tier_prices) AS val
    FROM price_tiers
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        plan,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) AS val_dense_rank,
        MAX(val) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_max_val
    FROM exploded
    WHERE currency IN ('EUR', 'THB')
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY plan_max_val DESC) AS plan_max_val_dense_rank,
        SUM(plan_max_val) OVER (PARTITION BY plan) AS plan_sum_plan_max_val,
        RANK() OVER w_recent AS plan_max_val_rank
    FROM with_windows
    WINDOW w_recent AS (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY plan_max_val DESC NULLS LAST)
),
scored_price_tiers AS (
    SELECT
        plan,
        val_dense_rank,
        plan_sum_plan_max_val,
        plan_max_val_rank,
        ROUND(plan_max_val_rank / SUM(plan_max_val_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY plan), 4) AS plan_max_val_rank_share,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY plan_max_val_rank) AS plan_max_val_rank_rank,
        ROUND(val_dense_rank / SUM(val_dense_rank) OVER (PARTITION BY plan), 4) AS val_dense_rank_share,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY plan_max_val_rank) AS plan_max_val_rank_dense_rank
    FROM scored
)
SELECT
    plan,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(plan_max_val_rank_rank, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS plan_max_val_rank_rank_quartiles,
    COUNT(*) AS row_count,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN plan = 'pro' THEN 1 END) AS pro_count,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(plan_max_val_rank_rank, 0.95) AS plan_max_val_rank_rank_p95
FROM scored_price_tiers
GROUP BY CUBE (plan)
ORDER BY row_count DESC
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.orderBy(F.col("val").desc())
w2 = Window.partitionBy("plan")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("plan_max_val").desc())
w_recent = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy(F.col("plan_max_val").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.orderBy("plan_max_val_rank")
w6 = Window.partitionBy("plan").orderBy("plan_max_val_rank")

exploded = (
    df_price_tiers
    .select("id", "plan", "currency", F.explode_outer("tier_prices").alias("val"))
)

with_windows = (
    exploded
    .filter(F.col("currency").isin(["EUR", "THB"]))
    .select(
        "id",
        "plan",
        F.dense_rank().over(w).alias("val_dense_rank"),
        F.max("val").over(w2).alias("plan_max_val"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "*",
        F.dense_rank().over(w3).alias("plan_max_val_dense_rank"),
        F.sum("plan_max_val").over(w2).alias("plan_sum_plan_max_val"),
        F.rank().over(w_recent).alias("plan_max_val_rank"),
    )
)

scored_price_tiers = (
    scored
    .select(
        "plan",
        "val_dense_rank",
        "plan_sum_plan_max_val",
        "plan_max_val_rank",
        F.round((F.col("plan_max_val_rank") / F.sum("plan_max_val_rank").over(w2)), 4).alias("plan_max_val_rank_share"),
        F.rank().over(w5).alias("plan_max_val_rank_rank"),
        F.round((F.col("val_dense_rank") / F.sum("val_dense_rank").over(w2)), 4).alias("val_dense_rank_share"),
        F.dense_rank().over(w6).alias("plan_max_val_rank_dense_rank"),
    )
)

result = (
    scored_price_tiers
    .cube("plan")
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("plan_max_val_rank_rank", [0.25, 0.5, 0.75]).alias("plan_max_val_rank_rank_quartiles"),
        F.count("*").alias("row_count"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("plan") == "pro", 1)).alias("pro_count"),
        F.percentile_approx("plan_max_val_rank_rank", 0.95).alias("plan_max_val_rank_rank_p95"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("row_count").desc())
)
```

sql:
WITH valid AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        status,
        ROUND(cost, 2) AS cost_rounded,
        CONCAT(carrier, ' ', status) AS carrier_status
    FROM shipments
    WHERE delivered_date >= TO_DATE('2023-06-01')
      AND shipped_date <= '2024-12-30'
),
matched_keys AS (
    SELECT carrier
    FROM valid
    EXCEPT ALL
    SELECT carrier
    FROM shipments
    WHERE order_id IS NULL
),
verified AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM valid s
    JOIN matched_keys k ON s.carrier = k.carrier
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        UPPER(carrier) AS carrier_upper,
        CASE WHEN cost_rounded >= 89 THEN 'High' WHEN cost_rounded >= 15 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS cost_rounded_level,
        COALESCE(carrier, 'N/A') AS carrier_filled
    FROM verified
    WHERE delivered_date >= DATE '2023-06-03'
      AND shipped_date >= '2023-07-19'
),
remaining_keys AS (
    SELECT status, carrier
    FROM filtered
    EXCEPT
    SELECT status, carrier
    FROM shipments
    WHERE cost BETWEEN 56 AND 65
),
reconciled AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM filtered s
    JOIN remaining_keys k ON s.status = k.status AND s.carrier = k.carrier
),
with_windows AS (
    SELECT *, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY carrier ORDER BY cost_rounded) AS cost_rounded_cume_dist
    FROM reconciled
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        delivered_date,
        cost_rounded,
        carrier_status,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cost_rounded NULLS LAST) AS cost_rounded_rank
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE shipped_date <= '2025-07-01'
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        CASE WHEN cost_rounded >= 66 THEN 'High' WHEN cost_rounded >= 10 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS cost_rounded_level,
        DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), delivered_date) / 365 AS years_since_delivered_date
    FROM scored
    WHERE delivered_date > DATE '2023-08-16'
      AND cost_rounded_rank > 3
)
SELECT
    cost_rounded,
    carrier_status,
    cost_rounded_rank
FROM base
ORDER BY cost_rounded_rank DESC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("carrier").orderBy("cost_rounded")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("cost_rounded").asc_nulls_last())

valid = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-06-01"))) & (F.col("shipped_date") <= "2024-12-30"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "status",
        F.round("cost", 2).alias("cost_rounded"),
        F.concat("carrier", F.lit(" "), "status").alias("carrier_status"),
    )
)

matched_keys = (
    valid
    .select("carrier")
    .exceptAll(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("order_id").isNull())
        .select("carrier")
    )
)

verified = (
    valid
    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.carrier") == F.col("k.carrier")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

filtered = (
    verified
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") >= F.lit("2023-06-03").cast("date")) & (F.col("shipped_date") >= "2023-07-19"))
    .withColumn("carrier_upper", F.upper("carrier"))
    .withColumn("cost_rounded_level", F.when(F.col("cost_rounded") >= 89, "High").when(F.col("cost_rounded") >= 15, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("carrier_filled", F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("N/A")))
)

remaining_keys = (
    filtered
    .select("status", "carrier")
    .subtract(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("cost").between(56, 65))
        .select("status", "carrier")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    filtered
    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.status") == F.col("k.status")) & (F.col("s.carrier") == F.col("k.carrier")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

with_windows = reconciled.select("*", F.cume_dist().over(w).alias("cost_rounded_cume_dist"))

scored = (
    with_windows
    .filter(F.col("shipped_date") <= "2025-07-01")
    .select(
        "delivered_date",
        "cost_rounded",
        "carrier_status",
        F.rank().over(w2).alias("cost_rounded_rank"),
    )
)

base = (
    scored
    .filter((F.col("delivered_date") > F.lit("2023-08-16").cast("date")) & (F.col("cost_rounded_rank") > 3))
    .withColumn("cost_rounded_level", F.when(F.col("cost_rounded") >= 66, "High").when(F.col("cost_rounded") >= 10, "Medium").otherwise("Low"))
    .withColumn("years_since_delivered_date", (F.datediff(F.current_date(), "delivered_date") / 365))
)

result = (
    base
    .select("cost_rounded", "carrier_status", "cost_rounded_rank")
    .orderBy(F.col("cost_rounded_rank").desc())
)
```

sql:
WITH cleaned AS (
    SELECT *, ROUND(quantity * 0.85, 2) AS quantity_scaled
    FROM order_items
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
      AND order_id = 31
),
enriched AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        quantity,
        unit_price,
        LAG(quantity_scaled) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC) AS prev_quantity_scaled,
        LEAD(quantity_scaled) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC) AS next_quantity_scaled,
        LAG(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC) AS prev_quantity,
        LEAD(quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC) AS next_quantity,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY quantity ASC, id ASC) AS event_seq
    FROM cleaned
),
cleaned_order_items AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        quantity,
        prev_quantity_scaled,
        next_quantity_scaled,
        prev_quantity,
        next_quantity,
        event_seq,
        LEAST(prev_quantity_scaled, quantity) AS least_prev_quantity_scaled_quantity
    FROM enriched
    WHERE prev_quantity_scaled < 42
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        quantity,
        prev_quantity_scaled,
        prev_quantity,
        next_quantity,
        SUM(quantity) OVER (ORDER BY event_seq ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_quantity,
        MAX(quantity) OVER (ORDER BY event_seq ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_max_quantity,
        AVG(quantity) OVER (ORDER BY event_seq ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_quantity,
        COUNT(quantity) OVER (ORDER BY event_seq ASC, id ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_quantity
    FROM cleaned_order_items
)
SELECT
    CASE WHEN running_max_quantity >= 8.6 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS running_max_quantity_tier,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(quantity, 0.5) AS quantity_p50,
    APPROX_PERCENTILE(prev_quantity_scaled, 0.95) AS prev_quantity_scaled_p95,
    COUNT(*) AS num_rows
FROM metrics
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY quantity_p50 DESC NULLS FIRST;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy("quantity", "id")
w2 = Window.orderBy("event_seq", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

cleaned = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("order_id") == 31))
    .withColumn("quantity_scaled", F.round((F.col("quantity") * 0.85), 2))
)

enriched = (
    cleaned
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity",
        "unit_price",
        F.lag("quantity_scaled").over(w).alias("prev_quantity_scaled"),
        F.lead("quantity_scaled").over(w).alias("next_quantity_scaled"),
        F.lag("quantity").over(w).alias("prev_quantity"),
        F.lead("quantity").over(w).alias("next_quantity"),
        F.row_number().over(w).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

cleaned_order_items = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("prev_quantity_scaled") < 42)
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity",
        "prev_quantity_scaled",
        "next_quantity_scaled",
        "prev_quantity",
        "next_quantity",
        "event_seq",
        F.least("prev_quantity_scaled", "quantity").alias("least_prev_quantity_scaled_quantity"),
    )
)

metrics = (
    cleaned_order_items
    .select(
        "id",
        "quantity",
        "prev_quantity_scaled",
        "prev_quantity",
        "next_quantity",
        F.sum("quantity").over(w2).alias("running_sum_quantity"),
        F.max("quantity").over(w2).alias("running_max_quantity"),
        F.avg("quantity").over(w2).alias("running_avg_quantity"),
        F.count("quantity").over(w2).alias("running_count_quantity"),
    )
)

result = (
    metrics
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("running_max_quantity") >= 8.6, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("running_max_quantity_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.percentile_approx("quantity", 0.5).alias("quantity_p50"),
        F.percentile_approx("prev_quantity_scaled", 0.95).alias("prev_quantity_scaled_p95"),
        F.count("*").alias("num_rows"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("quantity_p50").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

WITH with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event time per key
    SELECT *, LAG(reading_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id) AS prev_reading_ts
    FROM device_readings
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_reading_ts IS NULL OR reading_ts > prev_reading_ts + INTERVAL '30' MINUTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM with_prev
)
-- Running sum of the flag = session number
SELECT *, SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY device_code ORDER BY reading_ts, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS island_id
FROM gaps

WITH flattened AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        EXPLODE(coupon_codes) AS code
    FROM carts
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN code IN ('WELCOME5', 'BUNDLE') THEN 'Group A' ELSE 'Other' END AS code_group
    FROM flattened
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'SPRING10'
),
base AS (
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN code = 'VIP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_vip
    FROM filtered
    WHERE code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'SPRING10'
),
filtered_carts AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROUND(is_vip * 0.85, 2) AS adjusted_is_vip,
        COALESCE(is_vip, 0) AS is_vip_filled
    FROM base
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        code,
        COUNT_IF(code = 'VIP') AS vip_events,
        SIZE(COLLECT_SET(code)) AS num_codes,
        ROUND(SUM(adjusted_is_vip) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN code = 'VIP' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS adjusted_is_vip_per_vip
    FROM filtered_carts
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    s.code,
    s.vip_events,
    s.num_codes,
    CASE WHEN code RLIKE '^(SPRING10|VIP)$' THEN 'EXTENDED' WHEN code RLIKE '^(BUNDLE|WELCOME5)$' THEN 'CORE' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS code_zone,
    (SELECT MAX(t2.amount) FROM orders t2 WHERE t2.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS max_order_amount
FROM grouped s
ORDER BY customer_id DESC NULLS FIRST, vip_events DESC;
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

amount_by_customer_id = df_orders.groupBy("customer_id").agg(F.max("amount").alias("max_order_amount"))

flattened = df_carts.select("id", "customer_id", F.explode("coupon_codes").alias("code"))

filtered = (
    flattened
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull() & (F.col("code").eqNullSafe(F.lit("SPRING10"))))
    .select(
        "*",
        F.when(F.col("code").isin(["WELCOME5", "BUNDLE"]), "Group A").otherwise("Other").alias("code_group"),
    )
)

base = (
    filtered
    .filter(F.col("code").eqNullSafe(F.lit("SPRING10")))
    .withColumn("is_vip", F.when(F.col("code") == "VIP", 1).otherwise(0))
)

filtered_carts = (
    base
    .filter(F.col("customer_id").isNotNull())
    .select(
        "*",
        F.round((F.col("is_vip") * 0.85), 2).alias("adjusted_is_vip"),
        F.coalesce("is_vip", F.lit(0)).alias("is_vip_filled"),
    )
)

grouped = (
    filtered_carts
    .groupBy("customer_id", "code")
    .agg(
        F.count_if(F.col("code") == "VIP").alias("vip_events"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("code")).alias("num_codes"),
        F.round(F.sum("adjusted_is_vip") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("code") == "VIP", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("adjusted_is_vip_per_vip"),
    )
)

result = (
    grouped
    .join(amount_by_customer_id, on="customer_id", how="left")
    .select(
        "customer_id",
        "code",
        "vip_events",
        "num_codes",
        F.when(F.col("code").rlike("^(SPRING10|VIP)$"), "EXTENDED").when(F.col("code").rlike("^(BUNDLE|WELCOME5)$"), "CORE").otherwise("GROUP_A").alias("code_zone"),
        F.col("max_order_amount"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("customer_id").desc_nulls_first(), F.col("vip_events").desc())
)
```

with cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        order_id,
        carrier,
        shipped_date,
        delivered_date,
        status,
        datediff(current_date(), shipped_date) as days_since_shipped_date,
        coalesce(carrier, 'DIRECT') as carrier_filled
    from shipments
    where carrier is not distinct from 'FedEx'
      and shipped_date >= to_date('2023-02-11')
),
latest as (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    select *, row_number() over (partition by status order by delivered_date desc, id) as dedup_rank
    from cleaned
    qualify dedup_rank = 1
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select order_id
    from latest
    except all
    select order_id
    from shipments
    where shipped_date >= '2025-05-01'
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from latest s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.order_id = k.order_id
),
base as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        datediff(current_date(), shipped_date) as days_since_shipped_date_2,
        case when status = 'LOST' then 1 else 0 end as is_lost
    from verified
    where shipped_date >= date '2023-04-06'
      and carrier is not null
),
joined as (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    select
        src.*,
        p.amount,
        p.status as order_status
    from base src
    left join orders p
        on src.order_id = p.id
),
metrics as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        order_id,
        shipped_date,
        carrier_filled,
        days_since_shipped_date_2,
        is_lost,
        amount,
        round(amount / sum(amount) over (partition by carrier), 4) as amount_share,
        dense_rank() over (order by is_lost desc nulls first) as is_lost_dense_rank,
        cume_dist() over (partition by order_id order by days_since_shipped_date) as days_since_shipped_date_cume_dist,
        count(is_lost) over (partition by month(shipped_date), order_id) as shipped_date_month_count_is_lost,
        percent_rank() over (partition by date_trunc('month', shipped_date), order_id order by is_lost desc) as is_lost_percent_rank
    from joined
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
select
    order_id,
    percentile_approx(amount_share, 0.9) as amount_share_p90,
    count(*) as num_rows,
    percentile_approx(is_lost_percent_rank, array(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) as is_lost_percent_rank_quartiles
from metrics
group by 1
order by num_rows desc
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("status").orderBy(F.col("delivered_date").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy("carrier")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("is_lost").desc_nulls_first())
w4 = Window.partitionBy("order_id").orderBy("days_since_shipped_date")
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.month("shipped_date"), "order_id")
w6 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("month", "shipped_date"), "order_id").orderBy(F.col("is_lost").desc())

cleaned = (
    df_shipments
    .filter((F.col("carrier").eqNullSafe(F.lit("FedEx"))) & (F.col("shipped_date") >= F.to_date(F.lit("2023-02-11"))))
    .select(
        "id",
        "order_id",
        "carrier",
        "shipped_date",
        "delivered_date",
        "status",
        F.datediff(F.current_date(), "shipped_date").alias("days_since_shipped_date"),
        F.coalesce("carrier", F.lit("DIRECT")).alias("carrier_filled"),
    )
)

latest = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)
)

remaining_keys = (
    latest
    .select("order_id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_shipments
        .filter(F.col("shipped_date") >= "2025-05-01")
        .select("order_id")
    )
)

verified = (
    latest
    .alias("s")
```

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        *,
        CAST(is_flagged AS INT) AS is_flagged_flag,
        IF(is_flagged, 'Yes', 'No') AS is_flagged_label
    FROM transactions
    WHERE txn_time > TIMESTAMP '2023-04-17 07:00:00'
      AND merchant IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'Shell'
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach accounts attributes
    SELECT
        src.id,
        src.account_id,
        src.txn_type,
        src.amount,
        src.txn_time,
        src.merchant,
        src.is_flagged_flag,
        src.is_flagged_label,
        p.status,
        p.opened_date
    FROM base src
    LEFT JOIN accounts p
        ON src.account_id = p.id
    WHERE p.customer_id IN (3, 15, 38)
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY is_flagged_flag DESC, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM joined
    ) ranked
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        SUM(is_flagged_flag) OVER w_running AS running_sum_is_flagged_flag,
        COUNT(is_flagged_flag) OVER w_running AS running_count_is_flagged_flag,
        MAX(is_flagged_flag) OVER w_running AS running_max_is_flagged_flag,
        AVG(is_flagged_flag) OVER w_running AS running_avg_is_flagged_flag
    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_running AS (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY rank_in_group, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
-- Aggregate with conditional metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN running_count_is_flagged_flag >= 16 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS running_count_is_flagged_flag_tier,
    MIN(txn_time) AS started_at,
    PERCENTILE_APPROX(running_max_is_flagged_flag, 0.95) AS running_max_is_flagged_flag_p95,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'DEBIT' THEN 1 END) AS debit_count,
    MIN(txn_time) AS started_at_2,
    MAX(txn_time) AS last_seen
FROM enriched
GROUP BY 1
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy(F.col("is_flagged_flag").desc(), "id")
w_running = Window.partitionBy("account_id").orderBy("rank_in_group", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)

base = (
    df_transactions
    .filter((F.col("txn_time") > F.lit("2023-04-17 07:00:00").cast("timestamp")) & (F.col("merchant").eqNullSafe(F.lit("Shell"))))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_flag", F.col("is_flagged").cast("int"))
    .withColumn("is_flagged_label", F.when(F.col("is_flagged"), "Yes").otherwise("No"))
)

joined = (
    base
    .alias("src")
    .join(df_accounts.alias("p"), F.col("src.account_id") == F.col("p.id"), "left")
    .filter(F.col("p.customer_id").isin([3, 15, 38]))
    .select(
        "src.id",
        "src.account_id",
        "src.txn_type",
        "src.amount",
        "src.txn_time",
        "src.merchant",
        "src.is_flagged_flag",
        "src.is_flagged_label",
        F.col("p.status"),
        F.col("p.opened_date"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    joined
    .withColumn("rank_in_group", F.row_number().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("rank_in_group") == 1)
)

enriched = (
    deduped
    .select(
        "*",
        F.sum("is_flagged_flag").over(w_running).alias("running_sum_is_flagged_flag"),
        F.count("is_flagged_flag").over(w_running).alias("running_count_is_flagged_flag"),
        F.max("is_flagged_flag").over(w_running).alias("running_max_is_flagged_flag"),
        F.avg("is_flagged_flag").over(w_running).alias("running_avg_is_flagged_flag"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("running_count_is_flagged_flag") >= 16, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("running_count_is_flagged_flag_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.min("txn_time").alias("started_at"),
        F.percentile_approx("running_max_is_flagged_flag", 0.95).alias("running_max_is_flagged_flag_p95"),
        F.count(F.when(F.col("txn_type") == "DEBIT", 1)).alias("debit_count"),
        F.min("txn_time").alias("started_at_2"),
        F.max("txn_time").alias("last_seen"),
    )
)
```

WITH latest AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY last_restock DESC NULLS LAST) AS dedup_rank
    FROM inventory
    QUALIFY dedup_rank = 1
),
joined AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        a.id,
        a.store_id,
        a.product_id,
        a.quantity,
        a.last_restock,
        a.dedup_rank,
        s.region
    FROM latest a
    INNER JOIN stores s
        ON a.store_id = s.id
    WHERE s.opened_date <= '2024-08-01'
),
matched_keys AS (
    -- Set difference on keys
    SELECT id, store_id
    FROM joined
    EXCEPT DISTINCT
    SELECT id, store_id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE last_restock <= '2024-11-01'
),
verified AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM joined s
    INNER JOIN matched_keys k ON s.id = k.id AND s.store_id = k.store_id
),
enriched AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        store_id,
        quantity,
        last_restock,
        dedup_rank,
        region,
        CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(last_restock) ORDER BY quantity DESC) quantity_cume_dist
    FROM verified
),
joined_inventory AS (
    -- Attach stores attributes
    SELECT
        a.store_id,
        a.region,
        p.city,
        p.region AS store_region,
        p.opened_date
    FROM enriched a
    INNER JOIN stores p
        ON a.store_id = p.id
),
valid AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT
        *,
        CONCAT_WS('-', region, store_region) region_store_region_key,
        COALESCE(region, 'unassigned') region_filled
    FROM joined_inventory
    WHERE region IS NOT NULL
),
totals AS (
    -- Grouped metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', opened_date) AS quarter_start,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN city = 'New York' THEN 1 END) AS new_york_count,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE region = 'West') AS west_rows,
        COUNT(DISTINCT city) AS distinct_cities,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN region = 'North' THEN 1 END) AS north_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN store_region = 'South' THEN 1 END) AS south_count
    FROM valid
    GROUP BY quarter_start
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE region = 'West') > 1
)
SELECT
    quarter_start,
    west_rows,
    south_count
FROM totals
ORDER BY quarter_start DESC NULLS FIRST

```python
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("product_id").orderBy(F.col("last_restock").desc_nulls_last())

latest = (
    df_inventory
    .withColumn("dedup_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("dedup_rank") == 1)

joined = (

    .alias("a")
    .join(df_stores.alias("s"), F.col("a.store_id") == F.col("s.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.opened_date") <= "2024-08-01")

        .filter(F.col("last_restock") <= "2024-11-01")

verified = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(matched_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")) & (F.col("s.store_id") == F.col("k.store_id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")

enriched = (
    verified
    .select(
        "store_id",
        "quantity",
        "last_restock",
        "dedup_rank",

    .alias("a")

valid = (

totals = (
    valid
    .groupBy(F.date_trunc("QUARTER", "opened_date").alias("quarter_start"))
```

WITH base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, UPPER(status) AS status_upper
    FROM payments
    WHERE paid_at > TIMESTAMP '2023-09-11 10:00:00'
      AND method IS NOT NULL
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        status,
        status_upper
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, method ORDER BY amount NULLS FIRST, id) AS rank_in_group
        FROM base
    ) x
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach orders attributes
    SELECT src.*, p.amount AS order_amount
    FROM deduped src
    LEFT JOIN orders p
        ON src.order_id <=> p.id
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        order_id,
        amount,
        order_amount,
        AVG(amount) OVER (ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS amount_avg_5,
        SUM(order_amount) OVER (ORDER BY amount, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_order_amount,
        AVG(order_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY order_id, status ORDER BY order_amount, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS order_amount_avg_6
    FROM enriched
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    SELECT *, amount + amount_avg_5 AS amount_plus_amount_avg_5
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE order_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    id,
    amount,
    order_amount,
    amount_avg_5,
    order_amount_avg_6,
    amount_plus_amount_avg_5
FROM cleaned
ORDER BY order_amount_avg_6 DESC

```python
)
```

WITH with_dims AS (
    -- Attach sessions attributes
    SELECT e.*, d.browser
    FROM web_events e
    INNER JOIN sessions d
        ON e.session_id = d.id
    WHERE d.customer_id IN (16, 23, 25, 35)
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        NTILE(5) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(event_time), page ORDER BY duration_sec DESC, id) AS duration_sec_bucket,
        LEAD(duration_sec, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', event_time), event_type ORDER BY event_time, id) AS next_duration_sec,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY duration_sec DESC, id) AS event_seq
    FROM with_dims
),
scored AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        duration_sec,
        browser,
        next_duration_sec,
        event_seq,
        SUM(duration_sec_bucket) OVER (PARTITION BY page, session_id ORDER BY duration_sec_bucket, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_duration_sec_bucket,
        MAX(event_seq) OVER (PARTITION BY session_id ORDER BY CAST(event_time AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 604800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS event_seq_max_7d
    FROM with_windows
),
deduped AS (
    -- Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY browser ORDER BY duration_sec NULLS LAST, id) AS row_num
        FROM scored
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
)
-- Multi-level aggregation
SELECT
    CASE WHEN event_seq >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END AS event_seq_tier,
    ROUND(SUM(running_duration_sec_bucket) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN browser = 'Chrome' THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS running_duration_sec_bucket_per_chrome,
    COUNT_IF(browser = 'Safari') AS safari_events,
    COUNT_IF(browser = 'Edge') AS edge_events,
    SIZE(COLLECT_SET(browser)) AS num_browsers
FROM deduped
GROUP BY CASE WHEN event_seq >= 8 THEN 'PREMIUM' ELSE 'STANDARD' END
ORDER BY safari_events DESC NULLS FIRST
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("event_time"), "page").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc(), "id")
w2 = Window.partitionBy(F.date_trunc("WEEK", "event_time"), "event_type").orderBy("event_time", "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").desc(), "id")
w4 = Window.partitionBy("page", "session_id").orderBy("duration_sec_bucket", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)
w5 = Window.partitionBy("session_id").orderBy(F.col("event_time").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-604800, Window.currentRow)
w6 = Window.partitionBy("browser").orderBy(F.col("duration_sec").asc_nulls_last(), "id")

with_dims = (
    df_web_events
    .alias("e")
    .join(df_sessions.alias("d"), F.col("e.session_id") == F.col("d.id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("d.customer_id").isin([16, 23, 25, 35]))
    .select("e.*", F.col("d.browser"))
)

with_windows = (
    with_dims
    .select(
        "*",
        F.ntile(5).over(w).alias("duration_sec_bucket"),
        F.lead("duration_sec", 1).over(w2).alias("next_duration_sec"),
        F.row_number().over(w3).alias("event_seq"),
    )
)

scored = (
    with_windows
    .select(
        "id",
        "duration_sec",
        "browser",
        "next_duration_sec",
        "event_seq",
        F.sum("duration_sec_bucket").over(w4).alias("running_duration_sec_bucket"),
        F.max("event_seq").over(w5).alias("event_seq_max_7d"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    scored
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(w6))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
)

result = (
    deduped
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("event_seq") >= 8, "PREMIUM").otherwise("STANDARD").alias("event_seq_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.sum("running_duration_sec_bucket") / F.nullif(F.count(F.when(F.col("browser") == "Chrome", 1)), F.lit(0)), 2).alias("running_duration_sec_bucket_per_chrome"),
        F.count_if(F.col("browser") == "Safari").alias("safari_events"),
        F.count_if(F.col("browser") == "Edge").alias("edge_events"),
        F.size(F.collect_set("browser")).alias("num_browsers"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("safari_events").desc_nulls_first())
)
```

WITH cleaned AS (

    SELECT
        id,
        humidity,
        status_bits,
        firmware,
        LOWER(firmware) AS firmware_lower,
        INITCAP(TRIM(device_code)) AS device_code_title
    FROM device_readings
    WHERE reading_ts >= DATE '2025-09-01'
      AND pressure <= 1000
),
valid AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT *, LENGTH(firmware) AS firmware_length
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE firmware IN ('1.0.3', '1.1.0', '2.0.1')
),
enriched AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        humidity,
        status_bits,
        device_code_title,
        MAX(humidity) OVER w_running AS last7_max_humidity,
        AVG(humidity) OVER w_running AS last7_avg_humidity,
        SUM(humidity) OVER w_running AS last7_sum_humidity,
        MIN(humidity) OVER w_running AS last7_min_humidity
    FROM valid
    WHERE firmware = '1.0.3'
    WINDOW w_running AS (ORDER BY humidity, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, ROUND(last7_max_humidity, 2) AS last7_max_humidity_rounded
    FROM enriched
    WHERE last7_max_humidity >= 59
),
daily AS (
    -- Multi-level aggregation
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN last7_min_humidity >= 66 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS last7_min_humidity_tier,
        CASE WHEN last7_max_humidity >= 82 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END AS last7_max_humidity_tier,
        PERCENTILE_APPROX(last7_min_humidity, ARRAY(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)) AS last7_min_humidity_quartiles,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        SUM(status_bits) AS total_status_bits,
        BIT_AND(status_bits) AS status_bits_bit_and
    FROM base
    GROUP BY CUBE (CASE WHEN last7_min_humidity >= 66 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END, CASE WHEN last7_max_humidity >= 82 THEN 'LARGE' ELSE 'SMALL' END)
)
SELECT
    last7_min_humidity_tier,
    last7_max_humidity_tier,
    last7_min_humidity_quartiles,
    event_count,
    total_status_bits,
    status_bits_bit_and
FROM daily
ORDER BY total_status_bits DESC;

sql:
WITH flattened AS (
    -- Unnest the array into one row per element
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        created_at,
        coupon_codes,
        attr_key,
        attr_value
    FROM carts
    LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(attributes) li AS attr_key, attr_value
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, attr_key ORDER BY created_at, id, attr_key) AS event_seq,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_at DESC, id, attr_key) AS seq_no,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY created_at, id, attr_key) AS seq_no_2
    FROM flattened
),
base AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT
        id,
        created_at,
        attr_key,
        attr_value,
        seq_no_2,
        CEIL(seq_no) AS seq_no_whole,
        COALESCE(attr_key, 'NONE') AS attr_key_clean
    FROM enriched
    WHERE seq_no BETWEEN 5 AND 6
),
kept_keys AS (
    -- Set intersection on keys
    SELECT id
    FROM base
    INTERSECT
    SELECT id
    FROM carts
    WHERE created_at >= '2024-02-24'
),
reconciled AS (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    SELECT s.*
    FROM base s
    INNER JOIN kept_keys k ON s.id = k.id
),
enriched_carts AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        *,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER w_grp AS seq_no_whole_percent_rank,
        MAX(seq_no_whole) OVER (PARTITION BY TO_DATE(created_at), attr_key ORDER BY CAST(created_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 900 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seq_no_whole_max_15m,
        COUNT(seq_no_2) OVER w_running AS seq_no_2_count_1h,
        AVG(seq_no_whole) OVER (ORDER BY CAST(created_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 1800 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS seq_no_whole_avg_30m
    FROM reconciled
    WINDOW w_grp AS (PARTITION BY attr_key ORDER BY seq_no_whole DESC NULLS LAST), w_running AS (ORDER BY CAST(created_at AS BIGINT) RANGE BETWEEN 3600 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Keep recent, valid rows
    SELECT *, DATE_TRUNC('WEEK', created_at) AS created_at_period
    FROM enriched_carts
    WHERE attr_key IS NOT NULL
      AND created_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01 19:00:00'
),
enriched_carts_2 AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        created_at,
        attr_key_clean,
        seq_no_whole_avg_30m,
        created_at_period,
        ROUND(seq_no_2_count_1h / SUM(seq_no_2_count_1h) OVER (PARTITION BY attr_key), 4) AS seq_no_2_count_1h_share
    FROM cleaned
    WHERE attr_key != 'weight_kg'
)
-- Grouped metrics
SELECT
    CASE WHEN seq_no_whole_avg_30m >= 73 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END AS seq_no_whole_avg_30m_tier,
    ROUND(AVG(seq_no_2_count_1h_share), 2) AS avg_seq_no_2_count_1h_share,
    COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_ids
FROM enriched_carts_2
GROUP BY CASE WHEN seq_no_whole_avg_30m >= 73 THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'LOW' END
HAVING distinct_ids < 1000
ORDER BY avg_seq_no_2_count_1h_share DESC
reference:
```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("customer_id", "attr_key").orderBy("created_at", "id", "attr_key")
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("created_at").desc(), "id", "attr_key")
w3 = Window.orderBy("created_at", "id", "attr_key")
w_grp = Window.partitionBy("attr_key").orderBy(F.col("seq_no_whole").desc_nulls_last())
w5 = Window.partitionBy(F.to_date("created_at"), "attr_key").orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-900, Window.currentRow)
w_running = Window.orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-3600, Window.currentRow)
w7 = Window.orderBy(F.col("created_at").cast("bigint")).rangeBetween(-1800, Window.currentRow)
w8 = Window.partitionBy("attr_key")

flattened = (
    df_carts
    .select(
        "id",
        "customer_id",
        "created_at",
        "coupon_codes",
        F.explode("attributes").alias("attr_key", "attr_value"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    flattened
    .withColumn("event_seq", F.row_number().over(w))
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("seq_no_2", F.row_number().over(w3))
)

base = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("seq_no").between(5, 6))
    .select(
        "id",
        "created_at",
        "attr_key",
        "attr_value",
        "seq_no_2",
        F.ceil("seq_no").alias("seq_no_whole"),
        F.coalesce("attr_key", F.lit("NONE")).alias("attr_key_clean"),
    )
)

kept_keys = (
    base
    .select("id")
    .intersect(
        df_carts
        .filter(F.col("created_at") >= "2024-02-24")
        .select("id")
    )
)

reconciled = (
    base
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)

enriched_carts = (
    reconciled
    .withColumn("seq_no_whole_percent_rank", F.percent_rank().over(w_grp))
    .withColumn("seq_no_whole_max_15m", F.max("seq_no_whole").over(w5))
    .withColumn("seq_no_2_count_1h", F.count("seq_no_2").over(w_running))
    .withColumn("seq_no_whole_avg_30m", F.avg("seq_no_whole").over(w7))
)

cleaned = (
    enriched_carts
    .filter(F.col("attr_key").isNotNull() & (F.col("created_at") > F.lit("2025-03-01 19:00:00").cast("timestamp")))
    .select("*", F.date_trunc("WEEK", "created_at").alias("created_at_period"))
)

enriched_carts_2 = (
    cleaned
    .filter(F.col("attr_key") != "weight_kg")
    .select(
        "id",
        "created_at",
        "attr_key_clean",
        "seq_no_whole_avg_30m",
        "created_at_period",
        F.round((F.col("seq_no_2_count_1h") / F.sum("seq_no_2_count_1h").over(w8)), 4).alias("seq_no_2_count_1h_share"),
    )
)

result = (
    enriched_carts_2
    .groupBy(
        F.when(F.col("seq_no_whole_avg_30m") >= 73, "HIGH").otherwise("LOW").alias("seq_no_whole_avg_30m_tier"),
    )
    .agg(
        F.round(F.avg("seq_no_2_count_1h_share"), 2).alias("avg_seq_no_2_count_1h_share"),
        F.countDistinct("id").alias("distinct_ids"),
    )
    .filter(F.col("distinct_ids") < 1000)
    .orderBy(F.col("avg_seq_no_2_count_1h_share").desc())
)
```

with cleaned as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        *,
        unit_price * quantity as line_total,
        quantity * unit_price as line_total_2
    from order_items
    where product_id = 5
),
deduped as (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    select
        id,
        unit_price,
        line_total
    from (
        select *, rank() over (partition by order_id, product_id order by line_total desc nulls first) as latest_rank
        from cleaned
    ) t
    where latest_rank = 1
),
base as (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    select *, floor(line_total) as line_total_whole
    from deduped
    where unit_price >= 250
),
enriched as (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    select
        *,
        row_number() over (order by unit_price desc, id) as seq_no,
        dense_rank() over (order by unit_price nulls last) as unit_price_dense_rank
    from base
),
filtered as (
    -- Basic cleansing and defaults
    select
        id,
        unit_price,
        line_total,
        line_total_whole,
        seq_no,
        unit_price_dense_rank,
        ceil(line_total_whole) as line_total_whole_whole
    from enriched
    where line_total <= 23
),
remaining_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id
    from filtered
    except all
    select id
    from order_items
    where unit_price >= 350
),
verified as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from filtered s
    inner join remaining_keys k on s.id = k.id
),
kept_keys as (
    -- Set difference on keys
    select id
    from verified
    except
    select id
    from order_items
    where quantity between 5 and 6
),
verified_order_items as (
    -- Keep rows whose keys survive the set operation
    select s.*
    from verified s
    inner join kept_keys k on s.id = k.id
)
select
    line_total,
    line_total_whole,

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

w = Window.partitionBy("order_id", "product_id").orderBy(F.col("line_total").desc_nulls_first())
w2 = Window.orderBy(F.col("unit_price").desc(), "id")
w3 = Window.orderBy(F.col("unit_price").asc_nulls_last())

cleaned = (
    df_order_items
    .filter(F.col("product_id") == 5)
    .select(
        "*",
        (F.col("unit_price") * F.col("quantity")).alias("line_total"),
        (F.col("quantity") * F.col("unit_price")).alias("line_total_2"),
    )
)

deduped = (
    cleaned
    .withColumn("latest_rank", F.rank().over(w))
    .filter(F.col("latest_rank") == 1)
    .select("id", "unit_price", "line_total")
)

base = (
    deduped
    .filter(F.col("unit_price") >= 250)
    .select("*", F.floor("line_total").alias("line_total_whole"))
)

enriched = (
    base
    .withColumn("seq_no", F.row_number().over(w2))
    .withColumn("unit_price_dense_rank", F.dense_rank().over(w3))
)

filtered = (
    enriched
    .filter(F.col("line_total") <= 23)
    .select(

        "unit_price",
        "line_total",
        "line_total_whole",
        "seq_no",
        "unit_price_dense_rank",
        F.ceil("line_total_whole").alias("line_total_whole_whole"),
    )

remaining_keys = (
    filtered
    .select("id")
    .exceptAll(
        df_order_items

)

verified = (

    .alias("s")
    .join(remaining_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")

    .select("id")

    )
)

verified_order_items = (
    verified
    .alias("s")
    .join(kept_keys.alias("k"), (F.col("s.id") == F.col("k.id")), "inner")
    .select("s.*")
)
```
